2nd Shift: M-Th 2:30pm-12:30am

The Machine Operator will be responsible for processing mesh fabric material into semi-finished and finished products by performing slitting, cutting, stapling, and assembly techniques safely and efficiently.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Scan work orders and read instructions to understand product specifications, run quantities, component configurations, and raw material requirements.
• Perform slitting functions by selecting and loading raw material rolls, positioning blades in proper sequence and spacing, attaching slit ends to cardboard tubes, running the slitter/rewinder, and cutting material to specified lengths.
• Operate klicker/guillotine cutters by setting machine parameters, selecting appropriate carton sizes, attaching pre-print labels, sealing cartons, and stacking finished product on pallets.
• Operate mold press equipment by loading materials, unloading finished products, trimming, stacking, and packing cups as required.
• Perform assembly operations including rolling, folding, applying multiple components, and stapling using foot-activated industrial staplers or modifying components using band saws, drill presses, or table saws.
• Complete work order documentation by recording material usage, parts produced, rejected material, and job completion using bar code scanners.

Education/Experience

• One (1) year of manufacturing or machine operation experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Manufacturing/Technical Skills. Ability to read, interpret and apply basic drawings. Ability to perform basic mathematical skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) utilizing a calculator, including forms of measurement and other work material calculations. Working knowledge of tools, equipment, and devices, and ability to use hand operated and power tools. Proficiency with performing tasks with precision and manual dexterity. Ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification.
• Communication Skills. Ability to speak clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, listen and obtain clarification and respond well to questions. Proficiency in writing clearly and concisely and editing work for spelling and grammar.

jobs.title: CNC Set-Up Machinist - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
This is a hands-on role that will set up and operate CNC mills and lathes, create and modify programs, troubleshoot machining challenges, and ensure finished parts meet demanding quality specifications. An important part of this position is training team members, improving production efficiency, and maintaining safe, reliable machining operations.

** This position is eligible for a $1500 sign on bonus ($750 at 90 days, $750 at 180 days) **

Shift:  Monday - Thursday, 3:00 pm - 1:00 am

Day-to-Day

• Set Up & Operate CNC Equipment: Independently set up and operate CNC mills and lathes, ensuring efficient production and consistent part quality.
• Program & Optimize: Write, edit, and modify CNC programs at the machine to improve machining efficiency, optimize cutting paths, and reduce cycle times.
• Deliver Precision: Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and production orders to manufacture parts with multiple dimensions and tight tolerances.
• Inspect & Verify: Perform accurate first-piece and final inspections using calibrated measuring instruments, maintaining required documentation and quality records.
• Solve Technical Challenges: Select appropriate tooling, troubleshoot material and tooling failures, identify drawing discrepancies, and make necessary machining adjustments.
• Train & Support Teammates: Assist machinists with machine setups, programming, blueprint interpretation, quality procedures, and efficient operating techniques.
• Maintain Program Control: Manage CNC program versions using Cimco DNC software and help ensure programs remain accurate and controlled.
• Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve machining processes, tooling, cycle times, and overall productivity in collaboration with Engineering, Quality, vendors, and fellow machinists.
• Support Safe Operations: Follow Pyrotek safety requirements, applicable ISO management system standards, and established quality and operating procedures.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED/TASC, plus at least five years of CNC machining experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Demonstrated ability to set up and operate CNC mills and lathes with minimal supervision.
• Experience reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, and production orders.
• Working knowledge of machining theory, tooling, offsets, program editing, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
• Ability to write and modify CNC programs and produce parts to specified tolerances.
• Experience performing inspections and using calibrated measuring instruments.
• Strong troubleshooting, mathematical reasoning, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively, collaborate with others, and help train and develop fellow machinists.

Preferred Qualifications

• Accredited certification in CNC machining and programming.
• Working knowledge of GibbsCAM software.
• Experience using Cimco DNC software for CNC program management.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, barcode scanners, and Microsoft Office.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This position works in a manufacturing environment with exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical parts, and fumes or airborne particles. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required.

The role requires standing and walking for extended periods, bending, reaching, and using hands and fingers for precise work. The position also requires the ability to lift up to 75 pounds occasionally and up to 25 pounds frequently.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist Full time Rotating schedule
jobs.description:
The Clinical Pharmacist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Clinical Pharmacist is responsible for identifying, preventing, and/or resolving medication related problems; for providing authoritative information to other health care professionals, patients, and the public; and for assuring that the informational, clinical, and drug distribution components of pharmacy services function as an integrated system to provide patient centered care to the patients and staff of Northwestern Medicine.

The mission of the Department of Pharmacy is to deliver the safest, highest quality, most effective and efficient patient care while developing the best people, advancing research, and integrating pharmacy services to successfully coordinate care across the Northwestern Medicine enterprise.

The vision of the Department of Pharmacy is to be a recognized as a national leader in advancing the pharmacy enterprise through excellence, innovation, education and research.

Responsibilities:

• Interprets medication orders to ensure safety and proper use of medications and is alert to compatibilities, incompatibilities, medication duplication, medication allergies, and potential medication administration errors. Coordinates the solving of medication related problems between pharmacy, nursing, and prescribers, demonstrating initiative and sound judgment.
• Monitors medication therapy for significant drug-drug, drug-diet, or drug-laboratory test interactions. Intervenes in circumstances of significant interactions, therapeutic duplications, and other occasions where pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetic expertise is warranted.
• Evaluates and documents that the medication(s) selected are appropriate for achieving the desired therapeutic outcome. Communicates potential problems and likely solutions to the prescriber.
• Acts as a consultant in the areas of pharmacokinetics and adverse reactions to physicians, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Participates in all therapeutic drug monitoring or intervention programs; adjusting therapy as indicated by patient condition and laboratory results.
• Processes all medication order information into the Electronic Health Record to ensure accuracy of records regarding past, current and future dispensing and charging.
• Maintains a comprehensive pharmacy patient profile. The profile should include age, maturation, weight, allergies, diagnosis, estimated and actual pharmacokinetic parameters, and pertinent information which may affect medication therapy decisions.
• Oversees the packaging labeling, and distribution of medications for all patients and employees according to established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Monitors the use of scheduled medications on the nursing units and maintains controlled inventories of medication in the dispensing areas.
• Compounds and dispenses pharmaceuticals including sterile products, chemotherapy and parenteral nutrition products.
• Verifies medication orders before delivery to patient care areas and ensures accuracy and completeness. Resolves discrepancies as necessary.
• Reviews all laboratory data for appropriateness of medication use and recommends changes when needed. Including microbial culture and sensitivity data, toxicology, therapeutic drug monitoring, etc.
• Develops and presents orientation, education and training programs for medical, nursing, hospital and pharmacy staff, as well as assisting in the educating of pharmacy students, residents, and fellows.
• Educates patients and their families about specific medications.
• Responds to emergency situations to assist with medication management (e.g. response to cardiac arrests)
• Provides accurate and timely medication information and or teaching to healthcare professionals or patients.
• Maintains the hospital formulary and acts to limit medication usage to formulary items when appropriate
• Documents all clinical activities and interventions performed. Collects data, maintains logs, records and other documentation as required by the department
• Communicates professional knowledge effectively in both oral and written forms to patients and other health professionals.
• Participates in quality improvement and medication use review activities of the department.
• Organizes, prioritizes, and plans workload within given time constraints. Works cooperatively with fellow pharmacists to oversee and direct the activities of the work area, to assign work to technicians, and to assure that the established department objectives are accomplished
• Reviews restocking automated dispensing cabinets (ADCs) throughout the hospital and resolves any problems.
• Ensures compliance with hazardous waste collection and disposal procedures.
• Maintains proficiency and expertise in area/s of practice through continuous professional development.
• All other job duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmacy or a Doctor of Pharmacy Degree

Licensure:

• Active Clinical Pharmacist license in the state of Illinois (IDFPR)

Preferred:

• Training and knowledge of specialty areas (neonatology, critical care, oncology, etc.)
• Completion of a pharmacy residency program or equivalent hospital pharmacy experience

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The purpose of this role is to serve as a Scientific Research Program Manager (SRPM) supporting evidence strategy and research programs across Intuitive Surgical’s da Vinci platforms, products, and services. The SRPM will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify evidence needs and priorities and support the development and execution of evidence-generation strategies and research plans. This role oversees the initiation, progress, and conduct of evidence-generation studies, including those conducted by internal scientific teams, Intuitive-sponsored studies, and studies conducted in collaboration with external research partners. The SRPM serves as a key contact for internal and external parties involved in assigned programs and projects.

Essential Job Duties

• Collaborate with da Vinci and Multiport program leaders and cross-functional evidence stakeholders to identify evidence requirements and gaps, align on evidence priorities, and develop evidence strategies and plans.
• Manage and execute a portfolio of internal and external collaborative research studies and evidence-generation activities for Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci platforms, products, and services, with support from research coordinators as applicable.
• Manage research studies across the study lifecycle, including project development, budgeting, investigator selection, analysis of potential participant recruitment, preparation of study-related documents (e.g., protocols, case report forms, informed consents, research agreements), and management of Institutional Review Board and/or Ethics Committee submissions through successful outcome.
• Collaborate with data management professionals and statisticians as needed; maintain required study documentation; and plan and manage project timelines and budgets to support timely execution.
• Proactively identify and communicate project concerns, issues, and delays; develop risk assessments and contingency plans; and prepare project status updates, presentations, and reports for internal and external stakeholders and steering or advisory committees.
• Manage publication development, submission, and responses to peer review related to research studies.
• Ensure compliance with corporate requirements (e.g., SOPs) and applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GCP and U.S. and international guidelines), and maintain audit readiness to relevant regulatory and legal standards.
• Manage Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and independent research service providers, including partner identification, contract or statement-of-work development, and stakeholder management; facilitate meetings and reporting in accordance with Intuitive Surgical policies; and support review and development of internal research processes (e.g., SOPs).
• Build, nurture, and maintain relationships with external research partners and stakeholders, including surgeon key opinion leaders, operating room staff, hospital and health system administrative and technology leaders, surgical and scientific professional society leaders, and healthcare technology industry partners.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in life sciences, medicine, medical sciences, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field
• Minimum five years of experience in an academic setting or healthcare technology industry in a clinical affairs or scientific research function, with evidece of full project management responsibility; industry research management experience preferred.
• Knowledge of applicable clinical research and medical device regulations and guidelines, including GCP, ISO 14155, MEDDEV, MDR, and data protection requirements.
• Experience developing research protocols and case report forms (CRFs).
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities, including a minimum of three to five research projects across different surgical disciplines and/or products.
• Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage work autonomously and collaborate across teams while maintaining open communication with key stakeholders.
• Strong quantitative and literature analysis skills, with the ability to assess data and scientific literature and review data sets for data quality.
• Ability to manage CROs, external consultants, research coordinators, or other research staff in the execution of research studies.
• Strong problem-solving skills and initiative; English-language proficiency required.
• English language required, a second language is an advantage
• Work may require presence in hospital and surgical/operating room environments. Ability to travel 25%-50% of the time.

• Graduate degree in life sciences, medicine, medical sciences, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
• Five years of experience in the management of research, including clinical research management experience in both academic/hospital and industry settings.
• Experience with studies of health information technologies, including artificial intelligence.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program.   Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the daVinci Clinical Sales Representative .

Essential Job Duties

Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)

• Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
• Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
• Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
• Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

Clinical & Technical Support

• Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

• Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
• Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
• Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

• Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
• Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
• Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
• Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)

• Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
• Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
• Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
• Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
• Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

Escalation & Customer Issue Management

• Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
• Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
• Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

Market & Clinical Insights

• Collect and communicate customer feedback and experiences to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
• Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
• Assist in clinical trial support when required.
• Assist in field action activities when necessary.

Required Skills and Experience

• Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
• Clinical experience is preferred.
• Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
• Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
• Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
• Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
• Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
• Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
• Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
• Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
• Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

Required Education and Training

• Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
• Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

Working Conditions

• Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

• Provide excellent customer service to visitors, patients, and staff in person and
• Manages patient registration and eligibility of insurance.
• Connecting the uninsured and underinsured with enrollment services.
• Manages medical appointments and providers schedules.
• Collect and process accurate payments from individual patients.

jobs.title: Planning and Controls Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our growing team as a Planning Manager at Egis.  The Planner is responsible for carrying out planning management duties across a range of Egis projects in Ireland in our transportation team.

The role will be responsible for leading the planning function, developing and maintaining robust control of project programme. This includes providing active support to the project and programme team in all planning and reporting activities. This role would suit a collaborative individual with great leadership and communication skills who enjoys multi-tasking, loves a busy working environment and thrives under pressure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and support the planning team ensuring everyone is working in a positive environment, requirements are clear and goals are achievable.
• Assess the Planning team needs and upskill when required to ensure effective delivery and optimum performance.
• Understand clarify and implement the requirements of the Subcontract Works Information related to project controls. Demonstrate compliance to the standards by providing evidence during audits and protecting against breaches.
• Responsible for the development, update and maintenance of the programmes.
• Maintain a positive relationship with the client’s planning team to ensure programme aligned to the contract and is accepted at all times.
• Manage the programme interface with other work packages by identifying key milestones and align with access dates.
• Ensure that the programme comments raised by the client are reviewed, actions are validated and resubmission is made after closing out the comments.
• Support the commercial team in developing CE quotations by providing programmes and support the Bottom up Forecasts by providing labour and expenditure profiles.
• Ensure key compensation events, Contractor Instructions and Early Warnings are modelled in the programme promptly by maintaining daily check-ins on CEMAR.
• Manage the programme communications, ensure any critical changes are promptly relayed to internal stakeholders and external stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
• Ensure the programme aligns with the project leadership’s defined goals, including delivery approach and Compensation Events strategies.
• Ensure any movement in Planned Completion and / or Key Dates Planned Completion is well documented and the underlying reasons for the variance are substantiated.
• Ensure appropriate Time Risk Allowance (TRA) is allocated to the critical activities and maintain transparency in reporting and ownership of TRA.
• Responsible for integrating Commercial and Planning for aspects related to Earned Value Analysis (EVA), including:Spend profile,Earned ValuePlanned ValueSchedule Performance Index (SPI)
• Responsible for tracking quantities of materials and reporting planned, actuals and forecast.
• Liaise with Construction team on a daily basis to ensure robust project reporting is in place; integrate daily shift reports into the programme to ensure efficient delivery and realistic timescales.
• Liaise with the Procurement team to ensure the Tender Event Schedule (TES) is synced with the latest programme. Align construction sequencing with procurement lead times and material delivery schedules.

• Previous experience in Transportation, Infrastructure or Civil Engineering projects
• Significant experience in a project planning position
• Excellent knowledge of planning software
• Proficiency in Primavera P6 and MS Project is essential.
• Other scheduling software experience is a plus.
• Proven track record of successfully delivering major projects within a contractor environment.
• Excellent people management and development skills
• Excellent communication, negotiation and client management abilities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel as required for project assignments.
• Excellent time management, prioritisation, and troubleshooting abilities.
• Strong attention to detail, quality focus, and methodical working style.
• Adaptability in a dynamic environment with a proactive, ‘can-do’ attitude.

Desirable :

• Degree in Project Management, Engineering or a related field
• Chartered project manager or similar and member of a related professional body

Additional Information

Flexibility to based in any of our Ireland offices: Dublin, Cork, Castlebar or Limerick

Why join Egis?

Joining Egis means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation and determined to address today’s biggest challenges: fighting climate change, facilitating the digital transition and meeting the needs of growing populations.

In Ireland, Egis is delivering some of the most iconic projects, from motorways to tunnels, water and energy services, via rail to cyber, designing smart, green infrastructure, transport and buildings, connecting people and creating a sustainable future for communities everywhere.

We are passionate about solving our clients’ most complex challenges by delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industries and the planet.

Local experience backed by global reach

Egis engineering foundation and pedigree is in JB Barry's local legacy. Generations of engineers have passed through our doors, and our standing among Irish clients has been established over decades. We have been behind some of Ireland’s iconic infrastructure with specialisms including water & energy, structures and transportation. Now we’re part of Egis we have access to global talent, teams and technologies. A career with us can lead to opportunities to travel and experience some of our work in over 70 countries

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

We at EGIS are an Equal Opportunities employer and we recognise the value of a Diverse Organisation. EGIS appreciates all job applications. If you decide to apply for an opportunity at EGIS, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and everyone’s contribution as this builds our culture and means, if you work for EGIS, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

jobs.description:
The Social Worker reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Collaborates and participates in the coordination of screening, assessment, and discharge planning activities in high-risk patients and their families with complex psychosocial and economic needs. Utilizes expertise and problem-solving skills to achieve optimal clinical outcomes within effective resources and timeframes. Promotes a seamless and safe discharge throughout the continuum of care.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborates with the care team for discharge planning and community linkage for patients and families with complex social, economic, and emotional needs.
• Participates in care conferences and unit rounds. Keeps all members of the care team apprised of the current state and plan of care.
• Develops positive relationships with co-workers, members of the care team, and community resources.
• Collaborates with care team members to identify at risk populations and opportunities to improve care delivery and on-going support, thus increasing efficiencies and effectiveness.
• Makes timely and appropriate referrals to ancillary support staff in order to facilitate progress toward a safe discharge.
• Partners with the post-acute care providers and shares appropriate and pertinent information in order to create a seamless and safe discharge plan.
• Identifies, assesses and responds to patient and family needs, incorporating age specific developmental, psychological, cultural and spiritual needs. Emphasis is placed on addressing the social and emotional needs of the patient and family that may impact on the patient's response to medical treatment. These needs may include, but are not limited to, adjustment to illness, poor or limited coping abilities, functional impairment, mental illness, guardianship issues, compliance, need for additional resources due to limited funds available, substance abuse, cultural differences, death, dying, bereavement, and family welfare, including abuse, neglect, and domestic violence. Adoptions in the mother/ baby area.
• Provides timely and effective interventions for patients and families in emergency and crisis, including referrals to appropriate support resources.
• Educates team members regarding the socio-economic, emotional and cultural issues that impact care delivery, coping skills, and response to treatment.
• Serves as an advocate for the patient and family. Serves as a lead resource and assists with referrals in coordinating charity and financial resources, guardianship issues, family problems or conflicts, and competency issues.
• Assists with the maintenance of information and referral lists relative to post-acute care resources.
• Administers and interprets tests and measures of psychosocial functioning for the purpose of diagnosing mental, emotional, behavioral, addictive, and development disorders and disabilities.
• Develops and implements appropriate assessment- based treatment plan. Consults with team managers, statutory and voluntary agencies and patient’s relatives to ensure compliance with treatment plan.
• Provides crisis-oriented Psychotherapy and connects patient and family with the appropriate resources.
• Supervises and trains lower-level social workers, students or interns.
• Applies specialized clinical Knowledge and advanced clinical skills in the areas of assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of mental, behavioral, addictions disorders or conditions and makes appropriate referrals or transfers to the correct level of care.

Minimum Requirements:

Licensure:

• Licensed Social Worker (LSW)

Experience:

• One full year experience and/or internship in a medical social work role in and acute hospital setting or agency.
• Experience with maternal/child populations

Preferred:

• Experience in a level III nursery for maternal child area

jobs.title: Industrial Machine Assembly - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Essential Functions Performed by the Position

• Creates plans for the disassembly and repair per assembly procedures, following specifications provided and using knowledge gained by experience.
• Verifies conformance of parts to blueprints using measuring instruments such as calipers, gauges, and micrometers. Inspect parts to quality standards.
• Aligns components for assembly, manually or with a crane.
• Removes high spots and smooths surfaces using chisels, scrapers, files, and powered hand grinder. Assemble, set up, and operates machines to verify functionality, machine capabilities, and conformance to customer’s specifications.
• Form, bend, and fasten piping, fixtures, and attachments required to provide the machine with air, water, and oil.
• Verifies alignment and tolerances of moving parts using measuring instruments such as dial indicators and micrometers.
• Installs moving parts such as shafts, levers, or bearings, and works them to test free movement and operation of assembly by hand.
• Mounts and connects auxiliary, mechanical, electrical, electronic, pneumatic, or hydraulic equipment. Cuts and fits pipes and tubing.
• Test, or assist in testing, operation of completed product.
• 1st shift hours: Monday - Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Solid mechanical skills. Must have mechanical ability to proficiently use cranes and other heavy tools and equipment that are normally required in daily assembly and disassembly operations.
• Must own tools of the trade, and be able to use them effectively.
• Ability to use judgment to plan, perform, and make decisions as to the sequence of operations and processes within the limitations of established or standard methods and procedures.
• Must be able to interpret prints well enough to determine appropriate disassembly sequence for a variety of heavy equipment.
• Ability to read, interpret a variety of assembly prints, and understand verbal and written instructions.
• Capable of using small machine tools, welders, cranes, and forklifts.
• Basic computer skills and the ability to use basic shop math.
• Ability to verbally communicate with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
• Possess the physical strength and ability to safely handle heavy equipment and tools.
• Ability to bend tubing, lube, hydraulics, and pneumatics.

Because we seek to hire the best people, we work hard to provide benefits that make their lives better, so we offer a comprehensive benefit program which features:

• health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental, and vision plans
• a 401(k) plan in with a generous company match

• tax advantages through flexible spending accounts that allow you to pay for specific health-care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars
• a generous paid time off program in which the benefits increase along with your tenure with the company

When you join our team, you do more than simply switch companies to progress your career. You become part of our family, a group of talented women and men who drive business success.

jobs.description:
At this time, Palos Hospital is not considering external ADN candidates for our RN openings. We appreciate your interest in Northwestern Medicine and encourage you to apply to other opportunities at https://jobs.nm.org/. Internal employee ADN candidates are still encouraged to apply.

The Staff Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The registered professional nurse assumes accountability and responsibility for the individualized, age-specific care of a patient along the continuum from admission to discharge. She/He gives direct care to assigned patients and assists with other patient care when necessary. The registered professional nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of the patient/family are determined in an ethical manner. She/He collects and analyzes the assessment data in determining nursing diagnoses, collaborates with the patient/family and other health care team members, develops a plan of care to attain realistic outcomes, provides education founded on evidence-based practice, and systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and records patient status and identifies patient care needs upon admission/point of care entry.
• Organizes the assessment health data so that it is accurate, complete and accessible.
• Identifies problems that need immediate attention.
• Validates diagnoses with patient/family and other health care team members.
• Documents diagnoses in a manner that facilitates the determination of expected outcomes and plan of care.
• Initiates Problem List at the time of admission and updates as needed. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the patient’s plan of care.
• Documents that the patient’s individualized plan of care has been discussed with and agreed upon by the patient/family.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with patient/family and health care team members regarding discharge plan.
• Identifies patient teaching needs on admission and throughout hospital stay.
• Arranges conferences with patient and/or family and other members of health team when indicated to plan care.
• Prioritizes and organizes nursing interventions that are evidence based and reflective of established standards of care.
• Provides individualized, mutually agreeable, patient and family education that is founded on evidence-based practice and research guidelines.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient responses.
• Reviews consistently the patient’s health data to keep the Plan of Care updated.
• Assures that revisions to the plan of care are systematic and ongoing and are driven by measurable realistic goals.
• Documents the patient’s progression toward identified outcomes
• Identifies unmet outcomes and provides direction for continuity of care.
• Reassesses nursing actions for effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes.
• Communicates with patient/family and health care team members re: patient care and nursing’s role in the provision of care.
• Collaborates with patient/family and healthcare team members re: the patient’s progress/plan of care.
• Presents relevant patient information at multidisciplinary meetings/conferences for feedback from peers.
• Makes appropriate referrals as needed for continuity of care.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.
• Additional Requirements for the Emergency Room: ACLS, PALS/ENPC & TNCC within one year of hire Additional Requirements for the Pediatric Emergency Room: Pediatric Advanced Life Support TNCC within one year of hire Additional Requirements for Non-Invasive Cardiology: ACLS Preferred: Experience in specific clinical area Additional Preferences for the Emergency Room and the Pediatric Emergency Room: Trauma Nurse Specialist (TNS) Emergency Communications Registered Nurse Certified Pediatric Nurse Certified Emergency Nurse

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer, Customer Education & Enablement
jobs.description:
Instructional Designer, Customer Education & Enablement



CreatorIQ is seeking its first dedicated Instructional Designer on our Customer Education & Enablement team to build an AI-enabled learning program that helps customers, partners, and employees become confident, capable users of our platform. This builder role will design from scratch, set the standards others build on, and use generative AI to produce learning at a pace a small team normally can’t. Working with Customer Education & Enablement and cross-functional subject matter experts, the designer will create role-based learning paths, certifications, onboarding curricula, videos, self-paced courses, in-app guidance, and workshop materials, and will be measured on outcomes such as time to value, feature adoption, how-to support volume, and certification attainment.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

 - Design eLearning, microlearning, instructional videos, interactive activities, scenario-based exercises, job aids, and performance support materials, including product walkthroughs, feature tutorials, and short-form explainers.

 - Apply adult learning principles to create learner-centered experiences, from objectives and storyboards to scripts and facilitator guides.

 - Translate technical product concepts into clear, task-based content, and keep reusable templates and materials accurate and accessible.

 - Design role-based learning paths for customer personas (brand marketers, agency teams, campaign managers, analysts, and admins), partners, and global employees, mapped to the outcomes customers buy us for.

 - Build a certification program with assessments that measure real proficiency on platform workflows.

 - Create onboarding curricula that plug into our outcome-based implementation model, plus scalable asynchronous learning and virtual and in-person workshops tailored to diverse roles and regions.

 - Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, and other SMEs to capture the nuances of the platform accurately, and work with Product Education to align training with documentation and releases.

 - Turn recurring support ticket themes into learning, embed education into onboarding milestones, and design in-app guidance with Product and our digital adoption tools.

 - Use generative AI across the design lifecycle, from needs analysis and scripting to video production, assessment generation, and localization, with clear quality standards for human review, accuracy, and accessibility.

 - Build a modular, reusable content system that works for both people and AI, so support bots, agent copilots, and AI tutors can retrieve it accurately and education ships alongside product releases.

 - Develop, publish, and maintain learning content in our LMS (Sana).

 - Use product usage and support data to find where customers struggle, then design learning to close those gaps.

 - Create knowledge checks and practical assessments aligned to learning objectives, then use completion, assessment, engagement, and feedback data to improve content and report on learner readiness and program effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

 - 4+ years of instructional design, learning experience design, customer education, or training development experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS.

 - Portfolio of learning experiences designed for adult learners, including video content, with evidence of the results they produced.

 - Command of adult learning principles and design frameworks such as ADDIE or SAM, and evaluation models such as Kirkpatrick, applied pragmatically.

 - Hands-on, daily use of AI tools in your design workflow, with strong prompting skills and examples of how AI improved your speed or quality.

 - Strong video production skills with tools such as Camtasia, Descript, or Synthesia; authoring tools such as Articulate Rise 360; and experience administering an LMS.

 - Experience building a customer academy, certification program, or structured learning paths for a complex platform.

 - Comfort using adoption and support data to form hypotheses and tie learning to measurable outcomes.

 - Ability to learn a complex product quickly and work with SMEs; strong writing, visual communication, organization, and project management skills, with the judgment to cut content that doesn’t earn its place; ability to independently deliver projects.

 - Bonus: experience in martech, adtech, or creator marketing; digital adoption platforms such as Pendo or Appcues; AI-native learning platforms; help centers such as Zendesk Guide; or no-code automation such as n8n.



Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!









Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.



Learn more at www.creatoriq.com http://www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.



At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth.  Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Associate
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description:

Ready to help bring transformative global experiences to students around the world? As a Program Development Associate on the WorldStrides Higher Education team, you'll be at the forefront of building new university partnerships and expanding access to life-changing education abroad programs.  In this exciting, relationship-driven role, you'll connect with education abroad professionals, uncover new opportunities, and help design innovative international programs. Through outreach, virtual meetings, conferences, and campus visits, you'll grow a network of partners while helping turn ideas into impactful global experiences.  We're looking for someone who loves building relationships, thrives on achieving goals, and enjoys managing projects from concept to launch. If you're energized by sales, passionate about higher education, and excited by international education, we'd love to meet you!

Responsibilities:

• Sales & Business Development:

• Proactively generate new business opportunities, meet and exceed annual sales targets, and drive revenue growth.

• Partner Engagement:

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with education abroad professionals to understand their program needs and provide tailored solutions.

• Pipeline and Program Management Expertise:

• Utilize prior experience in project management to guide partners through the program development process, from initial concept to successful execution. Apply consultative selling techniques to guide prospects from initial contact through program development and closure.

• CRM & Data Management:

• Maintain accurate records in WorldStrides' CRM to track leads, opportunities, and ongoing partner communications.

• Collaboration & Communication:

• Work cross-functionally with internal teams—including operations, academic support, and risk management—to ensure seamless program execution.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in inside sales and recruitment, preferably in higher education.

• Demonstrates strong attention to details

• Highly motivated self-starter with a strong work ethic and a passion for learning.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing concurrent projects.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly.

• Competency in Microsoft Office, Zoom, and CRM platforms.

• Highly organized with strong time management skills.

• Goal-oriented mindset, with a track record of exceeding targets.

• Ability to maintain professionalism in all interactions

Work Perks:

• Comprehensive health benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, accident, critical illness, disability insurance, FSA/HSA options with employer HSA contributions, and a generous 401(k) match.

• Generous paid time off including 11 paid company holidays, 25 PTO days the first year (prorated), 1 paid volunteer day, 4 mental health days, and bereavement

• Professional development support, including up to $5,250 annually for tuition reimbursement and up to $1,000 for certifications annually

• Opportunities for paid and discounted travel

• Flexible work schedule providing on-site, remote, and hybrid office opportunities

• Encouraged participation in a wide variety of Employee Resource Groups

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness resources, including fitness centers at select locations

• Paid parental, caregiver, and disability leave

• Team Member Discount Program

• Engaging, collaborative, and fun work environment

The salary range listed for this position represents WorldStrides’ good-faith estimate of the base compensation for the role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills and qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. The range does not include other forms of compensation or benefits that may be offered as part of the total rewards package.

Compensation Range

$48,000—$48,000 USD

WorldStrides, a global organization, is committed to educate and serve communities worldwide. Our commitment is fueled by the passion of our team members and partners to make experiential learning accessible, while also being socially, environmentally, and ethically responsible. Together, we accomplish this by investing in initiatives to promote inclusion, diversity, and sustainability.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, WorldStrides is committed to building a diverse workforce, supported by an environment that promotes inclusion and belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

WorldStrides will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, J-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Select seasonal roles may consider students on J-1 or F-1 visas.

 - Entering their sophomore, junior, or senior year in the Fall of 2027.

 - Be available to participate for 10 consecutive weeks.

 - Support the HR department to deliver meaningful work that contributes to departmental and business objectives.

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

 - Professionalism in interacting with team members and internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Process Installation Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Project Manager
Location: Onsite – Louisville, KY
Level: Senior Manager
Client Facing: Yes

About PAC Group:

At The PAC Group (PAC), we specialize in engineering consulting, program management, and operational excellence—delivering high-impact solutions in more than 20 countries. We’re proud to partner with the world’s leading companies in automotive, aerospace, industrial, and technology sectors, providing strategic guidance and hands-on execution that drive innovation and efficiency. Whether we’re launching advanced manufacturing systems, deploying digital simulation tools, or scaling global operations, PAC thrives at the intersection of technology, engineering, and problem-solving.

Joining PAC means joining a dynamic, fast-paced, and global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Role Purpose:

Lead the full installation supervision team and be accountable for safe, on-time and on-budget installation of cell manufacturing equipment. Act as the single point of contact on site for the client, the EPC/general contractor and the equipment OEMs. The role sits within a 340–350-person team supervising the installation of calendering, slitting, winding, cell assembly and de-dusting equipment at a giga battery cell plant.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the installation execution plan for calendering, slitting, winding, cell assembly and de-dusting lines, from equipment receipt to mechanical completion and handover to commissioning.

• Lead area managers, discipline supervisors and the scheduling, materials, quality and controls functions; set up the site organization and mobilization plan for 340–350 people.

• Interface daily with the client, EPC/GC, building trades and OEM vendor teams (often Korean, Chinese or Japanese); chair progress, coordination and interface meetings.

• Drive the safety culture with the HSE lead: OSHA compliance, NFPA 70E for energized work, lifting and rigging plans, permit to work and LOTO.

• Manage the interface with building readiness: dry room completion, foundations and floor flatness for heavy calenders, and availability of utilities (power, compressed air, chilled water, exhaust).

• Control scope, cost and schedule with the controls team; approve change orders, monthly reports and forecasts.

• Manage risk and escalation: late equipment deliveries, damaged crates, vendor manpower gaps, labor productivity and union jurisdiction issues.

• Ensure turnover packages, punch list closure and readiness for SAT and pre-commissioning.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical or industrial engineering.

• 15+ years in industrial projects, including 5+ years as Project Manager on process equipment installation in a greenfield plant.

• Battery gigafactory experience, ideally covering electrode and cell assembly areas (semiconductor, display or automotive plant installation considered).

• Proven leadership of teams of 200+ people on a single site.

• Working knowledge of US contracting, OSHA regulations and union labor environments.

• OSHA 30 certification (or completion before mobilization).

• Fluent English.

Bonus Qualifications:

• PMP or equivalent project management certification.

• Experience managing OEM vendor teams from Asia on US projects.

The salary range for this position is dependent upon experience, education, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Technician, Maintenance Call Center
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Please enter a high-level summary of the job here (2-3 sentences)

Coordinates maintenance operations across retail locations by managing work orders, troubleshooting issues, dispatching internal and external service providers, and ensuring timely, cost-effective resolution of repairs. Oversees vendor performance, technician scheduling, purchase order administration, and maintenance spending while providing clear stakeholder communication, maintaining compliance documentation, supporting preventative maintenance programs, and ensuring adherence to service, safety, and budget objectives.

Essential Job Functions

1)Work Order Management: Receive, evaluate, prioritize, and coordinate maintenance work orders across retail locations using Salesforce and established prioritization guidelines. Partner proactively with store personnel to gather complete and accurate information regarding maintenance issues, required actions, and business impact, ensuring timely documentation and minimizing delays in service delivery.

2)Troubleshooting and Support:

Serve as the primary point of contact for maintenance-related inquiries, diagnosing issues and facilitating remote resolutions whenever possible. Assess repair requirements and determine the most effective resource solution by leveraging internal technicians, approved vendors, or other available resources based on urgency, complexity, cost, and service needs. Communicate repair scope, expectations, and timelines to service providers while negotiating pricing and not-to-exceed limits to support budget objectives.

Communicate clearly with vendors regarding scope, timelines, and expectations.  Negotiate "not to exceed" amounts with third party suppliers to meet budgetary commitments.

3)Follow-Up and Resolution:

Manage work orders throughout the full repair lifecycle, monitoring progress, documenting updates, communicating estimated completion timelines, and ensuring stakeholder visibility. Verify completion and quality of repairs prior to closing work orders, maintaining detailed records of resolutions and promptly escalating recurring, unresolved, or business-critical issues.

4)Vendor Management:

Administer relationships with approved service providers to ensure timely, high-quality, and cost-effective maintenance support. Create and manage purchase orders for third-party services, monitor project costs, source repair parts and materials, and coordinate repair activities through completion. Evaluate vendor performance against service-level expectations and maintain technician schedules to maximize resource utilization, meet response commitments, and support operational needs.

5)Communication and Reporting:

Provide consistent communication and reporting to store teams, regional leadership, maintenance management, and cross-functional partners regarding work order status, escalations, vendor performance, estimated completion timelines, and budget impact. Maintain accurate records and documentation to support business reporting, compliance requirements, audits, and operational decision-making.

6)Cost Control and Budget Awareness:

Manage maintenance expenditures by accurately creating and coding purchase orders, reviewing invoices for accuracy and compliance with negotiated pricing, and ensuring proper invoice reconciliation and payment processing. Monitor spending against departmental budgets, manage an annual maintenance spend exceeding $2 million, identify cost-saving opportunities, and negotiate favorable pricing while maintaining service quality and operational reliability.

7)Preventative Maintenance Oversight:

Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance activities for critical equipment and systems to support asset reliability and minimize operational downtime. Ensure all maintenance activities comply with company policies and applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

jobs.description:
At Harris, the true value of what makes us successful is found in our people. It is our unique mix of cultures, experiences, beliefs and backgrounds that sets Harris apart from the rest.  We constantly strive to cultivate, nurture and amplify an unparalleled environment, where we value intellectual curiosity and uniqueness of thought.  Inclusion is embedded in the very fabric of our culture of collaboration and openness.

We understand that a job description only tells one part of a broader story, and Harris is seeking dynamic candidates who can add to our best-in-class environment. We recognize that qualifications can be gained through both traditional and non-traditional paths, and we are committed to considering candidates who possess the potential to be excellent in this role regardless of prior experiences.

Therefore we encourage ALL interested individuals to submit their applications, even if they do not meet every requirement outlined in the job description.

The Position

Reporting to the Head of Testing and Controls, the Senior Compliance Officer will lead the firm's marketing compliance review function, providing regulatory oversight, guidance, and approvals for marketing materials and external communications across Harris Oakmark's investment advisory business, including separately managed accounts, mutual funds, and exchange-traded funds.  The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert on investment adviser and investment company marketing regulations, including the SEC Marketing Rule, and work closely with Marketing, Distribution, Legal, and other business partners to facilitate effective, timely, and compliant marketing initiatives.

This role combines hands-on marketing review responsibilities with broader ownership of the firm's marketing compliance processes, policies, and controls.  The individual will be expected to identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the marketing review function, including through the effective use of technology and workflow enhancements.  The ideal candidate will bring strong regulatory expertise, sound judgment, a collaborative and solutions-oriented approach, and the ability to balance regulatory requirements with the firm's business objectives.

Responsibilities

Marketing Review and Regulatory Oversight

• Lead the review and approval of marketing materials and external communications across the firm's investment advisory business, including separately managed accounts, mutual funds, ETFs, and institutional and intermediary distribution channels.

• Review marketing materials, including presentations, pitch books, fact sheets, performance reports, investment commentary, thought leadership, websites, social media, webinars, press releases, and other client-facing communications.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on the SEC Marketing Rule (Rule 206(4)-1), applicable Investment Company Act advertising requirements, and other relevant SEC and FINRA regulations.

• Evaluate investment performance advertising, including gross and net performance, hypothetical performance, extracted and related performance, composite presentations, benchmark comparisons, and associated disclosures.

• Assess marketing claims for accuracy, substantiation, fair and balanced presentation, and consistency with investment strategies, fund disclosures, and firm policies.

• Provide regulatory guidance regarding testimonials, endorsements, third-party ratings, awards, social media, and other marketing practices.

• Identify and escalate complex or higher-risk marketing compliance matters and work collaboratively with other stakeholders to develop appropriate solutions.

Program Management and Process Improvement

• Lead the ongoing administration and enhancement of the firm's marketing compliance review process, including procedures, workflows, review standards, documentation, and escalation protocols.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of marketing compliance reviews while maintaining appropriate regulatory safeguards.

• Partner with Marketing, Distribution, Technology, and other stakeholders to evaluate, implement, and optimize marketing compliance technology, including automated review tools and workflow management systems.

• Maintain appropriate review records, approval documentation, and substantiation of material marketing claims in accordance with applicable recordkeeping requirements.

• Monitor marketing compliance review activity, identify recurring issues or emerging risks, and recommend improvements to processes and controls.

• Support compliance testing, regulatory examinations, internal audits, and remediation efforts relating to marketing and communications compliance.

Business Partnership and Advisory Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted compliance adviser to Marketing, Distribution, Investment teams, Legal, and other business partners, providing timely, practical, and risk-based guidance on marketing and communications matters.

• Develop strong working relationships across the firm and collaborate proactively with stakeholders to support marketing initiatives while maintaining appropriate regulatory standards.

• Advise on new marketing strategies, products, distribution channels, and communications initiatives, identifying compliance considerations early in the development process.

• Develop and deliver training and guidance to business partners on marketing compliance requirements, regulatory developments, and firm policies.

• Work collaboratively to resolve complex regulatory questions and establish consistent interpretations of applicable requirements.

Social Media and Electronic Communications

• Provide compliance oversight and guidance relating to the firm's social media and external electronic communications activities, including applicable advertising, disclosure, supervision, and recordkeeping requirements. Review and advise on emerging digital marketing channels and communication practices, including the use of new technologies and AI-enabled marketing tools. Coordinate with other Compliance, Legal, and Technology personnel regarding electronic communications policies, monitoring, and escalation of potential compliance concerns.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance or related field.

• Ideally 10-15 years’ relevant work experience in the financial services industry (investment advisory, mutual funds, broker-dealer).

• Active FINRA Series 24 (General Securities Principal) registration required.

• Understanding of SEC and FINRA laws, regulations, and guidance, particularly as it relates to the investment advisory marketing activities, social media, and mutual funds.

• Understanding of GIPS compliance and disclosure requirements.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work with all levels of personnel with a high degree of integrity and maturity.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to present ideas and information clearly, logically, and succinctly.

• A proactive, hands-on, and collaborative attitude is essential, with a readiness to take ownership of specific initiatives.

• Attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, with the ability to project manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Characteristics & Attributes

• High level of integrity and professionalism.

• Excellent judgment in assessing potential compliance matters, the application of industry developments to the business and knowing when to seek independent advice and when to act independently.

• Driven by collective success.

• Desire to constantly improve status quo.

Benefits include, but are not limited to; medical, prescription drug, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, profit sharing plan, 401k plan, tuition reimbursement, commuter and holistic wellness benefits along with volunteer programs.

jobs.title: CapEx Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
The CapEx Procurement Specialist supports the execution of sourcing and procurement activities for North America capital expenditure (CapEx) projects. This role provides disciplined day-to-day coordination across RFI/RFQ events, supplier onboarding, contract routing and tracking, sourcing documentation, project follow-up, and status reporting. By owning these workflows, the role improves competitive bid coverage, cycle time, documentation quality, and visibility across the CapEx portfolio.

Working under the direction of the CapEx Procurement Manager, the Specialist translates approved commercial strategies into well-controlled execution. The role coordinates with Engineering, plant teams, Finance, Legal, Accounts Payable, Procurement Operations, supplier-enablement teams, and suppliers while supporting O-I’s North America operating and capital-investment priorities.

Responsibilities:

Sourcing Event Execution & RFI/RFQ Administration

• Coordinate RFIs and RFQs for assigned capital projects in accordance with the sourcing strategy, scope, and bidder list approved by the CapEx Procurement Manager.

• Prepare and issue sourcing-event packages; manage timelines, bidder communications, clarifications, and document control.

• Coordinate bid meetings, site visits, and supplier invitations; route commercial and technical questions to the appropriate owners and track responses.

• Compile bid submissions, completeness checks, commercial comparison materials, and supporting documentation for evaluation and sourcing recommendations.

• Track sourcing milestones, decisions, dependencies, and follow-up actions; promptly escalate delays or unresolved issues.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready sourcing records in Ivalua or the designated repository.

Supplier Onboarding & Enablement

• Coordinate supplier onboarding from approved selection through vendor activation, including collection of required tax, banking, compliance, insurance, and supplier-master information.

• Partner with Vendor Master, Finance, Accounts Payable, Legal, Risk, and other internal teams to progress onboarding requirements and resolve missing information.

• Maintain onboarding status, communicate readiness and open items, and coordinate the handoff to contracting and purchasing-process owners.

• Support suppliers with process and system requirements while ensuring that approvals and data are complete before activation.

Contract Workflow & Documentation

• Prepare contract-routing packages and coordinate review, approval, signature, and filing steps in accordance with Procurement policy and delegated authority.

• Maintain contract trackers, approval status, key dates, executed agreements, and required metadata in the designated system or repository.

• Follow up with internal reviewers and suppliers to keep contract actions moving and escalate aging or high-risk items to the CapEx Procurement Manager.

• Support renewal, expiration, amendment, and closeout tracking as assigned.

Project Coordination, Follow-Up & Status Reporting

• Maintain the CapEx sourcing pipeline, project trackers, action logs, milestone dates, and status dashboards for assigned work.

• Schedule meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document actions and decisions, and issue timely follow-up communications.

• Coordinate inputs and deliverables across Procurement, Engineering, plant teams, Finance, Legal, and suppliers.
• Prepare clear project-status summaries for the CapEx Procurement Manager and stakeholders, highlighting progress, decisions needed, risks, and overdue actions.
• Provide general project coordination and procurement execution support that improves consistency and execution across the North America CapEx portfolio.

Procurement Systems, Controls & Value Tracking

• Execute assigned sourcing and workflow activities in Ivalua, ERP, and other approved Procurement tools; maintain accurate records and status information.
• Verify that required approvals, competitive-bid documentation, contracts, and supporting records are complete before process closeout.
• Support savings, cost-avoidance, payment-term, and cash-impact tracking by maintaining approved baselines and benefit documentation.
• Prepare recurring reports and data extracts on sourcing activity, onboarding, contracts, project milestones, and compliance.
• Identify and implement practical improvements to templates, trackers, standard work, handoffs, and reporting.

Mandatory

• Demonstrated experience supporting sourcing events and commercial activities, including supplier negotiations.
• Strong commercial, analytical, and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
• Experience working with Procurement technologies and ERP systems.
• Fluency in English.

Preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• 1-3 years of Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Project Coordination, or a related field.
• Experience within the assigned category area.
• Experience in glass, packaging, industrial manufacturing, or process industries.
• Knowledge of supplier risk management, sustainability, and contract management practices.
• Experience leading cross-functional sourcing initiatives.
• Experience with Ivalua or equivalent Source-to-Pay platforms.
• Professional certifications such as CIPS, CPSM, ISM, or equivalent.
• Interest in AI, analytics, and digital Procurement technologies.

jobs.title: Manager, HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Tango Therapeutics is a biotechnology company dedicated to discovering novel drug targets and delivering the next generation of precision medicine for the treatment of cancer.

Using an approach that starts and ends with patients, Tango leverages the genetic principle of synthetic lethality to discover and develop therapies that take aim at critical targets in cancer.

This includes expanding the universe of precision oncology targets into novel areas such as tumor suppressor gene loss and their contribution to the ability of cancer cells to evade immune cell killing.

The Tango labs and offices are located at 201 Brookline Avenue, in the Fenway area of Boston, Massachusetts.

Summary

Reporting to the CHRO, the Manager, Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) supports the General & Administrative (G&A) functions, partnering with leaders and employees across areas such as Finance, Legal, IT, and HR, as applicable. The HRBP provides practical HR guidance, builds effective relationships, and helps implement people programs aligned with functional needs and company priorities. The role supports talent and career development, manager coaching, employee relations, performance management, and organizational change. The Manager independently handles routine HR matters and partners with the CHRO on complex, sensitive, or higher-impact decisions.

Your Role:

• Serves as the primary day-to-day HR partner for assigned G&A teams, providing timely guidance and delivering HR programs and services in support of functional priorities

• Uses HR data, employee feedback, and knowledge of G&A operations to identify people trends, highlight concerns, and recommend practical actions; escalates significant issues and recommendations to the CHRO

• Implements and improves HR processes and solutions in partnership with the CHRO and HR colleagues, recommending changes based on client needs

• Supports leaders with team effectiveness, role clarity, and organizational changes; partners with the CHRO on complex organization design or sensitive change initiatives

• Partners with G&A leaders to identify talent needs and implement practical approaches to employee development, engagement, and retention

• Supports annual workforce and headcount planning for G&A functions, including identifying hiring needs, skills gaps, and succession considerations; contributes analysis and recommendations for CHRO and functional leader review

• Collaborates closely with HR colleagues to deliver consistent employee experiences and implement company-wide HR programs across the G&A client group

• Coordinates performance and talent processes for G&A teams, including ongoing feedback, performance discussions, calibration, and compensation planning in partnership with the CHRO and relevant HR colleagues

• Partners with Talent Acquisition and G&A hiring managers to clarify role requirements, support hiring plans, and facilitate onboarding and integration

What You Bring:

Education and Experience:

• Undergraduate degree in human resources or related, relevant discipline

• Typically requires 5–7 years of progressive HR experience, including experience supporting leaders as an HR generalist or HR business partner, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge and Skills:

• Experience implementing HR programs and advising managers on day-to-day people matters

• Experience supporting headcount planning, talent reviews, or workforce planning activities

• Working knowledge of talent management, performance management, succession planning, and employee development

• Experience supporting organizational change, employee engagement, or team effectiveness initiatives

• Sound knowledge of manager coaching, employee relations, and HR data analysis; ability to recognize when to escalate complex or sensitive matters

Traits and Qualities:

• Ability to influence positively including in situations without direct authority

• Ability to manage routine responsibilities independently while seeking guidance on complex, sensitive, or precedent-setting matters; collaborates effectively across teams

• Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Excellent planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support, prioritize, and multi-task

• Highly collaborative team player who fosters open communication and develops important relationships with key stakeholders

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication abilities with a high degree of emotional intelligence

• Demonstrates sound judgment, discretion, and interpersonal skills to build credibility with employees and G&A managers

• Have proven communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to present information clearly to a variety of audiences

• Able to learn quickly, organize work, and execute defined HR projects with appropriate guidance and follow-through

• Thrives in high energy and fast paced organization with ongoing simultaneous initiatives

• Builds alignment through clear communication, collaboration, and practical recommendations

$108,800—$136,000 USD
