Job Title: Team Coordinator-Assembly

Title of Supervisor(s): Production Supervisor

Job Location: Morristown, TN

Company Website:  www.greenworkstools.com

You already know what it takes to keep an assembly line moving. Now it's time to do it with more influence, more ownership, and a bigger impact. As a Team Coordinator at Greenworks, you'll stay hands-on in production while serving as the go-to resource for Team Leaders and associates. You'll keep the line running safely, keep the team connected, and keep the people around you set up to win. If you're a Team Leader or senior production associate who is ready to take the next step, this is the opportunity you've been working toward.

Why Greenworks?

Greenworks is a rapidly growing global manufacturer of residential and commercial products, and we're leading the charge toward a more powerful and sustainable future. With over 20 years of research and development and more than 1,000 patents in outdoor power equipment, power tools, and lifestyle products, we're pushing the limits of what battery technology can do to improve the quality of work and life. When you build with us, you're building products that are changing the way the world works and lives.

What You'll Do

• Keep the line moving: Coordinate daily production activities, monitor line readiness and start-up, and help balance labor and workflow across stations to hit daily targets.

• Be the go-to leader: Give hands-on guidance to Team Leaders and assembly associates, reinforcing standard work and best practices as you coach your peers by influence.

• Connect the floor to supervision: Provide real-time status updates, spot recurring production, quality, material, or attendance issues, and escalate risks and trends early.

• Grow the team: Coordinate on-the-job training for new hires, support cross-training, and reinforce safety and quality expectations from day one.

• Stay hands-on: Maintain certification in all assembly stations, and step in on assembly and inspection tasks whenever the line needs you.

• Own the numbers: Track and share daily output, efficiency, scrap, rework, and downtime, and keep visual management boards current so the whole team knows where it stands.

• Partner across teams: Work with Materials and Warehouse to confirm material readiness, and flag component shortages or inventory risks before they hit production.

• Raise the bar on quality: Perform in-process quality checks, keep documentation accurate, and share floor-level feedback to improve work instructions.

• Champion safety and improvement: Reinforce safe work practices and housekeeping, join safety walks and hazard identification, and support 5S, standard work reviews, and waste reduction.

• Set the tone: Model teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and a positive work environment.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of manufacturing experience

• High school diploma or GED

• A strong understanding of assembly processes, standard work, and production flow

• Proven ability to lead by influence, coach peers, and support team performance without formal supervisory authority

• Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail

• Effective problem-solving skills, with good judgment on when and how to escalate

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other production tracking or reporting systems

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• A motivated, reliable, accountable, team-first attitude

• The ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

Bonus Points

• Experience in lawn and garden or outdoor power equipment manufacturing

• Prior experience as a Team Leader or senior production associate

What We Offer

• Competitive hourly pay based on your experience

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Paid vacation, personal, and sick time

• A clear step up in leadership, with the chance to grow your skills in a company that is shaping the future of battery-powered tools

Ready to lead from the front line? Apply today and help power what's next at Greenworks. Learn more about us at www.greenworkstools.com.

jobs.title: Director, Client Finance
jobs.description:
Director, Client Finance

Location: United States-Remote

Strategic Finance Leadership Role

Position Overview

The Director, Client Finance is a strategic leadership position tasked with ensuring financial integrity, operational governance, and strong economic performance throughout the entire client lifecycle—from RFP initiation to project closeout. This role collaborates closely with Client Services, Project Management, Finance, Delivery, and Leadership teams to manage client profitability and client compliance. This role will report directly to the CFO.

The Director is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing client financial outcomes. This includes revenue, margins, and profitability to ensure alignment with organizational goals and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

This is not a transactional accounting or billing role. Instead, the Director, Client Finance serves as a commercial partner and leader for client operations — translating delivery realities, staffing dynamics, and client economics into actionable insight, governance, and decision support.

The ideal candidate brings experience in all commercial aspects successfully managing a client portfolio for a media advertising agency. Exposure to Pharma clients is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Planning & Forecasting

• Partner closely with Finance on monitoring revenue recognition and pacing to approved scope

• Own revenue and margin forecasting methodologies, assumptions, and forecast accuracy

• Ensure CRM is accurate and up to date

• Adhere to governance models, escalation thresholds, and operating cadences to proactively manage financial risk

• Forecast demand, staffing pressure, and margin exposure across the business

• Build scalable reporting and decision frameworks that improve visibility and accountability

Client Financial Performance

• Lead interpretation of client-level financial performance, including pacing, burn, margin health, and delivery efficiency

• Translate project management inputs, scope signals, staffing realities, and delivery risks into clear financial insight

• Identify early warning signs related to margin erosion, scope creep, delivery inefficiencies, or commercial risk

• Develop clear financial narratives and decision tradeoffs for leadership and account teams — not just reporting data

• Distinguish between timing shifts, scope changes, estimation gaps, and operational inefficiencies

• Surface recurring trends and lessons learned to improve pricing strategy, forecasting accuracy, and delivery systems

• Provide leadership teams with actionable insights that support timely intervention and stronger business outcomes

Contract Compliance & Commercial Oversight

• Oversee financial governance of MSAs and SOWs to ensure consistency, clarity, and reduced commercial risk

• Partner with Client Services and leadership teams during SOW development and client presentations

• Ensure commercial assumptions align with operational realities, resourcing, and delivery expectations

• Ensure standards, guardrails, and governance processes across client contracts and commercial engagements are followed

Pricing Strategy & Commercial Modeling

• Support and evolve, in collaboration with CFO, the agency’s master pricing model, including scope-to-hours, cost, margin, and pricing methodologies

• Maintain and refine economic assumptions tied to staffing structures, utilization, delivery models, and service mix

• Analyze pricing effectiveness relative to realized delivery outcomes and profitability

• Partner with CFO to define margin guardrails, discounting logic, and commercial risk thresholds

• Partner with Client Services on pricing builds, scope changes, contract expansions, and commercial negotiations

• Support client procurement conversations alongside Client Services, New Business, and Leadership when needed

Capacity Planning & Delivery System Management

• Partner with business unit leaders to create staffing models and workforce plans aligned to business demand

• Manage utilization and throughput expectations grounded in operational realities

• Identify systemic delivery constraints, inefficiencies, and operational bottlenecks

• Recommend improvements to staffing structures, delivery models, and scope assumptions

• Build staffing and scenario models tied to pipeline activity and future business growth

Qualifications

• 8–12+ years of experience in progressive client finance roles

• Experience within a media agency, or project-based environment strongly preferred

• Proven experience managing financial governance processes and scalable operating models

• Strong understanding of pricing strategy, resource planning, margin management, and delivery economics

• Ability to synthesize financial, operational, and delivery data into strategic recommendations

• Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams

• Experience partnering with Client Services, Delivery, Finance, and Leadership teams in fast-paced environments

• Advanced Excel/modeling capabilities and comfort working within data-heavy environments

• Strong analytical mindset balanced with operational pragmatism and business judgment

• Knowledge of Wrike and CoPilot

Success in This Role Looks Like

• Improved forecast accuracy and financial visibility across client engagements

• Earlier identification and mitigation of margin and delivery risk

• Disciplined pricing, scoping, and commercial decision-making

• Stronger alignment between staffing models, delivery realities, and client economics

• Increased accountability and consistency in financial governance practices

• Clear executive-level insight that supports profitable, scalable growth

Why This Role Matters

As the agency continues to scale, the Director, Client Finance will play a critical role in helping the organization operate with greater rigor, predictability, and commercial discipline. This role will help bridge the gap between Finance, Client Services, and Delivery — ensuring strategic decisions are grounded in operational and financial reality while enabling the business to grow profitably and sustainably.

Interested?
Apply by submitting your resume and a brief note outlining your healthcare or media experience.

At The PAC Group (PAC), we specialize in engineering consulting, program management, and operational excellence—delivering high-impact solutions in more than 20 countries. At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.

• Processing clinician/rater forms and documenting data via status trackers and ePortal/LMS training systems.

• Review and process submitted clinician/rater surveys and deploy applicable LMS training modules.

• Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff

• Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.

• Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.

• Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.

• Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.

• Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.

• Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable

• Microsoft Office proficiency.

What’s In It For You

• Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!

• Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

Wage Range

$55,000—$60,000 USD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. jobs.description:
LEAD THE FUTURE OF DENTISTRY. 

Overjet is the world-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. Now, we’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission: improve oral health for all.

Overjet is where builders become leaders. Everyone here loves to make new things: new products, new partnerships, new content, and a new category of AI technology. And as Overjet grows ridiculously fast, so will you.

Simply put, there’s no better place to accelerate your career. Come join us!




THE MISSION AND THE HARD PART

Dentists and insurers use Overjet to make real decisions about patient care and claims, which means the software underneath has to be right. Features that ship late stall the product, and bugs that ship at all land in front of clinicians and payers. A Senior Engineer is the person who keeps both from happening: someone who takes a problem from vague idea to reliable production system, with minimal hand-holding. You’ll work with Product, ML scientists, and fellow engineers on the San Mateo team, and you’ll own meaningful pieces of the platform from the start.

Nobody will hand you a perfectly scoped ticket. You’ll untangle ambiguous requirements, make design calls, and then own what happens when your code runs in production, including being on call. If shipping dependable software for healthcare, at startup speed, sounds like a fun problem, keep reading.

What You’ll Own

 - Features and services from design through production. That means scoping the problem, choosing the approach, building it well, and staying accountable for how it behaves after launch.

 - The quality of the code you and your teammates ship. That means thoughtful reviews, solid tests, and fixing root causes instead of patching symptoms.

 - Reliability of the systems you touch. That means monitoring, alerting, and incident response that catch problems before customers do.

 - Clear technical communication with Product, ML, and other engineers. That means turning requirements into plans and flagging risks early.

 - The growth of less experienced engineers around you. That means mentoring through reviews, pairing, and sharing what you know.

What Makes the Right Candidate Keep Reading

You’ve spent years building and running production backend systems, and you’ve learned what separates code that works from code that holds up. You take ownership without being asked, you ask good questions when requirements are unclear, and you move fast without cutting corners that matter. The traits that matter most here are high agency and curiosity: you dig into root causes and you pick up new tools, including AI tools, and use them with good judgment. If you want a narrowly scoped role where someone else decides what to build, this isn’t the right seat.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience welcome

 - Skills: Strong backend development in Python (or Go, Java, or a comparable language); SQL and relational databases; REST APIs; cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS); Docker; CI/CD; sound testing practices; judicious use of AI tools in development. A plus: Kubernetes, Terraform, and healthcare or regulated-data experience (for example HIPAA)

 - Experience: 5+ years of software engineering building and shipping production systems

Why Overjet? 

 - Competitive Compensation and Equity

 - Hybrid workplace that provides flexibility, vibrant in-person workspaces, and the ability to build strong connections across all of Overjet - regardless of location

 - 401k plans with a matching program

 - Medical, Dental and Vision coverage: 99% employee premium covered, 75% dependent premium covered

 - Life and AD+D Insurance 

 - 8 weeks Paid Parental Leave 

 - Optional HSA with Employer contribution

 - Flexible Time Off and company paid holidays

Our Hybrid Workplace

We have a unique hybrid workplace at Overjet — which combines the teamwork of meeting in person, with the flexibility of working from anywhere.

Many of our positions are based in San Mateo, New York City, Boston, and Salt Lake City. The Jetters who live in these “geo-hubs” come to the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, while having the option to work from home the rest of the week.

Our People Team is happy to answer any questions about what hybrid work means for your specific role!

Director of Credentialing

Location Type: Remote (Must Resides in the United States)

Build Your Career with Us!

Upstream Rehabilitation is the country’s largest dedicated provider of outpatient physical and occupational therapy services. Our mission is to inspire and empower the lives we touch, to serve our communities, and to lead with purpose-driven passion.

We are committed to delivering remarkable experiences and fostering an inclusive workplace where differences are valued and celebrated. The Role:

As the Director of Credentialing, you will provide strategic leadership and oversight of provider credentialing, enrollment, delegated credentialing, and compliance programs across the organization. In this role, you will ensure regulatory and payer compliance, support organizational growth initiatives, strengthen delegated payer partnerships, and drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

Success in this role requires deep expertise in provider enrollment, delegated credentialing, payer relations, healthcare compliance, and team leadership, along with the ability to build strong partnerships across the organization. Your leadership will play a critical role in enabling organizational growth, maintaining compliance excellence, and advancing our mission to deliver high-quality care to the communities we serve.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, delegated credentialing, provider operations, or revenue cycle management.

• 5+ years of leadership experience managing credentialing, provider enrollment, or healthcare operations teams.

• Demonstrated success leading process improvement initiatives, driving operational efficiencies, and managing cross-functional projects.

• Experience supporting large, multi-state healthcare organizations, preferably within an outpatient or ambulatory care environment.

• Strong experience managing delegated credentialing programs, payer relationships, and regulatory audits for commercial and government health plans.

• Deep knowledge of NCQA credentialing standards, delegated credentialing requirements, accreditation processes, and audit readiness activities.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Per Diem) - Dublin, OH
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous referral reward program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Production Scheduler, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE SITE

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1, its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Production Scheduler to join our manufacturing team at Anduril who will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing the flow of products through the production process. Here you will work on cutting-edge technology aimed at advancing the state-of-the-possible. The Production Scheduler is responsible for provide tactical scheduling and strategic long range planning expertise to our production teams and more! If you are someone who is a highly motivated team player who is willing to support a fast paced team environment and detail oriented self-starter with minimal oversight then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Provide tactical scheduling and strategic long range planning expertise to our production teams

• Coordinate, review, plan and schedule inputs from the business and planning to create an integrated master schedule

• Works with the planning teams to ensure MRP is reflective of production

• Utilize Foundry and other applications to ensure work is scheduled and prioritized accurately and efficiently, and resources allocated appropriately

• Prepare daily work schedules, track work progress, update project critical path schedules, and advise leadership of needed adjustments to daily work activities

• Perform schedule baseline change control, collection and tracking performance, critical path analysis and variance analysis as required

• Ensure requisite production requirements are properly scheduled to facilitate an efficient production process

• Schedule production, operations planning, and engineering support to eliminate obstacles and deliver product on time

• Coordinate support from other internal resources such as inspection, testing, engineering, and supply chain as needed to meet program deliverables

• Lead efforts to uncover root-cause and develop permanent resolution on issues found during product builds as required

• Identify and support improvement opportunities for product yield, quality, safety, cost and team efficiency

• Identify process automation opportunities and drive organizational efficiency improvements

• Organize and communicate the daily priorities to production coordinators, team leaders, and supervisors as required

• Provide daily visibility, weekly status, and monthly reviews on schedule performance

• Develop and analyze metrics that tie production to enterprise goals as required

• Lead the creation of scheduling tools and initiatives in support of Anduril’s overall scheduling maturation

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or 3 years of manufacturing scheduling experience

• U.S. Citizen Required

• Project management professional certification

• Must be available for all shifts, extended hours, and weekends as needed

• Must be able to lift 25 lbs. unassisted

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2 years of scheduling experience with MS Project or similar scheduling software

• 4 years of practical experience with ERP/MRP systems in a production environment

• Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma and Kaizen

US Salary Range

$93,000—$124,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
POS-33677

Application Deadline: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET

Please note: Due to close working relationships with teams in Ireland and the UK, we are only considering candidates who are located in the Eastern time zone (US).

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. On the Operations Web Team, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the systems behind HubSpot’s digital experiences are reliable, scalable, and built to grow with our customers. This is a highly visible team responsible for delivering innovative web platforms and applications that power HubSpot’s global brand and are experienced by millions every day.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll design and operate the infrastructure that supports high-traffic, data-intensive marketing platforms and systems. You'll also work across our Cloudflare edge platform, including opportunities to lead experiments and initiatives in areas like web personalization as they develop. You’ll partner closely with developers and stakeholders to improve delivery velocity while upholding strong standards for security, performance, and operational excellence. Together, we’re on a mission to build the best web experience in the world, and the reliability of our platforms is foundational to that goal.

What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure for high-traffic, business-critical applications, improving it through automation and observability.

• Operate and improve our Cloudflare edge platform (CDN, caching, WAF, DNS), and contribute to edge experiments and initiatives - such as traffic routing, staged rollouts, and personalization - as those efforts grow.

• Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews, ensuring learnings are translated into systemic improvements.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and establish and evolve infrastructure-as-code standards for consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

• Use AI-assisted tooling in day-to-day DevOps work and help the team adopt what proves valuable for reliability, delivery velocity, and cost efficiency.

• Own medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives from design through production, including documentation, runbooks and long-term support.

• Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap planning, helping prioritize infrastructure investments that improve reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.

• Evaluate technical trade-offs and clearly communicate risks, impact, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders across Web Development, QA, and Product.

• Support the growth of less-experienced engineers through informal mentoring, code review, and sharing best practices in DevOps and cloud architecture.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure-focused software engineering roles.

• Significant experience operating production systems in at least one major public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Practical experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

• Hands-on experience operating Cloudflare in production - CDN and caching, WAF, and DNS.

• Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed systems.

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experience operating large-scale, customer-facing, highly distributed systems in production.

• Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, and communication skills - able to drive complex issues to resolution, manage competing work with minimal oversight, and explain technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Experience designing, running, or measuring controlled changes at the edge (traffic splitting, staged rollouts, A/B testing, or personalization), including production experience with edge compute such as Cloudflare Workers, KV, or R2.

• Familiarity with web technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.

• Exposure to observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

• Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering or operations tools to improve productivity or system reliability.

• A collaborative approach to mentoring or supporting other engineers.

Where You’ll Work

• Location: United States (East Coast)

• Work location preference eligibility: Remote

• Travel/Shift: None

Application Requirements

• Applications must be submitted by: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET

• Applications must be submitted in: English

• Cover letters: Optional

Pay & Benefits

In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

$108,300—$162,500 USD

If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

Technical Execution Manager

Second Front Systems (2F) is seeking an ambitious Technical Execution Manager to join our mission-driven team. We are a dynamic, fast-growing entrepreneurial company at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and national security, committed to delivering transformative solutions that empower our nation’s defenders. This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of a company that is redefining the way software is delivered and secured in the defense sector.

At 2F, we thrive on innovation and purpose, combining a startup’s agility with a clear mission to support national security. You will be at the forefront of driving the implementation strategy behind the deployment and scaling of our revolutionary Game Warden platform—an industry-leading tool that is accelerating the secure adoption of mission-critical SaaS solutions for the U.S. government. If you’re ready to contribute to a team that values ingenuity, collaboration, and impact, we want to hear from you.

The Technical Execution Manager will lead the customer journey from kick off, onboarding to the platform, authorization and deployment to production.

Note: Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:
• DC/Maryland/Virginia
• Denver/Colorado Springs, CO

This is a full-time position.

What You'll Do
• Own end-to-end onboarding of customer applications onto Game Warden, including project planning, accreditation coordination, and production deployment.
• Serve as primary technical point of contact for customers, running kickoff sessions, technical working groups, and recurring status reviews.
• Coordinate the authorization workstream with Second Front Security to guide customer applications through RMF, FedRAMP, and DoW impact level IL2–IL6 accreditation processes.
• Drive comprehensive, continuously updated project plans that serve as the source of truth for customer deliverables and timeline.
• Identify, document, and escalate technical and operational risks with proposed solutions to engineering and leadership.
• Capture lessons learned from each implementation and feed them into Game Warden onboarding documentation, process improvements, and product roadmap recommendations.

 
 

What You Bring
• 5+ years of technical project management, implementation delivery, or customer-facing software program execution in regulated or complex environments.
• Working knowledge of containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architecture on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Strong understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
• Demonstrated familiarity with federal software authorization—RMF, NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, ATO processes, and DoW impact level requirements.
• Experience with vulnerability scanning, CVE remediation, and continuous security monitoring concepts.

We eliminate the friction that slows innovation, enabling faster, more secure development and deployment of software across government and regulated networks. Built by national security veterans and backed by top-tier venture capital, our platform is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to cut deployment timelines from years to weeks. We move fast, solve hard problems, and deliver trusted capabilities where they’re needed most. CURIOUS HOW AI COULD RESHAPE THE WAY ACCOUNTING TEAMS WORK — AND WANT TO BE THE ONE WHO BUILDS IT?



Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for an Accounting Manager to be part of our Finance department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.



The team:

The Finance team at Jobber is responsible for anything money-related, helping us plan, budget, and implement Jobber's best ideas.



The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager will drive the accounting projects that make the rest of the function better. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, working in focused sprints — you sit outside the day-to-day general ledger close, but you understand it deeply enough to improve it. You're known for your curiosity, your bias to action, and your ability to turn an ambiguous question into a documented, defensible answer.



The Accounting Manager will:

 - Own technical accounting expertise, serving as the go-to resource for new or complex transactions — think revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), stock compensation (ASC 718), business combinations, and capitalized software.

 - Lead our controls mapping work, connecting risks to controls, documenting how our processes run, and identifying gaps — building the internal control framework that lets us scale with confidence.

 - Bring a strong working knowledge of the month-end and year-end close, without owning it, so you can map controls and redesign processes with a real understanding of how they run.

 - Collaborate across Finance and other departments to deliver projects with cross-functional impact, and act as a resource for our Finance-owned tools.

 - Reimagine our accounting processes with AI, redesigning workflows around what Company-approved AI and automation tools make possible — building processes that are faster and better controlled, while applying professional judgement and human review to every output.



To be successful, you should have:

 - Your CPA designation, with strong knowledge of US GAAP; SEC reporting experience is strongly preferred.

 - Significant accounting experience, including time in public practice, with a track record of technical accounting research and documentation of process and controls.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the judgement to make decisions based on accurate, timely analysis.

 - Solid project management instincts — the ability to scope ambiguous work, sequence it, and drive it to the finish line on your own.

 - Coachability and adaptability, with the flexibility to thrive amid change and experimentation in a growing organization.

 - A genuine team player who collaborates widely, champions best practices, and rolls up their sleeves when it's all hands on deck.

 - Experience working with a SaaS company is an asset.

OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application deadline and instructions :

• Please complete and submit your application by 11:59 pm EST on Monday, December 7th, 2026

• Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a Business desk and what you envision the top focus areas should be for the desk in 2027.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Chief Business Editor has overall operational and editorial responsibility for business and economics coverage on all platforms. This editor supervises assignments and provides editorial guidance to a team of business reporters, correspondents and editors across the country. The position also advises NPR shows, including Morning Edition and All Things Considered, and coordinates editorial content closely with the Planet Money podcast team. This includes preparation of material on all platforms, overseeing the editorial integrity and quality of content, monitoring and evaluating staff performance, recommending new hires and providing editorial support to the Executive Editor.  This position will be responsible for a team and report to the Executive Editor.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

• Leads NPR’s business coverage through a combination of distinctive stories, daily news, enterprise and scoops

• Identifies and sharpen areas of coverage across broadcast and digital platforms

• Supervises assignments and provide editorial guidance to staff, station and freelance reporters, and production staff

• Works across the newsroom to determine the best approaches to stories, subjects to be discussed and treated, and individuals to be interviewed

• Tracks station, freelance and staff submissions and assignments.

• Ensures that speculative submissions from stations and freelancers are auditioned to determine suitability for airing.

• Regularly has critical discussions about pieces with reporters and editors, and with the Executive Editor, as appropriate.

• Makes hiring and salary recommendations for staff members under his or her supervision, in consultation with the Executive Editor.

• Responsible for preparing performance reviews for assigned staff members.

• Assists in planning and monitoring the business unit’s annual budgets and in monitoring current spending.

• Coordinates business unit staff schedules, submits and approves time sheets and maintains other personnel records as needed.

• Responsible for tracking overtime and travel expenditures.

• Ensures that all material aired and published meets the highest journalistic standards and practices, including standards of accuracy, fairness and probity.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

• A minimum of 15 years’ experience as a news reporter or editor, including demonstrated experience covering business and economics

• Demonstrated experience overseeing editorial output for social media and digital platforms

• Demonstrated collaborative approach to newsgathering and story presentation across platforms

• Considerable skill in both news and feature editing

Preferred Qualifications

• Broadcast and specifically radio news experience

• Familiarity with the NPR member station network

Required Skills/Competencies

• Previous managerial experience

Education Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience

Work Location & Requirements

• Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C., New York City, or Culver City location at least 3 days a week.

Job Type

• This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $190,000-215,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.

Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front.

Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur.

Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.

Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre.



Ce que tu vas faire chez nous

 - Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production.

 - Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler.

 - PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité.

 - Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes.

 - Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs.

 - Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi.

Ce qui t'attend techniquement

 - Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo

 - Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry

 - Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour



Profil recherché

 - 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs.

 - Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps.

 - Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run.

 - Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework.

 - Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion.

 - Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique.

 - Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite.

 - Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs.



Processus de recrutement

 - Echange RH

 - Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe

 - Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO

 - Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs

 - Prise de référence et offre



Conditions

 - Salaire: 50-65 k€ selon expérience

 - Télétravail: full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie)

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Senior Associate
jobs.description:
We’re leading the way in redefining the workwear category. Our mission is to engineer better boots and apparel for our country’s tradesmen and women by working directly with real workers to learn what they actually need to execute their jobs.

The BRUNT team is not only devoted to improving on the old workwear standards, but we’re also creating a community that tradesmen and women can call their own. From our weekly hangouts at the BRUNT Garage, to hosting events across the country, we’re all about getting boots on the ground and building something real with the BRUNT crew.

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for an organized, energetic Marketing Operations Senior Associate to report directly to our Chief of Staff and support the day-to-day rhythm of our marketing team. You will collaborate closely across Brand, Growth, Creative, Product, Retail, Customer Service, and Operations to keep our projects moving forward.

You will manage project workflows in Monday.com, organize digital asset distribution in Brandfolder, coordinate physical sample logistics via EZO, and facilitate cross-functional campaign execution to keep launches on track.

How You’ll Do It:

Systems & Workflow Management

• Manage and optimize our Monday.com workspace, building boards, automations, and cross-functional dashboards that are intuitive, easy to follow, and up to date.

• Serve as the go-to Monday.com resource for the marketing team, sharing best practices that keep projects accurate and workflows smooth.

• Co-manage Brandfolder (our Digital Asset Management platform), ensuring photography, creative assets, and collateral are organized and accessible for internal teams and external partners.

Cross-Functional Project Management

• Partner with marketing leadership to guide high-visibility initiatives across Growth, Brand, Creative, and Digital Product from concept through launch.

• Track milestones, spot dependencies early, clear bottlenecks, and keep deliverables moving forward.

• Act as an enabler for the team by providing the right context, tools, and shared resources so stakeholders can make fast, confident decisions and do their best work.

• Lead regular project check-ins as an approachable, trusted partner. We value practical, lightweight operations. Your focus will be on removing hurdles and helping teams move smoothly rather than adding heavy processes.

Creative & Product Launch Coordination

• Partner closely with Creative to map out upcoming product drops and their asset needs (e-commerce photography, naming, packaging, and labeling).

• Collaborate with the Product team to draft, format, organize, and distribute standardized technical specification sheets (tech sheets).

• Empower teams to do their best work by connecting the dots across departments, sharing key context, and equipping contributors with self-serve tools.

• Maintain a central source of truth for go-to-market dates, product details, and campaign assets across the marketing team.

Compensation

$65,000—$92,000 USD

jobs.title: Business Development – Mining Pool & Firmware
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Luxor is a full-stack platform for the Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure industries. We build software, hardware, financial, and energy solutions that help mining operators improve performance, manage risk, optimize costs, and scale their operations.

Location: Miami, FL or San Francisco, CA, in office. Our Miami office opens in Q1 2027; until then, Miami-based hires work remotely with regular customer travel.
Start: Immediately
Reports to: SVP, Business Development




ABOUT THE ROLE

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods, and one person owns each pod's revenue. We're hiring the person who will own Mining Pool & Firmware, the core of Luxor's Bitcoin mining business.

 - Luxor Mining Pool has operated since 2017 and serves institutional miners with >50 EH/s across BTC, LTC, DOGE and ZEC. It offers FPPS payouts, fixed and upfront payout options, and SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II controls, and it has paid 35,000+ BTC to miners in 113 countries.

 - LuxOS is our custom ASIC firmware for Antminer and WhatsMiner fleets. Per-domain autotuning, power targeting and fast curtailment help operators get more hashrate per joule and respond to the grid. Paired with Luxor Pool, it gives miners one integrated stack.

This is a mature, competitive market. Winning here means displacing incumbents at a fee that makes money and respects the quality of our product. We care about profitable market share, not market share at any price.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Pool & Firmware revenue and the quarterly targets you agree with leadership.

 - Hunt and close new hashrate: public miners, large private operators, hosting providers and international fleets.

 - Lead commercial negotiations on pool fees, firmware fee tiers, payout structures and referral partnerships, while protecting margin.

 - Run firmware pilots end to end with our customer success and firmware engineering teams, and turn test results into signed fleet-wide deployments.

 - Build the partner channel: hosting providers, repair shops, resellers and referral partners who bring hashrate with them.

 - Bundle across the stack (Pool, LuxOS, Commander, hashrate derivatives) to win deals that single-product competitors can't.

 - Spend 80%+ of your time external: customer sites, industry events, in-person meetings.

 - Keep a clean pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, and bring competitive intelligence back to product.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in B2B sales, business development or commercial roles, with a record of deals you personally sourced and closed.

 - Bitcoin mining industry experience: you understand pools (FPPS vs. PPS vs. PPLNS), ASICs, hashprice and fleet economics, and you know the major players.

 - An existing network among mining operators is a strong plus.

 - Experience with firmware, mining infrastructure or hosting is a plus.

 - A strong negotiator who can hold a price and walk away from a bad deal.

 - Willingness to work in office in Miami or SF and travel regularly to customer sites and industry events.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

 - You've won business against entrenched incumbents and know how to make switching feel low-risk.

 - You want to own a product line, not just a territory.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You prefer to set strategy and hand deals to someone else to close.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base plus uncapped, gross-profit-based commission.

 - Ownership of Luxor's core business line, with direct access to leadership.

 - The broadest product stack in mining to build deals with.

 - Health, dental and vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO.



At Luxor we believe that meaningful contributions can be made by anyone. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Luxor welcomes all!


HOW WE USE AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use AI tools to support certain parts of our hiring process, and we believe in being transparent about how they’re used.

During your application, AI may assist in reviewing CVs, qualifications, and assignments by providing additional insights, but it does not make decisions, every application is evaluated at each step by a member of our hiring team.

We also use AI to transcribe interviews so our team can stay focused on the conversation rather than note-taking. Any voice recordings are automatically deleted within 15 days.

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods:

 - Hardware & Logistics: ASIC procurement, brokerage and global logistics.

 - Hashrate Derivatives: hashprice hedges, fixed payouts and financing.

 - Mining Pool & Firmware: institutional Bitcoin mining pool and LuxOS firmware.

jobs.description:

ABOUT THE ROLE

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods, and one person owns each pod's revenue. We're hiring the person who will own Energy & Commander, our fastest-growing product surface and our biggest untapped opportunity.

 - Luxor Energy is a Bitcoin-native retail electric provider (REP) in ERCOT and a QSE expanding into SPP. We help large flexible loads cut power costs and earn from their flexibility through competitive retail supply, demand response (ERS), ancillary services, 4CP avoidance and CRR credit maximization. Miners can post collateral in BTC or settle power bills directly from pool earnings.

 - Luxor Commander is our fleet management platform, already running on roughly 500 MW of mining infrastructure. It gives operators real-time monitoring, remote control and automated curtailment that responds to hashprice and energy prices.

Texas and SPP are full of miners and other large loads heading into supply renewals. Your job is to turn that footprint into revenue.

This is a hunter-closer seat. Our energy, operations and product teams will support you, but you own the pipeline, the number and the close.

 - Source and close new REP, QSE and demand-response business with Bitcoin miners, data centers and other large flexible loads in ERCOT and SPP.

 - Convert Commander's free and trial users to paid, and pair Commander with energy contracts so they sell as one deal.

 - Get ahead of the renewal calendar: know when every target site's power contract renews, and be in the room 6+ months out.

 - Build and work broker and channel relationships, while growing a direct RFP flow.

 - Run the full cycle: outbound, discovery, pricing (adders, DR revenue shares, term structures), proposals, negotiation and close.

 - Spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers and partners, including on-site visits and industry events.

 - Bring what you learn in the market back to product: what customers want, what competitors charge and where the openings are.

 - A working understanding of US power markets: retail supply, adders, index vs. fixed pricing, demand response and ancillary services. ERCOT and/or SPP experience is a strong plus.

 - Comfort selling technical, consultative products to senior operators, CFOs and energy managers.

 - A network among miners, data center operators, brokers or energy market participants is a plus.

 - Exposure to Bitcoin mining, ASICs or mining management software is a plus.

 - Willingness to work in office in Miami and travel regularly to customer sites and events.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

 - You'd rather own a number than a strategy deck.

 - You get energy from connecting with a net new site and turning it into a signed contract.

 - You prefer to set strategy and hand deals to someone else to close.

 - Real ownership: you are accountable for two product lines.

jobs.title: NPI Director- Operations Readiness
jobs.description:
Role

The NPI Director - Operations Readiness is accountable for Operations readiness across each workflow as well as for cross-functional, strategic product & offer launches and accelerating GTM success. The role will be instrumental in ensuring operational readiness across key enterprise processes, in particular working closely with Product Management, Monetization, Legal, Compliance, Revenue, Sales Operations, Deal Desk and other operations teams, to ensure transactability for innovation launching into market.  In addition, this role will drive continuous improvement in operational readiness, and a scaled operating model to deliver quality outcomes that accelerate sales and customer outcomes. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of working with GTM business processes, tools, and operations, leading cross-functional teams, and transforming processes to that operational scale to support speed of product innovation.  In addition, candidates with roles supporting selling organizations through systems and processes will be highly favorable. The successful candidate is a results-driven leader across both direct and matrixed teams, who brings a strategic approach and thought leadership to achieve desired business outcomes.  In addition, the selected candidate has demonstrated process excellence, operational rigor and continuous delivery of improvements with measurable impact.

What you get to do in this role

• Lead NPI & GTM readiness for operations, refining & optimizing processes for strategic products, including new business models
• Influence and work cross-functionally to align functional plans, identifying, and actively managing risks and issues to resolution to ensure successful launch
• Ensuring comprehensive planning across sales & ops processes (goal to commission, lead to cash, account planning, deal lifecycle) and tools (CPQ, CLM, Dashboards) across all sales roles
• Define & manage KPI’s (leading, lagging indicators) for operations success
• Accountable for identifying and driving action plans cross-functionally to improve processes and KPI’s
• Mobilize and lead a variety of initiatives, including digitization and automation projects
• Develop, manage and execute detailed project plans that consider all requirements, constraints, resources, and deliverables associated with the defined objectives
• Drive projects from inception to completion, ensuring all workstream deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and with quality
• Conduct thorough and detailed analysis to produce data driven recommendations to enable leadership decisions
• Deliver progress updates to stakeholders and leadership
• Continuously apply a customer / partner lens across the customer journey to identify and execute optimization opportunities to improve NPI objectives

Our ideal candidate

• Experienced leader – both matrixed and people management
• Desired: Master’s in Business, Product Management, or Operations and 10+ years of related experience
• Proven experience in launching SaaS offers, with expertise in lead to cash, goal to commission, and idea to offer processes
• Superb leadership and influencing skills; ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally, including challenge the status quo and developing mindshare to drive towards a common goal
• Ability to motivate others, drive collaboration, teaming & resolve conflict between diverse stakeholder groups
• Strong program/project management skills & strong facilitation skills
• Excellent people leadership skills and experience; ability to build strong, diverse, high performing teams
• Highly analytical, fact driven, and process-oriented mindset
• Ability to conduct meaningful analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable messages and deliverables
• Thrives in fast-paced environment, adept at managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment to drive results
• Well-versed in SaaS business processes and customer lifecycle.
• Combination of strong intellect, exceptional active listening skills, and creative problem solving skills
• Excellent verbal & written communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information that can be easily consumed by various executive audiences

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $165,600 - $289,800, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Center-Based Child Autism Specialist- We Train You
jobs.description:
Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Career growth: Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis.

• Perks: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) mental health support and retail discounts through our Benefit Hub.

What you'll do

Working under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), you will:

• Provide one-on-one ABA therapy to children with autism at home or in our centers.

• Teach communication, social, and daily living skills with positive reinforcement.

• Help children work through challenging behaviors calmly and safely.

• Record session data on a company-provided tablet.

• Keep sessions fun, engaging, and focused on each child's goals.

What you need

• 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED.

• Valid ID and reliable transportation for in-home sessions.

• Ability to pass a background check and complete a TB test and CPR/First Aid course (we cover the cost).

• Ability to stay active with kids and move in various positions: bending, squatting, kneeling, sitting on the floor, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

• Patience, empathy, and a positive attitude.

What happens after you apply

We move fast. You'll complete online modules, a CPR class, a TB test, and a background check, and your onboarding specialist will guide you through each step.

Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.

jobs.title: Center-Based Registered Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Career growth: Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis.

• Perks: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) mental health support and retail discounts through our Benefit Hub.

What you'll do

Working under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), you will:

• Provide one-on-one ABA therapy to children with autism at home or in our centers.

• Teach communication, social, and daily living skills with positive reinforcement.

• Help children work through challenging behaviors calmly and safely.

• Record session data on a company-provided tablet.

• Keep sessions fun, engaging, and focused on each child's goals.

What you need

• 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED.

• Valid ID and reliable transportation for in-home sessions.

• Ability to pass a background check and complete a TB test and CPR/First Aid course (we cover the cost).

• Ability to stay active with kids and move in various positions: bending, squatting, kneeling, sitting on the floor, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

• Patience, empathy, and a positive attitude.

What happens after you apply

We move fast. You'll complete online modules, a CPR class, a TB test, and a background check, and your onboarding specialist will guide you through each step.

Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.
