jobs.title: Material Flow Supervisor
jobs.description:
Material Flow Supervisor

Company: Greenworks Tools

Location: Morristown, TN

Job Type: Full-time

Lead the Flow That Powers the Future of Green Equipment

Ready to step into a leadership role where your decisions keep a fast-growing factory moving? At Greenworks Tools, the materials you manage become the battery-powered mowers, side-by-sides, and utility vehicles that are changing how the world gets work done. As our Material Flow Supervisor, you'll lead a hands-on team, keep production running, and see the impact of your work roll off the line every day.

Who We Are

Greenworks Tools is a leader in battery-powered outdoor power equipment for DIY consumers and landscaping professionals. Our vehicles division builds everything from commercial and residential riding mowers to off-road side-by-sides and utility vehicles. With best-in-class battery, control, and drive technology, we deliver the power and performance of gas equipment without the fumes, noise, vibration, and mess. We're growing fast, and we're looking for dynamic leaders who want to help bring cutting-edge green technology to market.

Why You'll Love This Role

• Lead a real team. Coach, schedule, and develop warehouse associates, material handlers, and forklift drivers, and help them grow.

• Be at the center of production. Nothing gets built without the right materials in the right place at the right time. That's you.

• Shape how we work. Help lead kaizen events,5Saudits, and flow improvements that make a visible difference.

• Get in on the ground floor of new products. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) trials and see new designs come to life.

• Grow with a growing company. Join a high-energy, high-growth environment in a market that's moving toward a cleaner, quieter future.

What You'll Do

• Keep materials moving smoothly through the facility by executing material flow plans aligned with production schedules and lean manufacturing goals.

• Supervise receiving, put away, staging, and shipping so inbound and outbound freight is accurate and on time.

• Maintain kanban and replenishment systems, and spot and escalate shortages before they slow the line.

• Drive inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, and variance investigations.

• Partner daily with Production, Quality, Purchasing, and Engineering to hit operational goals.

• Use ERP and MES systems to track inventory, material movement, and logistics performance.

• Build a safety-first culture by leading safety talks, enforcing forklift/PIT, PPE, and housekeeping standards, and following OSHA requirements.

• Coach your team with regular feedback, training, and clear expectations, and work with HR on hiring and employee relations.

What You Bring

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 2+ years of experience in materials management, internal logistics, warehouse operations, or manufacturing

• Working knowledge of receiving, shipping, and freight processes

• Familiarity with lean principles such as 5S, kanban, and standard work

• Comfort with ERP and warehouse management systems

• Forklift/PIT certification, or the ability to obtain it

• Strong communication, team leadership, and problem-solving skills

Bonus Points If You Have

• An Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field

• 1+ year of lead or supervisory experience

• A background in consumer products, power equipment, automotive, or other high-volume manufacturing

• Experience thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Work Environment

• Active, hands-on role in a manufacturing and warehouse setting, with frequent standing, walking, and time on the production floor

• Ability to lift 30lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation

• Required PPE per company safety policy

What's In It for You

• Health, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid sick time, paid vacation, and company holidays

Ready to lead the flow? Apply today. If you're a hands-on leader who loves solving problems, building strong teams, and keeping things moving, we'd love to meet you. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. Join Greenworks Tools and help power a more sustainable future.

Greenworks Tools is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, veteran status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability （in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act） with respect to employment opportunities.

jobs.title: IT Knowledge Management Analyst
jobs.description:
About Cook Systems

For over 30 years, Cook Systems has partnered with organizations across the country to solve technology challenges and build strong technology teams. As a veteran-owned IT consulting company, we combine decades of industry experience with a continued focus on how technology, AI, and the way people work are evolving.

Our work spans technology consulting, talent development, and AI-enabled solutions. We value people who take ownership, adapt quickly, communicate well, and care about the quality of their work. Whether you’re early in your career or bringing years of experience, you’ll have the opportunity to keep building your skills, contribute to meaningful client work, and grow with a company that continues to evolve with the industry.

IT Knowledge Management Analyst

Memphis, TN (hybrid/3 days onsite)

6 months (should be extended, work orders are issued in six-month increments)

The IT Knowledge Management Analyst enables our technology teams to create, organize, and maintain high-quality information. Working closely with Sr. Advisor for Knowledge Management, the analyst will operationalize Knowledge Management standards and best practices to improve our knowledge from multiple perspectives: accuracy, consistency, findability, and usability, etc.

To support our ongoing AI Adoption, this person will also leverage AI agents to assess knowledge at scale, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and support ongoing knowledge health. The ideal analyst is detail-oriented with strong writing skills.

They can flexibly apply experience in Knowledge Management, AI enablement, governance, and continuous improvement to ensure trusted knowledge is accessible to employees and optimized for AI-powered discovery and reuse.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Partner with teams to establish sustainable knowledge-management practices, ownership, standards, and lifecycle processes to govern policies, procedures, SharePoint lists and other technical documentation.

Manage standard knowledge activities including reviews, remediation, consolidation, archival, and retirement of outdated content.

Develop and apply knowledge-quality rubrics measuring accuracy, completeness, clarity, consistency, findability, and ownership.

Build and leverage AI agents to evaluate knowledge against established rubrics, identify gaps, and recommend improvements.

Design testing methodologies to validate agent evaluations for accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness in documentation and prompts.

Improve knowledge structure, metadata, organization, searchability, and suitability for AI retrieval and reuse.

Self Starter capable of multitasking and prioritizing individual and collaborative work.

Detail oriented in writing and editing technical documentation with clarity to promote self-service and consistency.

REQUIREMENTS:

1-3 years of related experience.

Education in IT, Information Systems, Management Information Systems (MIS); Technical Communication / Professional Writing or experience with Knowledge Management / Information Management

Familiarity or previous background in AI agents, content governance, analytical problem-solving

Enterprise knowledge platforms such as Confluence, SharePoint, or Microsoft 365

Experience working with and maturing a taxonomy or knowledge/info architecture for ease of usability by people with and without AI assistance

Additional considerations for candidates with 1-3 yrs experience in IT if also paired with background in Library and Information Science or Social Sciences

Benefits at Cook Systems

We want our employees to have benefits that support their health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Eligible Cook Systems employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package beginning the first of the month following their hire date, including:

• Medical coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield, with two plan options

• Dental and vision coverage

• Life, critical illness, and accident insurance through Unum

• Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care FSA options through Navia

• Health Gap Insurance through Sun Life

• 401(k) retirement plan through The Standard, with eligibility after six months

Beyond benefits, Cook Systems is a place where we expect people to take ownership of their work, communicate openly, continue learning, and contribute to the teams and clients they support.

We have been building technology careers and client partnerships for more than three decades, and we continue to evolve with the industry. If you’re looking for an opportunity to do meaningful work, develop your capabilities, and be part of what comes next in technology, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff/Principal Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
STAFF/PRINCIPAL FULLSTACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Location: Mountain View, CA | Hybrid, 2 days/week in office




ABOUT US:

WitnessAI is the unified AI security and governance platform enterprises trust to govern and protect all AI activity. We provide complete, network-level visibility into every interaction including employees and autonomous agents, even in native apps where legacy tools are blind. Unlike security that relies on outdated keywords, our platform understands intent, enabling intelligent policies that stop novel threats like prompt injection while empowering productivity. WitnessAI transforms security from a bottleneck into the enabler of your AI strategy as the confidence layer for enterprise AI.


THE ROLE

This is a Staff/Principal role with org-wide scope. You’ll work hand in hand with the Head of Product Engineering on technical strategy and help grow the engineers around you. That work centers on our web platform, which customers rely on to see, control, and secure AI activity across their company. You’ll shape its architecture end to end, from the React UI to the Go/Rust services and data stores behind it.

This is an individual contributor role, and you’ll be in good company: nobody here has stopped coding. We all ship code every day alongside our AI Agents, which feels fitting to a team whose job is keeping AI in check. You’ll lead technical work across the stack, from the UI to the ingress pipeline and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentoring, and the example you set in your own code.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architecture. Design and own the end-to-end architecture of the product application: frontend, APIs, services, and data model. Write ADRs for the big decisions and see them through to production.

 - Build across the stack. Ship features in full-stack TypeScript (React Router), Rust and Go services. Take a feature from a rough idea to a running release.

 - API and data design. Define API contracts and schemas that stay stable as the platform and customer base grow. Own multi-tenant concerns like isolation, performance, and migrations.

 - Performance and reliability. Find and fix bottlenecks in page load, query time, and service latency. Set standards for testing, observability, and release safety.

 - Make complex data usable. Work with product and design to turn dense security and policy data into dashboards and workflows that a busy admin can understand in seconds.

 - Technical leadership. Lead design reviews, review code across teams, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers. Settle technical disagreements with clear reasoning.

 - Cross-team work. Partner with product, design, platform, and security engineers to plan and deliver work that spans teams. Break large projects into pieces others can pick up.

 - Hands-on AI work. Be an advocate for building an AI native SDLC and PDLC with associated tooling.
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years building production web applications, with at least 3 years in a senior, staff, or principal technical leadership role.

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Experience with React Router or Remix, or another server-rendered full-stack framework.

 - Strong backend skills. Production experience with Go or a comparable language, and with building services and REST or GraphQL APIs.

 - Solid SQL and data modeling skills. Experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS.

 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, and of CI/CD pipelines.

 - Demonstrated mastery in architecture design, enterprise scalability, and cross-domain tech stacks.


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A STELLAR CANDIDATE

 - You have owned a platform, not just features. You can point to a system you designed, ran in production, and lived with for years, including the parts you would change.

 - You are equally good at the UI and the service behind it. You care about what a user sees and about what happens to the request after they click.

 - You have built for enterprise customers. You know what role-based access, audit logs, and tenant isolation require, and you plan for them early.

 - You write things down. Your design docs and ADRs are clear enough that someone new can follow the reasoning a year later.

 - You have shipped with LLM APIs or AI-assisted tooling. You have a view on where it helps and where it does not.

 - You have worked in a startup. You are comfortable with unclear scope and changing priorities, and you pick a direction and move.




WHY THIS ROLE

 - You set the technical direction for the product application at a company growing fast in AI security.

 - Enterprise customers use what you build to govern real AI activity, so the work matters from day one.

 - You work directly with product, design, and the CEO's leadership team, with few layers between you and the decision.

 - The problems are new. AI security has no settled playbook, and you help write it.




BENEFITS:

 - Hybrid work environment

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) plan

 - Opportunities for professional development and growth

 - Generous vacation policy


SALARY:

$216,000 - $274,000 (The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.)

jobs.title: Commercial Manager
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

This position serves the local commercial lead of a greenfield soybean processing plant in Ohio.  This role will be critical in developing and maintaining effective relationships with the local farm community, feed buyers and logistics providers including truck carriers and both short-line and Class 1 railroads.  Role will be expected to foster a professional and collaborative atmosphere between the commercial, industry and quality management of the facility

Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions

• Leads local commercial & administrative team and drives team’s professional development
• Oversees the execution of the soybean origination strategy from the local farm & commercial supply base
• Develops and fosters commercial relationships with suppliers & customers to expand market opportunities
• Serves as the primary local liaison between the commercial team and the industry group
• Communicates commercial priorities on grain receiving and product load with industry group
• Coordinates and leads the team effort of managing LDC’s private hopper and tanker car fleet
• Aligns with the operations team regarding expectations and forward plans for railcar receipts & shipments
• Maintains strong relationships with both the short line and Class 1 railroad representatives
• Collaborates across commercial, operations, and logistics functions to optimize business performance, improve operational efficiency and reliability, and consistently meet product quality, safety, and customer service expectations
• Serve as a visible company representative in the community, developing strategic relationships with local leaders, agricultural partners, industry organizations, schools, and other stakeholders to strengthen community engagement, promote the business, and support long-term growth
• Develops & maintains local supply/demand balance sheets for use in shaping soybean procurement effort
• Distributes daily/weekly market wires to regional group recapping relevant trade highlights
• Actively participates in regularly scheduled market calls, internal market chats and balance sheet discussions
• Ensures team’s timely entry of trades into position management system and validates daily positions
• Assists in business analysis for internal and external implementation
• Participates in strategic planning discussions

Additional Responsibilities

• Responsible for recruiting, hiring and developing a strong and talented local team.
• Provides regular performance feedback to direct reports, ensuring individuals are rewarded for performance.
• Enhances LDC’s brand awareness in the local area through community engagement and outreach
• Coordinates and facilitates supplier customer visits on both the soybean and product side
• Commercial lead on KPIs, daily production report and other internally produced industrial reports
• Stays abreast of all company, federal, state and local laws, regulations tied to grain handling to ensure compliance
• Gathers news, statistics and information related to individual commodity supply and demand from customers and trade sources and distributes that information to the broader group to support overall strategic trading/positioning
• Actively supports the Company’s Safety, Health and Environmental systems and objectives
• Follows updates to & ensures compliance with NGFA, NOPA, etc oil trade rule developments
• Other duties as assigned

Company Conformance Statements

In the performance of their respective tasks and duties all employees are expected to conform to the following:

• Perform quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision.
• Interact professionally with co-workers, Company business associates and the general public.
• Works together in a cooperative spirit to serve the best interests of the Company.
• Operate in a fully responsible manner and comply with the law and Company policy.

Education/Professional Certifications/Licenses

Basic qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Agricultural Economics, Finance, Business Administration

Experience

Basic qualifications:

• 10 years of experience in the Grains and Oilseeds industry
• Prior experience managing larger teams & management experience in an operations/industry capacity
• Full level of comfort with logistics and inventory management around a larger production facility
• Thorough understanding of balance sheet analysis, position management & P&L reporting
• Prior experience interacting with rail class 1 railroads

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities (including any physical demands)

Basic qualifications:

• Knows the competitive landscape and is aware of how strategies and tactics work in the marketplace
• Knowledgeable in current and possible future policies, practices, trends, technology and information affecting the grain and export business
• Builds appropriate rapport with farm community, and employees using diplomacy and tact
• Effectively defuses high-tension situations comfortably
• Negotiates skillfully in tough situations with both internal and external groups
• Quickly gains trust of other parties in negotiations
• Steadfastly pushes self and others for results
• Communicates clearly in both verbal and written form and can set clear direction and stretch goals for individuals and teams
• Maintains two-way dialog with others on work and results
• Monitors workloads and recognizes and easily expresses appreciation for extra effort
• Constructs compelling developmental plans and assists in their execution
• Clearly and comfortably delegates both routine and important tasks and decisions to individuals and teams
• Shares wins and successes and creates a team atmosphere
• Proficient with spreadsheets, word-processing software and web-based applications (e.g., MS Office Suite, SharePoint)
• Must be able to periodically work outdoors and lift small objects
• Must have valid driver’s license

Equipment Used

• Telephone, Photocopier, Personal Computer, Calculator
• Other handheld tools

Employee Supervision

• Oversees local commercial and administrative staff

Decision Making/Accountability

• The position is accountable for the supervision of the local commercial, logistics and clerical office staff
• This position will also be accountable for the development and maintenance of positive relationships with the local farm community, and employees and employee groups.
• Prioritizes work schedule to meet deadlines and continuously adjusts priorities to meet unexpected problems; works with little supervision and consults with supervisor regarding unusual problems or occurrences.
• The incumbent will also complete various projects and duties as assigned by their immediate manager.
• Occasional travel required.

Safety, Health & Environmental Responsibilities

Is an active member of the facility SHE Program. Maintains good working knowledge of SHE policies, rules and procedures applicable to area of responsibility and ensures all applicable requirements are adhered to. Ensures employees are provided required training for area assigned, and jobs and tasks prior to assigning work. Ensures area of responsibility is maintained in orderly and safe manner. Ensures unsafe working conditions are remedied as soon as practicable.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer | Luma
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

Dotmatics is seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team working on ground-breaking Scientific Software products such as Luma.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to help improve our processes, infrastructure and security by applying best practices with the latest technologies. You will be AI fluent and know how AI influences engineering and DevOps

In this role you will get to:

• Design and manage CI/CD and deployment pipelines for both AWS-native and Kubernetes-based applications

• Provide advice/assistance to the product teams, clarifying requirements for deployment

• Collaborate with product teams on cloud and container best practices

• Manage IT infrastructure in cloud computing environments

• Automation: Use CI tools to automate code changes, builds, testing, and analysis

• Monitoring: Monitor performance after release

• Develop and improve monitoring systems for automated alerts

• Strategy: Design and manage the DevOps infrastructure, pipelines, and processes

• SECURITY: Embed security into every stage of the delivery lifecycle (DevSecOps), including automated SAST, DAST, dependency, secrets, and container image scanning in CI/CD pipelines

• SECURITY: Implement and enforce least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, encryption in transit and at rest, and secrets management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, KMS)

• SECURITY: Harden Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments using policy-as-code, admission controls, runtime protection, and CIS/NIST benchmarks

• SECURITY: Support vulnerability management, incident response, audit readiness, and compliance efforts (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001)

• AI: Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate pipeline development, infrastructure code, troubleshooting, and incident analysis

• AI: Apply AI/ML-driven capabilities to monitoring, including anomaly detection, alert noise reduction, and automated root-cause analysis

• AI: Build and operate deployment pipelines and infrastructure for AI/ML and LLM-based workloads, including model serving, GPU-enabled clusters, and cost controls

• AI: Establish guardrails for responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data privacy, access controls, and review of AI-generated code and configuration

We are looking for people who have 8+ years of experience maintaining high-traffic applications and complex technical infrastructure. You will be someone with a proven background in supporting cloud environments, with hands-on experience translating AWS Well-Architected principles into action.

The key skills we are looking for:

• Kubernetes clusters/customer cloud environments

• AWS (ECS, EKS, ALB, EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront, Route53, etc.)

• Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

• CI/CD tools (Octopus Deploy, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity, CodePipeline, etc.)

• APMs and logging (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, ELK, App Insights)

• Networking concepts in cloud environments

• Software development lifecycle processes/version control

• Security: DevSecOps practices, AWS security services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Config, KMS), container and supply chain security (image signing, SBOMs), and security scanning tools (e.g. Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov)

• Security: Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, network policies, Pod Security Standards, OPA/Kyverno) and secrets management

• AI: Practical experience using AI coding and operations assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Amazon Q) to improve engineering productivity

• AI: Understanding of how to deploy and operate AI/ML workloads (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, model-serving on Kubernetes) and observe their performance and cost

• AI: Awareness of AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and insecure AI-generated code

You may also have:

• Scripting languages (e.g. Python, Bash)

• Linux administration and networking (e.g. HTTP/2)

• Microservice and serverless architectures

• Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g. Argo CD, Flux)

• Experience building internal tooling or agents that apply AI to DevOps workflows (e.g. automated incident triage, ChatOps)

• Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, CKA/CKS)

• Databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)

• Exposure to AI-enabled tooling or workflows, with openness to incorporating AI into day-to-day work

Total Rewards

Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

Other Total Rewards Offered

• Medical, Dental, Vision, Insurance

• Health Spending Accounts

• Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)

• Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance

• 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting)

• Flexible Time off Plan (for US exempt employees)

This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

Base Pay Range

$122,187—$165,311 USD

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector - New Berlin, Wisconsin
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Quality Inspector -KNES

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Quality Inspector is responsible for performing dimensional, visual, and other required inspections of incoming parts, materials, and components to verify conformance with applicable drawings, specifications, purchase order requirements, and quality requirements. The position performs inspections using appropriate precision measuring and test equipment, documents inspection results and nonconformances, and supports supplier quality and continuous improvement activities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Review drawings, specifications, tolerances, and other technical requirements necessary to determine product acceptance.

· Perform dimensional inspections using a Romer portable CMM arm and other precision measuring and test equipment, including micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, height/depth gauges, hardness testers, protractors, and radius gauges, and ensure equipment is properly used and cared for.

· Support investigation of product quality issues and provide objective inspection data to assist with nonconformance and corrective action activities.

· Participate in supplier visits or source inspection activities when required.

· Follow established procedures, work instructions, safety requirements, and applicable quality requirements.

· Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including proper care and storage of inspection equipment.

· Perform other quality-related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

· Two or more years of related inspection or manufacturing experience preferred.

· Portable CMM/Romer arm experience preferred.

· Ability to read and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

· Working knowledge of dimensional inspection techniques and tolerancing; GD&T knowledge preferred.

· Ability to document inspection results clearly and accurately.

· Ability to work independently with limited supervision while following established procedures and quality requirements.

· Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies between product characteristics and specified requirements.

· Effective written and verbal communication skills.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other standard computer applications used for inspection records and documentation.

· Valid driver's license and ability to travel to supplier locations as required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

· Visual ability to read drawings and measuring equipment and inspect components.

· Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and handle inspection equipment.

· Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lb in accordance with workplace safety requirements.

What we offer:

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

jobs.title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
jobs.description:
Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.



Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.



What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

 - Attention to detail and accuracy

 - Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

 - Working effectively with others

 - Organisation and the ability to follow processes

 - Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

 - Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.



What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.



What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

 - Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

 - Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

 - Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

 - Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

 - Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

 - Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

 - Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.



About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.



Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

 - Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience

 - Opportunities for training and professional development

 - Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

 - A supportive and collaborative team environment

 - The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare

 - The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.



Ready to Join Us?

Assessment Centre: Monday 2 November 2026

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre.

Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day.

jobs.title: Vice President, People & Culture
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Title: Vice President, People & Culture

Department: People & Culture

Report to: COO and General Counsel

Compensation: $225,000 – $250,000

FLSA: Exempt

Employee Type: Full-Time, Regular

Location: New York, NY

Work Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days/week in the SEO office at 55 Exchange Place, New York, NY 10005

ABOUT SEO

Founded in 1963 during the Civil Rights Movement, SEO closes educational and career opportunity gaps for 7,000 ambitious young people annually.

POSITION OVERVIEW

SEO is seeking a transformational Vice President, People & Culture to help shape the next chapter of our organization and employee experience. This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished people leader to build on a strong foundation and elevate how SEO attracts, develops, supports, and engages exceptional talent in service of our mission.

Over the past several years, SEO has made meaningful investments in talent acquisition, total rewards, workplace flexibility, and talent processes. The next chapter is about bringing those efforts together into a cohesive, high-impact people strategy that strengthens culture, deepens employee trust, and enables organizational excellence across the enterprise. Working alongside a new CEO focused on growth, clarity, and organizational effectiveness, the Vice President will help translate vision into the people systems, management practices, leadership capabilities, and cultural norms required to support SEO's next stage of expansion. This leader's charge is to ensure that as SEO grows, it does so with the consistency, accountability, and employee experience necessary to sustain long-term impact.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and General Counsel, the Vice President will serve as both a strategic thought partner and an operational leader. The VP leads four functional areas, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Management, and People Operations, with the four functional leaders reporting directly to the VP. The P&C team totals 8.5 FTE, including the VP, with one People Operations & Executive Assistant position split equally between P&C and the Executive Office. They will advise executive leadership on talent and organizational matters, partner closely with managers to strengthen leadership effectiveness, and champion a people-centered culture where employees can do their best work. At the same time, they will oversee the systems, processes, and practices that ensure the People & Culture function operates with consistency, credibility, and excellence.

The ideal candidate is an influential relationship-builder who combines curiosity and adaptability with sound judgment with executional rigor. They are a trusted advisor, a skilled change leader, and an empathetic listener who seeks first to understand. They bring a clear and confident point of view, know how to translate ideas into action, and can thoughtfully prioritize, communicate, and sustain meaningful organizational change. Most importantly, they are energized by the opportunity to help build an exceptional employee experience and culture that enables SEO's people and mission to thrive.

Organizational Leadership & People Strategy

• Lead SEO’s People & Culture functional areas, including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Management, and People Ops.

• Develop and communicate a practical, sequenced P&C roadmap that distinguishes urgent priorities from important longer-term work and protects the organization from initiative overload.

• Clarify P&C’s partnership with each SEO team, along with decision ownership, service expectations, and escalation paths so employees and leaders know where to go and what to expect.

• Establish priorities and measures of success, communicate trade-offs and rationale, and sustain focus long enough for changes to take hold.

Change Management & Organizational Effectiveness

• Make disciplined change management a core organizational capability, particularly for technology, process, policy, and new ways of working.

• Use structured, continuous-improvement and project management approaches to understand the work, define the problem, simplify processes, engage users early, pilot where appropriate, and measure adoption.

• Build stakeholder engagement, communication, training, feedback loops, and reinforcement into implementation from the start rather than treating adoption as an afterthought.

• Listen before prescribing, build on what is already working, and avoid repeated redesign before prior changes are fully embedded and evaluated.

Talent Development & Performance Management

• Translate SEO’s job roles and competencies into visible career pathways, development plans, succession practices, and stronger internal mobility.

• Strengthen performance management and accountability so expectations, feedback, development, and consequences are clearer and more consistent.

• Build sustained manager and leadership development rather than relying on one-time programs or leaving development solely to individual departments.

• Partner with leaders to strengthen succession planning, develop internal talent, and expand equitable access to development opportunities across the organization

Culture & Employee Experience

• Help SEO navigate organizational transition with clear communication, appropriate transparency, and thoughtful attention to employee experience.

• Clarify which people practices should be enterprise-wide and where local flexibility matters; strengthen inclusion across sites and address regional realities in compensation, benefits, and policies.

• Bring empathy and practical judgment to a modern, multigenerational workforce while balancing care for employees with organizational needs and accountability.

People Operations & Systems

• Ensure high-quality employee relations, total rewards, benefits, compliance, onboarding, policies, and core P&C services.

Position Description

The Mission Systems Group (MSG) provides security solutions for the United States government. MSG employees offer a multi-disciplinary approach to solve some of the most challenging technical problems in complex operational environments. Our areas of expertise are in sensor development and integration; chemical, biological, nuclear, and geophysical phenomenology; software applications; modeling and simulation; and operational applications of technology.

ENSCO is looking for a senior data analyst to provide laboratory quality assurance (QA) analysis and sample data curation for an upcoming project. Responsibilities will include writing reports, developing/modifying scripted analytics using R, and periodic onsite subject matter expertise (SME) consultations to assist in the formulation, maintenance, documentation, and application of R-scripted analytical tools for use in operations.

jobs.title: Technical Publications Specialist - Advanced Effects
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

*** THIS ROLE IS ON-SITE IN COSTA MESA, CA. RELOCATION ASSISTANCE PROVIDED ***

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to create and maintain user documentation across our diverse business lines. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of our products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Technical Publications Specialist - Advanced Effects (also known internally as a Technical Writer), your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate complex hardware and software systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well-written and presented artifacts.

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. You will engage subject matter experts at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available.

Along with our commercial offerings outlined above, Anduril is pursuing programs with the government, which require documentation in standards such as MIL-STD-40051D and S1000D, delivered via IETMs / IETDs. Familiarity with these standards and delivery methods is highly desired.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and operations to deliver task, conditions, and standard-centric documentation.

• Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and considering input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions.

• Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time and shared with leadership.

• Help build a culture of technical documentation by contributing to the living documentation process, ensuring that those who come after you learn from your acquired Anduril experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation for complex hardware, software, or aerospace systems.

• Experience writing technical, user-facing documentation.

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation (e.g., schematics, CAD, or software specs).

• Experience building content in a variety of formats (Word, XML, DITA, etc.).

• Strong written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on explaining highly technical subjects simply.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local, to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, etc.).

• Passion for excellent documentation and user experience.

• Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD).

• Experience delivering content on fast-paced, complex projects with multiple stakeholders.

US Salary Range

$117,000—$154,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Global Head of Supply Chain
jobs.location: Singapore- Remote; Tampa, Florida, United States; Veszprém, Veszprém, Hungary
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT is a global leader in critical infrastructure protection — trusted by governments, defense agencies, and enterprise organizations across the world. We build technology that keeps the world's most sensitive environments secure. Our Singapore office is a strategic hub for our APAC and global operations, and this role sits at the center of that growth.

We are open to candidates who will be based on-site in Singapore, Tampa or Veszprém.

As our hardware business grows, we need a single global supply chain capability that serves customers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

We are building, not inheriting. This is an executive Global Head role for a strategic leader who can set the vision for a world-class supply chain, build the organization to deliver it, and stay close enough to operations to make sure it runs with precision across regions. You will be the single global owner of OPSWAT's supply chain: strategy, sourcing and manufacturing, quality, fulfillment, trade compliance, supply chain security, and organizational leadership. If you thrive in environments where you set the direction, build the team, and are accountable for the results, this is your role.

If you're interested in working as Global Head of Supply Chain at OPSWAT, please apply, and we will get in touch!

You Will Have the Opportunity to

• Set Global Supply Chain Strategy and Vision

• Own and define OPSWAT's multi-year global supply chain strategy, aligned with the company's hardware roadmap, growth targets, and go-to-market priorities across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

• Design one global operating model, from sourcing and manufacturing through delivery and post-sales logistics, including regional fulfillment footprint and make/buy/partner decisions.

• Serve as the executive voice of supply chain to the leadership team, presenting strategy, performance, risks, and investment cases.

• Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Strategic Supplier Management

• Lead global sourcing strategy and own relationships with contract manufacturers, ODMs, component suppliers, carriers, and logistics partners.

• Negotiate strategic supply agreements, pricing, and terms; drive COGS reduction and supplier performance through structured business reviews and scorecards.

• Build a resilient supplier base through dual-sourcing, lifecycle and end-of-life management, and mitigation of component shortages.

• Supply Chain Security, Risk, and Resilience

• Establish a secure, trusted hardware supply chain covering component provenance, traceability, anti-counterfeit controls, and tamper-evident processes, in line with OPSWAT's mission and its government and defense customers' requirements.

• Build a global supply chain risk management framework addressing geopolitical, tariff, logistics, and supplier concentration risks, with business continuity plans for each.

• Quality Standards and Governance

• Set and own global QA/QC standards across hardware assembly, imaging, testing, and packaging at every site.

• Ensure every unit shipped meets OPSWAT's functional, security, and branding standards, no exceptions, and drive the relevant quality and regulatory certifications.

• Planning, Inventory, and Financial Ownership

• Establish and lead a global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process with Sales, Product Management, and Finance, driving forecast accuracy and supply alignment.

• Own the global supply chain budget, inventory strategy, landed cost, and working capital targets.

• Global Trade Compliance, Logistics, and Customs

• Own global trade compliance, including US EAR, APAC export control regimes, sanctions screening, import/customs, tariff classification, and country-of-origin requirements for government and public sector sales.

• Oversee end-to-end global logistics, warehousing, and fulfillment to ensure on-time delivery at optimal cost, with strong governance over freight forwarders, customs brokers, and 3PL partners.

• Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Product Management and Engineering on new product introduction, design for manufacturability, and BOM cost optimization.

• Work alongside Creative and GTM teams to ensure packaging and branding deliver a premium customer experience.

• Partner with Finance, Legal, and Sales Operations on planning, contracts, compliance, and customer commitments.

• Systems, Metrics, and Continuous Improvement

• Lead the roadmap for supply chain systems and tooling (NetSuite ERP, planning, supplier and warehouse management) so the operation can scale.

• Define global KPIs across procurement, manufacturing, quality, fulfillment, and cost, and drive a culture of data-driven continuous improvement.

• Global Organizational Leadership

• Build, lead, and develop a multi-region supply chain organization, including regional leaders and a core team in Singapore.

• Set the organizational design, succession plans, and talent strategy for the function, building a culture rooted in ownership, precision, and pride in work.

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA preferred.

• 15+ years of supply chain experience in hardware or technology, including 7+ years in senior leadership roles with global scope.

• A track record of building and scaling a global supply chain function, not just running one, ideally in a high-growth company.

• Experience leading multi-region organizations and managing leaders, teams, and sites in different countries.

• Deep expertise in strategic sourcing, contract manufacturer/ODM management, and complex supplier negotiations.

• Strong command of international export regulations (including US EAR and APAC regimes), trade compliance, and hardware-specific controls; familiarity with government procurement requirements (e.g., TAA, NDAA) is a strong plus.

• Experience building supply chain security and risk management programs; knowledge of frameworks such as NIST SP 800-161 is an advantage.

• Proven experience leading S&OP, inventory strategy, and supply chain financial management.

• Deep familiarity with ERP systems, particularly NetSuite, and supply chain planning tools.

• Solid understanding of hardware QA/QC: assembly, imaging, testing, and packaging.

• Executive presence and strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and partners across cultures.

• Fluency in English required; other language skills are an advantage.

• Comfortable leading through ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-moving environment, and willing to travel internationally.

Why You'll Love Working Here

• Strategic impact: You will build something that matters: a global supply chain capability that directly enables OPSWAT's worldwide hardware mission.

• Global reach: Lead and work closely with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

• Ownership culture: At OPSWAT, we trust our people to lead. You will have the autonomy to build, decide, and execute.

• Mission-driven work: Our technology protects critical infrastructure worldwide. The work has real stakes — and real meaning.

• Competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and professional development opportunities.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse Surgical Intermediate Full Time Days
jobs.description:
Full time Days 7am-7:30pm with rotating weekends

• Patient population will include but are not limited to esophagectomies, whipples, surgical-oncology cases, high-volume liposuction, multi-level spinal fusions, and vascular cases. Other opportunities for this unit will be any surgical patients that require a medication drip that is not appropriate for the medical-surgical inpatient unit.

The Staff Nurse Inpatient  reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the acutely ill patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation.  Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Collects and analyzes data, identifies expected outcomes, develops and implements an individualized plan, coordinates care delivery and evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.
• Directs care and determines the appropriate utilization of any assistant involved in providing direct patient care.
• Collaborates with patient, family, physicians and ancillary staff. Creates a documented plan, focused on outcomes and decisions related to the care and delivery of services that indicates communications with patients, families, and others.

jobs.title: Experienced Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

About Re:Build Answer Engineering

Answer Engineering, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is an exceptional engineering firm providing aerospace design and analysis services to companies around the world. The team tackles challenging engineering problems ranging from electric vertical take-off platforms (EVTOL), to space tourism. To meet the demands of our customers, Answer Engineering is embarking on building a first-class support organization to ensure the engineering team can remain focused on engineering challenges.

Answer Engineering is a casual work environment where discussions take place in the open, events are frequent including company BBQs and ski trips, and our office remains stocked with a variety of snacks and beverage options. Answer Engineering reinforces the value of having a diverse workforce and promotes equity and inclusion for all employees.

Who are we looking for?

As an Experienced Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the design of aerospace structures and lead teams of younger engineers. This position will encompass all program cycles including concept design, prototyping, analysis, modeling, drafting, manufacturing, testing, and flight. You will frequently use CAD programs to bring conceptual ideas to reality. Significant experience with multiple CAD packages (Catia, Inventor, NX, SolidWorks, Creo) is required.

What you get to do!

• Design of primary and secondary aerospace structures and systems

• Creating and delivering CAD models and presentations to customers

• Communicate across engineering disciplines to make program critical decisions

• Identify core issues, develop solutions, and effectively communicate the impacts across internal and external teams

• Lead, mentor, and collaborate with other engineers, both internally and externally

• Develop supporting material for design such as bill of materials, assembly or installation procedures, and weight optimization trades

What you will bring to the Team

• 5 plus years of proven experience

• Engineering degree, preferably in mechanical or aerospace engineering

• Demonstrated experience designing composite and metallic parts and assemblies

• Must be a US citizen or permanent resident with the ability to obtain a security clearance

Additional Qualifications

• Systems design experience: flight controls, landing gear, hydraulic, etc.

• Proficient with multiple CAD programs such as Catia or Solidworks

• Familiar with analysis packages such as FEMAP and NASTRAN (or equivalent)

• Proficient in designing parts, assemblies, and installation drawings following GD&T (ASME Y14.5) standard methodologies

• Solid understanding of aerospace materials, hardware, and fabrication techniques

• Rapid prototype experience

• Familiar with fabrication, inspection, and repair of composites and metallic parts and assemblies

• Experience with design lifecycle and configuration management systems

• Hands on experience with machining and composite layup

• Test plan development and structural testing experience

• Comfortable working on Military/DoD projects

Salary Range

The base salary range for this position is $95,000 - $230,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company! We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Or for any other reason.
