jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Global Markets
jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

This is a hands-on technical role within Staffbase Build, responsible for turning specific enterprise customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions of the Staffbase platform, using its extensibility capabilities (widgets, plugins, integrations, and other platform objects). The role owns assigned customer solutions end-to-end, defining the use case with stakeholders, building and testing across the stack, deploying it, and validating it with users.

The aim is to drive adoption and stickiness of the platform, not to create one-off, standalone customer solutions. The role acts as a bridge, helping customers do what they and the platform can't do alone yet, and feeds what's learned back into shared standards and the product roadmap.

This is a hybrid role. Core in-office days in our Minneapolis office are Tuesdays-Thursdays, and it is expected that folks will be in the office a minimum of 2 day per week during core days.

The role reports into the regional Build Leader.

What you’ll be doing

Solution Delivery

• Owning the technical design, implementation, testing, and release of assigned custom solutions end-to-end

• Building across the stack (customer-facing UI, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third-party APIs)

Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration

• Partnering with customers, consultants and internal teams, e.g. Sales, to define and detail use cases before development. Supporting pre-sales in a technical advisory capacity, primarily during requirements discovery: join customer and Sales conversations to clarify needs, assess technical feasibility, and help scope custom solutions

• Validating shipped solutions with users and gathering feedback afterward

• Supporting customers in building basic solutions themselves using Staffbase-provided platform tools where appropriate, rather than defaulting to a fully bespoke build

Platform-First Engineering

• Keeping up to date with new and evolving platform capabilities (new extensibility primitives, APIs, and platform objects) so solutions are built using the latest native capabilities rather than defaulting to more bespoke patterns

• Applying the company's architectural, security, and compliance standards so solutions remain supportable

Pattern Capture & Product Feedback

• Identifying reusable patterns and components arising from customer engagements; documenting and contributing them to a shared Build asset catalogue

• Surfacing recurring, validated customer needs for consideration in the product roadmap

Craft & Team Contribution

• Maintaining a strong quality bar (testing, code reviews, healthy CI/CD practices).

• Participating in the Build on-call rotation to support shipped customer solutions, in line with the applicable regional on-call policy.

• Helping bring structure and engineering standards to the team, and mentor less experienced engineers

What you need to be successful

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and running production systems

• Customer-facing technical experience (forward-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting)

• Strong React, TypeScript/JavaScript and experience in either Go, Java, Kotlin or Node.js on the backend

• Deep experience designing and integrating REST APIs and third-party systems, as well as testing, assessing and integrating APIs of third-party systems

• Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences

• Experience mentoring or guiding less-experienced developers, and a knack for bringing structure to how a team works

• Comfort working directly with stakeholders — you can translate business needs into technical solutions and validate them afterwards

• A strong focus on quality, clean code, testing, and continuous learning

• A self-starter who works well both independently and as part of a team

• You understand and appreciate diversity and inclusivity in the workplace

What you'll get

• Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)

• Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of $1608

• Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August

• Support - we’re offering a 401(k) plan with company match and health plans, including dental & vision as well as competitive Paid Parental Leave to support new parents

• Volunteer Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles that will be performed in Minnesota. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Staffbase's total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $130,000 - $175,000 base salary per year. Other rewards may include commissions and program-specific awards. In addition, Staffbase provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, equity, paid parental leave, an employee growth budget, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, wellness days, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.description:
Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $17.00 - $20.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Career growth: Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis.

• Perks: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) mental health support and retail discounts through our Benefit Hub.

What you'll do

Working under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), you will:

• Provide one-on-one ABA therapy to children with autism at home or in our centers.

• Teach communication, social, and daily living skills with positive reinforcement.

• Help children work through challenging behaviors calmly and safely.

• Record session data on a company-provided tablet.

• Keep sessions fun, engaging, and focused on each child's goals.

What you need

• 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED.

• Valid ID and reliable transportation for in-home sessions.

• Ability to pass a background check and complete a TB test and CPR/First Aid course (we cover the cost).

• Ability to stay active with kids and move in various positions: bending, squatting, kneeling, sitting on the floor, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

• Patience, empathy, and a positive attitude.

What happens after you apply

We move fast. You'll complete online modules, a CPR class, a TB test, and a background check, and your onboarding specialist will guide you through each step.

Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.

jobs.title: Global Data Product Lead - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Sika, we are strengthening our global data capabilities across Supply Chain and Procurement. We are looking for an experienced Global Data Product Lead who combines strong end-to-end Supply Chain expertise with hands-on data engineering capabilities.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant technical ownership and global exposure. You will lead through expertise while remaining hands-on, working closely with Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders, Global Process Owners, IT, data teams, platform specialists and external engineering partners. You will design solutions, build critical components, guide external engineers and take ownership of maintaining the resulting data products beyond their initial delivery.

• Translate Procurement and Supply Chain requirements into clear, buildable data-product designs, working with business owners and Global Process Owners to clarify KPI definitions, calculation logic, source data, dimensions, and acceptance criteria.
• Design, develop, test, and maintain data pipelines, analytical data models, semantic models, dashboards, and data-quality controls that build reliable data foundations for global Procurement and Supply Chain key performance indicators.
• Assess source-system data and identify quality, availability, lineage, and integration issues; develop practical analytical and data-science solutions where they create clear business value.
• Build prototypes and critical solution components directly, and maintain and enhance productive data solutions as business requirements and source systems change.
• Define engineering standards, testing requirements, documentation, and technical acceptance criteria; ensure that solutions follow applicable architecture, security, access, deployment, and data-governance standards.
• Lead external data engineers when additional capacity or specialist expertise is required, including technical assessment, design review, code review, and knowledge transfer.
• Coordinate technical decisions with Mercury, IT, Data & Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, security, and relevant platform owners; challenge requirements and proposed solutions that create unnecessary complexity or cannot be maintained sustainably.
• Support portfolio prioritization based on business value, data readiness, technical dependencies, and available capacity, whilst contributing to a reusable data-product architecture.
• Monitor productive data products, investigate issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain documentation covering data models, lineage, business rules, quality controls, ownership, and support arrangements.

• University degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management or a related technical field.
• Minimum 5-7 years of relevant professional experience developing and delivering data products within Supply Chain and Procurement.
• Proven hands-on experience with SAP S/4 Hana Supply Chain and Procurement suite.
• In-depth understanding of end-to-end Supply Chain and Procurement processes within a complex, international manufacturing environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of data modelling, data integration, data quality, data lineage, testing, monitoring and designing maintainable production solutions.
• Solid SQL skills and practical experience with Power BI, semantic models or enterprise analytics solutions.
• Proven ability to translate business requirements and questions into technical specifications and usable, business-oriented data products.
• Experience leading technical delivery across cross-functional teams and external engineering partners, including design reviews, technical guidance and quality assurance.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, engineers, architects and senior management.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 10–20%.

Preferred:

• Experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Microsoft Azure data services, or comparable solutions.
• Practical programming experience with Python.
• Experience designing, developing and maintaining data pipelines and analytical data models.
• Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, forecasting or advanced analytics.

We look forward to your application. For this position visa sponsorship is not offered and only direct applications will be considered. For any further information please reach us at inbox.hr@ch.sika.com

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training.  We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Title: Vice President, Finance

Department: Finance

Report to: Chief Operating Officer/General Counsel

Compensation: $230,000 – $260,000

FLSA: Exempt

Employee Type: Full-Time, Regular

Location: New York, NY

Work Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days/week in the SEO office at 55 Exchange Place, New York, NY 10005

ABOUT SEO

Founded in 1963 during the Civil Rights Movement, SEO closes educational and career opportunity gaps for 7,000 ambitious young people annually.

POSITION OVERVIEW

SEO is seeking a Vice President, Finance to lead and evolve its financial strategy and operations. As the senior-most finance leader in the organization, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and General Counsel, the VP will lead a team of nine managing Accounting and FP&A strategy and execution. Under its new President & CEO, SEO is preparing for continued growth with a renewed emphasis on multi-year planning, clear metrics, and systems that enable accountable decision-making at scale. The VP will bring clarity to financial ownership, help program leaders leverage financial data and insights to maximize their resources, and develop more predictable, scalable financial management and reporting tools. This role requires a finance leader who thrives building capabilities within organizations. The successful leader will pair technical credibility with curiosity, a desire to teach and learn, strong, communication, sound judgment, and the ability to drive adoption of new tools and simple policies across a complex organization.

Financial Strategy

• Serve as SEO’s senior financial subject-matter expert, establishing clear decision authority and ownership for financial policies, revenue treatment, accounting, reporting, compliance and planning.

• Set a clear enterprise financial agenda with the President & CEO and COO/GC, executive leadership, and Board of Directors; sequence the highest-value Finance priorities rather than treating every request or project as equally urgent.

• Lead annual budgeting, multi-year planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and resource-allocation discussions so leaders can understand trade-offs and make informed decisions.

• Communicate financial decisions and the reasoning behind them in language that program, development, executive, and board audiences can use.

FP&A & Business Partnership

• Strengthen FP&A as a forward-looking decision-support capability, using forecasts, trends, scenarios, program budgets, and cost analysis to help leaders plan rather than simply report historical results.

• Build predictable partnership rhythms with program, development, and functional leaders and engage early enough to shape decisions before issues become urgent.

• Understand the distinct revenue models and operating realities of SEO’s programs while creating organization-wide consistency in core financial practices.

• Increase the usefulness and clarity of management and board reporting, connecting the numbers to risks, choices, sustainability, and organizational priorities

Accounting & Compliance

• Ensure reliable books, timely close, strong audit readiness, cash and treasury management, compliance, and appropriate internal controls.

• Clarify ownership and workflows for revenue tracking, gift coding and allocation, reconciliation, expense management, and other financial processes.

• Balance stronger control and accountability with practical implementation, bringing stakeholders along rather than imposing process without context.

• Maintain the financial discipline and transparency expected of a complex nonprofit with multiple funding streams and program models.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

• Bring strong technology fluency and ownership to finance systems and data, including workflows involving Salesforce, Intacct, A/P, budgeting/forecasting, revenue tracking, and reporting.

• Assess fragmented tools, spreadsheets, handoffs, and manual work; establish clearer sources of truth and simplify processes where possible.

• Lead implementation and adoption of financial technology with discipline, recognizing that successful systems work requires process clarity, stakeholder engagement, training, and sustained follow-through.

• Reduce avoidable workload and recurring urgent demands, particularly around board cycles, forecasting, budget changes, and reconciliation.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Lead, develop, and align the accounting and FP&A teams, establishing clear accountability while delegating effectively and building bench strength.

• Create a Finance team culture that is rigorous, responsive, curious, and integrated into the organization.

• Partner closely with operations, development, IT, program leadership, and other functions to improve planning, ownership, and execution across shared work.

• Build a team model and operating cadence that reduces dependence on the VP as a bottleneck while maintaining appropriate escalation and judgment.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

• Progressive senior financial leadership in a complex nonprofit or mission-led organization; strong understanding of nonprofit accounting and multiple revenue/funding models is highly relevant.

• Broad command of accounting, audit, controls, budgeting, forecasting, cash/treasury, financial reporting, and compliance, paired with genuine FP&A and decision-support depth.

• Demonstrated ability to move finance beyond reporting and stewardship into forward-looking planning, scenario analysis, resource allocation, and business partnership.

• Strong technology capability and experience improving finance systems, data, and cross-functional workflows; experience integrating or improving ERP, CRM/revenue, budgeting, or reporting tools is especially relevant.

• Experience partnering with distinct program or business leaders in a decentralized or multi-line organization where enterprise consistency must coexist with differing operating needs.

• Track record leading and developing Accounting and FP&A talent, delegating effectively, and setting clear performance expectations.

• Excellent communication and translation skills, including the ability to explain rationale, trade-offs, and financial concepts to executives, program leaders, development professionals, and board members.

• High EQ, curiosity, patience, accountability, and the confidence to make decisions and challenge constructively while bringing others along.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

SEO offers a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits plan including low-cost health, vision, and dental options, a generous holiday schedule and PTO policies, disability coverage, fully paid time off for new parents, and employer contributions to health reimbursement and retirement accounts. We are constantly working to improve our benefits each year based on the needs of our employees. We value wellness and strive to put people first and foremost.

The compensation listed in this posting reflects what SEO believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and SEO reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

EEOC Policy

At SEO we are committed to cultivating a team that embodies the backgrounds and experiences of the constituencies we serve and the communities we live in, and a workplace that reflects the impact we make in the world. Candidates from all communities – including people of color, women, members of the LGBTQIA+ Community, veterans, and people with disabilities – are strongly encouraged to apply.

Equal Employment Opportunity is not just the law, it is our commitment.

Sponsors for Educational Opportunity is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – M/F/D/V. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information or characteristics, or any other legally protected status.

If you need accommodation while applying for a role with SEO, due to a disability, please email SEO Talent.

THE ORGANIZATION

Established in 1963 by Michael Osheowitz, SEO (Sponsors for Educational Opportunity) is an educational non-profit founded on the belief that talent is everywhere; but opportunity is not. Our programs are designed to educate, train, mentor, and amplify the voices of our participants to give them a seat at the table – every table. We propel human potential.

jobs.title: Consultant, Medical Affairs Scientific Communications and Review
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced Medical Affairs Scientific Communications & Review Consultant to support scientific communications and promotional medical review, with a primary focus on PBH and the opportunity to contribute across the broader pipeline as business needs evolve.

This hands-on role combines scientific content development, clinical data interpretation, promotional medical review, and oversight of external medical communications agencies. The consultant will work independently and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver accurate, balanced, and consistent scientific materials. This contracted engagement is anticipated to run from January 2027 through June 2027.

Responsibilities

Promotional Medical Review

• Serve as a primary Medical Affairs reviewer of promotional materials through the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process.

• Evaluate promotional claims, clinical data presentations, references, and supporting evidence for scientific accuracy, balance, and consistency with approved product labeling; identify unsupported claims and potentially misleading interpretations.

• Provide clear, actionable medical review comments and collaborate with Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, and Medical Affairs stakeholders to resolve scientific questions.

• Partner with therapeutic area Medical Affairs leads on complex scientific issues and escalate matters requiring additional medical judgment.

Scientific Communications

• Independently develop and critically review scientific materials, including abstracts, posters, oral presentations, manuscripts, slide decks, and medical education resources; verify data, references, tables, figures, and scientific claims.

• Critically evaluate clinical trial data and scientific literature, translating findings into clear scientific narratives with consistent interpretation and presentation of the evidence.

• Support the execution of scientific communications plans, including congress and publication activities.

• Collaborate with Medical Affairs therapeutic area leads, biostatistics, clinical development, and other stakeholders to ensure scientific accuracy and alignment with evolving Medical Affairs priorities.

• Provide scientific direction and oversight to external medical communications agencies, including reviewing deliverables, providing substantive feedback, and ensuring high-quality execution.

Required Qualifications

• Advanced scientific or clinical degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent).

• Approximately 5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology Medical Affairs, scientific communications, or related functions.

• Demonstrated experience performing medical review of pharmaceutical promotional materials.

• Strong experience developing scientific communications, including abstracts, posters, presentations, and/or peer-reviewed manuscripts.

• Demonstrated ability to independently interpret clinical trial data and critically evaluate scientific evidence.

• Excellent scientific writing, analytical, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail and commitment to scientific accuracy and quality.

• Experience collaborating with and providing scientific oversight to external medical communications agencies.

• Ability to work independently, collaborate cross-functionally, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting Medical Affairs activities during prelaunch or commercial launch.

• Experience in endocrinology, metabolic diseases, neuroscience, or rare diseases.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical promotional review requirements and relevant FDA regulations and guidance.

• Experience working in a small or growing biotechnology organization.

• Demonstrated ability to contribute to multiple scientific projects across therapeutic areas.

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska and Hawaii.

• Occasional travel may be requested for business meetings or other Medical Affairs activities. Actual hours may vary based on project requirements and business needs.

• You must have access to work in a setting that meets all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to communication via video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

• The engagement may be extended, and the consultant may be considered for future full-time opportunities, subject to business needs, performance, and applicable company policies.

Compensation

The hourly pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Contractor Hourly Compensation Range

$105—$120 USD

jobs.title: Recruiter, Manufacturing and Operations
jobs.description:
Build the Path Forward

At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

The Recruiter, Manufacturing & Operations will support a broad portfolio of roles across Manufacturing Operations, Deployment & Fleet Operations, Field & Customer Operations and Supply Chain. You’ll recruit everyone from the people building and commissioning our systems to the teams deploying them in the field, supporting our customers, managing our fleet, and ensuring we have the materials and infrastructure required to scale.

This is not an order-taking recruiting role. You’ll work directly with operations and business leaders to understand their organizations, anticipate talent needs, challenge assumptions, and build recruiting strategies that deliver the right talent at the right time.

What You’ll Do

• Own end-to-end recruiting across manufacturing, production, deployment, fleet operations, field services, customer-facing technical roles and supply chain.

• Recruit across a wide range of levels, from highly skilled technicians and individual contributors to managers and operational leaders.

• Build sourcing strategies for specialized and difficult-to-find operational talent rather than relying solely on inbound applicants.

• Conduct candidate screens, manage interview processes, develop offers, and close candidates.

• Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines ahead of future hiring needs.

• Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through consistent communication, urgency, and transparency.

• Build strong relationships with hiring managers and become a trusted partner on their organizational and hiring needs.

• Help leaders define what great talent looks like before launching a search.

• Use market data, candidate feedback, and pipeline performance to influence hiring decisions.

• Push back when requirements unnecessarily limit the talent pool and recommend alternative approaches.

• Translate hiring demand into business impact and help leaders prioritize roles accordingly.

• Maintain a strong operating rhythm with hiring managers around pipeline health, interviews, offers, risks, and hiring forecasts.

Build & Improve

• Develop repeatable recruiting strategies and talent pipelines that can scale alongside Path.

• Use recruiting data to understand funnel health, identify bottlenecks, and improve outcomes.

• Build targeted sourcing campaigns, referral strategies, talent maps, and competitive intelligence.

• Identify opportunities to automate or simplify recruiting processes.

• Partner across the Talent Acquisition team to continuously raise the quality and speed of hiring.

Who You Are

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally supporting operations, manufacturing, supply chain, field service, defense, or other technical environments.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple operational functions rather than a single job family.

• Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and senior leaders to define requirements and develop recruiting strategies.

• Strong proactive sourcing skills with demonstrated success engaging passive talent.

• Experience recruiting in fast-moving environments with high hiring volume and changing priorities.

• Ability to understand technical and operational roles deeply enough to effectively assess and sell candidates.

• Experience using recruiting data to manage pipelines and influence hiring decisions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple searches and candidate funnels simultaneously.

• Self-sufficient and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy.

• Willingness to get close to the work—whether that means spending time on the production floor, learning our technology, or understanding what teams experience at customer sites.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team

• Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)

• 401(k) retirement plan through Empower

• Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!

Who We Are

At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.

What You’ll Do

• Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure.

• Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.

• Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.

• Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.

• Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.

• Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.

• Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified.

• Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment.

• Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.

• Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.

• Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.

What You’ll Bring

The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

jobs.title: Brand Manager (crafts)| DTC E-commerce | 100% Remote EU
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/b540b9e2-0673-4d2d-91fd-e293658f4f6a/d5db35d1-81f0-4140-b61c-f3fb1004c7d1/job%20ad%20visual.png]


At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..


The role 

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Find, test and approve the crafts. Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.

 - Own kit quality. Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.

 - Plan the box calendar. Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.

 - Learn from subscribers. Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.

 - Own churn. It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.

 - Protect acquisition quality. Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.

 - Keep the subscription running smoothly. Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.

 - Stay aligned with Customer Service. Turn recurring ticket themes into fixes, and close the loop with CS when they ship.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Must have

 - 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.

 - A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.

 - A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.

 - Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.

 - Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.

 - Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.

 - Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers

 - Clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

 - Experience running a subscription box.

 - Experience writing craft instructions.

 - An active presence in craft communities or social media.

 - Experience with Shopify.

 - Spreadsheet analysis skills.



THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.

 2. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.

 3. Test Task 

 4. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

FIXED SERVICE FEE

Up to € 2300 euros after taxes, depending on your skills, competencies, and experience.

❕Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.


ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

❕This role is 100% remote.

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $17.00 - $20.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Career growth: Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis.

• Perks: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) mental health support and retail discounts through our Benefit Hub.

What you'll do

Working under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), you will:

• Provide one-on-one ABA therapy to children with autism at home or in our centers.

• Teach communication, social, and daily living skills with positive reinforcement.

• Help children work through challenging behaviors calmly and safely.

• Record session data on a company-provided tablet.

• Keep sessions fun, engaging, and focused on each child's goals.

What you need

• 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED.

• Valid ID and reliable transportation for in-home sessions.

• Ability to pass a background check and complete a TB test and CPR/First Aid course (we cover the cost).

• Respond to donor referral calls from hospitals and clinical partners, gathering and evaluating medical information to determine donor suitability.
• Guide families through the donation process with empathy and professionalism, including conducting medical and social history interviews and obtaining informed authorization for donation.
• Coordinate tissue recovery logistics with internal teams and external partners.
• Communicate effectively with hospitals, medical examiners, funeral homes, district attorneys, and other stakeholders while delivering exceptional service and support.
• Maintain accurate documentation and adhere to established regulatory and organizational standards.

Schedule & Work Environment

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join the Imaging team. This is not a product development role, and it isn't a traditional cloud-SRE role either. You are the frontline for keeping fielded imaging systems alive: the person field personnel and customer-support escalations turn to when a deployed system isn't behaving. You'll be the second SRE on a small, high-trust team, working directly with our lead, with real room to shape how Imaging reliability and support operate as we scale.

The work is varied and often ambiguous. You might spend a morning triaging a networking failure on a system being stood up at a remote site, an afternoon walking a field operator through a sensor calibration over the phone, and the back half of a week hardening a runbook so the next person never has to solve that problem live again. When a fielded system misbehaves, the root cause could be anywhere in the stack--and you're the one who narrows it down.

If you get energy from diagnosing live systems under pressure, being the reason a deployment stays up, and turning recurring fire-drills into durable fixes, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Own fielded system reliability. You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise--whether the root cause is in the network, the calibration, an upgrade, or the sensor hardware itself--you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.

Run point on escalations. You'll be first and second line of response for issues coming through our support channels and Anduril's customer-support pipeline (Tier 0 to Mission Success / Product Operations to SRE), acting as the deep-expertise backstop the rest of the funnel escalates to.

Turn fires into runbooks. Recurring issues shouldn't be solved live twice. You'll build and maintain runbooks, diagnostics, and self-service tooling that reduce repeat problems and shrink the support load over time.

Hold the boundary with engineering. You own everything short of a code fix. When an issue turns out to be a genuine software defect, you'll cleanly reproduce it, document it, and hand it off to the Mission Software Engineers--protecting their focus by keeping frontline support where it belongs.

Feed reliability back into the product. You'll turn what you learn in the field into signals that make our systems more supportable--better observability, safer upgrades, more graceful failure.

Travel expected approximately 20% of the time for field support and deployment windows.

What We're Looking For

Required

• 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, field/systems engineering, or production support of deployed hardware/software systems--with real ownership after systems ship, not just standing them up

• Strong Linux fundamentals, including comfort troubleshooting real networking issues (IP, routing, VPNs, connectivity in constrained or field environments)

• Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component

• Comfortable owning a structured on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to run a remote troubleshooting session with a non-technical operator and document what happened

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance

Preferred

• Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments

• Experience with fielded hardware or sensor systems (EO/IR, optical, or similar), including familiarity with sensor calibration

• Scripting for diagnostics and automation (Python, Bash, or similar)

• Familiarity with Nix or NixOS--uncommon, but valuable on our stack

• Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux

• Familiarity with incident tooling (PagerDuty or equivalent)

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The people who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone else's problem.

They stay calm under pressure. A system down in the field with an operator waiting is a high-stress moment. They work the problem methodically instead of reacting.

They communicate proactively. They don't wait to be asked for a status update. They document what they find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed.

They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer.

They know where the line is. They own frontline support fully, and they know when an issue is a true code-level defect that belongs with engineering--handing it off cleanly rather than either sitting on it or tossing it over the wall half-formed.

US Salary Range

$124,000—$164,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

You will implement and deploy the core real-time image processing software of our infrared imaging systems. Your work will be essential to ensuring we can quickly field new technologies to embedded and SWAP-limited hardware, scale quickly, and securely integrate into the complex defense systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Apply your experience configuration Linux based operating systems and developing terminal-based software

• Become an expert in Nix and NixOS and help define and implement NixOS based embedded systems

• Gain a deep understanding of our unique infrared sensor systems and our existing image processing software

• Contribute to the development of real-time, high-bandwidth processing pipelines in C++ and/or CUDA

• Define and implement test and simulation environments, incorporating both software- and hardware-in-the-loop methodologies

• Support end-to-end system delivery, from initial design to manufacturing, deployment, and sustainment

• Work with a multi-disciplinary team on challenging problems in a fast-paced environment

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of professional C++ software development experience and using development tools such as GIT, JIRA, and CI/CD systems

• Experience developing low-latency, high-throughput software on Linux based systems, including knowledge of system utilities and basic configuration

• Familiarity in graphics programming or image processing

• Experience testing and debugging firmware on hardware platforms

• Experience with software infrastructure fundamentals including networking, security, and distributed systems

• Ability to quickly learn and implement new technologies and frameworks

• Ability to communicate ideas clearly and produce detailed technical documentation

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with configuration Linux operating systems and Linux kernel development

• Experience working with a variety of programming languages such as C, Rust, Python, etc.

• Familiarity in graphics programming or image processing

• Experience in connectivity and high-performance networking software development

• Any experience in Nix/NixOS is a big plus

• Active Secret U.S. security clearance

US Salary Range

$191,000—$254,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. ALTEN Technology USA is hiring a Director of Human Resources to lead HR for a fast-growing engineering services company headed to 1,500+ employees across multiple states. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and sit on the senior leadership team.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set HR strategy and lead a team of 5–10, while staying close to day-to-day HR work. We need a business partner who finds compliant ways to say yes, not a department that defaults to no.

• Own compliance: keep the company compliant with multi-state US employment law (including California and Colorado) and manage employee relations with leaders and legal counsel.

• Run talent programs: benefits, total rewards, performance management, succession planning, onboarding, engagement and retention.

• Integrate acquisitions: support M&A due diligence and lead HR integration of acquired companies.

• Lead the HR team: develop a team of 5–10 and do hands-on HR work alongside them.

• Partner globally: work with ALTEN Group to align HR tools and practices with US requirements.

What you bring

• 15+ years of HR experience, including 12+ years in leadership roles.

• Experience leading HR across all areas in an organization of 1,000+ employees.

• A track record in fast-paced, high-turnover, high-growth environments.

• Strong knowledge of multi-state US employment law, benefits and compliance.

• Comfort working in gray areas: finding practical, compliant solutions for the business.

• A hands-on, service-minded leadership style.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources or a related field.

• HR integration experience from mergers and acquisitions.

jobs.title: Sr. Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. At LinkedIn, hybrid roles are performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. Remote roles are performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval.

This role can be based in Sunnyvale, San Francisco, Carpinteria, Chicago, Detroit, New York, Omaha, and Washington, D.C, or remote.

As a Senior Event Marketing Manager, you will define and lead the approach for complex, high-impact events and experiential initiatives. You will connect business priorities, audience insights, and brand objectives to an integrated experience, bringing internal teams and agency partners together across creative, content, production, operations, and marketing workstreams.

This role combines event marketing strategy with hands-on program delivery. You will determine how assigned initiatives succeed when the path is not fully defined, align partners on the approach, and make recommendations when scope, budget, timing, and experience quality compete. You will also help strengthen the tools and practices that make successful event delivery repeatable.

Responsibilities

• Define the event approach. Translate business priorities, audience insights, accessibility considerations, and market context into event objectives, experience principles, an attendee journey, and a clear approach for assigned initiatives.
• Lead interconnected workstreams. Build and drive integrated plans across creative, content, production, operations, and marketing, establishing milestones, dependencies, owners, decision points, and measures of success.
• Deliver an integrated experience. Partner with internal specialists and experiential agencies to carry the intended experience from brief and concept through production, onsite delivery, and post-event wrap up. Ensure touchpoints work together for the audience and support the event’s objectives.
• Manage agency and production partners. Lead day-to-day alignment on briefs, scopes, deliverables, schedules, budgets, feedback, approvals, and quality. Surface relationship or delivery risks early and recommend a path forward.
• Resolve complex trade-offs. Assess options across scope, schedule, budget, partner capacity, production feasibility, and experience quality. Bring clear recommendations and decisions needed to stakeholders rather than simply escalating issues.
• Drive stakeholder decisions. Clarify objectives, roles, decision rights, and next steps; establish effective working rhythms; and influence cross-functional partners to resolve ambiguity and maintain momentum.
• Lead through delivery. Oversee readiness reviews, rehearsals, contingency planning, and onsite coordination for assigned initiatives, adapting to change while protecting the audience and brand experience.
• Define and apply measures of success. Establish learning questions and success criteria with relevant partners. Interpret performance data and attendee and stakeholder feedback to communicate impact and improve future experiences.
• Scale effective practices. Lead the development, adoption, and improvement of event playbooks, templates, and quality standards across connected workstreams. Share relevant industry practices and lessons learned with peers.
• Apply AI responsibly. Use AI to improve planning, documentation, analysis, and delivery efficiency while evaluating outputs and maintaining appropriate human judgment and quality standards.

Basic Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in event marketing, experiential marketing, event production, or a related field.
• Experience defining the approach and leading delivery for complex events or experiential initiatives spanning multiple connected workstreams.
• Experience managing experiential, creative, or production agencies, including scopes, deliverables, budgets, timelines, and execution quality.
• Experience defining success criteria, interpreting quantitative and qualitative feedback, and using findings to improve outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

• Ability to turn business objectives and audience insights into a differentiated event experience and actionable delivery plan.
• Strong project-management skills, including the ability to anticipate dependencies and risks and resolve competing priorities.
• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, communicate a clear point of view, and drive decisions through ambiguity.
• Experience with attendee-journey planning, experiential design, and onsite production for high-impact events.
• Experience developing and driving adoption of reusable event tools, playbooks, or quality standards.
• Proficiency with project-management tools such as Smartsheet and integrated project trackers.
• Experience applying AI tools responsibly to improve work quality or efficiency.
• PMP certification or equivalent project-management training.

Suggested Skills

• Experiential Strategy
• Project Management
• Vendor Management
• Stakeholder Management
• AI Fluency

Travel: 25% or more, depending on the event schedule.

jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/b540b9e2-0673-4d2d-91fd-e293658f4f6a/d5db35d1-81f0-4140-b61c-f3fb1004c7d1/job%20ad%20visual.png]


At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..




THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Quilting Assistant Brand Manager  to join us in growing Mrs Quilty , one of our creative brands built around quilting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves staying organized, spotting the little details others miss, and making sure things actually get done. You’ll work across product development, customer feedback, marketing, and day-to-day brand projects, helping keep everything running smoothly and looking for ways to make things better.

Crochet or knitting knowledge is a big advantage here. Understanding the craft helps you get our products, understand our customers, and spot issues they might notice.



🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

🧶 Product Development & Shopify

 - Help develop and improve products for Mrs Quilty.

 - Review patterns, instructions, and content for accuracy and quality.

 - Work with creators and internal teams to bring projects to life.

 - Help manage our Shopify store.

🔍 Customer Feedback

 - Review customer feedback and spot trends, issues, and opportunities.

 - Turn insights into ideas for improving products and the customer experience.

📈 Market Research

 - Keep up with quilting trends.

 - Research new ideas, products, and opportunities for the brand.

💬 Customer Support & Community

 - Help with product-related customer questions and feedback.

 - Keep an eye on our online communities and what customers are talking about.

📣 Marketing Support

 - Help execute marketing initiatives and campaigns.

 - Source creative content and support product storytelling.

🤖 AI & Smarter Ways of Working

 - Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, and everyday tasks.

 - Look for ways technology can help us work faster and smarter.




🦊 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Extreme attention to detail - You catch the small mistakes and inconsistencies.

 - Organized - You like keeping projects, tasks, and details under control.

 - Tech-savvy - Comfortable working with tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Sheets, Claude, InDesign, and other AI tools.

 - Independent - You take ownership and follow things through without being chased.

 - Adaptable - You handle changing priorities without losing focus.

 - Curious - You enjoy learning, testing ideas, and finding better ways to do things.

 - Open to feedback - You take feedback on board and use it to improve.

 - Quilting  knowledge - A strong advantage, especially when working with patterns and product content.

Experience in e-commerce, product development, or brand management is helpful, but we’re also interested in people who are smart, proactive, detail-focused, and eager to learn.



THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.

 2. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.

 3. Test Task 

 4. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

FIXED SERVICE FEE

Up to € 1500 euros after taxes, depending on your skills, competencies, and experience.

❕Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

❕This role is 100% remote.

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

 - For full-time roles, we expect hires to be available during at least 5 hours of typical working hours in the EET time zone to ensure effective collaboration and communication.
   
   This requirement does not apply to part-time roles.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

Ready to lead Foxelli’s growth journey? Apply now!

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
As Lead Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.
• Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.
• Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.
• Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.
• Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.
• Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).
• Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.
• Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.
• Excellent presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.
• Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

BONUS POINTS

• Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.
• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
• Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
• Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
• Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year
• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• Free language courses
• Birthday day off!
• 1 month of remote work
• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career-development opportunities.
• Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!
