jobs.title: Vertical Leader - Power Generation
jobs.description:
At Keeley Companies, we believe in empowering our people and fulfilling career aspirations. Keeley is a career destination with countless opportunities for advancement, and a world-class family culture that is centered around creating the best possible environment for our people to thrive.

The Vertical Leader - Power Generation is responsible for establishing, growing, and leading Keeley Construction's Power Generation market sector. This role serves as the strategic architect, industry expert, and operational leader responsible for developing a sustainable and scalable business platform focused on power generation facilities and related energy infrastructure.

The Vertical Market Leader will drive market strategy, client acquisition, operational readiness, talent development, and project execution capabilities to position Keeley as a premier construction partner within the power generation industry. The successful candidate will leverage deep market expertise, industry relationships, and strategic leadership to identify and pursue opportunities ranging from plant expansions, balance-of-plant infrastructure, renewable generation facilities, combustion turbine projects, distributed energy systems, and other power-related infrastructure projects.

This individual will be responsible not only for winning work but also for creating the organizational framework, processes, partnerships, staffing strategies, and operational capabilities necessary to successfully deliver projects in this market sector while supporting Keeley's long-term growth objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

• Develop and execute a comprehensive long-term growth strategy for the Power Generation vertical market.

• Establish Keeley's market positioning and value proposition within the power generation sector.

• Identify target clients, market segments, geographic priorities, and strategic opportunities.

• Develop measurable annual growth, revenue, and backlog objectives.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with utilities, independent power producers, developers, EPC firms, original equipment manufacturers, and industry stakeholders.

• Lead major pursuits and capture planning efforts for strategic opportunities.

• Represent Keeley at industry conferences, trade associations, client meetings, and market events.

• Serve as the company's principal subject matter expert and external face of the Power Generation market.

• Assess current organizational capabilities and develop a strategic roadmap for market expansion.

• Design and implement scalable processes, delivery models, and operational standards specific to power generation projects.

• Establish preconstruction, estimating, risk management, and execution methodologies tailored to power generation work.

• Develop strategic partnerships, joint venture opportunities, and subcontractor relationships that enhance Keeley's capabilities.

• Identify required investments in people, technology, training, and equipment to support market growth.

• Evaluate project delivery approaches including EPC support, self-perform opportunities, construction management, and general contracting roles.

• Provide recommendations regarding market expansion, service offerings, and organizational structure necessary to support future growth.

• Provide operational oversight and strategic guidance for all Power Generation projects.

• Collaborate with regional and operational leaders to ensure successful pursuit and execution strategies.

• Establish project controls, quality standards, safety expectations, and operational best practices specific to the market sector.

• Participate in executive project reviews and provide leadership on risk identification and mitigation.

• Drive continuous improvement and lessons-learned programs across all power-related projects.

• Ensure consistent execution standards are implemented throughout the organization.

• Develop and execute workforce strategies necessary to support market growth.

• Identify, recruit, and develop key leadership, operations, engineering, project management, and field supervision talent required for successful market expansion.

• Build a sustainable pipeline of industry expertise within the organization.

• Mentor account leaders, project executives, and operational teams supporting Power Generation projects.

• Assess manpower requirements and develop strategic staffing plans aligned with projected backlog growth.

• Establish training and development programs to build technical competencies required within the market.

• Develop annual market business plans, forecasts, and growth initiatives.

• Drive revenue growth, profitability, and backlog development within the Power Generation vertical.

• Support strategic pricing, estimating, and pursuit decisions.

• Monitor key market performance indicators and adjust strategies accordingly.

• Evaluate business cases for strategic investments, partnerships, and market expansion opportunities.

• Ensure financial objectives align with overall company strategic goals

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or related field required.

• 15+ years of experience in power generation, energy infrastructure, industrial construction, or related markets

• Demonstrated success developing and growing a business line, market sector, or vertical market.

• Extensive knowledge of power generation technologies including combined cycle, simple cycle, renewable energy, distributed generation, battery storage, and related infrastructure.

• Proven ability to establish and maintain executive-level client relationships.

• Experience leading large-scale project pursuits and strategic capture efforts.

• Strong understanding of EPC, construction management, and self-perform project delivery models.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing teams.

• Strong financial acumen and understanding of project economics, risk management, and market analysis.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influence skills.

• Ability to travel extensively to support client development and project execution activities.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Security Architect (Digital Assets)
jobs.location: WA - Seattle; UT - Cottonwood Heights; CA - San Francisco; NY - New York City; TX - Frisco
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

The SoFi Security Architecture and Enablement team assists and partners with engineering, product, and design organizations to build secure products and services delivered to our members and customers. We deploy proven Product Security practices, compliance frameworks, and design patterns while collaborating with product owners, engineers, and executives to ensure new products and features meet the highest security standards and regulations.

As a Senior Staff Security Architect (Digital Assets), you will serve as the principal technical authority responsible for the end-to-end security architecture of our digital asset platforms, products, and services. You will work in conjunction with security, compliance, and risk teams to guide strategic decisions, drive architectural blueprints, and lead initiatives that ensure timely delivery of resilient security solutions supporting our business targets. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, adept at balancing robust security with business goals, and inspired to creatively solve complex Product Security challenges across high-velocity distributed environments.

What you’ll do:

• Advocate and establish security standards and best practices across digital assets and crypto currencies product lifecycles.

• Lead threat modeling, architecture design reviews, and define technical security standards for crypto platforms.

• Architect end-to-end security architectures for custody, deposit, withdrawal, staking, and treasury operations.

• Design and implement Multi-Party Computation (MPC) protocols, multi-signature workflows, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) / Key Management Service (KMS) key lifecycles.

• Secure wallet integrations, partner APIs, and critical connections with institutional custody providers and settlement networks.

• Automate security verification checks (SAST, DAST, SCA) and embed "security as code" controls into continuous delivery pipelines.

• Assess smart contract ecosystems, cloud environments, and blockchain infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities and engineer mitigations.

• Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to evaluate digital asset regulatory requirements, perform security impact assessments, and establish digital asset policies.

• Develop security test plans, build reusable blueprint solutions, and balance stringent crypto security controls with a seamless member user experience.

• Partner across multiple engineering teams to raise the security bar, mentoring senior engineers and leading incident response coordination for complex crypto threats.

What you’ll need:

• Education & Minimum Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s degree + 4+ years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree + 3+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Proven security architecture experience with deep specialization in cryptocurrency, digital assets, and decentralized systems.

• Demonstrated technical expertise in applied cryptography, Multi-Party Computation (MPC), Threshold Cryptography, and HSM/KMS key lifecycle management.

• Solid track record designing end-to-end Zero Trust security architectures for high-stakes institutional crypto custody, staking, trading, and settlement platforms.

• In-depth knowledge of core blockchain protocol internals, transaction signing lifecycles, and multi-signature wallet infrastructures.

• Proven proficiency in threat modeling, smart contract auditing, vulnerability assessments, and secure API design.

• Hands-on experience architecting secure cloud-native environments (AWS, Kubernetes) and embedding automated "security as code" controls into CI/CD pipelines.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to interpret digital asset regulations and operationalize compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
About Decimal

Decimal is a franchise network of operator-owned accounting firms. We built the technology, processes, and infrastructure we had when we were running a firm, then made it available to independent accountants who want to grow without giving up ownership.





About Decimal

Our mission is to solve accounting operations for small to mid-sized businesses (SMBs). Currently, 60% of the 6 million SMBs in the United States say they are unhappy with their accounting operations: it's a mess of disconnected processes, technology, and people. To solve this need, we take over our clients’ accounting operations by pairing our people with our technology platform that unifies financial data, workflow, and communications. The Decimal platform helps automate large chunks of repetitive manual processes and manages the completion of work that can’t be automated.



About your role

Every business needs accounting operations to pay their bills, get paid, and track it all. Small business (SMB) accounting operations are painful and expensive; a tangled web of fragmented systems and poorly managed processes that touch every person in a company. The Accounting Managers' main role at Decimal is to build client relations and be the point of contact for all of our clients. They own the relationship with the client directly after sales and work cross-functionally with a support team who will be responsible for completing daily tasks and the Accounting Managers will be responsible for the QA of these tasks that have been completed by their support team.



This is an individual contributor position that is responsible for the management of the process and there is no people management involved.

 - Delight clients with expert guidance and support

jobs.title: Showrunner / Senior Producer, B2B Livestreams
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Organic Social Media Marketing
Location: Remote US
US Compensation Range: $130,000 to $140,000 base, plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Showrunner to own our B2B livestream programming end-to-end — from concept through story development to post-show cutdowns. You'll be the creative force behind our live product and thought-leadership streams, working directly with our Director of Organic Social Media and Content. This is a builder's role: you'll start as the sole owner of the discipline and grow it into a function as the slate expands.

You should think like a TV producer, not a webinar coordinator. We want someone who can shape a narrative arc for a 45-minute product livestream the same way they'd shape one for a talk show — casting the right voices, writing the copy that makes an exec sound human, and making sure the thing doesn't feel like corporate content.

Responsibilities:

• Own the full production lifecycle of Huntress's B2B livestreams and related video programming, including concept development, pre-production, scripting, and post-production.

• Research the story through background interviews and SME research, then write host scripts, talking points, and voice-over copy that bring the narrative to life.

• Cast, direct, and coach internal SMEs, executives, and partner guests so non-professional presenters perform with confidence on camera.

• Oversee cutdowns and repurposing of livestream content into shorts and social-first formats.

• Build the show calendar, production documents, and runsheets that keep the program predictable and repeatable.

• Partner with social, email, and demand generation on stream packaging and promotion, and help build the production function as the slate grows.

• Use AI tools to speed up everyday scripting, editing, research, and production workflows while applying sound editorial judgment.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Experience as a producer, showrunner, or executive producer in cable news, podcast or YouTube production, corporate livestream or webinar production, or a similar field.

• A natural reporter's instinct to conduct the interview, find the real story, and build the narrative rather than take a brief at face value.

• The ability to write scripts, host copy, and voice-over, while coaching nervous SMEs and executives to sound like real people on camera.

• Comfort being the only production person in the room, paired with a systems mindset that turns one-off execution into a repeatable process.

• Fluency with production tools, including Adobe Suite and basic post-production workflows, along with the taste to make B2B livestreams feel like compelling programming.

• Experience producing in a B2B marketing or demand generation context, or a track record of building a production function from scratch.

• The ability to use AI tools with good judgment to work faster and smarter across scripting, editing, research, and production workflows.

What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

• Stock options for all full-time employees

• One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office

• Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

• $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

• Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

jobs.title: Social Worker – Mental Health and Reablement
jobs.description:
Our client based in Leicestershire is seeking an experienced Social Worker to join their Mental Health and Reablement Team. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to support adults with mental health needs to maximise their independence, wellbeing, and recovery through strengths-based and person-centred social work practice.

The successful candidate will work with adults experiencing a range of mental health needs, supporting individuals through assessment, reablement, recovery-focused interventions, safeguarding, and care planning. Working closely with health professionals, community services, carers, families, and partner agencies, you will play a key role in promoting independence, reducing reliance on long-term services, and supporting individuals to remain safe and well within their communities.

This role requires a confident Social Worker with strong assessment skills, experience of Adult Mental Health practice, and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary environment.

Key Responsibilities

Core duties include:

• Managing a caseload of adults with mental health needs requiring assessment, intervention, reablement, and ongoing support.

• Undertaking Care Act 2014 assessments, reviews, reassessments, and support planning to identify eligible needs and achieve positive outcomes.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote recovery, independence, and wellbeing.

• Supporting adults through reablement pathways, helping them regain skills, confidence, and independence.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and responding appropriately to concerns relating to abuse, neglect, exploitation, and self-neglect.

• Assessing and managing risk effectively, balancing individual choice, safety, wellbeing, and positive risk-taking.

• Working collaboratively with Community Mental Health Teams, health professionals, housing providers, carers, families, community organisations, and partner agencies.

• Supporting hospital discharge and community-based interventions where required.

• Promoting social inclusion, recovery, resilience, and access to community resources that support long-term wellbeing.

• Providing advice, guidance, and practical support to individuals and carers throughout their social care journey.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, safeguarding discussions, case reviews, and professional forums.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records, assessments, reports, and support plans.

Qualifications & Experience

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care or Adult Mental Health Services.

• Mental Health Experience: Experience supporting adults with mental health needs, recovery planning, and community-based interventions.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Mental Health Act 1983, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake strengths-based assessments, reviews, support planning, and risk management interventions.

• Reablement Knowledge: Understanding of reablement principles and experience supporting individuals to maximise independence and reduce dependency on services.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with health professionals, community services, carers, families, housing providers, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred, recovery-focused practice and continuous professional development.

This role is ideal for someone who is organised, collaborative, proactive and comfortable communicating with senior stakeholders.

At Ramboll, our ambition is to be The Partner for Sustainable Change, and we are committed to creating innovative solutions that will contribute to accelerating the ongoing sustainable transition. Working for Ramboll means working for a company that strives to make a difference for our employees, clients and society. Combining local presence with global reach, we offer you a strong platform for continuous professional growth. The successful applicant for this role will have the opportunity to contribute to our strategy to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Work with Pursuit Consultants across all phases of the pursuit process by researching, finding, developing and coordinating content for pre-tender materials, tender responses, interview materials and post-pursuit activities
• Create first drafts and source relevant materials for pursuit briefing decks, tender submissions, credentials, CVs and project references
• Work closely with Pursuit Consultants and technical teams to produce well formatted and visually compelling materials
• Set up and manage pursuit collaboration spaces, including Teams or SharePoint sites, and maintain well-organised content and supporting information
• Coordinate clarification questions, responses and review cycles
• Proofread documents and help maintain consistency, accuracy and compliance
• Manage practical pursuit coordination where required, including meeting arrangements, review scheduling, portal testing, submission coordination and document close-out
• Support strategy and planning sessions by capturing and sharing notes, generating research to help technical teams translate ideas into compelling response content

About you

• Experience in bid, proposal, tender processes and familiarity with best-practice processes
• Good proposal writing, editing, formatting and proofreading skills
• Strong research skills, with the ability to source business, client, competitor and stakeholder information
• Strong organisational and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple information requests, deadlines and review cycles
• As this is a global role, you will be comfortable working remotely and with teams based internationally
• Confidence using Microsoft 365 collaboration tools, particularly Teams, SharePoint, Word and PowerPoint
• Ability to build effective relationships across technical and support teams and to work collaboratively, using your own initiative
• This role offers opportunities to grow within a new and evolving process so a desire to learn new skills and input into new processes is essential
• Strong communication skills and willingness to challenge unclear or incomplete instructions
• Experience of using AI systems is desirable
• In-Design skills will be desirable
• APMP foundation certification desirable but not required

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $65,000- $75,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Senior Designer, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Senior Motion Designer, Performance Marketing

Position Overview:
As a Senior Motion Designer at Fanatics Sportsbook, you will play a pivotal role in conceptualizing and executing high-quality 2D and 3D motion graphics that resonate with our target audiences. This role will primarily work within our performance marketing environment, creating assets built to drive acquisition, engagement, and conversion across paid channels. You will work closely with our creative and marketing teams to develop compelling visual narratives, animations, and effects, including 3D motion design, that elevate our brand and messaging.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with the creative and performance marketing teams to conceptualize and storyboard motion graphics projects.

• Design and animate engaging 2D and 3D visuals for a wide range of digital platforms, including paid social, websites, and advertisements.

• Produce high-volume, performance-driven creative, including variations and iterations for testing, and apply learnings from performance data to improve results.

• Create visually stunning title sequences, transitions, and other graphical elements for videos and multimedia projects.

• Incorporate internal feedback and iterate on designs to ensure they meet project objectives and exceed expectations.

• Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in motion design, 3D, and animation techniques.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Animation, Motion Graphics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of proven experience as a Motion Designer or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing your creative work.

• Demonstrated experience in 3D motion design, with 3D work featured in your portfolio.

• Proficiency in industry-standard design and animation software, such as Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, and Adobe Illustrator, plus a 3D tool such as Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar.

• Experience creating motion content in a performance marketing or paid media environment is strongly preferred.

• Solid understanding of design principles, typography, and color theory.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively present and articulate creative ideas.

• Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering exceptional visual experiences.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$90,000—$120,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

jobs.title: IT Systems Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

As our first dedicated internal IT hire, you'll take ownership of the systems, devices, and processes that keep our growing team productive and secure. You'll lead the implementation of company-wide device management, endpoint security, identity and access controls, and IT support processes across a distributed workforce.

With a significant engineering population running Ubuntu Linux, we're looking for someone who brings strong technical depth, practical security experience, and the ability to build reliable IT systems from the ground up.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll work closely with Engineering, Operations, and People teams, as well as external IT and security providers, to establish scalable processes without adding unnecessary complexity.




YOU WILL 

 - Own AeroVect's corporate IT infrastructure, including employee laptops, workstations, shared devices, and associated IT systems.

 - Lead the implementation and ongoing management of a company-wide device management platform across Ubuntu Linux, macOS, IpadOS and Windows.

 - Establish and maintain endpoint security standards, including disk encryption, patch management, endpoint protection, device monitoring, and recovery procedures.

 - Manage identity and access controls across Google Workspace and other business-critical applications, including MFA, permissions, and secure onboarding/offboarding.

 - Build and maintain automated workflows for device provisioning, software deployment, configuration management, and employee lifecycle management.

 - Own IT onboarding and offboarding, ensuring employees receive properly configured equipment and appropriate access from day one.

 - Provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting for employees

 - Manage hardware procurement, inventory, equipment lifecycle, repairs, replacements, and device recovery.

 - Develop and maintain practical IT security policies, documentation, incident response procedures, and operational standards.

 - Partner with Engineering to ensure security controls are compatible with development tools, containers, drivers, and specialized engineering workflows.

 - Coordinate with external IT and security providers on implementation, escalations, monitoring, and incident response.

 - Support employees across multiple countries through remote administration, equipment logistics, and coordination with local service providers.

 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security, automate repetitive tasks, and scale IT operations as AeroVect grows.


YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, systems administration, corporate IT, or a related technical role.

 - Strong hands-on experience administering Ubuntu Linux endpoints, including system configuration, troubleshooting, software management, and security.

 - Experience managing mixed operating system environments, including Linux, macOS, and Windows.

 - Experience implementing and administering endpoint or mobile device management (MDM) solutions.

 - Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace administration, identity and access management, MFA, and employee onboarding/offboarding.

 - Experience implementing endpoint security controls, including disk encryption, patch management, endpoint protection, and recovery processes.

 - Proficiency with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar tools.

 - Experience independently leading IT infrastructure projects, from initial assessment and tool selection through deployment and ongoing operations.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, endpoint hardware, networking, and business applications.

 - Ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Excellent communication skills and a service-oriented approach to supporting employees across technical and nontechnical teams.

 - Ability to work onsite in Atlanta and provide hands-on support for local equipment and employees.


WE PREFER

 - Experience as an early IT hire or IT systems owner at a rapidly growing technology or engineering company.

 - Experience supporting organizations with 100–500 employees and distributed international teams.

 - Familiarity with Fleet, JumpCloud, or similar cross-platform device management solutions.

 - Experience deploying and managing Linux disk encryption, including LUKS and recovery-key management.

 - Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR), security monitoring, and incident response coordination.

 - Familiarity with CIS Controls, NIST cybersecurity guidance, or similar security frameworks.

 - Experience working with managed service providers (MSPs) or external security vendors.

 - Familiarity with GitOps, infrastructure automation, or configuration management tools such as Ansible.

 - Experience supporting engineering environments involving Docker, Kubernetes, SSH, and specialized Linux development tools.

 - Experience establishing IT processes, documentation, and security standards from scratch.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Pursuits
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As a Director of Strategic Pursuits at Via, you will lead our most important new business opportunities from first conversation to signed contract. You’ll work with cities, transit agencies, and operators who are rethinking how their communities move, and you’ll own the strategy that turns their goals into winning proposals and long-term partnerships. Our team is made up of talented, collaborative people who are passionate about making public transit better, and at Via, the work we do together translates into real impact for the people who depend on it every day.

About the Role:

• Own the strategy for Via’s highest-value, most complex pursuits, from early market shaping through RFP response, negotiation, and award

• Build relationships with prospective partners at the most senior levels, becoming a trusted advisor long before a procurement is issued and helping shape how agencies think about what’s possible

• Develop a clear win strategy for each pursuit, grounded in a deep understanding of the agency, the competitive landscape, and the community the service is meant to support

• Use service data, benchmarks, and performance insights to make the case for Via’s approach and to inform pricing, scope, and commercial structure

• Independently lead high-stakes negotiations with executive stakeholders, turning politically sensitive and highly complex situations into agreements that work for both the partner and Via

• Partner closely with Partner Success to ensure a seamless handoff from pursuit to launch, so that what we promise is what we deliver

• Bring what you learn in the market back to Via, influencing our roadmap, positioning, and approach to new geographies and service models

About You:

• 10+ years of experience in complex, senior-level public sector environments, working with city governments, transit agencies, and elected officials

• Experience with public procurement, including RFPs, negotiations, and contracting, and a sharp instinct for what evaluators and decision-makers care about

• Quantitatively inclined and data savvy; you use complex data sets to build a compelling case and influence senior stakeholders both internally and externally

• An entrepreneurial relationship builder who brings clarity and confidence to ambiguous, politically sensitive situations, turning them into opportunities to build trust

• An exceptional communicator and storyteller, in writing and in the room, who can make a complicated idea feel simple and persuasive

• A reliable, motivated self-starter who shapes the way things are done and sets a standard others aspire to

• A natural leader in every sense, someone whose judgment, presence, and way of operating raises the quality of the work and the people around them, regardless of title

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range: $160,000-$210,000, determined by experience, knowledge, and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.

• Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.

• A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.

• Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.

• Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).

• 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility.

Ready to join the ride?

jobs.title: Registered Nurse BSN-Breast Imaging Casual Days
jobs.description:
**This is a casual/ as needed position located at Catherine Gratz Griffin Lake Forest Hospital. We are looking for someone with availability on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays as needed. This role is to cover PTO and high-volume days and does not have guaranteed  hours.  **

The Registered Nurse BSN embodies the attributes of the Relationship Based Care model and performs to PPM core functions. Under the direction of the department leadership, consistently reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the State of Illinois Nurse Practice Act, the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

Relationship to Patient/Family and Community

Care Coordination

• Performs a comprehensive assessment on all assigned patients as evidenced by completed documentation.
• Communicates changes in patient’s condition promptly.
• Utilizes appropriate nursing diagnosis and data from the assessment to derive realistic outcomes and documents them as measurable goals on the plan of care; modifies care plan, if indicated, in order to identify realistic patient goals.
• Identifies and prioritizes patient needs and/or nursing diagnosis for patients and documents.
• Collaborates with patient, family, and other members of the health care team when planning patient care and documents accordingly. Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary.
• Evaluates and documents the patient response to nursing interventions and alters the plan of care as necessary.
• Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary, including palliative care.
• Assures a completed discharge instructions, medication reconciliation and provide information to patient/family regarding the use of the patient portal and other pertinent resources.

Patient Education/Ethic and Diversity

• Supports patient/family/spiritual/cultural needs when assessing the patient and family needs for teaching; identifies the patient's learning level and readiness, and documents education record.
• Utilizes the teach back methodology for advancing patient education about medication side effects and new medication education.
• Utilizes and distributes Krames for patient education /clinical condition.
• Utilizes culture vision as a resource in care planning and delivery.
• Treats patients, families and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity.
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care.
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice.
• Calls for an ethics consult when appropriate.

EBP and Research

• Implements nursing interventions consistent with the established plan of care based on evidenced based care.
• Maintains and advances the professional image and science of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through use of best available evidence utilizing resources such as Ovid/Joanna Briggs, Up to Date, Culture Vision, and other reliable sources of evidence.
• Demonstrates active involvement in clinical LADDER project or process improvement at the unit/organization level.

Healing Safe Environment

• Demonstrates safe medication administration through the use of bar coding
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Conveys complete, timely, and accurate information at bedside shift report/hand-off
• Rounds hourly in collaboration with patient care technician
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment of excellence
• Demonstrates innovation and participation in meeting unit based and organizational quality metrics on the exceptional care dashboard
• Ensures clinical practice excellence that focuses on preventing pressure ulcers, falls, CAUTI’s and central line infections (as appropriate to area of practice).

Shared Leadership

• Demonstrates proficiency in the charge nurse/preceptor role when assigned; assumes responsibility for coordinating patient care for the entire unit.

Use of Technology

jobs.title: Experienced Social Worker – Transitions Team
jobs.description:
Our client based in Wolverhampton is seeking three experienced Social Workers to join their Transitions Team. This is an excellent opportunity for skilled practitioners to support young people and adults with a range of disabilities through key transition periods, promoting independence, wellbeing, and positive long-term outcomes through strengths-based and person-centred practice.

The successful candidates will work with young people aged 16-18 and adults with complex needs, supporting preparation for adulthood, transition planning, safeguarding, complex assessments, and care planning. The role involves working closely with individuals, families, carers, Children's Services, health professionals, education providers, housing services, and partner agencies to ensure smooth transitions into adulthood and Adult Social Care.

This role requires confident and experienced Social Workers who can manage complex casework, undertake court-related work, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment whilst maintaining high standards of professional practice.

Key Responsibilities

Core duties include:

• Managing a caseload of young people and adults with learning disabilities, physical disabilities, autism, and complex care and support needs.

• Supporting young people through preparation for adulthood and transition from Children's Services into Adult Social Care.

• Undertaking Care Act 2014 assessments, transition assessments, reviews, and support planning to identify eligible needs and positive outcomes.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote independence, wellbeing, and community inclusion.

• Working collaboratively with young people, families, carers, Children's Services, education providers, health professionals, housing teams, and partner agencies.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Completing Court of Protection work, including Community Deprivation of Liberty Safeguards (CDoLS) applications and Section 16 welfare applications where required.

• Preparing high-quality court reports, professional assessments, and supporting legal documentation.

• Undertaking Mental Health Act-related duties, including Social Circumstances Reports where appropriate.

• Completing Home Office reports and supporting individuals with complex legal, forensic, or immigration-related circumstances where required.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and responding to safeguarding concerns in accordance with Adult Safeguarding legislation and local procedures.

• Managing complex risks and supporting positive risk-taking whilst promoting choice, control, and independence.

• Participating in duty functions and responding to urgent referrals and service demands as required.

• Attending and contributing to multidisciplinary meetings, court hearings, Best Interest meetings, safeguarding discussions, and transition planning meetings.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant case records, assessments, reports, and support plans.

Qualifications & Experience

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Disabilities Experience: Proven experience supporting adults with learning disabilities, physical disabilities, autism, and complex support needs.

• Transitions Experience: Experience supporting young people aged 16-18 through preparation for adulthood and transition into Adult Social Care is highly desirable.

• Court Experience: Experience undertaking complex court work, including Court of Protection applications, CDoLS, Section 16 welfare applications, and court report writing.

• Mental Health Knowledge: Experience completing Social Circumstances Reports and an understanding of Mental Health Act processes is desirable.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Mental Health Act 1983, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and relevant statutory guidance.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with Children's Services, health professionals, education services, housing providers, carers, families, legal services, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Ability to work at pace, manage competing priorities, and confidently engage with a wide range of professionals and stakeholders.

Interested? Apply now or get in touch with us to learn more about this opportunity.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Construction (Utilities & Site Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.

Ready to join our team?

At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. Now, we’re bringing that commitment to Durham, North Carolina, with a new manufacturing campus that will expand our ability to produce medicines and create opportunities in the Research Triangle.

The campus will integrate advanced manufacturing, laboratory technologies and AI to support the production of immunology, oncology and neuroscience medicines. The first phase will include manufacturing facilities, next-generation laboratories, a warehouse, administrative offices and employee wellness facilities.

To learn more about this investment, please visit https://www.abbvie.com/abbvie-north-carolina-manufacturing.html

We are now recruiting our Project Manager - Construction (Utilities & Site Infrastructure) as part of the core start up team.

In this role, you will:

* Utility systems will include Industrial Utilities (IU) and Clean Utilities (CU) including Domestic Water, Chilled Water, Condenser Water, Heating Hot Water, Plant Steam and Condensate, Electrical Distribution including UPS and Generator backup systems, Compressed Air, Process Waste, Sanitary Waste, Vacuum, Pre-Treated Water, Water for Injection (WFI), Gaseous Delivery (i.e., Nitrogen), Clean Steam, and Clean Compressed Air.

* Manages key design interfaces between SVP and BDS A&E firm(s) to ensure that the Basis of Design for both CU and IU systems are aligned including any pre-treatment steps that may be centralized.

* Manages key design interfaces between SVP and BDS A&E firm(s) and the Balance of Campus (BOC) A&E firm to ensure that clear system boundaries are established.

* In coordination with AbbVie's Startup and CQV group, ensure that utility system preparation for operation steps, i.e., pressure testing, cleaning, descaling, passivation, etc. is included for all CU and IU systems.

* Ensure up-front planning is established for handling feed and waste stream flows for typical utility system preparation for operation steps.

* Evaluate modularization of CU and IU systems during design to ensure that future expansion of utilty systems are accommodated.

* Evaluate skidded systems, off-site fabrication, pipe racks, etc. to ensure fastest installation and startup approach can be delivered.

* Ensure Industrial Use Permit (IUP) requirements for both domestic water inflow and sewer outflow is coordinated throughout the initial design process and that the site IUP is approved in advance of project requirements.  Additionaly, ensure that any other environmental and/or permitting considerations are evaluated such as Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) concentrations in effluent.

* Ensure that a common set of utility system engineering specfications and standards are established across the program.

* Establish third-party testing programs for all CU and IU systems and ensure that off-site testing, inspections, reporting, etc. is clearly defined prior to bidding those services.

* Align on long-lead equipment required for early procurement and ensure that equipment specifications and procurement packages are initiated as soon as practicable.

* Working with AbbVie EHS, align on sustainability and energy efficiency requirements as well as establishing a Power Monitoring System.

* Working with AbbVie BTS, ensure that control architecture is aligned for all utility systems.

* Evaluate constructability and sequence of all utility systems to ensure fastest possible beneficial use and qualified operational dates can be achieved.

* Working with the SVP and BDS A&E firm(s) and AbbVie leads for both, ensure that a clearly defined and delineated interface between utility system design scopes are established.

* Working with AbbVie EHS, ensure that safe work plans are established for construction, pre-startup, commissioning and qualification activities are establshed and aligned.

* Manages and controls budget for all utility systems scope.

* Manages and controls schedule for all utility systems scope.

* Manages and controls risk assessments and remediation for all utility systems scope.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and operate data platform components and data-intensive products. You will own significant data engineering work from requirements and design through implementation and production support, partnering with Data Engineering, Data Science, Cloud, DevOps, Application, Product, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable solutions that support business growth.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who can solve distributed-data challenges, contribute to sound technical decisions, support other engineers, and help bring emerging technologies into reliable production capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, platform components, and data-intensive services.
• Own data engineering work from requirements and technical design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
• Contribute to data acquisition strategies, dataset contracts, acceptance criteria, quality standards, lineage, and lifecycle policies.
• Build scalable batch and real-time data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and distributed processing solutions for high-volume workloads.
• Help evolve the data ecosystem to support growth in data volume, velocity, variety, and product complexity.
• Apply and improve reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration, testing, observability, and delivery.
• Build production systems that meet expectations for reliability, security, performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and SLA-driven delivery.
• Contribute to operational practices for monitoring, incident response, failure recovery, replay, backfills, schema evolution, and disaster recovery.
• Partner with Data Science and ML teams to productionize ML, AI, and LLM-based workloads and integrate them into customer-facing products.
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Application, Security, Product, and client teams to deliver robust solutions for business and customer needs.
• Evaluate technologies and architectural patterns, contribute to technical proofs of concept, and recommend adoption based on measurable value.
• Document technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation approaches.
• Participate in technical reviews and help improve design, code quality, testing, maintainability, and production ownership.
• Support engineering roadmaps, hiring, and capability development across the data engineering discipline.

• 6+ years of hands-on software or data engineering experience, including experience designing, building, and operating production-grade data systems.
• Experience contributing to complex data initiatives across teams.
• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or comparable practical experience.
• Strong understanding of data-intensive and distributed systems, including scalability, reliability, consistency, and performance trade-offs.
• Strong proficiency in Python and working proficiency in Scala.
• Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
• Experience with large-scale data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and Databricks.
• Experience designing and operating event-driven or streaming systems using technologies such as Apache Kafka.
• Experience with workflow orchestration and platform tooling such as Apache Airflow, including maintainable DAGs and operational business-critical workflows.
• Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with data modeling, query optimization, and data storage systems.
• Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: data lake or lakehouse architectures; columnar or analytical databases; or NoSQL or distributed database systems.
• Experience owning production-grade batch and/or streaming pipelines, including data quality, observability, schema evolution, backfills, recovery procedures, and SLA management.
• Hands-on experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating production-grade microservices.
• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices; experience with Helm is an advantage.
• Familiarity with LLM application and workflow frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
• Ability to evaluate technologies, make sound technical decisions, and communicate trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
• Strong collaboration, mentoring, and technical communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while balancing platform improvements with near-term product delivery.
• Pragmatic, results-driven approach and commitment to strong engineering fundamentals.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg; ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow.
• Experience with Pandas/Polars and building data services/APIs (e.g., FastAPI).
• Experience building LLM-powered agents or chat assistants (RAG, tool/function calling, workflow or multi-agent orchestration) using modern frameworks and platforms.
• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation) and cloud security fundamentals (IAM, secrets, encryption).
• Experience with observability tooling (metrics/logging/tracing) and cost/performance optimization for distributed workloads.
• Experience building applications with React and Node.js.

Our Benefits

• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Senior Engineer with Python, Agentic AI, Multi-cloud, MCP along with IAM, Cyber experience
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.

In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.

The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
• Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
• Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
• Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
• Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
• Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
• Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
• Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
• Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
• Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
• Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
• Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
• Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
• 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
• Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
• Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
• Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
• Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
• Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
• Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).

The Water Treatment Plant Operator will:

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, demonstrate manual dexterity, climb stairs, talk, hear, and see.

• Work is in a surface mine plant setting, which may include exposure to extremes in temperature and humidity.

The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

As a Sr. Security Engineer at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), your knowledge and experience in designing, implementing and maintaining security measures will help the organization stay ahead of security risks and protect company assets. This role sits on the Security Operations Team within the Information Security department and reports to the Manager, Security Engineering.

Responsibilities

• Partner with cross functional teams on endpoint security initiatives, ensuring configurations, policies, and enforcement mechanisms are sound and aligned with organizational risk tolerance.

• Monitor and help remediate vulnerabilities across the endpoint and mobile fleet, partnering with IT on patch management and compliance tracking.

• Continuous evaluation of several security tools including but not limited to Data Loss Prevention, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Web Application Firewall, Email Protection and Endpoint Protection.

• Develop and maintain a library of scripts to be leveraged to automate threat hunting, detection, and digital forensics efforts.

• Design, implement and refine security detection mechanisms to improve operational efficiency and observability.

• Leverage AI tools and workflows to accelerate threat hunting, detection, and other automation efforts.

• Mentor junior team members and build out runbooks and training resources that raise the bar for the whole team.

• Stay up-to-date on the latest threats, vulnerabilities, and security trends to ensure that our organization is prepared to address emerging threats.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that secure implementation guidelines are followed.

• Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for critical incident escalations.

Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience as a security engineer or in a similar role

• Strong hands on experience securing and managing mobile devices at scale

• Experience with vulnerability management practices and tools, particularly for endpoint and mobile device compliance.

• Experience participating in incident response efforts, with the ability to lead investigations involving endpoint or mobile compromise.

• Experience with identity management protocols (e.g., OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect).

• Experience evaluating, selecting, or implementing enterprise security tools (e.g., DLP, IAM, WAF, email security).

• Experience building or tuning detection logic to identify malicious activity (detection engineering).

• Experience automating security workflows via SOAR or custom scripting.

• Demonstrated ability to adapt to evolving priorities, ambiguous requirements and a rapidly changing security landscape.

• Team player and strong communicator able to translate technical concepts for any audience.

• Eager to learn and adapt with a drive to learn new tools, techniques, and approaches as the security landscape evolves.

• Experience drafting high quality documentation such as standards, policies, and architecture diagrams.

• Demonstrated experience leveraging Infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or Ansible is preferred.

• Experience with Cloudflare Datadog, Wiz and Tines is preferred.

• Foundational knowledge in agile methodologies required.

• Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Bash is required.

• Relevant certifications such as GCIH, OSCP, or GSEC are a plus

Associate Marketing Manager, Bantam Books, Mystery/Thriller/Fiction (Hybrid)

The Bantam marketing team is seeking an Associate Marketing Manager to lead and execute dynamic marketing campaigns across a wide list of fiction titles, including mystery, thriller, horror, cozy mystery, and other commercial fiction.  This position reports to the Bantam marketing lead at Random House.

The ideal candidate is deeply engaged with the mystery and thriller reader community, excited by emerging trends in digital and social marketing, and eager to help connect readers with unforgettable books and authors. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment where creativity and innovation are highly valued.

Bantam is home to bestselling and breakout voices in the mystery, thriller and horror categories, publishing suspenseful titles people are dying to read and discuss online. Some of our authors include Lee Child, Holly Jackson, Ashley Flowers, Erin E. Adams, Liv Constantine, and more.

The Role:

• Lead, develop and execute marketing campaigns for 8-10 suspense and commercial fiction titles a season, from launch through publication and relevant backlist support
• Identify target audiences and develop creative approaches to reach readers across social media, digital communities, retail channels, and emerging platforms
• Contribute to social media strategy and influencer event programming
• Maintain a strong awareness of trends within the mystery and thriller spaces, including BookTok, Bookstagram, Goodreads, Substack, and creator/influencer communities
• Build strong working relationships with authors, agents, influencers, and internal stakeholders to support successful campaign execution
• Analyze campaign performance and audience engagement metrics to optimize marketing strategy and identify growth opportunities.

• 2–4 years of experience in digital or title marketing
• Organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail
• Strong communication skills, with confidence interacting across departments and with external partners
• Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable approach to problem-solving and campaign management
• Familiarity with Canva, TikTok, Instagram, and other digital marketing tools
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a hybrid work environment
• A genuine passion for mystery, thriller, and suspense content.

The salary for this position is $70,500.  All positions are currently eligible for annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

This hybrid role requires in-office responsibilities, including but not limited to in-office meetings, author visits or events, and daily ad hoc administrative projects. We will consider candidates who can work from a commutable distance to our offices at 1745 Broadway, which includes the tri-state area (NJ, CT, & PA).

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 1, 2026, or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. For this position a complete application should include your resume and cover letter, as both are required for consideration. Before applying for any role at Penguin Random House, we recommend you review our applicant resources page and our FAQs page.

Penguin Random House job postings include a good faith compensation range for each open position. The salary range listed is specific to each particular open position and takes into account various factors including the specifics of the individual role, and candidate's relevant experience and qualifications.

Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program. Our range of benefits include, but are not limited to, Medical/Prescription drug insurance, Dental, Vision, Health Care/Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Pre-Tax and Roth 401(k), Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life/AD&D Insurance, Commuter Benefits, Student Loan Repayment Program, Educational Assistance & generous paid time off.

jobs.title: Director Engineering
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. 


About the Role 
As the Director of Engineering for Card Issuing, you will lead the engineering organization that builds and runs our card issuing product. You will own engineering vision, architecture and delivery across product development, quality assurance, release management, reliability engineering and process automation. 
You will be a key strategic partner to our Global business, shaping how we build and deliver software and growing the people who do it. You will work closely with product, business and customer-facing leaders to make sure engineering stays aligned with where the company is going.
