jobs.title: Senior Mulesoft Developer
jobs.description:
Buscamos incorporar un/a Senior MuleSoft Developer con experiencia sólida en las distintas soluciones del ecosistema MuleSoft. Este rol formará parte de nuestros equipos de desarrollo, colaborando en la construcción de soluciones de integración y datos de la más alta calidad funcional y técnica para nuestros clientes.

Si te apasiona diseñar e implementar soluciones robustas, escalables y de alto rendimiento, y quieres trabajar en un entorno dinámico donde tu criterio técnico tiene peso real, este reto es para ti.

Responsabilidades Principales

• Diseñar arquitecturas de integración MuleSoft bajo el enfoque API-Led Connectivity, alineadas con los objetivos técnicos y de negocio de cada cliente.
• Implementar soluciones técnicas de alta calidad, en cumplimiento de los requisitos funcionales y no funcionales definidos para cada proyecto.
• Supervisar la integración de APIs y flujos Mule, garantizando la correcta conectividad entre sistemas, así como su seguridad, escalabilidad y rendimiento.
• Participar activamente en equipos de desarrollo bajo metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban), contribuyendo a la planificación, estimación y entrega continua.
• Colaborar en procesos de calidad: peer-review de código, documentación técnica y definición de estándares y buenas prácticas de gobernanza en Anypoint Platform.
• Apoyar y/o liderar el diseño técnico de integraciones: contratos de API, mapeos de datos, estrategias de error handling y resiliencia.
• Documentar APIs y activos reutilizables utilizando Anypoint Exchange y herramientas de diseño de MuleSoft.
• Interactuar con clientes de forma directa, recogiendo requisitos, comunicando avances y aportando soluciones orientadas al negocio.
• Mantener y dar soporte a soluciones existentes: debugging, optimización de rendimiento y mejora de la observabilidad.

Requisitos Mínimos

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de APIs e integraciones (implementación, testing, hardening).
• Dominio de MuleSoft Studio, DataWeave, MUnit, API Manager y Anypoint Exchange.
• Experiencia en diseño y gestión del ciclo de vida de APIs bajo el enfoque API-Led Connectivity.
• Conocimiento de RAML y/o OAS (OpenAPI) para el diseño y documentación de APIs.
• Experiencia en integración con sistemas heterogéneos: REST, SOAP, JDBC, (S)FTP, JMS, CRMs y ERPs.
• Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS y uso de políticas de seguridad en MuleSoft.
• Manejo de Git, pipelines CI/CD, prácticas de calidad de código y troubleshooting en runtime.
• Integraciones asincronas, MuleSoft VM queues, colas de mensajería(RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)...
• Revisión de Observabilidad en Anypoint Monitoring, logs de CloudHub, uso de herramientas de observabilidad como Elastic, Azure Monitor, Datadog...
• Capacidad de autogestión: organización eficaz de tareas, seguimiento proactivo y entrega sin supervisión constante.
• Habilidades de comunicación con cliente: escucha activa, presentación de soluciones y gestión de expectativas.Experiencia en liderazgo técnico: capacidad para guiar y supervisar a otros miembros del equipo, realizar revisiones de código, definir estándares técnicos y servir como referente para perfiles junior y mid.
• Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería, Big Data, o un campo relacionado.
• Idiomas: B1 mínimo de inglés.

jobs.title: School Account Manager II
jobs.description:
About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

Job Description

The School Account Manager II is responsible for managing and selling Renaissance Learning’s products and services, within assigned territory, and achievement of revenue goals through prospecting, new business, customer renewals, cross-sell, and up-sell opportunities.

The School Account Manager II has meaningful sales experience and brings developing expertise for cultivation and long-term development of customer relationships, maintaining high product renewal rates and strong collaboration with Customer Success partners and members of the Account Executive team. You will operate are the primary account contact for customers, increasing customer loyalty and retention while driving business value and expansion.

This position requires occasional travel for customer engagements, conferences, and other revenue-generating activities. We are ideally looking for someone who resides in either South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, or Alabama.

In this role as School Account Manager II, you will be responsible for:

• Managing Opportunities: Drive new business, cross/up-sell and renewal opportunities proactively by engaging multiple decision makers to ensure communication and agreement through the life of the opportunity and use internal and external networks to increase opportunity value. Grow assigned book of business to exceed revenue goals.

• Consultative Solution Selling: Understand and sell solutions aligned to customers’ unique problems and strategic objectives. Leads across the account team, internal, and external partners to develop winning solutions bringing value for both the customer and Renaissance.

• Closing Business: Understand and sell solutions aligned to customers’ unique problems and strategic objectives. Leads across the account team, internal, and external partners to develop winning solutions bringing value for both the customer and Renaissance.

• K-12 Education Acuity: Possesses a deep knowledge of the K-12 education space including public, private, and parochial schools. Strong understanding of K-12 districts and school administrative roles, funding, purchasing process, buying cycles, policies, practices, trends, and school board oversight. Knows customer workflows, contacts, and how they integrate into decision-making processes.

• Domain Expertise: Possess strong technical knowledge of common tools and trends in ed tech space; staying current on probable future state policies, practices, and information affecting customer businesses. Knows the competition and how strategies and tactics work in the marketplace.

• Credibility: Builds rapport based on factual accuracy, expertise across offerings, delivering on expectations and proactively providing market insights that inspire customers to think of Renaissance as a partner

Qualifications

For this role as School Account Manager II, you should have:

• 4+ years with prior experience in sales

• Proficient in collaboration tools (e.g., Outlook, Microsoft Teams, etc.)

• Familiarity with CRMs and other sales technology (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics)

• Knowledge of education customers, their organizational structures, and leadership personas

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills

Bonus Points:

• Experience in education sales

• Demonstrated capacity for resourcefulness and creative problem-solving

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Salary Range: The base range for this position is $61,800 - $85,000 with a total target compensation (TTC) range of $123,000-158,000.  This range is based on national market data and may vary by experience and location.

jobs.title: Adult Social Worker – Hospital Discharge
jobs.description:
Our client in East Sussex is seeking an experienced and motivated Adult Social Worker to join its Hospital Discharge Team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified Social Worker with experience in Adult Social Care, hospital discharge and community-based services.

The successful candidate will work across hospital and community settings, supporting adults with care and support needs to leave hospital safely and transition back into their homes or appropriate care environments.

You will work closely with hospital staff, healthcare professionals, families, carers and community services to undertake assessments, coordinate discharge plans and ensure individuals receive the right level of support to maximise their independence and wellbeing.

The service promotes a home-first approach, strengths-based practice and discharge-to-assess principles, helping adults recover safely while reducing unnecessary reliance on long-term care.

Key Responsibilities

• Undertake Care Act 2014 assessments for adults with care and support needs.

• Support safe and timely hospital discharges into the community.

• Conduct assessments within hospital settings and individuals' homes.

• Develop personalised care and support plans based on individual needs and desired outcomes.

• Undertake Mental Capacity Act assessments and Best Interest decisions where required.

• Identify and manage safeguarding concerns and assess potential risks.

• Coordinate appropriate care packages, rehabilitation and community support.

• Work collaboratively with hospital teams, NHS professionals and multidisciplinary services.

• Engage with families, carers and service users throughout the discharge process.

• Review care arrangements and promote independence and wellbeing.

• Maintain accurate case records, assessments and professional reports.

Essential Experience & Skills

• Previous experience working within statutory Adult Social Care.

• Experience undertaking Care Act assessments.

• Knowledge and experience of hospital discharge and community-based social work.

• Experience managing complex cases and undertaking risk assessments.

• Understanding of adult safeguarding procedures.

• Knowledge of Mental Capacity Act legislation.

• Experience working within multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent communication, assessment and report-writing skills.

• Ability to manage a varied caseload and work independently.

• Flexibility to work across hospital and community environments.

Essential Qualifications

• Recognised Social Work qualification (Degree, CQSW, DipSW or equivalent).

• Current registration with Social Work England.

• Completion of the Assessed and Supported Year in Employment (ASYE), where applicable.

• Good working knowledge of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005 and adult safeguarding legislation.

Interested? Apply now or get in touch with us to learn more about this opportunity.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

Reasonable Adjustments:

If you consider yourself to have a disability or require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please highlight this at the earliest opportunity by contacting our team. With this information, we will provide appropriate support to you throughout the process and into your work placement.

jobs.title: Risk Assurance Specialist x2
jobs.description:
NOTE: This role does not offer Relocation or Sponsorship. Applicants must be eligible to work in Jersey

We're seeking two Risk Assurance Specialists to provide independent assurance across the business, helping to strengthen our control environment, identify areas for improvement, and ensure effective risk management practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong internal audit background who enjoys working closely with stakeholders, conducting detailed reviews, analysing complex information, and driving meaningful business improvements.

As a Risk Assurance Specialist, you will be responsible for planning and delivering risk-based assurance reviews across the organisation. You'll evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, governance frameworks, and business processes, while providing practical recommendations that support the achievement of strategic objectives.

Key Outputs

• Conduct independent assurance reviews across business functions.
• Analyse processes, controls, risks, and operating procedures to identify areas for improvement.
• Perform walkthroughs and detailed assessments to develop a thorough understanding of how business activities operate.
• Prepare clear, concise reports detailing findings, insights, and recommendations.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and communicate outcomes confidently and professionally.
• Challenge existing practices and encourage continuous improvement in risk and control environments.
• Support the implementation and validation of agreed actions to ensure issues are effectively addressed and embedded.
• Use data, evidence, and business insight to support robust audit conclusions and recommendations.

Experience and Qualifications

• At least 5 years' experience in Internal Audit, Assurance, or a related audit function.
• Experience conducting end-to-end audits, reviews, and assessments.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand complex processes and identify key risks and control weaknesses.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence and challenge constructively.
• Experience tracking, implementing, and validating remediation actions.
• A collaborative approach and confidence interacting with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
• Banking or financial services experience (preferred).
• A degree in Internal Audit, Risk Management, or a related discipline.

Behavioural competencies

• Examining Information
• Articulating information
• Challenging ideas
• Providing insights
• Interpreting data

Technical Competencies

• Internal Audit Methodology
• Risk & Control Assessment
• Control Testing & Assurance Reviews
• Stakeholder Management
• Data Analysis & Interpretation

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Python and AI/ML Development
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer with solid technical depth to build, deploy, and operate Python services and machine learning components, working with Python, NumPy, Pandas, FastAPI/Flask, LLM frameworks, and Azure.

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop maintainable, modular Python components and services that follow SOLID and equivalent principles
• Build, train, evaluate, and productionalize ML models and AI components (classical ML, NLP, and LLM based features) in collaboration with product and architecture teams
• Develop LLM powered capabilities such as prompt pipelines, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and tool or function calling using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex
• Build data processing and feature engineering pipelines using NumPy, Pandas, and SQL
• Design, build, and consume REST APIs with FastAPI and Flask to serve models and AI capabilities
• Apply concurrency, asynchronous programming (asyncio), and batching techniques to improve inference and service throughput
• Track experiments, version models and datasets, and support model deployment using MLflow or equivalent MLOps tooling
• Monitor models and AI services in production for latency, cost, drift, and output quality, and act on findings
• Solve technical problems by analyzing possible solutions and their impact on the function and the business
• Provide informal guidance to new and junior team members through code reviews and pairing
• Understand how the team's work integrates with closely related teams and account for interdependencies
• Write and execute unit tests using pytest and mocking libraries; perform API integration testing and basic model validation testing
• Implement CI/CD pipelines to build and deploy applications and maintain a high level of quality maturity in pipeline quality gates
• Implement security best practices (input validation, authentication, authorization, secrets handling, OWASP guidelines) and responsible AI practices such as prompt injection awareness and data privacy
• Deploy and operate applications on Azure using Docker and Kubernetes
• Collaborate with cross functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, test, and production environments
• Explain technical, sometimes complex and dynamic concepts clearly to others

• 3.5+ years of strong working experience in Python development, including at least 1.5 years building ML or AI enabled applications
• Solid experience with NumPy, Pandas, and scikit learn for data oriented services and model development
• Working experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
• Hands on experience with LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI or similar), prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases
• Strong experience in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs; experience building and operating FastAPI or Flask services
• Strong experience with common software design patterns (for example Adapter, Strategy, Factory)
• Good experience using AI assisted tools in the SDLC
• Experience with code execution best practices (memory footprint, profiling) and database query analysis (explain plan, statistics)
• Working knowledge of RDBMS and NoSQL stores; hands on experience in messaging and queuing
• Proficiency in pytest; experience with API integration testing using Postman
• Experience with quality gates and security tools integration in CI/CD processes
• Hands on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure cloud services
• Excellent problem solving skills and attention to detail
• Strong communication and teamwork skills
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies

• Volunteer time off

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Imagine the What. Build the How.

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Our Work Model

• Travel: c.20% on average, sometimes at short notice, usually 1 to 3 day trips to customer sites and Scandit events.

• Timezone requirements: Central or Eastern time zone. You’ll work US business hours, with overlap with our European colleagues in the morning.

• Work model: This role is hybrid if you live near one of our offices, remote if you don’t. We’re happy to talk through what that looks like for you.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Customer Success Engineer to join our US team and support a portfolio of key enterprise accounts.

This is a more technical Customer Success role than most.

You’ll be the technical partner customers’ engineers rely on: building demos, sharing code to unblock integrations and guiding implementation, while owning adoption, renewal and growth. This is not an account management or sales role.

What You Will Do

• Own a portfolio of key US enterprise accounts and drive adoption, retention, and growth

• Become a deep expert in Scandit’s products and SDKs, and guide customers through technical decisions

• Lead discovery conversations and translate customer needs into feasible Scandit solutions

• Build tailored demos and share code snippets and small integrations to unblock customers

• Run workshops, adoption reviews, and QBRs with technical and business stakeholders

• Spot at-risk accounts and expansion opportunities early, and partner with Sales to act on them

• Be the voice of the customer inside Scandit, working with Product, Engineering, and SupportUse AI tooling (Claude Code, etc.) to speed up customer-facing technical work

Who You Are

• 2+ years in a customer-facing technical pre-sales, post-sales or support role at a B2B software company e.g. Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, etc.

• A solid technical foundation and coding experience in any language: you have written or debugged code, scripts or integrations, ideally using SDKs or APIs

• Strong written and verbal communication, and you can present to both business and technical audiences and explain a technical problem clearly and concisely

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills

• A solid understanding of enterprise IT architectures

• You build strong relationships with customers and colleagues, and you are likeable, humble and fun to work with

• You learn quickly and act on feedback and coaching

Nice to Have

• Strong discovery skills: translating customer requirements into feasible technical solutions

• A track record running workshops, adoption reviews or QBRs

• Experience working with Product, Engineering, Sales and MarketingBackground as a software engineer, mobile developer, solutions engineer or solutions consultant

• Mobile development experience (iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter)

• Industry experience in retail, transport and logistics, computer vision, or mobile data capture

• Salesforce and a CS platform such as Planhat (what we use) or Gainsight

• Comfort using AI development tools such as Claude Code

How We Hire

• 30 to 45 minute call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

• 30 to 45 minute conversation with the hiring manager

• 1-hour technical interview with a member of the team (no preparation needed)

• 1-hour panel presentation of a case study, sent at least 5 days before

What We Offer

• Here are some of the reasons people choose to build their career at Scandit:

• Certified as a Great Place To Work for four years in a row

• Rated 4/5 by our employees on Glassdoor

• Access to Claude Cowork and Claude Code, plus a budget to experiment with other AI tools

• Weekly “How to Use AI” sessions and internal AI Champions to help turn your ideas into reality

• A share in our success through an individual equity planOffice shutdown days, global team events and innovation hackathons

• Your birthday off and much more

• Plus specific benefits depending on the location you are joining.

You could be the difference

At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all.

All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical [dis]ability or length of time spent unemployed.

Imagine the What. Build the How.

jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Account Manager Farming - Goiania
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

Nosso time de Farmer atua no modelo presencial, sendo necessário ter disponibilidade para visitas diariamente aos clientes de Goiânia e região.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

O time de Marketplace do QuintoAndar está expandindo sua atuação para novas praças, incluindo Goiânia! Dentro da estrutura de Marketplace, o time de Farmer é responsável por identificar, atrair, desenvolver e reter imobiliárias parceiras com alto potencial — construindo relacionamentos duradouros que sustentam o crescimento da nossa rede local.

Suas Responsabilidades

• Construir e gerenciar o relacionamento com uma carteira de imobiliárias parceiras em Goiânia, com potencial de crescimento conforme a operação local se expande.

• Realizar visitas presenciais recorrentes às imobiliárias para fortalecer o relacionamento, entender necessidades de cada parceiro e apoiar o uso da plataforma QuintoAndar.

• Alimentar e gerenciar funis de prospecção em ferramentas de CRM, assegurando visibilidade, previsibilidade e eficiência.

• Adaptar a abordagem comercial ao perfil de cada imobiliária — de parceiros mais orientados a relacionamento a parceiros mais orientados a resultado/dado.

• Treinar e orientar corretores e imobiliárias no uso das ferramentas do QuintoAndar, com comunicação clara e acessível para públicos com diferentes níveis de familiaridade com tecnologia.

• Acompanhar indicadores de performance da carteira, identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua e conduzir planos de ação.

• Aplicar estratégias de farming para impulsionar a produtividade da base ativa de parceiros, com foco na qualidade da experiência do cliente final.

• Contribuir com sugestões e melhorias de processo.

O que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Residir em Goiânia devido ao volume de deslocamento para visitas presenciais.

• Experiência prévia em negociação e desenvolvimento de relacionamento comercial com parceiros externos.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Hubspot, Salesforce ou equivalentes).

• Perfil analítico e orientado para resultados, com foco em metas, performance e eficiência de aquisição.

• Autonomia, organização e adaptabilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico, com alto volume e ritmo acelerado.

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de simplificar informações técnicas para públicos variados.

• Disponibilidade para rotina de trabalho majoritariamente em campo.

Diferenciais

• Vivência em ambientes de expansão comercial, especialmente em modelos de rede ou marketplace.

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

• Triagem

• Entrevista com People

• Entrevista com o gestor da vaga

• Live Case

• Etapa de entrevista com Stakeholder

• Offer

Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

• Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).

• Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).

• Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.

• Flexibilidade: Auxílio Home Office e programa Work From Anywhere (WFA).

• Família e Cuidado: Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Parentalidade Atípica, Licença Parental Estendida e Kit Leiturinha.

• Educação e carreira: Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone).

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

• Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

• Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

• Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

• Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

• Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

• AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

• Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

• Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

• Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

• Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

• Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

• Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

• Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

• Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

• Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.

• Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

• Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

• Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

• Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.

• Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.

• Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

• Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.

• A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.

• Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.

• Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.

• Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.

• Open source contribution or maintainership.

• Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In US, the base compensation range for this role is USD $167,000 - $209,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Retention Lead - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

This is a talent pool for future US-based opportunities. We are not actively hiring for this position at this time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Lead, Retention combines strategic account ownership, hands-on CRM expertise, and team leadership to help direct-to-consumer brands grow customer lifetime value. In this role, you would own retention strategy and client relationships across a portfolio of e-commerce accounts, translating business goals and customer insights into email, SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs that drive measurable revenue and repeat purchase.

Working with the Director of Retention and partnering closely with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams, you would lead the roadmap from customer acquisition through first purchase, repeat purchase, subscription retention, and win-back.

This role is designed for an experienced strategist and operator who can lead senior client conversations, connect lifecycle performance to commercial outcomes, and guide specialists through complex execution without losing touch with the work.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own retention strategy, client relationships, and performance roadmaps for a portfolio of DTC accounts, serving as a senior strategic partner rather than simply managing campaign delivery.

 - Translate client objectives into clear KPI frameworks, retention revenue forecasts, and prioritized plans. Explain performance, identify gaps, and recommend actions to improve results.

 - Build lifecycle strategies spanning lead capture, welcome and first-purchase journeys, post-purchase engagement, repeat purchase, subscription activation and retention, loyalty, and win-back.

 - Develop email and SMS campaign calendars, segmentation plans, automation roadmaps, and testing priorities grounded in customer behavior and business goals.

 - Lead client conversations, presenting results and recommendations clearly, managing expectations, and bringing a confident point of view to complex strategic decisions.

 - Coordinate specialists and designers across accounts, delegate effectively, and review briefs, creative, segmentation, and campaign builds to maintain a high standard of delivery.

 - Stay close to execution: build or troubleshoot automation logic, lead-capture forms, and app integrations when needed, and ensure campaigns and flows are thoroughly quality-assured before launch.

 - Turn cohort analysis, repeat purchase behavior, subscription performance, and lifetime value insights into practical opportunities for client growth.

 - Mentor team members on retention strategy, analysis, execution, and quality control, helping them develop stronger judgment and greater ownership.

 - Partner with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams so acquisition investment, messaging, and lifecycle programming reinforce one another.

 - Identify opportunities to deepen client programs through personalization, loyalty, subscription journeys, and stronger cross-channel coordination.
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

 - You have a strong track record of developing and scaling retention programs for DTC or e-commerce brands, with meaningful ownership of client relationships and performance outcomes.

 - You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You can build a compelling roadmap, guide a team through delivery, and get into the platform when a complex problem needs solving.

 - You have deep experience with Klaviyo or a comparable email service provider, including segmentation, event-triggered journeys, lifecycle automation, and personalization, alongside working knowledge of Shopify and its ecosystem.

 - You understand how to build effective SMS programs, including audience segmentation, cadence, and compliance considerations, using platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or Klaviyo.

 - You have developed loyalty or rewards strategies that improve repeat purchase and lifetime value, and understand how email and SMS support subscription sign-ups, retention, cancellation prevention, and win-back.

 - You are fluent in retention measurement, including cohort analysis, repeat purchase rate, customer lifetime value, and LTV:CAC. You can connect channel results to revenue and explain what should happen next.

 - You are comfortable setting commercial targets and building the forecasts and reporting needed to track progress against them.

 - You have demonstrated leadership through direct management or strong cross-functional team leadership, with the ability to coach others, prioritize workloads, and raise the quality of delivery.

 - You can manage multiple accounts and workstreams in a fast-paced environment without losing sight of strategic priorities or execution details.

 - You communicate clearly with clients and colleagues at every level, translating complex data and technical concepts into focused recommendations.

 - You stay curious about emerging tools, customer behavior, and best practices in DTC and lifecycle marketing.




WHAT IT’S LIKE TO WORK AT DARKROOM

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

 - Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

 - Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

 - Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

 - Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

 - Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Research & Development Manager (m/w/d) Hair Care
jobs.description:
We are Kao, listed as one of the world’s most ethical companies for the last 20 years.

Our EMEA brand portfolio spans across three sectors; Consumer Care (John Frieda, Guhl, Bondi Sands, Bioré, Jergens, Curél), Professional Hair (Goldwell, Oribe, KMS Hair, Kerasilk), and Molton Brown.

Our corporate philosophy, The Kao Way, guides us in everything we do – acting with integrity, courageously driving innovation, and treating each other with trust and respect.

About our role:

Displayed pay range (base salary) is a guide and local market specific. The pay offered to a successful candidate will be based on skill set and professional experience assessed throughout the interview process: EUR 72,500.00 - EUR 101,250.00

The Research & Development Manager (m/w/d) Hair Care, leads the development and delivery of innovative products and technologies that meet consumer and professional salon needs. The role drives project execution from concept to implementation, ensuring quality, timeline, and business objectives are achieved. By applying scientific expertise, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration, the position translates market insights into differentiated product solutions. As a people leader, the R&D Manager develops team capabilities, fosters innovation, and strengthens the organization’s ability to deliver sustainable growth through a strong innovation pipeline.

This is a full-time maternity cover position based in Darmstadt, running until 31 December 2029.

What you will do:

• Lead execution of product development and technology development projects within agreed scope, timelines and with defined quality, in alignment with Associate Director/Director.

• Ensure alignment on project objectives, priorities and timelines, supported by effective project management, documentation and transparent communication of progress, risks and key decisions, with clear recommendations to management.

• Translate consumer and salon professional needs into technical targets for product performance and product experience.

• Completion and communication of feasibility studies and recommendations for PD product development phase

• Cooperate with other functions to finalize project (technical files, patent clearance and patent filing, safety and regulatory compliance, start-up and production, testing, claims support, etc.)

• Lead execution of maintenance projects

• Ensure systematic competitor benchmarking and analysis to identify and communicate performance gap and sdiafferentiation opportunities

• Contribute to portfolio planning, concept development in collaboration with Associate Director.

• Lead and develop 2–5 direct reports and create an environment that enables data-driven decision-making, innovation and the growth of technical capabilities.

• Build team capabilities by coaching technical and project leadership and develop expertise aligned with current and future R&D needs.

What you will need:

• Bachelor Degree or higher in natural science (PhD)

• Experience in product development, technology development or applied research, preferably in hair care, styling or cosmetics.

• Ability to set priorities, manage risks and resources, and provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

• Independent, reliable and above average dedicated working style

• Excellent collaboration and communicational skills

• Very good knowledge in English language (oral and written)

• Open team player

• Excellent knowledge of MS-Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

• Experience with data-driven, digital and AI-enabled approaches and the ability to drive their effective adoption within a development team is preferred

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Digital & AI literacy

• Analytical and data-driven mindset

• Effective stakeholder management

• Continuous learning and knowledge sharing

• Business, consumer, and sustainability awareness

At Kao, we believe the diversity of our teams strengthens our global mission. Here we trust and respect each other, collaborating in a friendly and inclusive work environment to achieve great results.

What you can expect from us:

• An entrepreneurial environment where passionate and innovative teams come together.

• Respect, teamwork and collaboration are at the heart of how we work.

• A workplace culture that prioritises employee wellbeing, with opportunities to get involved in initiatives such as Mental Health First Aiders, our Charity Committee, and DE&I communities

• A broad range of benefits, including flexible working, competitive salaries, health and wellbeing offers, pension schemes, insurance options, and more…

• Learning and development opportunities

Your voice matters here, we value entrepreneurial thinking and innovation from our teams.

jobs.title: Manager - Treasury
jobs.description:
About Us:
DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center. http://www.dailypay.com/press


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager, Treasury is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the treasury function, ensuring optimal liquidity and capital preservation to support DailyPay’s mission. You will lead a team of professionals to execute cash management strategies, manage banking relationships, and uphold rigorous internal controls. As a tactical leader within the Finance team, you will translate departmental goals into actionable plans, ensuring that team delivery aligns with the company’s broader financial objectives.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Team Leadership: Provide direct supervision and mentorship to the treasury team, focusing on professional development and the achievement of tactical operational targets

 - Liquidity Management: Oversee daily cash positioning and short-term forecasting to ensure adequate liquidity for daily operations and member disbursements

 - Banking Relations: Serve as a primary point of contact for banking partners, managing account documentation, KYC requirements, and service fee optimization

 - Execution & Delivery: Ensure the accurate and timely execution of all wire transfers, ACH movements, and debt facility settlements in compliance with established policies

 - Risk Mitigation: Maintain and strengthen treasury internal controls (SOX compliance) and lead the identification of operational risks within the payment lifecycle

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with the Capital Markets and Accounting teams to ensure seamless integration of treasury activities into financial reporting and debt management

 - Process Automation: Lead initiatives to automate routine treasury tasks, leveraging API integrations and treasury management systems (TMS) to improve efficiency

 - Investment Oversight: Assist in the execution of the corporate investment policy, ensuring idle cash is deployed in alignment with safety, liquidity, and yield objectives

 


WHAT YOU BRING TO DAILYPAY

 - Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in corporate treasury or cash management, with at least 1-2 years in a supervisory or team lead capacity

 - Fintech Expertise: Prior experience in a high-volume payments environment or fintech company is highly preferred

 - Technical Proficiency: Deep knowledge of banking portals, ERP systems (NetSuite preferred), and treasury management workstations

 - Strategic Execution: Proven ability to translate functional goals into actionable team work plans and oversee complex financial projects

 - Analytical Skills: Advanced Excel skills and the ability to perform complex cash flow modeling and variance analysis

 - Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) designation is a significant plus

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Exceptional health, vision, and dental care

 - Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401K with company match

High-performing cultures aren't built in silos, they thrive on partnership. At DailyPay, we Commit Together to an inclusive, professional environment where multifaceted perspectives are our greatest competitive advantage. We recognize that our team members don’t live “single-issue lives,” and we lean into the wide-ranging backgrounds and life stages that sharpen our collective decision-making.



In our high-trust environment, we empower you to Challenge Norms. We’ve created a space where it is safe to ask difficult questions, disrupt the status quo, and share bold perspectives without fear of professional fallout. We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.

We provide the space for you to do your best work through peer advocacy and transparent career development. If you are looking for a culture that values intellectual honesty, celebrates the unique lived experiences of its people, and thrives on collective success, you’ll find it here.



If you require reasonable accommodation for any aspect of the recruitment process, please send a request to peopleops@dailypay.com. All requests for accommodation will be addressed as confidentially as practicable.



DailyPay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS)
jobs.description:
YOUR NEXT MISSION

Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay.

As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Order processing and data integrity: Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily.

 - Compliance and export documentation: Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork.

 - Logistics coordination and internal handovers: Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution.

 - Cross-functional status tracking: Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking data and handover packages across departments. Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Vocational degree (MBO Level 4 / Associate degree) or equivalent practical experience in administration, supply chain, or logistics

 - 3+ years of experience in administrative support, order processing, or logistics coordination, preferably within a high-tech manufacturing or hardware environment

 - Practical experience working with ERP systems and databases (experience with Odoo is a strong advantage)

 - Experience handling compliance or logistics paperwork, such as shipping manifests, export control documentation, or QA certificates

 - Strong command of English (both written and spoken) and working proficiency in Dutch is considered a strong asset

 - High attention to detail with a methodical approach to data accuracy and documentation

 - Strong organisational and coordination skills to handle multiple handovers efficiently

 - Collaborative, supportive mindset suited for cross-functional internal operations


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Architect
jobs.description:
We’re building the future of how the world communicates.

Netcracker, part of NEC Corporation, combines deep telecom industry expertise with cutting-edge cloud-native and AI-powered innovations to enable communications service providers and enterprises to transform their businesses, unlock innovation, and create meaningful digital experiences for millions of people around the world. With more than 30 years of experience serving over 250 customers in more than 70 locations worldwide, we are the global market leader in telecom software and services.

Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future but is leading the way.

Job Summary

The Enterprise Solution Architect is accountable for defining and governing end-to-end solution architecture for the company’s telco software offerings while serving as a trusted technology advisor to telecom operator clients. The role guides customers on architecture modernization, cloud adoption, OSS/BSS strategy, and complex system integration, ensuring alignment between business intent, solution design and delivery feasibility.

As the senior technical authority, the BSA sets architecture standards and reference designs across products, works closely with the CTO and engineering teams, and supports complex customer engagements. With deep expertise in OSS/BSS, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and telco standards, the role ensures scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions for both the vendor and its clients.

They contribute to solution architectures and best practices, but with a strong emphasis on customer-specific solution design, storytelling, and executive communication, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and future-ready while bringing business value in customer reality.

Responsibilities

• Proven expertise in solution and enterprise architecture for large-scale, mission-critical software systems, with strong ability to frame architecture in business terms

• Strong client advisory mindset, capable of understanding customer strategy, identifying constraints and obstacles, and proposing solution options with clear rationale and impact

• Deep understanding of telecommunications architectures, including OSS/BSS, network and service orchestration, charging, billing, and customer management and integration with network platforms

• Ability to design and articulate end-to-end solution architectures, spanning products, integrations, data, and operational processes

• Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and event-driven design

• Strong knowledge in legacy modernization and complex system integration, including multi-vendor brownfield environments

• Architecture governance skills, including defining principles, standards, reference architectures, and design review processes

• Ability to develop and articulate end-to-end solution narratives, including architecture diagrams, transformation roadmaps, and business-aligned trade-offs

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and influencing skills across executive, technical, and commercial audiences

• Proven ability to create clear, compelling, and executive-ready presentations that convey architectural intent and business value

• Ability to balance customer vision, product capabilities and delivery constraints

Skills and experience

• 12+ years of experience in software architecture, with significant experience in the telecommunications industry

• Demonstrated experience leading architecture for complex, multi-vendor telco environments

• Proven track record advising telecom operators on technology transformation, cloud migration, and OSS/BSS modernization from strategy to execution

• Experience working closely with engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are implementable and coherent

• Experience supporting pre-sales, RFPs, and executive customer engagements, including solution positioning and differentiation

• Familiarity with TM Forum standards (e.g., TMF Open APIs, SID, eTOM)

• Experience working in Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery models

• Prior experience in a software vendor or system integrator environment preferred

• Ability to Travel

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.

jobs.title: Demand Generation
jobs.description:
ABOUT US


Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.


We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.


We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.


Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.


If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.




ABOUT THE ROLE AND YOU

We're hiring a Demand Generation Lead to own pipeline generation for North America. Today, demand gen at Lorikeet is spread across several people who each carry a piece of it alongside their day jobs — this role exists to change that. You'll be the first person whose sole focus is building the machine that fills our pipeline.

You'll own a North American pipeline target and work backwards from it — designing and executing the mix of events, webinars, industry programs, and campaigns that gets us there. You'll also help shape how demand gen scales as a function as we grow, defining the playbook rather than inheriting one. This is a mid-senior role for someone who's comfortable being accountable to a hard revenue-linked number with a high degree of autonomy over how they hit it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the North American pipeline target and build the quarterly plan that gets us there

 - Design and run the full demand gen program mix: field events, executive dinners, webinars, industry programs, and integrated campaigns

 - Work backwards from pipeline goals to channel-level targets, budgets, and forecasts, and report clearly on what's working and what isn't

 - Partner closely with Sales to ensure every program converts — tight handoffs, fast follow-up, and shared accountability for pipeline quality

 - Build the demand gen operating infrastructure from scratch: campaign tracking, attribution, and reporting that give us a real view of the funnel

 - Identify which channels and plays are worth scaling and which to kill, iterating quickly with limited resources

 - Define the demand gen playbook for Lorikeet as we grow, laying the foundation for the function's future team and budget
   


THE RIGHT CANDIDATE

We're looking for someone who is energized by owning a number, not just running programs — someone who sees a pipeline target as a puzzle to reverse-engineer rather than a burden. The ideal candidate learned the fundamentals of demand gen inside a rigorous, well-resourced marketing org, then proved they could build the whole thing from scratch with none of that scaffolding.

You might be a fit if you:

 - Have 4–7 years of demand generation experience in B2B SaaS

 - Have  early-stage startup (under ~100 people) experience, building the demand gen function from zero -  choosing channels, setting up systems, and owning outcomes without a big team or budget

 - Have hands-on experience across the program mix: field events, webinars, executive dinners, and industry programs, not just digital campaigns

 - Think in pipeline, not MQLs — you work backwards from revenue targets and can defend your math

 - Operate with high autonomy and low need for direction, and are relentless about follow-through

 - Care about the quality of the pipeline you create, not just the volume — you see Sales as your customer

 - Are curious about AI and excited to help define what an AI-first company looks like from the inside

If you don't quite match this and are from an under-represented background we strongly encourage you to reach out. We know first hand that diverse teams are higher performing and are proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.




WHAT'S UNIQUE ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.


A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.


Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.


We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.


Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.


A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.



If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.


A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.



If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.
