jobs.title: Finance Officer (Payments & Treasury)
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

• Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

• Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

• Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

• Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

• Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

• Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

• Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

• Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role

The Finance team supports all financial activities in 10 countries, 9 of them in Africa. As part of the global finance team, you will run payment cycles across multiple countries and make them faster and more accurate. You’ll also support country finance operations, working closely with the rest of the Finance team.

You are a great candidate for this role if you have hands-on payments experience, strong numerical skills, learn new systems quickly, and already use technology and AI tools to work smarter.

Reports to: Finance Manager

Level: Officer

Location:This role is open only to candidates based in Rwanda, DRC, Malawi, Kenya or Uganda, where we can employ you directly through a GiveDirectly entity.

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel 1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or colocations

What you’ll do:

• Payments and treasury Run payment cycles in multiple countries end to end: preparing, validating and issuing payments, and resolving exceptions and failed payments quickly. Reconcile payments with bank and mobile money statements, and investigate and clear any differences. Support account funding, cash forecasting, and FX across multiple currencies to ensure payments are never delayed. Work with banks, mobile money operators and country teams to fix payment and funding issues. Improve and standardise payment processes across countries, and document them in clear SOPs. Use automation and AI tools to improve payment accuracy, speed and reporting.

• Country finance operations Support country finance operations, e.g., petty cash counts, asset counts, and finance liaison with authorities on tax and statutory filings. Support the wider Finance team as needed to meet department goals.

• Risk and compliance Apply strong controls in every payment process, including maker-checker, audit trails and segregation of duties. Handle recipient and payment data securely, and flag fraud risks early. Understand and implement compliance requirements from tax regulators and payment partners. Support in-country audits and special reporting to donors and regulators on request.

What you’ll bring:

• Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

• A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related field, or equivalent experience. A professional qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA or similar, completed or in progress) is a plus.

• 2+ years of professional experience in accounting or finance, including at least 1 year running payments. For example: bulk or high-volume disbursements, bank and mobile money transfers, payment reconciliations and fixing failed payments.

• Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail. You can reconcile large datasets accurately under deadline pressure and catch errors before they reach recipients.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (e.g. XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, data validation), and experience with finance and payments software (e.g. Intacct, Tipalti, Emburse, QuickBooks, online banking platforms).

• You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) every day to work faster and better, for example to analyse data, draft procedures or investigate exceptions. You check AI output carefully and handle sensitive data responsibly.

• You learn quickly and do well in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities and processes change often.

• Fluent English. Working knowledge of French or Portuguese is an advantage.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

The compensation for this role across the various locations is as shown below:

Kenya:

Base Salary: $16,030

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Rwanda:

Base Salary: $13,810

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Uganda:

Base Salary: $14,840

Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

• A supportive team that works hard and cares hard

• A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)

• Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take

• Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Model Launches
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Token Factory is hiring a Product Manager for new model launches. We bring the newest state-of-the-art models to production, often on day-0 as a launch partner to frontier and emerging AI labs. Reporting into the product organization, you’ll own end-to-end delivery and work with engineering, billing, legal, marketing and our partners to ensure timely and quality model launches on the platform.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States

Your responsibilities will include:

• Own end-to-end execution of new model launches on Token Factory, from intake and kickoff to public release and post-launch activities. Ensuring every model launches on time and with quality.

• Coordinate across engineering, billing, legal and marketing to ensure all deliverables that each launch depends on are ready, such as: model metadata, serving configuration, pricing, licensing and GTM communications.

• Responsible for the quality of every model release through hands-on QA validation of inference, configuration and metadata and third-party integrations. You drive remediation of any gaps or defects identified to ensure model launch quality.

• Act as the operational point of contact for model partners during a launch, aligning scope, timing, access to model assets and post-launch follow-up so that day-0 launches land cleanly.

• Keep stakeholders informed with regular status updates, and report on post-launch traction and economic performance.

• Maintain and improve model launch operating procedures: runbooks, intake criteria, templates and onboarding materials and acceptance gates. Run retrospectives to gather insights and opportunities that feed back into that process-improvement loop.

• Coordinate issues, escalations and questions for upcoming and recently launched models, including support escalations, known issues and duty coordination for model problems.

We expect you to have:

• 5+ years in a product, engineering or similar role shipping software, AI or other developer-facing products/services. jobs.title: Field Officer
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are looking for a driven Field Officer to join Wave as we launch our operations in the DRC, where you will manage product rollouts and help build our agent and merchant network on the ground. You will represent Wave in the field, overseeing distribution and marketing activations while ensuring our services are accessible to the communities we serve. You will also engage directly with users, agents, and merchants to better understand their needs and challenges related to money transfers and financial services, providing valuable insights to inform our local strategy.

In this role, you'll:

• Ensure agent quality and compliance with legal and policy requirements.

• Guarantee the agent network is fully trained on applications, the contents of the contract before signing, rebalancing options, fraud management, etc.

• Collaborate with the BTL team to build a well-branded, well-equipped agent network.

• Collaborate with the agent liquidity team to monitor cash and float availability at agent locations.

• Manage risk through routine visits to report emerging issues and assess agents' performance in your territory.

• Identify underperforming agents, close them, recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure branding materials are removed.

• Be the primary contact for all agency networks acquiring Wave products in your territory.

• Champion excellent customer service among distributors and agents within your territory.

Requirements

• Fluent in English & French, with ideally a good command of one additional local language.

• Experience working with informal merchants, market vendors, or agent networks is a plus.

• 2–3 years of experience in field sales, microfinance, telecoms, or fintech.

• Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned zone.

• Comfortable working in fast-paced, sometimes challenging field conditions.

• High level of integrity and reliability.

Key details

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.



The challenge

Our Charlotte office is scaling fast, and fast growth without the right structure just creates bigger problems, faster. We need someone to take ownership of revenue across our Account Executive and BDR teams, build scalable processes, and become the senior voice that makes Wayflyer impossible to ignore in the region.



What you'll actually do

 - Own the revenue growth strategy for Charlotte and lead the team locally to execute on this

 - Run performance across our revenue teams, setting a high bar and exceeding it

 - Analyse revenue and attainment data closely enough to catch underperformance before it becomes a pattern

 - Build the sales processes and frameworks that will enable our next phase of growth

 - Help to build and elevate Wayflyer's profile in the region

 - Work closely with underwriting, product, partnerships, finance, and marketing, because revenue doesn't operate in a silo

 - You’ll have second line management responsibility, and you’ll build a culture where high performance is the norm, not the exception

 - Set the tone for the Charlotte office as our most senior leader on the ground
   
   

What this role could turn into

Our leaders who've built regional revenue engines from the ground up have gone on to take on broader revenue leadership remits, or helped shape our GTM strategy company-wide. Charlotte is early enough that this role will keep growing alongside the office - the ceiling here isn't fixed.



Who thrives here

Someone who wants to build, not maintain. You'll need to care as much about the people on your team as the numbers on your dashboard, because scaling an office means scaling humans, not just processes. You're confident making decisions independently and know when to loop in the wider business. If something's not working, you fix it before anyone asks you to.



We hire for range

We're less interested in a specific title history and more interested in trajectory: have you taken a revenue function from scrappy to scaled before? Ideally you've led across more than one function (BDR, AE, or CS), managed both ICs and other managers, and owned a P&L. Bonus if you've scaled an office or region from the ground up, or if you understand eCommerce and revenue-based financing well enough to spot an opportunity before a competitor does.



Location and working policy

📍Charlotte, NC Hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)



The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and 401k. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice. https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.*

jobs.title: Director of Marketing

About Chicago Public Media

Chicago Public Media is one of the nation’s largest local nonprofit news organizations. Home to WBEZ 91.5FM, the Chicago Sun-Times, and Vocalo. As a mission-driven organization, we aspire to be the most trusted news source Chicagoans turn to for understanding the people, events, and ideas shaping our community.

Murrow Awards, and the National Association of Black Journalists.

We believe independent journalism is essential to a healthy democracy and that access to objective, fact-based news is a right for every citizen. We serve the public interest by creating diverse content that informs and enriches our community, supported by a dedicated staff of approximately 250 professionals.

The Opportunity

As Director of Marketing at Chicago Public Media (CPM), you will drive the strategy, planning, and execution of marketing campaigns across chicago.com, WBEZ, the Chicago Sun-Times and Vocalo. This role reports to the VP of Marketing & Communications and sits at the center of CPM’s audience growth efforts, connecting brand, content and revenue through cohesive, multi-channel marketing.

Your primary objective is to translate organizational priorities into high-impact campaigns that grow audience reach, deepen engagement, and support membership and revenue goals. You will lead campaign development from concept through execution, drive brand storytelling, creative concepting, and copywriting that define how our brands show up in the world, and shape channel strategy that builds our brands and extends audience interaction across social, digital, paid and owned platforms.

In this role, you will serve as a key connector between Marketing, Circulation, Editorial and Membership, ensuring alignment across storytelling, audience engagement and conversion efforts. You will balance strategic thinking with operational execution, building systems and workflows that enable CPM to scale its marketing efforts across a multi-brand ecosystem.

Our ideal candidate is both a strategic marketer and creative strategist; someone who can manage complexity, lead cross-functional collaboration, bring bold ideas to brand storytelling and apply a deep understanding of audience behavior, digital channels, and mission-driven media.

Key Responsibilities

• Campaign Development & Execution: Lead end-to-end development of integrated campaigns across CPM's portfolio, including brand, programming, product, and audience growth initiatives.

• Creative Strategy & Brand Evolution: Lead creative strategy and messaging across social media and content marketing, and help evolve how each of CPM's brands looks, sounds, and shows up in the world. Work with VP to develop brand-specific voices, content frameworks, and creative concepts that keep our brands relevant, distinctive, and growing in reach and engagement.

• Owned & Organic Channel Strategy: Own and evolve CPM's owned and organic channel strategy across email, organic social, and digital platforms. Build engaged communities on social media, grow newsletter audiences, and partner with Editorial and Membership teams to optimize lifecycle journeys through segmentation, testing, and performance insights that drive engagement and revenue.

• Performance & Paid Media Strategy: Bring a strong understanding of performance marketing to plan, optimize, and measure paid campaigns across search, social, and digital channels.

• Team Management & Development: Manage and mentor marketing team members, translating strategy into clear execution plans and ensuring high-quality output.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5–8+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in media, publishing, or mission-driven organizations

• Strong creative strategy, brand storytelling, creative concepting, and copywriting skills, with a portfolio that shows it

• Digitally savvy and fluent in social, content, and platform trends, including short-form video, creators, and emerging formats

• Solid understanding of performance and paid media across search, social, and digital, including influencer and creator partnerships

• Analytical mindset, with the ability to define KPIs, read performance data, and turn insights into sharper creative and channel decisions

• Scrappy and resourceful, comfortable producing work with lean tools and knowing when to bring in agency, freelance, or production partners

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Compensation

The expected pay range for this position is $104,000 to $125,000 per ANNUM.

Chicago Public Media provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the organization reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, geographical location, and external market pay for comparable jobs.

Working at Chicago Public Media

At Chicago Public Media, we care deeply about our employees as we know attracting, developing, and growing talent is key to our success and enhancing our impact.

Our culture is one where collaboration, diversity of ideas, and innovation are encouraged.  We value colleagues who will enhance our culture by bringing new ideas, divergent experiences, and talents to our dynamic workplace.

At Chicago Public Media we believe dedication to a great workplace includes supporting our employees and their families. As a result, we provide a broad and generous benefits package for employees at hire and in the years to come.

Our benefits include a competitive salary and benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, vacation, holidays, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement savings, and a commuter benefits plan.

Chicago Public Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we actively seek and welcome people from all backgrounds, orientations, and life experiences to join our team.

jobs.title: Account Manager (Retention & Expansion)
jobs.description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.
Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give actionable feedback, and honestly listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact.
Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.

The role
As an Account Expert on our US team, you’ll own a portfolio of merchants and be directly responsible for keeping them, growing them, and making sure they pay fairly for the value they get. This is a commercial role: retention, churn prevention and account expansion are your core goals, not a side task.
You’ll spot risk early, step into tough conversations with confidence, and turn “we’re thinking of leaving” or “we need a bigger discount” into a plan that works for both the client and Omnisend. You’ll also find the growth in your book — upgrades, add-ons and new channels — and close it.
This role is for you if you like targets, enjoy negotiating, move fast when priorities shift, and want full ownership of your results. You’ll work independently, with a team and manager behind you when you need them — but nobody will chase you to get things done.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for drivingmerchant engagement, increasing payment acceptance, growing GMV, and identifyingopportunities to cross-sell payment solutions. 
 
 Key Responsibilities * Manage a portfolio of key merchant accounts and build long-term relationships.
* Drive merchant activation, engagement, and business growth. 
* Increase GMV and payment volumes across UPI, QR, Soundbox, and EDC.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell products such as Soundbox, EDC, Merchant Loans,Insurance, and other value-added services. 
* Conduct regular business reviews with merchants and recommend growth opportunities
.* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve merchant issues quickly.
 * Monitor merchant performance and work to improve retention and reduce churn.
* Track competition and market trends to identify new business opportunities.
* Achieve monthly sales, revenue, and activation targets.
 
 Eligibility
 * Graduate in any discipline (MBA is an added advantage). 
* 1–4 years of experience in Key Account Management, B2B Sales, FinTech, Banking,Payments, Telecom, or FMCG. 
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to analyze merchant performance and identify growth opportunities
* Comfortable working in a target-driven environment. * Proficient in MS Excel and CRM tools. 
 
Preferred Skills
 * Experience in merchant acquiring or digital payments. 
* Understanding of UPI, QR, POS/EDC, and Soundbox solutions. 
* Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. 
 
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
* GMV Growth
 * Merchant Activation 
* Active Merchant Rate 
* Cross-sell Revenue 
* Merchant Retention
 * Customer Satisfaction 
* Target Achievement

 Work with one of India’s leading digital payments ecosystems. 
 Fast-paced learning environment with strong career growth opportunities. 
 Performance-driven culture with attractive incentives 
 
Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users,21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratizecredit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digitallending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

We're looking for the performance marketer who wants to own profitable growth across Google and Microsoft for our Make & Manage Money business, set the plan, and build the campaigns themselves. Our listicles connect people with offers across personal finance, insurance, banking, credit cards, gaming apps, and more, and winning here means understanding how intent, creative, landing pages, offer selection, partner payouts, and lead quality work together. You'll run an eight-figure annual media portfolio with the freedom to put budget wherever it earns, and the trade is that it's yours: you find what's holding growth back, whether it's in the account or not, and you go get it fixed.

Tip: Only apply if you've directly owned and profitably scaled $10M or more a year in paid media for affiliate or consumer lead generation.

Why This Seat

• Real ownership. You own the portfolio across Google and Microsoft, set the plan, and make the calls. No layers between you and the result.

• Partners who can move the levers. Yield, account management, and creative work alongside you on payouts, offers, and landing pages, so you're fixing the whole funnel, not just the account.

• Room to build. Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included, is early for us, and budget follows what works.

• A team that gets better together. We share what works, own what didn't, and turn wins into playbooks the whole paid team uses.

• An AI-forward stack. Claude is in the daily workflow, with room to automate analysis, concepting, and creative iteration.

What You'll Bring

• Ownership, Accountability & Strategy. You set the plan, prioritize the tests, and make the call, then bring your manager recommendations, not questions about what to do next.

• A track record of profitably scaling affiliate or consumer lead gen, with direct ownership of $10M or more in annual media spend.

• Buying traffic to competitive affiliate listicles, comparison pages, or multi-offer marketplaces.

• Hands-on depth in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads, and the range to own a portfolio across both. If your strongest experience is in Microsoft Ads, audience buying, or native inventory, we want to hear from you.

• Scaling across Search, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, and native placements.

• A real grasp of affiliate economics: partner payouts, revenue per click, conversion rates, offer mix, traffic quality, ROAS, and margin.

• A habit of finding the actual constraint. You can tell whether a problem sits in the buying, the creative, the landing page, the offer, the payout, or the measurement, and you go to the team that owns the fix with a clear ask.

• Clear, direct communication, including short performance updates that say what changed, why it matters, and what you need.

Nice to Have

• Running across several consumer categories or variable-payout partner programs.

• Using AI and self-serve creative tools to speed up analysis and asset iteration.

• Working with competitive intelligence tools and in regulated consumer categories.

• Building playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

What You'll Own

• Strategy and execution across Google Search, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included.

• Budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, reporting, and profitability for the portfolio.

• A prioritized growth plan that names the biggest constraints and the tests most likely to move the business.

• The case to Sales, Account Management, Yield, Creative, Product, and Analytics for what the campaigns need, and the follow-through until it lands.

• Campaign architecture, bidding, targeting, conversion signals, exclusions, tracking, and testing discipline.

• Testing new inventory and platforms with a clear hypothesis and a point where you stop.

What Great Looks Like

• You run the portfolio on your own and bring your manager recommendations and decisions.

• Profitable spend and margin grow because of a deliberate, prioritized testing plan.

• Microsoft grows into a real second source alongside Google.

• Partner teams know what you need, why it matters, and how their work moves growth, and payouts, offers, or pages change because of the case you made.

• Your playbooks make the broader paid team better.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

• See the ad account as the whole job.

• Want someone else to set the plan or tell you what to test next.

• Have mostly managed agencies or reporting rather than building campaigns yourself.

• Would rather not push other teams for changes you don't control.

Total Compensation

• Base: $150,000 to $170,000

• Annual Bonus: profit sharing, based on company and personal performance, set by the level of the role

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Technician
jobs.description:
Qualastat Electronics, a Trexon company, seeks a dedicated Senior Manufacturing Engineer Technician for its Chandler, AZ location. This role offers opportunities for professional growth, and advancement within our dynamic organization. As a Manufacturing Engineer Technician, you will tackle a diverse array of complex and detail orientated tasks and projects that support our staff/company.

The successful candidate should possess strong attention to detail, a “Do it Right the First Time” mentality, and the willingness to learn new processes. They will foster a collaborative team environment while demonstrating the ability to assess and enhance existing processes.

Weekly Schedule: Full Time, 9/80 Schedule

Week One: Monday – Friday 6:00am-2:00pm (overtime as required)Week Two: Monday - Thursday 6:00am-4:00pm (overtime as required)

Pay: DOE

Position Summary

The Manufacturing Engineering Technician is responsible for translating customer technical requirements into manufacturable solutions and owning technical execution on the production floor. This role serves as a key technical interface between customers, engineering, quality, and production, with responsibility for resolving manufacturability challenges, supporting new product introduction (NPI), and driving consistent, repeatable build processes. The Manufacturing Engineering Technician exercises independent judgment in interpreting technical data packages (TDPs), making real-time decisions on build approach, and ensuring alignment between customer requirements and production capability. This position requires strong technical expertise, ownership mentality, and the ability to communicate effectively with both internal teams and external customers/vendors. Success in this role requires hands-on technical strength, a proactive mindset, strong communication, attention to detail, and the ability to guide others in a high-urgency, high-reliability environment.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree or 5 years of related experience OR

Experience:

• 5 years of related experience within a military or aerospace manufacturing environment. Build-to-print manufacturing experience preferred.

Knowledge:

• Complex wire harness assembly and interconnect integration

• SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar 3D/CAD tools

• IPC/WHMA-A-620 and J-STD-001 (certification preferred)

• Military and aerospace product standards and compliance requirements

• Schematic interpretation, wire sizing, connector selection, overmolding, and potting techniques

• Root cause analysis and RCCA methodologies

Skills:

• Engineering mindset – problem solving and critical thinking are a must

• Proactive mindset – look for existing problems and identify solutions

• Proficiency with hand tools (wire cutters, strippers, crimpers, etc.)

• Ability to read, understand, and interpret schematics, blueprints, and technical drawings

• Comfort with change orders, revision control, and configuration management systems

• Advanced soldering and hand assembly (including fine-pitch components)

• Ability to mentor, train, and lead less experienced technicians

• Strong organizational, documentation, and communication skills

• Familiarity with ERP/MES systems and change management workflows

Job Responsibilities

• Own engineering efforts for the company on assigned projects, solve engineering and technical problems throughout the process.

• Create and revise manufacturing travelers, visual work instructions, and process documentation from customer-provided TDPs

• Engage in internal training efforts to improve technicians and assemblers’ understanding of documentation and build expectations

• Lead coordination between Engineering, Quality, and Production teams to resolve manufacturability and design issues

• Set up and oversee the use of test equipment, fixtures, tooling, and visual aids, and provide training to others.

• Provide on-the-floor support and troubleshooting during first article, prototype, and legacy builds

• Lead or support RCCA activities related to internal quality issues or customer returns (RMAs)

• Own continuous improvement of manufacturing processes, focusing on efficiency, repeatability, and quality, and analyze build performance and drive corrective actions to eliminate recurring issues.

• Act as a technical point of contact for customers and vendors for build clarification, manufacturability feedback, and issue resolution, and communicate technical risks, questions, and proposed solutions directly with customer engineering teams

jobs.title: Finance Transformation - Procure to Pay Supervisor (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team

Agoda has taken many great strides in recent years, expanding our reach around the globe as well as our list of travel products. A critical driver to this success has been the Agoda Finance team. We keep a steady hand on maintaining day-to-day financial operations while also keeping an eye out for future opportunities. Not only do we have the unique role of balancing risk management with continued innovation and growth, but we also serve as a means of empowerment for both our team members and those within the company. Having experimentation and data analysis deeply ingrained in our culture, we provide the strategic insights Agoda’s business leaders need to push into new territories in sustainable and scalable ways. We also prioritize career development in Agoda Finance. Every function within the team has a well-defined career track with clear goals and development targets each step of the way.

Job Description

• Supervise and oversee day-to-day Accounts Payable financial and accounting activities, including supplier payments, ensuring all financial transactions are accurate, properly authorized, executed, and recorded on time.

• Lead month-end closing activities, including the reconciliation of Accounts Payable-related accounts, analysis of unusual items, and timely resolution of discrepancies and outstanding balances.

• Review and monitor accounting processes, systems, and procedures to ensure effective operation and compliance with internal controls, applicable regulations, accounting principles, and company standards.

• Provide guidance and oversight for complex transaction processing, ensuring appropriate review, accurate resolution, and timely completion.

• Identify, assess, and escalate unusual or high-risk items and cases for discussion, ensuring timely resolution in consultation with relevant stakeholders.

• Lead and support projects, process improvements, and other initiatives to enhance efficiency, control, and service quality, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines.

• Act as a key Finance business partner by proactively collaborating with stakeholders within and outside Finance and ensuring responsive, effective, and fair support.

• Coach, guide, and support team members in daily operations, complex cases, accounting matters, and adherence to policies and procedures.

• Coordinate and prioritize team responses to ad hoc requests, ensuring appropriate ownership, timely delivery, and high-quality outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field.

• 5-8 years’ experience in Accounts Payable Accounting or related field, with prior supervisory or team leadership experience preferred.

• Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable processes, month-end closing, account reconciliation, financial controls, and accounting principles.

• Strong Interpersonal skills, problem solving, prioritization, proactive handling, and teamwork with ability to meet deadlines.

• Proficient in MS Office Application.

• Dynamic and able to adapt to a fast-paced environment with growth mindset.

• Team working skills – ability to collaborate, influence and mediate effectively with other teams both within and outside of Finance.

• Energetic, initiative with effective communication skills in Thai and English.

It’s great if you have

• Proficient ERP Software (Oracle is preferable)

• Accounting experience in online travel agency business

jobs.description:

Key Responsibilities

AI, Automation & Reporting

• Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor vendor utilization, purchasing activity, and operational performance.

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.title: Sales Team Coordinator | ON-SITE
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Sales Team Coordinator to support and coordinate the daily activities of our sales team.

This is a hands-on sales support, customer service, and people-coordination position. The employee will help organize priorities, monitor assignments, follow up with team members, coordinate communication, and make sure sales-related tasks continue moving forward.

The Sales Team Coordinator serves as a central point of communication between sales representatives, customers, management, and other departments.

Work Location

This is a full-time, on-site position located at:

508 S D Road

Giltner, Nebraska 68841

The employee is expected to work from the Bish Enterprises office during normal working hours.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to the Giltner office.

A company laptop may be provided for business use. Receiving a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Travel Requirement

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include:

• Customer visits
• Trade shows
• Agricultural events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Training
• Sales meetings
• Dealer visits
• Other company-related activities

Travel may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, or overnight stays.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

This position may not be a good fit for someone who requires constant step-by-step direction for routine work or who is uncomfortable following up with coworkers about incomplete assignments.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position that generally requires approximately 44 to 50 working hours per week.

The normal schedule is Monday through Friday.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required due to:

• Customer deadlines
• Company travel
• Trade shows or events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Agricultural seasonality
• Increased workload during busy periods

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval.

Any schedule adjustment must still allow the employee to meet customer needs, attend required meetings, complete on-site responsibilities, coordinate the sales team, and fulfill travel requirements.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to assist with reasonable duties outside their normal task list.

People Coordination and Leadership Skills

• Ability to coordinate the daily work of the sales team members.
• Ability to clearly communicate assignments, priorities, deadlines, and expectations.
• Ability to follow up professionally when tasks or customer commitments are incomplete.
• Confidence asking team members for updates and required information.
• Ability to document responsibilities, deadlines, decisions, and next steps.
• Ability to lead or help facilitate sales meetings.
• Ability to identify when work is delayed, unclear, duplicated, or missing.
• Ability to address routine accountability concerns professionally.
• Ability to escalate serious or repeated issues to management.
• Ability to balance supporting team members with maintaining clear expectations.
• Ability to work with different personalities and communication styles.
• Ability to keep people organized and aligned without waiting for management to intervene in every situation.

Computer Skills

The employee must be comfortable using:

• Microsoft Outlook
• Microsoft Word
• Microsoft Excel
• Online calendars
• Customer relationship management systems
• Video meeting platforms
• Web-based business software
• Printers, scanners, telephones, and standard office equipment

The employee should be able to:

• Write clear and professional emails.
• Create, edit, save, and organize documents.
• Schedule meetings and manage calendar invitations.
• Enter data accurately.
• Sort and filter information in Excel.
• Use simple Excel formulas.
• Prepare small spreadsheets and basic reports.
• Create clear lists of assignments, owners, deadlines, and next steps.
• Learn new software with reasonable training.
• Perform basic office-equipment troubleshooting, such as reconnecting equipment or clearing a printer paper jam.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but may not be required:

• Previous experience coordinating employees, sales representatives, projects, schedules, or cross-functional teams.
• Previous experience in sales support.
• Customer-service experience.
• Administrative or office experience.
• Order-entry or order-processing experience.
• Experience preparing quotes or proposals.
• Experience using customer relationship management software.
• Experience leading meetings or tracking team assignments.
• Experience working with agricultural equipment, farming customers, machinery, manufacturing, parts, or service departments.
• Experience supporting trade shows, events, or customer demonstrations.
• Previous sales experience.

Applicants do not need to have held the exact title of Sales Team Coordinator.

Related experience in team coordination, customer service, office support, sales administration, order processing, project coordination, or account support may be considered.

Compensation

Wage is $40,000 base salary plus commission.

Expected yearly earnings are approximately $45,000–$70,000 during the first year. Actual earnings may vary based on performance, eligible sales, and the terms of the company’s commission plan.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time, on-site position located at Bish Enterprises in Giltner, Nebraska.

The normal work schedule is Monday through Friday, generally totaling approximately 44–50 hours per week.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required based on customer needs, company travel, trade shows, events, and agricultural seasonality.

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval, provided that customer coverage, required meetings, on-site responsibilities, team coordination, and travel requirements are met.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Travel

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include customer visits, trade shows, agricultural events, equipment demonstrations, training, dealer visits, sales meetings, and other company-related activities.

Travel may occasionally include overnight stays, early mornings, evenings, or weekends.

The amount of travel may vary based on company needs and the agricultural season.

Benefits

Bish Enterprises offers a variety of benefits to eligible full-time employees. Benefits may include:

• Health insurance assistance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Life insurance
• Paid time off
• Paid holidays
• Retirement plan options
• Employee discounts
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Company-provided equipment required for the position

Health Insurance

Bish Enterprises does not currently offer a traditional company-sponsored group health insurance plan.

Eligible employees may purchase individual health insurance through the federal Health Insurance Marketplace or another provider of their choice.

The company may provide a monthly health insurance contribution or reimbursement toward an eligible individual health insurance plan, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

Employees are responsible for selecting, enrolling in, and maintaining their own individual health insurance coverage.

The availability and cost of Marketplace coverage may vary based on the employee’s household, location, income, selected plan, and eligibility for government subsidies.

Specific details regarding the company’s health insurance contribution or reimbursement will be explained during the hiring and enrollment process.

Benefit Eligibility

Some benefits are available only to employees who meet full-time status or other eligibility requirements.

Benefit eligibility, waiting periods, employee costs, company contributions, coverage terms, and plan availability are governed by the applicable company policies and benefit documents.

Benefits may be changed, replaced, or discontinued as permitted by law and company policy.

Other Information

A company laptop and other necessary equipment may be provided for business use.

Providing a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to perform reasonable duties outside their normal task list to support customers, coworkers, and changing business needs.

Regular and reliable attendance is an essential part of this position.

Employment with Bish Enterprises is at will. This means that either the employee or Bish Enterprises may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Bish Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to COO
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, industry partners, nonprofit organizations, and other external contacts.
• Make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.
• Maintain professional relationship continuity on behalf of the COO.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Take clear meeting notes and turn discussions into organized action items.
• Keep project information, notes, and supporting documents organized.
• Update customer records, notes, CRM information, and project information when requested.

Administrative & Business Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and other documents.
• Organize and maintain electronic files and records.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with internal and external meetings, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.
• Provide administrative support for industry associations, nonprofit initiatives, and other organizational activities.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Assist with changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Executive Assistant at Bish does more than complete assigned tasks.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.
• Notices when something is incomplete and works to resolve it.
• Keeps commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is needed.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally with different personalities and departments.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage interruptions and changing priorities without losing organization.
• Identifies practical solutions instead of simply reporting problems.
• Pays close attention to details while still understanding the larger priority.
• Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
• Knows when to take initiative and when to ask for direction.
• Is reliable, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

Required

• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, or in a closely related support role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external partners.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred

• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes.

jobs.title: Procurement Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE FINANCE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Build procurement's operating system from the ground up. Intake, purchase requests, PO creation, supplier coordination, and downstream financial handoffs run on AI-enabled workflows and clean data, built for a company scaling faster than any playbook anticipated.

 - Turn increasing complexity into an exception-based model, not more headcount. As request volume, speed, and spend scale, the team absorbs it through automation and judgment, not by growing linearly with the business.

 - Own the full stack from purchase request to payable spend. Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Accounting, and AP all touch the same lifecycle, and this team makes sure nothing drops between them.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Convert a steady volume of purchase requisitions into accurate purchase orders in Zip, checking vendor, coding, subsidiary, quantities and terms before each one issues.

 - Help the team run the procurement Slack Support Channel, answering a high volume of requester questions, unblocking stuck requests, and routing issues to AP, legal, security or IT.

 - Process change orders, cancellations and closures on open POs, and help clear invoices against them so vendors get paid on time.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Systems Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE FINANCE SYSTEMS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Build the financial infrastructure from the ground up (NetSuite, Zip, Pigment, Visual Lease, Shareworks, Travel and Expense, and Treasury management).

 - Stand up a lean finance org for the fastest-growing data center hyperscaler.

 - Own the full stack from vendor invoice to cap table.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own procurement globally in ZipHQ, from intake forms and approval workflows to purchase orders, vendors, and invoices, partnering daily with Accounting, AP, FP&A, Legal, IT, and budget owners so spend is requested, approved, and recorded accurately and on time.

 - Own the ZipHQ-to-NetSuite integration and the wider finance systems stack, clearing failed syncs and coding mismatches and keeping vendor, PO, invoice, and GL mappings, access, and data audit-ready as transaction volume scales.

 - Own NetSuite functional configuration end to end, including subsidiaries, chart of accounts, segments and dimensions, approval routing, fixed assets, manufacturing, and saved searches and reports, so the setup supports multi-entity growth and a clean close.

 - Build and ship NetSuite customizations, such as SuiteScript User Event, Map/Reduce, Scheduled, Suitelet, and RESTlet scripts, through source control, code review, and sandbox-to-production releases.

 - Build the automation roadmap that reshapes purchase-to-pay as the company scales, and own segregation of duties, access reviews, and change management so SOX and internal and external audits stay clean.

 - Train and support finance users as the first point of contact for ZipHQ and NetSuite, and document every workflow and script clearly enough that others can pick it up.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've traced failed syncs and coding mismatches between a procurement or AP system and NetSuite to their root cause and fixed them before they reached the close.

 - You've configured NetSuite functionally (subsidiaries, segments, roles, workflows) and partnered with Accounting to translate close and reporting requirements into system setup.

 - You've written and shipped NetSuite SuiteScript (User Event, Map/Reduce, Scheduled, Suitelet, RESTlet) through code review and sandbox-to-production releases.

 - You've run segregation of duties, access reviews, and change management that held up through SOX and internal and external audits.

 - You work well with accountants and engineers alike: you explain technical issues plainly, train users, and align stakeholders on how systems should work.

 - Bonus: Spend management and travel platforms (Navan, Brex). Treasury or lease accounting software. NetSuite manufacturing and fixed asset module. NetSuite developer tooling (SuiteCloud Development Framework, SuiteQL). Scripting for finance automation.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic
jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies, from scrappy startups to global brands, use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Hi! I’m Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at Customer.io. I’m looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic to join our Americas team and own relationships with some of our largest customers. You’ll guide each account from onboarding through renewal, tie platform use to the business results your customers care about, and partner with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering along the way.

What we value

• Customer outcomes first: you connect what a customer does in Customer.io to the goals their business is trying to reach

• Ownership: you run your book of business, watch for risk early, and decide on next steps with confidence

• Collaboration: you work with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering to get customers what they need

• Curiosity about AI: you pick up new AI functionality quickly and bring it into your conversations with customers

• Adaptability: you handle a varied, non-verticalized book and a fast pace of change with a steady head

What you’ll do

• Manage a book of roughly 20 to 35 Strategic customers, each above $100k in ARR, guiding them through onboarding, adoption, and long-term success

• Link platform use to measurable business outcomes, and track results such as renewal rate and growth dollars across your book

• Partner with Account Managers to spot and qualify expansion opportunities, shape renewal strategy, and keep customer value aligned with revenue goals

• Lead quarterly and executive business reviews, including onsite EBRs, and build mutual success plans with senior stakeholders

• Build relationships with several stakeholders in each account, including leaders above the day-to-day decision maker

• Read account risk closely, dig into the signals, and decide on the best next steps, including managing escalations

• Talk through technical needs with users, then raise the conversation to strategic impact with executive sponsors and give recommendations that keep customers renewing year after year

• Act as a bridge between Customer Success, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering, advocating for customers and bringing fresh perspectives to the CS org

What we’re looking for

• Based in the U.S. or Canada, and open to travel

• 5+ years of enterprise CSM experience in SaaS, managing complex, strategic accounts

• Hands-on commercial involvement in renewals, upsell, or expansion, with a clear grasp of gross retention and expansion drivers

• Strategic, consultative skills: you can tie platform usage to business value and present that impact to executives through EBRs and partnership reviews

• Comfort with APIs, integrations, and data models, enough to problem-solve at a high level without handing off every technical question

• Influence across teams, with a track record of getting colleagues to focus on customer needs

• Enthusiasm for AI and the urgency to keep learning new functionality as it ships

Bonus points!

• Background in martech, CDPs, or messaging platforms

• Spanish language skills

• Experience running client onsites

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $130,000 base + 10% variable (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.  In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

Here's what you can expect from our hiring process:

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• 60-minute Case Study Review with the Hiring Manager and potential team members

• Final 30-minute video call with Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read, apply now.
