jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here:

• Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.

• Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.

• Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.

• Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.

• Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.

• Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.

• Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.

• Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive:

• Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.

• Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.

• Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.

• Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

• Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.

• Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.

• A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.

• A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

• Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

• Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

• Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

• An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

• 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

• 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

• Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.

• Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.

• $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

• And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through.

jobs.title: [Product] [SPM] Senior Product Manager, AI-Native Builder (Bangkok-based)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED.

AI has changed what one person can build in a week. We're looking for someone who has already made that shift. You'll find where work at Agoda is slow, manual or inconsistent, build something better yourself, and prove that it works.

This role is mostly inward-facing. Your customers are your colleagues, and your product is how Agoda works: how we go from idea to production, how teams make decisions, and how much of their day goes on work that shouldn't need a person. You'll join Product AI Labs, a small team within Product, building the tools, agents and ways of working that make Agoda faster and raise the quality of what we ship.

Your work happens in two settings:

• With your own small team, working alongside developers to turn what works into products people rely on.

• Across the whole company. One week you might be inside an engineering team's release process. The next you might be with Legal, Finance or Customer Experience, working out how AI could change the way they work.

You'll run many experiments. Some won't work, and we'll stop those quickly. The ones that do work can grow from one team to hundreds of colleagues, and sometimes to the whole company.

Like every Agoda Senior Product Manager, you're analytical, data-driven and hands-on. The difference is that your main output is working software, and your success is measured by how fast and how well Agoda builds.

This is an Individual Contributor position with high visibility to Product and Engineering leadership.

In this role, you'll get to:

• Find the opportunities yourself. Spend time with teams across the company, in Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Operations and beyond. Map how their work actually flows, and decide which problems are worth solving. Turn what you learn into a prioritized set of problems, not a queue of requests.

• Build the first version yourself. Use current AI models and agentic tools to prototype and ship agents, internal tools and automations. Make prototype-first the default: turn an idea into something that runs, then decide whether it deserves to become a product.

• Prove it, then scale it. Take an idea far enough on your own to show clearly whether it works. When it does, partner with Engineering to make it robust, secure and ready for everyone to rely on. When it doesn't, stop it early and move on to the next experiment.

• Make us more productive, and prove it. Define and track the measures that matter, such as cycle time, time saved, quality, and adoption that lasts. Measure outcomes, not activity.

• Raise the quality of our work. Use AI to raise the bar on specs, reviews, testing, experiment design and decision-making. Define what "good" means for every AI tool you ship, and keep watching it after launch.

• Do it safely. Work with Engineering, Security and Legal so that what you build handles data, privacy and cost responsibly.

• Spread the practice. Teach, pair, demo and write up what works. Turn one-off wins into reusable patterns and playbooks, so building with AI becomes how Agoda works, not something one team does.

What you'll need to succeed:

• A record of building, especially with AI. You use AI models and agentic tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) in your real work, every week, to build working tools, agents and prototypes, and you can show us. How you build matters less than whether it ships and works. Using AI only to summarize documents or draft text doesn't count.

• Things you've built that people use. Ideally at least one tool, workflow or product, at work or outside it, that others adopted and kept using. You can explain how you measured whether it worked.

• 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience building products (for example as an engineer, data scientist, designer or founder who owned outcomes).

• A bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics or similar), or equivalent practical experience building products.

• Strong data skills. You use analytics and quantitative methods to make decisions, and you're comfortable answering your own questions with data.

• Product judgment. You can do discovery, prioritize, give a reasoned no, and tell an impressive demo apart from a real improvement.

• Judgment and accountability with AI. You define "good" before you start, check outputs critically, and own the result. You think about privacy, security and cost by default.

• Entrepreneurial, with a bias for action. You break down ambiguous problems, don't need the problem scoped for you, and drive change across teams that don't report to you.

• Excellent communication in English, written and spoken. You explain complex things clearly, concisely and with conviction, often with a demo instead of a deck.

• Learning momentum. You're visibly better at building with AI than you were six months ago, and you can tell us what you tried, dropped and changed.

It's great if you have:

• The ability to read and change code (Python, TypeScript, SQL or similar).

• A background as an engineer, data scientist or technical founder before moving into product.

• Experience with developer experience, internal platforms, or tools that improve how teams work.

• Hands-on work with agent frameworks, MCP, evals, or multi-step automations.

• Experience rolling out AI tools inside a company, including the change management that goes with it.

• Public writing, talks or open-source work on building with AI.

Show us what you've built

Alongside your CV, share one thing you've built with AI. It can be personal or professional, and you choose what to share. Tell us briefly:

• What it is, and what problem it solves.

• Evidence that it exists and works, such as a link, demo video, repo, live app, screenshots or a short write-up.

• Which part you built, and how.

• What happened as a result, such as who uses it or what changed.

Something rough that real people use tells us more than a polished demo nobody uses.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT DUST



Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.



With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.



With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.



We're serving great customers https://dust.tt/customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.



Dust is backed by Sequoia https://techcrunch.com/2024/06/27/dust-grabs-another-16-million-for-its-enterprise-ai-assistants-connected-to-internal-data/ with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dust-tt_were-honored-to-be-recognized-on-the-generalists-activity-7359284343929741313-Rq04.


TL;DR

We're looking for a Growth Engineer who writes code that moves revenue. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market, owning the technical systems that power how Dust acquires, activates, and converts users. Think: shipping directly on dust.tt http://dust.tt, building our analytics and tracking infrastructure from the ground up, and creating high-leverage internal apps that make our GTM team wildly more effective.



You'll work alongside Growth Marketers and GTM Engineers, translating ambitious growth ideas into production systems, fast. And you'll do all of it supercharged by AI, using Dust and Claude Code every single day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Website & Growth Funnel

 - Ship directly on dust.tt http://dust.tt: landing pages, conversion flows, forms, and experiments, with the velocity of a founder, not the process of a platform team.

 - Implement and own end-to-end tracking across our growth funnel (ads attribution, UTM params, gclid, cookie/browser tracking, HubSpot integration).

 - Design and run rapid experiments (A/B tests, new pages, new CTAs) and double down on what the data says works.

Internal Apps & GTM Tooling

 - Build high-leverage internal applications for Sales, Growth, and Marketing: signal-based notification systems, control towers, quote-to-cash automation between HubSpot and Stripe, outbound tooling.

 - Create production-grade tools that our GTM team actually relies on daily, going far beyond prototypes, with real security, reliability, and autonomy.

 - Leverage Dust's own platform to build AI-powered agents and workflows that give our go-to-market team an unfair advantage.

Data & Analytics Infrastructure

 - Own our marketing and growth data stack: instrument events, build dashboards, and ensure data is clean, reliable, and actionable across PostHog, Snowflake, and Metabase.

 - Partner with Growth Marketers to define metrics, track performance, and generate insights that drive campaign and funnel decisions.

 - Build and maintain integrations across our GTM stack (CRM, CDP, ad platforms, enrichment tools).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Serve as the technical backbone of the growth team: translate vague marketing requests into scoped technical specs and ship them autonomously.

 - Work closely with GTM Engineers on data architecture and with Growth Marketers on acquisition strategy.

 - Maintain a dotted line to Product Engineering to ensure code quality, security best practices, and architectural coherence.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Software engineer first. Strong engineering fundamentals, ideally full-stack (TypeScript/React + backend). You write clean, production-grade code.

 - AI-pilled. You're a power user of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent). You don't just use AI, you build with it and think about how it changes what's possible. This is a hard requirement.

 - Growth mindset, literally. Genuine interest in growth, marketing funnels, and user acquisition. You care about conversion rates as much as code quality.

 - Hands-on with analytics and tracking. Experience with tools like PostHog, GA4, Segment, Mixpanel, or similar. You've instrumented events, debugged attribution, or built dashboards before.

 - Autonomous and fast. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You don't wait for a spec; you write the spec and ship the solution.

 - 1-4 years of professional software engineering experience. Prior growth engineering, marketing technology, or internal tools experience is a plus.



Ideal, but not required:

 - Background in SEO infrastructure, programmatic content, or developer marketing

 - Familiarity with Stripe integrations, billing systems, or commerce flows

 - Prior work at a high-growth startup (especially AI-native or developer tools)




LOCATION



We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.



We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.




WHY DUST



The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.



We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.



If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.



Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 



Learn how we think and work.

 - Our product constitution, https://blog.dust.tt/a-first-version-of-our-product-constitution/ a story about our mission

 - Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIvlRWEXqqw, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

 - Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/dust, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry helps over 4 million developers understand and resolve issues in their applications. Behind every error, performance trace, replay, and log is a large-scale data platform responsible for storing, querying, and analyzing massive volumes of telemetry data.



We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Events Analytics Platform (EAP) team, which builds and operates the distributed data systems powering Sentry's products. The team manages petabytes of data and develops high-performance analytical infrastructure using technologies like ClickHouse, enabling fast, complex queries across billions of records.



As Sentry grows, so do the technical challenges. The team is evolving its storage and query infrastructure to support increasing data volumes, more complex analytical workloads, and unified access to different types of telemetry data. EAP also provides the data foundation for Seer, Sentry's AI-powered debugging agent, enabling AI systems to access the production context needed to investigate and resolve issues.



In this role, you'll lead a team of engineers tackling complex distributed systems challenges while balancing architectural improvements with the reliability and performance of production systems. You'll bring strong technical judgment, guide engineering decisions, and work closely with product engineering teams to build capabilities that directly impact the developer experience.



This is an opportunity to lead a critical part of Sentry's infrastructure, solve challenging problems at scale, and shape how developers and AI-powered tools interact with application data.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and develop a team of engineers working on large-scale distributed data systems, fostering technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.

 - Drive technical execution and architectural decisions across EAP's storage and query infrastructure, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Build and evolve analytical data systems supporting complex queries, high-throughput workloads, and efficient access to petabytes of event data.

 - Guide the evolution of EAP's architecture, including query optimization, storage and compute separation, and the unification of different event types into a common analytical platform.

 - Own the operational health of the platform, leading efforts to improve reliability, troubleshoot production issues, manage incidents, and address scaling challenges.

 - Partner with product engineering teams to understand their technical requirements, make informed tradeoffs, and deliver platform capabilities that support new product experiences.

 - Support Sentry's AI-powered capabilities by ensuring the platform efficiently serves the analytical workloads and production context required by Seer and other AI-driven experiences.

 - Set clear priorities and drive projects from design through production, helping the team execute effectively while managing competing technical and product needs.




YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy leading engineers while staying closely involved in technical discussions, architecture, and complex problem-solving.

 - Get excited about building and operating large-scale distributed systems where performance, reliability, and efficiency matter.

 - Have a strong interest in analytical databases, storage engines, query systems, and the engineering challenges behind processing massive volumes of data.

 - Like working through difficult technical tradeoffs and turning ambiguous requirements into practical engineering solutions.

 - Take pride in building reliable production systems, understanding how they behave under load, and continuously improving their performance.

 - Enjoy collaborating with product engineering teams and understanding how infrastructure decisions influence the end-user experience.

 - Want to lead a team whose work directly supports Sentry's core products and growing AI-powered capabilities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant professional software engineering experience, including experience managing and developing engineers, leading technical projects, and driving engineering execution.

 - Strong technical background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, analytical databases, or large-scale backend systems.

 - Hands-on experience building, scaling, or operating complex data-intensive systems, with depth in at least one of the following:
   
   - Analytical database infrastructure: Operating, scaling, optimizing, or maintaining OLAP systems such as ClickHouse, Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, or similar technologies in production.
   
   - Complex distributed data platforms: Designing and building sophisticated systems using analytical databases or distributed storage technologies as foundational components, with meaningful ownership of the underlying architecture, performance, and reliability.

 - Experience making architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs involving system scalability, performance, reliability, or operational complexity.

 - Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including troubleshooting, incident response, performance optimization, and operational improvements.

 - Experience leading engineering projects from technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operations.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders and translate technical requirements into actionable engineering priorities.



Bonus points for:

 - Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid, or other column-oriented analytical databases.

 - Experience with query optimization, analytical storage architecture, or high-throughput data processing.

 - Experience building infrastructure for observability, telemetry, developer tools, or event-driven applications.

 - Experience working closely with product engineering teams to develop infrastructure supporting customer-facing features.

 - Proficiency with Python, Rust, or similar backend programming languages.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Experiences
jobs.description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

Team

As an engineering team, we believe strongly that empathy improves our solutions. Seeing how people use the product is a priority and the way we get to the right answer. Engineers will have the opportunity to work closely with our team onsite to understand the variety of use cases that Peregrine serves.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join Product Experiences, the team that builds the features our users work in every day across the Peregrine platform. You'll work cross-functionally with design and product management to ship experiences that are fast, intuitive, and trustworthy, turning enormous amounts of data into something an investigator or analyst can act on in seconds.

We value both ownership and collaboration. You will take full responsibility for major features and work closely with other engineers to drive them to completion. We believe that humility and empathy are essential for building the right solutions. You will collaborate directly with our deployment team and users as we iterate to solve their problems. Perseverance and creativity are crucial to executing our vision.

Role

We are looking for strong product-minded developers to join our small but growing team. As a Software Engineer on Product Experiences, you'll have vast ownership across the capabilities that define how customers use the Peregrine platform, including Search, Dossier, Charts, Dashboards, Maps, Network, Table, Workspace, Docs, Automations, and Mobile, making decisions that will shape the product for years to come.

You'll take on some of our most visible challenges, like building search and semantic discovery that helps users find the right answer across billions of records, designing Dossier views that assemble a complete picture of an entity on demand, and crafting real-time, collaborative experiences on detailed maps and networks. You'll bring AI-powered capabilities to users where source transparency and trust are non-negotiable, and you'll obsess over the craft details such as latency, interaction design, and resilience that make complex workflows feel effortless.

Our stack is constantly evolving but built on a frontend of React, Redux, TypeScript, and Mapbox; a backend foundation of Python, Django, Celery, Airflow, and Kafka; data stores including PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch powering search and discovery; machine learning models hosted in Bedrock and Sagemaker behind our semantic and AI-assisted experiences; and with AWS, Pulumi, Terraform, and Kubernetes as our underlying infrastructure.

About you

• Desire and drive to own large portions of the user-facing platform from start to finish

• Passion for crafting and shipping product experiences that delight users

• A strong eye for interaction design and a partnership instinct with design and PM

• Thrive on ambiguity and love taking on hard problems

• Excellent technical vision with the ability to synthesize product requests into strong and reliable software components

What we look for

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of experience working with cross-functional software development teams

• Experience shipping and iterating on production-grade, user-facing software professionally and / or in the open-source community

• Strong frontend fundamentals (React/TypeScript) and comfort working full-stack to ship a feature end to end

• Ability to write robust, well tested, and well-designed code that frequently gets deployed to users

• Solid understanding of architecting and scaling distributed software systems

• Strong best practices in modern software development and comfort navigating large codebases

• Located in San Francisco or Washington, D.C. and open to working in office 4 days a week

Salary Range: $200,000 - $275,000 Annually + Benefits + Equity (if applicable) + Bonus (if applicable)

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Research & Insights Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing -- they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce -- where community, conversation, and commerce converge.


THE ROLE

We're looking for our first Research and Insights hire to turn Nectar's data into the stories that define how brands show up on social. Nectar sits on a unique and growing dataset: the conversations between consumer brands and their communities across comments, DMs, and mentions. Your job is to find what's true and interesting in that data, and share it in ways that make community managers, social media managers, and CMOs better at their jobs, while occasionally securing Nectar compelling press coverage in leading publications like the NYT, WSJ, Fobes and others.

Reporting to VP, GTM, you'll own Nectar's research program end-to-end, from asking the right questions and pulling the data to building the visuals and writing the copy. The goal is to make Nectar the most trusted source of truth on social engagement and community-driven commerce.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Dig into Nectar's proprietary data to uncover trends, benchmarks, and surprising patterns in how brands and communities interact on social

 - Build an always-on engine of data content: charts and social posts, recurring benchmark reports, and flagship research

 - Develop public reports cited by the likes of the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Forbes, WWD, and others, and contribute to data-driven customer acquisition.

 - Create your own visualizations and write your own copy, turning complex analysis into charts and narratives people want to share

 - Publish where our audience already spends time: social platforms, newsletters, podcasts, industry events, and the press

 - Partner with marketing, sales, and customer success to bring insights into campaigns, sales conversations, and customer business reviews

 - Become a recognizable voice on social and community data, representing Nectar on social platforms, panels, podcasts, and with journalists

 - Partner with Data Science to develop the methodology and data standards that keep our research rigorous and credible


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–7 years of experience in data science or analytics

 - Fluency in SQL and Python or R, and comfort working with large, messy datasets

 - Strong data visualization skills (Tableau, Looker, Hex, Datawrapper, Figma, or similar): you build your own charts and care how they look

 - A natural storyteller who can explain complex findings simply, in writing and out loud

 - Genuine curiosity about the future of buying behaviors, social media, online communities, and consumer brands

 - Demonstrated ability to turn data analysis into clear, compelling writing for non-technical readers, such as reports, blog posts, or research summaries.

 - Statistical rigor and good judgment about what the data can and can't support

 - An owner's mindset: comfortable building a function from scratch, switching contexts, and operating in a fast-moving startup


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience building a data content or insights program at a B2B company

 - An existing audience, or a track record of data posts that resonated on LinkedIn or elsewhere

 - Experience with social media data, social listening, or NLP and text analysis

 - A background in data journalism, research, or consulting

 - Comfortable on camera either speaking with reporters, podcasters, internal videos, etc.

 - Familiarity with consumer, DTC, or CPG brands




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation and early equity

 - Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match

 - ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes

 - $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees


FOR OUR PALO ALTO OFFICE

 - Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)

 - Free lunch in the office

 - $1,000/month housing stipend for living near the office

 - Fully paid for commuter benefits (train stipend or Palo Alto parking reimbursement)

jobs.title: Sr. Launch Engineer, Propellant Systems (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. LAUNCH ENGINEER, PROPELLANT SYSTEMS (STARSHIP)

The Starship launch team is looking for a highly motivated individual to support the design and build of launch-pad fluid systems, focusing on implementing cryogenic propellant processing and generation systems for all Starship launch sites, landing sites, test sites, production facilities, etc. Join the team responsible for launching the largest and most powerful rocket on Earth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Analyze, design, and build systems that support critical rocket launches and testing

• Cradle-to-grave project ownership through hosting design reviews, project decision justification, equipment procurement, and coordination and assistance in the construction of your ideas

• Apply interdisciplinary engineering skills in fields of system-level process design and initial sizing, detailed pressurized fluid and thermal analysis, structural engineering, materials and component selection, and cost/schedule optimization

• Work directly with technicians and support groups to build your designs and fix real-world problems on the fly

• Maintain a tight feedback loop with operations and construction teams to rapidly alter plans as necessary to meet tight deadlines

• Activate, commission, and troubleshoot equipment to achieve design objectives and iterate system maintenance strategies to reduce future downtime

• Apply a hands-on approach to tackling daily field projects necessary to keep the company launching rockets

• Provide innovative solutions to problems under minimal supervision or direction

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline

• 5+ years of hands-on build or design experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with quick-thinking and problem solving in time-critical situations

• Collaborative team player, enthusiastic, self-motivated, with a positive can-do attitude

• Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems

• Creative and passionate approach to addressing opportunities and challenges while balancing cost and schedule

• Strong fundamental intuition of fluid and/or structural/mechanical systems

• Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch

• General hands-on experience; automotive, machining, welding, and other fabrication techniques is a plus

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a high-paced, challenging work environment

• Ability to verify designs with simplified hand calculations; experience in finite element analysis or computational fluid dynamics is a plus

• 3+ years of mechanical, fluids, or thermal design experience in an industrial setting or equivalent

• Experience with instrumentation, testing, data review and analysis, verification against an analytical model

• Experience with high pressure and cryogenic fluid systems and components and operations

• Experience producing drawings for fabrication

• Intermediate skill level using CAD (NX a plus)

• American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) piping and pressure vessel design experience

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to respond to emergencies to support priority projects, missions, and launches

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility is required

• Ability to work in extreme outdoor environments when needed – heat, cold, wind, rain, etc.

• Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Working conditions may be in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required

• Ability to lift heavy objects up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Ability to work on ladders, lifts, and at elevated heights (up to 300 feet) with proper personal protective equipment (PPE)

• Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX sites and vendors - up to 15%

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: VP Marketing
jobs.description:
View All Jobs

About the Role

Updater is seeking a strategic, commercially minded Vice President of Marketing to lead our next stage of growth across enterprise platform marketing and large-scale consumer acquisition.

This is a senior leadership role overseeing product marketing, go-to-market, performance marketing, brand, user engagement, and marketing operations. You'll shape how enterprise customers understand and adopt Updater's technology while driving consumer acquisition programs that convert demand into orders.

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you'll lead an established, high-performing marketing team and oversee significant marketing investments. You'll work closely with our current VP of Marketing during the leadership transition, building on a strong foundation to elevate our market position, accelerate growth, and deliver meaningful business results.

Key Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

• Turn our products and technology into compelling stories, clear value propositions, and effective sales strategies.

• Partner with Product to bring new offerings to market, drive adoption, and identify growth opportunities.

• Drive marketing strategies that contribute to pipeline, bookings, customer growth, and retention.

Performance Marketing

• Lead performance marketing strategy across paid acquisition, digital channels, and conversion optimization, managing eight-figure annual marketing budgets.

• Optimize acquisition economics, conversion rates, and return on marketing investment to drive efficient, sustainable growth.

• Identify and test new channels, strategies, and opportunities to increase consumer acquisition and orders.

Brand & Market Leadership

• Shape how Updater shows up in the market, building a clear, differentiated brand and establishing our leadership in the commerce industry.

• Lead corporate communications, thought leadership, brand strategy, and PR to grow awareness, credibility, and market presence.

Team Leadership & Marketing Excellence

• Lead and elevate an established, high-performing team, fostering creativity, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

• Set clear priorities and oversee marketing operations, resources, and performance to maximize the team’s impact.

Requirements

• A strategic platform marketing executive. You’ve led marketing at a sophisticated SaaS, marketplace, or technology platform business and know how to position complex products, build market credibility, and drive enterprise sales.

• A product marketer at heart. You understand how to connect product strategy, customer needs, and go-to-market execution to create compelling value propositions and help the company move faster.

• A performance-driven growth leader. You have deep experience with paid acquisition, conversion optimization, customer acquisition economics, and managing significant marketing investments. You’re as comfortable discussing CAC and ROAS as you are with positioning and brand strategy.

• A commercially minded business partner. You understand how marketing drives pipeline, orders, and revenue, and you make decisions based on measurable business impact.

• A proven people leader. You’ve led talented, multidisciplinary teams and know how to elevate an already strong group.

• A creative, hands-on thinker. You can set an ambitious vision, challenge conventional thinking, and get into the details when it matters.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $240,000 - $270,000 annually. Factors that may affect compensation within this range include skills, experience, and other qualifications aligned with Updater's internal leveling guidelines.

About Updater

Updater is a leading technology platform helping major brands acquire and retain customers at scale. We are on a mission to power millions of complex transactions through intelligent, autonomous systems. By combining deep integrations, real-world data, and purpose-built AI agents, we’re transforming fragmented purchasing workflows into seamless, automated experiences – freeing businesses and consumers from operational friction and enabling a new standard of speed, accuracy, and scale.

Updater has raised over $450 million from leading investors, including SoftBank Capital, Vista Credit Partners, IA Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Second Century Ventures (the strategic investment arm of the National Association of Realtors®), and more. For more information, please visit www.updater.com.

Updater is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants regardless of color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, actual or presumed belonging to an ethnic group, or any other legally protected status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for full-time positions, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Flexible PTO

• 13 paid company holidays annually

• Updater Stock Options

• 401(k) with employer match

• Wellbeing Subsidy

• One Medical membership

• Virtual on-demand healthcare through Teladoc and Talkspace

• Flexible spending account (FSA)

• Health savings account (HSA)

• Supplemental Short & Long Term Disability Insurance

• Supplemental Life Insurance

• Paid Parental Leave

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Product Marketing to be the bridge between what we build and how the market hears about it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll lead the product marketing function: hiring and managing product & technical marketers who ship content for both customers and our sales team. This is a player-coach role, so you should enjoy being in the trenches with the team, able to write positioning, frame launches, evaluate competitors, and pitch customers.



This role demands a technical background since you will spend time with engineers, and you will need to understand retrieval, agents, and APIs.  It is also imperative that you be fluent with AI tools, both to drive team productivity and to understand how our AI-forward customers are doing their jobs.



This role bridges product marketing to the product/engineering org. The person in this role will ensure that our fast-moving product roadmap translates into a steady stream of high-impact launches, announcements, and demos. Conversely, this role should bring market feedback into the prioritization process. You will be the person to surface valuable features and evaluate competitive positioning, with the ultimate aim of building the world’s best search engine for AI agents.

This role is based in-person at our San Francisco HQ.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




THE LAUNCH CALENDAR

Own the conversion of the engineering roadmap into a sequenced calendar of launches, announcements, and demos. Decide what gets a moment and what ships quietly, and make sure every launch that deserves attention gets a coordinated one. Success is measured by launch cadence and the  reach of launch (coverage, signups, developer buzz).




COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE

Document the competitive landscape: who is shipping what, where we lead, and where we need to be wary. Help train our sales team to educate customers how Exa can best meet their needs.  Success is measured by our win rate.




POSITIONING AND MESSAGING

Own the positioning and messaging architecture for Exa. Maintain a consistent structure, and fill it in yourself for major releases. Success is measured by clarity and consistent adoption.




CONTENT FOR WEBSITE HOME & PRODUCT PAGES

Ensure our website tells the story: the homepage, product, industries, and use case pages. You own the message, navigation, and page structure, while Digital Marketing owns the site mechanics, performance, and conversion surfaces. Success is measured by website freshness and visitor satisfaction.




INTERLOCK WITH PRODUCT

Be the trusted channel between marketing and product/engineering. Sit close enough to the work to know what's coming, translate engineering features into market vernacular, and synthesize market signals to shape our roadmap (such as win/loss, customer needs, adoption by segment, etc). Success is measured by market share and customer consumption.




TEAM LEADERSHIP

Manage, coach, and grow the product marketing team, starting with 4 headcount today. Set the bar, develop people, and build a function that ships without you in the room. Success is measured by the caliber of the team and by their output trajectory under your stewardship.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Positioning is consistent, technically credible, and used across the company.

 - Launches increase in reach and impact

 - Competitive gaps are surfaced and prioritized with evidence

 - The website is compelling for developer audiences, leading to high conversion

 - Sales is well-supported with assets and training for high win-rate and fast sales cycles

 - PMM team grows in capability, able to ship when you’re out-of-office

 - Engineering welcomes your collaboration because you make the product better.




YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - 8+ years in product marketing or product management at a B2B technology company, with meaningful time on the more technical, roadmap-facing end.

 - A genuinely technical background. You can hold a conversation with engineers about retrieval, agents, and APIs, and you have the credibility to push Engineering on competitive gaps.

 - Experience managing a team of 3 or more, with evidence you developed people.

 - A track record turning a roadmap into launches with impact.

 - Deep competitive intelligence experience, synthesizing signals into decisions about what to build or how to position.

 - Excellent writing. You can still write positioning when it counts.

 - Evidence of influence without ownership: a time you changed what a product team prioritized using market evidence, without having authority over the roadmap.

 - A proven AI builder mindset: you've shipped tools & assets using agents, not just used ChatGPT.


NICE TO HAVE

 - A background as an engineer, or a computer science or technical degree, before moving into marketing or product.

 - Experience at an API-first, infrastructure, or developer tools company.

 - Domain depth in search, retrieval, RAG, or agent frameworks.

 - Experience as the marketing counterpart to a founder-owned roadmap, and a track record of making that relationship productive.

 - Experience building a product marketing function from small beginnings at a high-growth startup.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Content & Brand Producer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARGE

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (one-fifth of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we developed robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables. We’ve shipped our first commercial system already, and are in the process of scaling up our operations to meet our massive demand.

Charge is a fast-moving company, which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with 🤖 giant robots 🤖.

If you are excited to work on interesting technical problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

 - YouTube - Introducing Sunrise, the assembly line for solar https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ix0oMgqTfko

 - Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems https://www.fastcompany.com/91108331/these-solar-assembling-robotic-arms-could-solve-one-of-the-industrys-biggest-problems

 - MIT News - Making solar projects cheaper and faster with portable factories https://news.mit.edu/2025/charge-robotics-makes-solar-projects-cheaper-faster-portable-factories-0312

Charge’s funding:

We’re MIT-founded and backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Founders Fund, Energy Impact Partners, Lux Capital, YC (S21), and more.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be our first dedicated content hire. You'll embed with our engineering, manufacturing and field teams, film Sunrise building solar farms, and turn it into a steady stream of videos, posts and stories on LinkedIn, Instagram, X and our blog. Your job is to make Charge a brand that customers, future teammates and the wider energy world recognize and follow.

This role is structured as contract-to-hire: start hourly, convert to full-time. See bottom for details.

What you'll be working on:

 - Building our digital brand: Own the publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Instagram, X and the blog, cut each piece for its platform, and shift the mix toward what's working

 - Turning our product + engineering journey into stories: Translate the R&D happening daily at our HQ into clips, threads, photo sets and blog posts that powerfully tell the story of our product, company, and industry

 - Keeping the content engine humming: Keep an organized footage library the team can pull from for decks, press and recruiting, and create shot lists so field techs can capture usable footage when you're not on site

 - Amplifying founders and launches: Help draft and package founder posts, talks and podcast clips, and work with our PR agency on announcements

 - Filming Sunrise in the field: Travel to active solar sites to capture the system in motion, from wide aerials to tight mechanism shots and crew interviews, working safely alongside our field team

You:

 - Have strong creative judgment and self-direction (a stellar portfolio beats degrees or years of experience), and have independently produced content in a professional setting before, whether in-house, at an agency, or as a freelancer or creator

 - Have a storyteller’s instinct - you can find and create narrative arcs in video and writing alike, matching tone and style to audience and platform

 - Write clearly and powerfully, and can turn a technical idea into a sharp LinkedIn post or a readable blog paragraph

 - Have editing fluency and platform expertise, with a good instinct for how to distill our brand pillars into the right channels (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Blog) and reach the right audiences

 - Are genuinely excited about solar, climate, and robotics: you believe the energy transition is now a race to build, you want to show the world how robots like Sunrise get solar into the ground at the speed the climate needs, and that conviction comes through in everything you make

 - Are based in or can relocate to the SF Bay Area, and able to work 4-5 days/week from our San Leandro HQ

 - Are open to 15% travel to field (solar construction sites all over the US) to film our product and team at work in our deployment environment, often in remote locations with harsh outdoor conditions

It'd also be nice if you:

 - Are or want to be a drone pilot, with an FAA Part 107 license and aerials in your reel, or are willing to get certified in your first month (we’ll cover it). Utility-scale solar sites span hundreds of acres, and aerials are how people grasp the scale and impact of our system

 - Have visual range beyond shooting and editing video, like still photography or light motion graphics

 - Have experience creating content for hardware, climate, energy or construction companies

 - Have worked at an early-stage startup and like the pace of work




STRUCTURE OF THE ROLE:

The first 3 months are a full-time W-2 contract with a conversion decision against agreed-upon goals. After conversion, the role converts to full-time base plus equity and benefits. 




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost  including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:

• Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported

• B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.

• Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.

• Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.

• Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.

• Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.

• Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.

What you'll bring:

Core Experience

• 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.

• B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

• Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.

• Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).

• Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.

• Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.

• Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.

• Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.

• Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.

• Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.

• Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.

• Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.

Nice to have:

• Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization

• Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment

• Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.

• Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.

Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

• Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.

• Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.

• Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.

• Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.

• See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.

What you'll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

• Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

• Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

• One-time home office stipend

• Annual professional development budget

• Quarterly wellbeing stipend

• Considerable paid parental leave

• Employee referral bonus program

• Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.
