About the Role

Updater is seeking a commercially minded, highly strategic, and technically fluent Enterprise Accounts Director to own and grow a focused portfolio of our most important enterprise customers.

This is a senior, highly visible individual contributor role. You’ll become deeply embedded in your customers’ businesses, building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, understanding their technical environments and strategic priorities, and developing account strategies that drive long-term partnership health, performance, and growth.

You’ll work closely with Sales on strategic accounts, help create continuity from late-stage sales through implementation and launch, and serve as the ongoing business owner for the relationship. We’re looking for someone who can navigate complex technical partnerships, challenge customers when needed, build compelling business cases, and turn strong relationships into meaningful commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities

Own Strategic Accounts

• Serve as the senior relationship owner for a focused portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts, developing strategies that drive long-term health, performance, retention, and growth.

• Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business model, technical environment, strategic priorities, organizational dynamics, and success metrics.

• Build strong, trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators and technical stakeholders to senior executives and decision-makers.

• Anticipate changes in customer priorities, performance, and organizational dynamics that create opportunity or risk.

Manage Relationships Across the Customer Lifecycle

• Partner with Sales in late-stage conversations to build customer context, understand commercial commitments, and create continuity through launch.

• Partner with cross-functional teams through implementation and transition accounts successfully into ongoing strategic account management.

• Serve as the primary business owner for accounts post-launch, aligning internal teams and driving complex initiatives, escalations, and decisions.

Drive Account Growth and Commercial Outcomes

• Identify and develop opportunities to expand existing relationships across products, use cases, business units, customer experiences, and other areas of strategic value.

• Build compelling business cases for expansion by connecting customer needs and performance data with Updater’s products and capabilities.

• Proactively sell up within customer organizations, engaging senior decision-makers beyond day-to-day operational contacts.

• Lead strategic commercial conversations around expansion, pricing, and other changes to the relationship.

• Anticipate underperformance or relationship risk and develop clear strategies to improve outcomes.

Navigate Complex Enterprise Relationships

• Develop a strong working understanding of Updater’s products, APIs, integrations, data flows, and customer workflows.

• Translate technical capabilities and constraints into clear business implications for customers and internal stakeholders.

• Drive complex partnership initiatives across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Sales, and other internal teams.

• Bring customer insights into internal decision-making while balancing customer needs with Updater’s product and commercial priorities.

Requirements

• 8–10+ years of experience across enterprise account management, strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, customer success, consulting, or a related commercially focused role.

• Meaningful experience owning large, complex enterprise relationships involving software, APIs, integrations, embedded products, or other technically complex partnerships.

• Demonstrated ability to move beyond day-to-day relationship management and develop strategic account plans that improve customer outcomes and create commercial growth.

• Experience building relationships with and influencing senior executives and decision-makers.

• Strong commercial instincts, including experience identifying expansion opportunities, developing business cases, navigating objections, and advancing complex commercial conversations.

• Demonstrated ability to take initiative, operate autonomously, and drive cross-functional work across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Sales, and other teams.

• Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and make clear, persuasive recommendations.

• Entrepreneurial, startup mentality with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being built.

• Experience in telecommunications, utilities, real estate, financial services, marketplaces, or other complex enterprise ecosystems is a plus.

• Familiarity with AI tools for analysis, workflow automation, or account management is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you’ll develop a deep understanding of your account portfolio, including each customer’s business, stakeholders, technical environment, economics, performance, risks, and growth opportunities. You’ll build strong internal and external relationships and establish clear account strategies and priorities.

Over time, you’ll become the trusted strategic partner and internal business owner for your accounts. You’ll understand where relationships are performing well, where risk exists, and where meaningful opportunities exist to deepen and grow the partnership.

Ultimately, success means building enterprise relationships that perform better, grow over time, and create meaningful long-term value for both our customers and Updater.

Compensation

The new hire OTE for this position is  $170,000 - $230,000 annually. Factors which may affect the starting pay within this range include skills, experience, and other qualifications aligned with Updater's internal leveling guidelines.

About Updater

Updater is a leading technology platform helping major brands acquire and retain customers at scale. We are on a mission to power millions of complex transactions through intelligent, autonomous systems. By combining deep integrations, real-world data, and purpose-built AI agents, we’re transforming fragmented purchasing workflows into seamless, automated experiences – freeing businesses and consumers from operational friction and enabling a new standard of speed, accuracy, and scale.

Updater has raised over $450 million from leading investors, including SoftBank Capital, Vista Credit Partners, IA Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Second Century Ventures (the strategic investment arm of the National Association of Realtors®), and more. For more information, please visit www.updater.com.

Updater is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants regardless of color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, actual or presumed belonging to an ethnic group, or any other legally protected status. jobs.title: People Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a People Compliance Specialist, you will play a critical role in managing, scaling, and operationalizing Anduril’s people compliance programs. Serving as a subject matter expert, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including People Operations, Employment Legal, and People Business Partners —to ensure compliance across federal, state, and local regulations. In this role, you will drive key compliance workflows, compliance initiatives for our growing hourly and non-exempt workforce, background check adjudications, and mandatory reporting obligations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of People Team policies, procedures, forms, templates, and process documentation, including communication and acknowledgment tracking.

• Oversee HR reporting, audits, documentation management and end-to-end background check and adverse action processes.

• Manage and administer Anduril’s drug and alcohol screening program, ensuring full compliance with federal and state testing requirements (pre-employment, random) and mandatory reporting.

• Serve as the primary subject matter expert and escalation point for compliance-related inquiries from employees, Onboarding, People Operations, and Talent Acquisition.

• Lead routine and ad-hoc internal compliance audits, identifying operational vulnerabilities and implementing proactive corrective actions.

• Lead the preparation, validation, and submission of mandatory compliance reporting (e.g., EEO-1, VETS, and state-specific reporting).

• Design, standardize, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), documentation retention schedules, and workflow materials across all people compliance programs.

• Oversee mandatory employee compliance training programs, ensuring tracking and high completion rates across both exempt and hourly employee populations.

• Partner with external vendors to ensure SLA adherence and operational excellence.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of dedicated experience in HR compliance, people operations, or employment legal operations.

• Hands-on experience administering and managing DOT-regulated drug and alcohol testing programs and clearinghouses.

• Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.

• Proven ability to own and drive programs independently, with strong analytical and project management skills.

• High level of discretion and integrity when handling sensitive, confidential employee data.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory requirements to stakeholders at all levels.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

US Salary Range

$101,000—$135,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation: The wage range for this role is $140,000 - $350,000 salary per year (for a full-time position), inclusive of base salary and discretionary production bonus target. The expected base salary for this role is between $180,000 - $200,000 of this wage range (for a full-time position). , including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

The expected base salary for this role is between $180,000 - $200,000 of this wage range (for a full-time position). , including base and 401K match

jobs.title: General Manager, Data Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT DAVID AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.



David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors. 



Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.




ABOUT OUR DATA OPERATIONS TEAM

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.



This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0→1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1→N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.

 - Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.

 - Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.

 - Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.

 - Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.

 - Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.

 - Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.
   
   


YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 5–10 years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).

 - Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.

 - Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.

 - Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.

 - A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.

 - Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.
   
   


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.

 - Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.




BENEFITS

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.

 - FSA & HSA access.

 - 401k access.

 - Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.

 - Unlimited company-sponsored Barry’s classes.


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

jobs.title: Transportation Supervisor
jobs.description:
ABOUT NEVOYA:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Transportation Supervisor in our Perris, California operation, you’ll combine driver management and customer success into one accountable seat. You’ll own live execution from the moment the approved plan is released through delivery and billing-ready closeout. Planning owns the capacity and network plan; you own the driver, the customer, the load, the equipment, every exception, and the next action.

You’ll be the person who keeps freight moving and customers informed. That means coaching drivers, staying ahead of late risk, recovering quickly when things break, and handing off a clean shift so nothing falls through the cracks. Success is measured by on-time pickup and delivery, proactive customer communication, driver safety and productivity, and accurate, billing-ready load closeout.

This is a full-time, hybrid overnight role in a 24/7 operation. You’ll work four 12-hour shifts, Friday through Monday, from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM, with three days off each week. You’ll be in the office on Friday and Monday and work remotely on Saturday and Sunday. Coverage includes holidays that fall on your scheduled days. The salary for this role is $70,000 per year.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Driver Readiness and Performance:

 - Confirm driver attendance, start times, Hours of Service, tractor and trailer assignments, and dispatch acknowledgment before each run

 - Monitor movement, dwell, relay readiness, and schedule adherence, and step in early when a load is at risk

 - Coach drivers on safety, attendance, productivity, equipment care, and customer conduct

 - Track coaching completion and work to reduce recurring issues across the driver team

 - Contribute to driver retention by building trust and consistent day-to-day communication

Customer and Load Execution:

 - Monitor customer channels, tenders, instructions, loads, and appointments

 - Keep future freight visible to Planning so capacity stays aligned with demand

 - Send proactive, verified updates to customers on load status and any changes

 - Own active loads through pickup, relay, delivery, POD, accessorial documentation, and portal completion

 - Ensure every load closes out accurate and billing-ready

Exception and Recovery Ownership:

 - Act as incident owner for late risk, callouts, HOS conflicts, breakdowns, rejected loads, OS&D, appointment changes, and missing equipment

 - Carry each exception through to resolution or an explicit handoff

 - Execute recovery steps within the operating playbook

 - Make time-critical adjustments overnight within your delegated authority

 - Escalate material safety, customer, financial, capacity, or relay-plan risk quickly

Systems, Equipment, and Shift Control:

 - Maintain Apollo, our TMS, as the source of truth for load and milestone data

 - Use Samsara and direct driver contact to verify HOS, location, equipment, and milestones

 - Manage customer portals, Front, trailer visibility, and equipment defect escalation

 - Handle load closeout end to end, since this role carries operations support responsibilities

 - Complete an actionable shift handoff covering each open exception, customer impact, action taken, next step, owner, and deadline


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - 2 or more years in driver management, fleet operations, dispatch, customer operations, dedicated transportation, brokerage, or a related asset-based environment

 - Working knowledge of DOT and FMCSA requirements, Hours of Service, ELDs, equipment inspections, and safe dispatch practices

 - Ability to manage drivers and customer commitments at the same time while staying calm, factual, decisive, and safety-first under pressure

 - Experience with TMS and ELD or telematics tools, customer portals, and POD and accessorial workflows

 - Strong follow-through, structured handoffs, and a track record of coaching others

 - High school diploma or GED

Desired Experience:

 - Experience supporting a 24/7 transportation operation on overnight or weekend shifts

 - Hands-on experience with Samsara, Front, or similar telematics and shared inbox tools

 - Background with relay or team-based freight networks

 - Experience in electric vehicle fleets or zero-emissions transportation

 - Familiarity with OS&D handling and claims documentation




AT NEVOYA, WE BELIEVE DIVERSE TEAMS BUILD BETTER SOLUTIONS.

We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Process Operator Specialist, Air Separation Unit (Starship) - Night Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP) - NIGHT SHIFT

SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars.

As a process operator specialist on the ASU team, you will operate and support cryogenic distillation, turboexpanders, centrifugal compressors, molecular sieve systems, and high-purity LOX production under the direction of Lead and Level 4/5 operators. You will monitor process parameters, execute approved procedures, complete thorough field rounds, and qualify toward independent watch standing. If you thrive in high-stakes cryogenic environments, want to learn these systems from first principles, and want ownership of mission-critical hardware as you grow, this is the role for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Monitor the ASU via distributed control system/human-machine interface and conduct thorough field rounds, identifying equipment and process deviations early and reporting them immediately

• Execute assigned steps of plant startups, shutdowns, mode changes, and abnormal situation response in accordance with approved operating procedures and alarm response matrices

• Support troubleshooting, maintenance, and calibration of ASU equipment including centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turboexpanders, cryogenic distillation columns, molecular sieve beds, gas analyzers, control valves, and instrumented electrical systems

• Collect process samples, perform basic field testing, log operational data accurately, and escalate immediately when plant conditions do not match the procedure

• Execute lockout/tagout (LOTO), permit-to-work, job hazard analyses, and Process Safety Management (PSM) activities as trained and authorized, and maintain rigorous 5S, housekeeping, and visual management

• Learn and qualify on standard operating procedures for major ASU systems, support shift pass-down, and participate in continuous improvement in reliability, purity, and housekeeping

• Learn and qualify on standard operating procedures for major ASU systems; build understanding of cryogenic thermodynamics, distillation, adsorption, and equipment performance through the ASU training and qualification gates

• Support shift pass-down and leave the board and field ready for the following shift; participate in continuous improvement in reliability, purity, and housekeeping

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 1+ years of experience working in an industrial environment or plant operations dealing with air separation units, cryogenics, industrial gases, chemical, or oil & gas

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience using P&IDs and/or process flow diagrams as part of work (isolation or LOTO boundary definition, valve lineups, troubleshooting, or field rounds against drawings)

• Hands-on experience in a cryogenic plant, industrial gas facility, chemical plant, utilities plant, launch pad, or propellant farm

• Exposure to compressors, pumps, heat exchangers, or other industrial rotating / process equipment

• Experience with a Distributed Control System (Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell, or equivalent) and/or HMI operation

• Familiarity with mechanical equipment isolation or basic maintenance on industrial rotating machinery

• Experience with lockout/tagout, job hazard analysis, hot work permitting, confined space, or Process Safety Management (PSM) practices

• Familiarity with 120V and 480V industrial electrical equipment (medium-voltage experience is a plus)

• Track record of catching equipment or process issues early and raising them to the shift lead

• Experience in shift operations (nights, weekends, or 24/7) in an industrial environment

• Interest in learning process behavior from first principles (thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat/mass transfer)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Anticipated hours for this position are 6:00 PM - 6:00 AM

• Role may require extended hours, weekend work, and shift schedules that vary depending on site operational needs; flexibility required

• Stand: Up to 10 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 10 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to 75 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 and 2 hours per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 10 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 and 2 hours per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 10 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees for 6 hours or more per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500 ft.), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)
jobs.description:
About BlueSky

We are a clinician-led, patient-centered, collaborative behavioral health company of mental health professionals committed to improving access to high-quality mental health care. Each clinician is dedicated to evidence-based care.

Our objective is to make our services more accessible to those in need of high-quality mental health care. We aim to serve not only individuals in rural areas but patients across all regions who prefer the privacy, security, and convenience of a telehealth consultation.

About the Job

• Provide effective individual psychiatric care via telehealth in an outpatient setting.

• Provide direct patient care, conduct comprehensive patient assessments, develop individualized treatment plans, and prescribe medications as clinically appropriate.

• Ensure all patient care is delivered in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical guidelines.

• We are not affiliated with any hospitals or clinics, allowing clinicians the autonomy to practice in the best interest of their patients without unnecessary corporate administrative interference.

• Work within collaborative clinical teams consisting of multiple therapists and a psychiatric prescriber. During onboarding, you will have the opportunity to connect with eligible psychotherapists seeking a prescriber to join their team, with team matching facilitated by BlueSky.

• Participate in regular staffing with collaborating therapists, at least monthly, to discuss patient cases, treatment coordination, and clinical topics.

• Provide clinical services remotely from your home. Days and hours are flexible and determined by the clinician, including mornings, afternoons, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

• Participate in virtual clinical team meetings.

• Attend BlueSky's clinical conferences, which are held four times per week. Attendance is required at least once per week during the first 90 days of employment and once per month thereafter.

Job Requirements

• Must hold an active, unrestricted PMHNP license in at least one of the states we serve: AZ, CO, IA, IL, MA, MD, MN, MS, NC, OH, TN, TX, or WA.

• Must be willing to obtain additional state licenses as needed to support patient access and BlueSky's growing service areas.

• Prior experience working as a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) is preferred but not required.

• Must not own or operate a private practice.

• Ability to work collaboratively with a diverse group of healthcare professionals.

• Strong clinical background in psychiatry and behavioral health.

• Strong knowledge and experience in the assessment and diagnosis of psychiatric disorders and psychopharmacological treatment.

• Familiarity with non-pharmacological and evidence-based behavioral health interventions.

• Strong computer skills and comfort using EHRs, telehealth platforms, and other basic technology.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to provide patient-centered, evidence-based, and collaborative psychiatric care in a telehealth environment.

HOURLY

Salary Range

$70—$95 USD

The ideal candidate loves building great user interfaces, optimizing conversion, experimenting to produce data driven decisions, is knowledgeable of modern frontend technologies and concepts, and has a high level of comfort diving all the way down the stack to the backend and data layers.  

Come do the best work of your career and help us transition $150B in healthcare spending towards prevention, before people get sick.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT TRUEMED

 - Own large, user-facing features from inception to completion

 - Collaborate with the product, marketing, and design teams to set the direction of truemed.com http://truemed.com

 - Work with the engineering team to establish the norms and standards of our front-end

 - Expand our back end systems and data models to support important product initiatives 




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Senior Level experience on a great engineering team using NextJS, React, Typescript, Tailwind, or similar technologies

 - Experience with Python, Django, or similar technologies

 - Deep understanding of rendering behavior of frameworks such as NextJS and how to optimize page loads

 - Experience using core web vitals and similar metrics to optimizing website performance

 - Experience working within scaled front-end projects utilizing concepts such as component libraries, monorepos, and a headless CMS.

 - Experience designing, using and expanding back end APIs and data models.

 - Bonus — experience with payments systems and infrastructure




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Comp and equity in the top decile for Series A startups.  Our Senior Engineering pay band is $175k to $225k plus stock options

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer sponsored HSA contributions

 - 401(k)

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Remote Work

 - Coworking stipend

 - L&D Stipend

 - 2x/year company offsites and 2x/year team offsite




ABOUT TRUEMED

Our mission is to help people take control of their health.  Today, 95% of all medical costs go to treating illness. Our goal is to empower people to invest in healthy habits today rather than treating illness in the future.  We do this by supporting these 5 habits that research shows are tied to significantly improved health outcomes:

 1. Eating healthy food

 2. Getting an adequate quantity and quality of sleep

 3. Increasing movement and exercise and reducing sedentary behavior

 4. Reducing chronic stress

 5. Increasing sunlight and minimizing environmental toxins

Today Truemed enables patients to use pretax HSA/FSA funds to buy healthy food, exercise equipment, and supplements. We support brands like Peloton, Eight Sleep, Momentous, and hundreds of others. We're building the infrastructure that allows health and wellness merchants to accept the $150+ billion tied up in HSA and FSA accounts. By allowing consumers to spend these pre-tax dollars on goods that make them healthier, we'll incentivize consumers to invest in their health and begin to reverse the explosion in chronic illness that's plagued the US for the last 50 years.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Compiler & Spark Runtime
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 Staff Software Engineer – Compiler & Spark Runtime

Location: Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Spark Runtime Engineering Team brings Snowflake’s performance, efficiency, and reliability to Spark workloads. Our mission is to help customers scale data processing while preserving the familiar Spark APIs and semantics they rely on. We build the compiler and runtime integration that translate Spark workloads into efficient execution on Snowflake’s cloud-native query engine. This includes tackling complex challenges in compiler infrastructure, query-plan lowering, Spark compatibility, execution integration, and end-to-end observability to deliver faster, more cost-efficient data processing at scale.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to lead complex engineering initiatives and influence technical direction. You will design and build critical compiler and runtime capabilities, guide architectural decisions, and mentor engineers through technical collaboration.


ROLE OVERVIEW

You will own complex projects from design through implementation and production rollout, contribute directly to the codebase, review critical designs and code, and investigate challenging correctness, performance, and reliability issues. You will provide technical leadership for engineers building production compiler and runtime capabilities for Spark workloads on Snowflake.

In partnership with compiler, query engine, runtime, and product teams, you will translate customer needs into focused technical priorities and measurable engineering outcomes. You will lead through technical judgment, hands-on execution, mentorship, and influence—not through formal reporting relationships.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the technical design and implementation of Spark query compilation and runtime integration, including intermediate representations, type resolution, semantic compatibility, query-plan transformations, and efficient SQL generation.

 - Own complex engineering initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, validation, and production rollout.

 - Provide technical leadership to project teams by clarifying engineering trade-offs, aligning contributors, reviewing designs and code, and resolving technical blockers.

 - Improve end-to-end workload performance and cost-efficiency through profiling, compilation-latency reduction, metadata-access improvements, and collaboration with query-engine teams.

 - Establish strong correctness and compatibility practices, including differential testing against Apache Spark, regression coverage, and clear handling of unsupported behavior.

 - Drive production quality for owned components, including observability, incident investigation, fault recovery, and safe rollout practices.

 - Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and knowledge sharing, strengthening the team’s technical capabilities.

 - Partner with senior technical leaders and Product Management to prioritize investments, identify dependencies, and scope deliverable engineering milestones.

 - Validate changes against representative customer workloads and track measurable improvements in compatibility, latency, reliability, and cost-efficiency.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial work on compilers, query-processing systems, or runtime infrastructure.

 - Demonstrated experience serving as a technical lead for complex engineering initiatives, guiding engineers and coordinating delivery without requiring formal management authority.

 - A track record of designing, implementing, and delivering production systems, with ownership of significant architectural and implementation decisions.

 - Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as compiler architecture and IR transformations, relational query processing, language semantics and type systems, or runtime integration.

 - Proficiency in Scala, Java, C++, or a comparable implementation language, with the ability to write and review production code.

 - Strong systems fundamentals, including concurrency, memory behavior, and performance analysis, together with experience debugging complex production issues.

 - Ability to translate technical and customer requirements into practical engineering priorities and collaborate effectively across teams and locations.

 - Strong technical communication and mentorship skills, including the ability to build alignment around architectural decisions and explain complex trade-offs.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with Apache Spark internals, Catalyst, Spark Connect, or DataFrame APIs.

 - Experience with relational algebra, SQL generation, query optimization, or database execution systems.

 - Experience with Scala/JVM performance, native runtime functions, metadata caching, or compilation-performance optimization.

 - Experience building compatibility-test frameworks, differential testing, performance benchmarks, or production observability for data systems.

 - Experience technically leading systems through customer adoption, production hardening, and staged releases.

 - A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Perplexity's security team protects products used by millions of people and thousands of enterprises, including AI agents that browse the web, run code, and act in customer systems. The team is small, senior, and builds most of what it uses: our own detections, agents that triage and investigate alerts around the clock, continuous offensive testing, and secure-by-default platforms for the rest of engineering.

We're also turning what we've built into cybersecurity products for customers, so the same team that defends Perplexity builds what we ship.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow Security Engineering, including the engineers building our cybersecurity products. You'll own the team's execution and people, set the technical direction for how we defend our infrastructure, products, and corporate environment, and lead the product engineering work that brings those systems to customers. You'll stay close enough to the work to run an incident or review a design yourself. You'll report to Perplexity's head of security and work with engineering, infrastructure, IT, product, legal, and our co-founders.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead, hire, and grow a team of security engineers across detection and response, cloud and infrastructure security, application and product security, offensive security, and identity and corporate security.

 - Lead the engineers building our cybersecurity products: set technical direction for agent-driven products across application security, offensive testing, cloud security, and detection and response, and own delivery to design partners and enterprise customers.

 - Keep the internal security program and the product tightly linked, so what the team runs on Perplexity every day becomes what we ship, and customer feedback improves how we defend ourselves.

 - Set the roadmap for Security Engineering, balancing incident load, risk reduction, and long-term platform investments, and make clear prioritization calls.

 - Own security incident response operations: on-call health, escalation, cross-team coordination during incidents, and postmortems that lead to real fixes.

 - Drive an AI-first security program. Push the team to automate investigation, response, and remediation with agents, and hold that automation to a high bar for accuracy and safety.

 - Partner with engineering and infrastructure leaders to get security work into their roadmaps, from threat models and design reviews to least-privilege access and secure-by-default libraries.

 - Represent Security Engineering in enterprise customer security reviews, external researcher and bug bounty engagements, and audits.

 - Build the team's operating rhythm: clear ownership, metrics that matter (time to detect, time to contain, open risk), and written standards others can follow.

 - Stay hands-on: review designs and code, run investigations when needed, and keep a working understanding of the systems the team defends.
   
   

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of engineering experience in security, with at least 3 years managing security or infrastructure engineering teams.

 - Deep hands-on background in at least two of: detection and response, cloud security (AWS preferred), application or product security, offensive security, or identity and access management.

 - Experience leading incident response for serious security incidents, including technical investigation, containment, and communication with executives and customers.

 - Strong management practice: clear feedback, effective 1:1s, career development, and a track record of hiring and retaining strong senior engineers.

 - Comfortable with modern infrastructure (Kubernetes, cloud-native services, CI/CD) and able to engage credibly with engineers on design and code.

 - Ability to make good tradeoffs under pressure and explain risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Experience shipping software products to external customers, ideally security products, including working with design partners and turning customer feedback into a roadmap.

 - Experience building security programs at a fast-growing company, where you built more than you bought.

 - Bonus: experience securing AI/ML systems, LLM applications, or autonomous agents, or using AI to scale security operations.

 - Bonus: experience supporting enterprise compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) from the engineering side.

jobs.title: Staff Field Service Engineer
jobs.location: Reno, Nevada, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

About the Role

Role Summary

Amperesand is bringing solid-state transformer (SST) technology to market, and our first deployments at data centres and other critical sites will define how customers and partners see us. We are hiring a Staff Field Service Engineer – MV to be our lead medium-voltage expert in the field: the person who makes sure every installation is safe, repeatable and successful, and who builds the processes that let us scale beyond our own staff.

You will own the MV install, maintenance and RMA standard operating procedures and safety guidance, act as Technical Account Manager for key customers and partners, and lead installs at reference-critical pilot sites. You will also build and run our partner training and certification program so that qualified third-party installers can deploy Amperesand systems to our standard. Just as importantly, you will be the voice of the field in product design – feeding real-world installation, serviceability and reliability insight back to R&D, and freeing our engineering teams from day-to-day site work.

This is a Staff-level role with significant organizational impact. Over time you will build and lead a small, growing field service team and work closely with power electronics, firmware, software, hardware and operations engineers, as well as customers’ facilities and electrical teams. It suits someone who thrives in a startup: comfortable switching between hands-on site work and process building, willing to travel for extended periods, and driven by outcomes rather than hours.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

• Own MV service procedures and safety: Author, own and continuously improve MV installation, commissioning, maintenance and RMA SOPs, including safety guidance, LOTO/switching procedures and arc-flash practices aligned with NFPA 70E.

• Lead pilot site installs and ongoing maintenance: Lead and personally deliver safe, on-time installations and commissioning, and ongoing maintenance, at reference-critical pilot sites, including data centres, achieving zero safety incidents, 99.999% availability and first-time-right energization.

• Act as Technical Account Manager: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for key customers and partners – managing site readiness, escalations, root-cause investigations and service reviews to drive uptime and customer satisfaction.

• Build partner certification: Design and deliver a training and certification program that enables effective training of in-house or external installers to deploy and maintain Amperesand systems at scale, and audit their work to Amperesand’s standards.

• Be the voice of the field in product design: Capture field learnings and translate them into clear, prioritized design inputs (via Jira) for serviceability, installability and reliability; participate in design reviews as the field representative.

• Drive diagnostics and RMA: Use system telemetry and field data to diagnose faults, support RMA failure analysis with R&D, and identify trends that improve fleet reliability.

• Build and lead the field team: Hire, mentor and lead a team of field service engineers/technicians, setting standards for safety, documentation and customer conduct.

• Be a hands-on generalist: Contribute wherever needed in a startup environment – from site surveys and tooling to spares planning and service pricing input.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

• Years of experience: 10+ years in field service, commissioning or installation engineering, with substantial hands-on MV (e.g. 4.16–35 kV) switchgear, transformer or power conversion equipment experience.

• Education: BSc in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g. military, utility or trade background).

• Domain expertise: Deep knowledge of MV systems, protection, switching, grounding and safe work practices; current NFPA 70E / arc-flash training.

• Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring field teams, and authoring SOPs, training material or certification programs.

• Industry experience: Data centre, mission-critical facility, utility or energy infrastructure experience strongly preferred.

• Flexibility: Willingness to travel 30–50%, including multi-week deployments, and to work extended or irregular hours when site schedules demand.

• Collaboration: A team player who communicates clearly with customers and with software, electrical and hardware engineers alike.

Technical Skills

• MV switchgear, transformers, protection relays and power distribution architecture

• Familiarity with power electronics (inverters, converters, UPS or SST systems) and their commissioning

• Basic understanding of telemetry, SCADA/BMS/monitoring systems and using data to troubleshoot

• Jira (or similar) for issue tracking and feeding field feedback into engineering

• Test equipment: insulation resistance/hipot testers, power quality analyzers, oscilloscopes, multimeters, relay test sets

• Reading and marking up single-line diagrams, schematics and installation drawings

• Knowledge of relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, UL/IEC)

Nice to Have

• Startup or early-stage product deployment experience

• NETA Level III/IV certification

• OSHA 30 certification

• Experience with solid-state transformers, power electronics converters or grid-tied energy storage

• Experience building technical training or partner/installer certification programs

• Basic scripting (e.g. Python) for data analysis or test automation

Working Model

Employment Type:
• Full-time

Location:
[San Francisco/South Bay Area / Reno]

Work Model:
• Onsite

Travel Requirements:
30%-50%

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:
Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems • High ownership and visibility • Cross-functional collaboration • Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure • Fast-moving startup environment

Please note: This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.

While this role is listed for the location above, we may consider candidates in other locations on a case-by-case basis.

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:

Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems

• High ownership and visibility

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure

• Fast-moving startup environment

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States:

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

• Medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their dependents, effective from the start of hire

• Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 401k retirement savings plan through Empower

• Employees receive paid time off (PTO), paid sick days, and paid company holidays

• Commuter Benefits

• 100% paid maternal leave (12 weeks) and paternal leave (6 weeks)

The benefits outlined below apply to employees located in Singapore:

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

• Group medical, hospitalisation and surgical insurance, outpatient or GP coverage, group term life, dental and personal accident insurance

• Employer and employee Central Provident Fund contributions in accordance with the CPF Act (for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents)

• Annual leave, paid sick leave, hospitalisation leave, and all Singapore public holidays, in line with or exceeding the Employment Act

• Commuter Benefits

• Government-paid maternity, paternity, shared parental, and childcare leave in accordance with prevailing Singapore statutory entitlements

Additional benefits may be available depending on the role and employment type. Benefits are subject to the terms of applicable company policies and plans.

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.

Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Amperesand is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Amperesand is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Department: Events

The Lighthouse is an innovative campus for creators and their teams, with locations in Venice, CA, and Brooklyn, NY.

We are a creative playground designed for creators to Learn, Make, and Belong. Our mission is to assemble the creator collective, helping them grow and sustain their careers while provoking the next act of the creator economy.

The Lighthouse is looking for an Event Manager to produce brand and member events at our Brooklyn campus and deliver strategic brand experiences for our partners. You’ll own events from first inquiry to post-event recap, turning one-off events into lasting partnerships that help The Lighthouse grow. You’ll report to the General Manager, with a dotted line to the Programming Team. jobs.title: Principal Solution Deployment Strategist (Healthcare)
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



About the Role

We're building a Healthcare Vertical Solutions team that turns AI-powered automation into measurable revenue cycle outcomes for health systems and payers.

We're looking for a Principal Healthcare Deployment Strategist to lead the most strategic customer engagements while helping define how UiPath deploys healthcare solutions across the industry. This is a highly visible individual contributor role for someone who combines deep healthcare operations expertise, exceptional customer leadership, and the ability to shape product direction through real-world implementation experience.

You'll embed with executive customer teams, lead enterprise deployments of AI-powered Revenue Cycle solutions, identify repeatable implementation patterns, and influence the evolution of our Healthcare platform. Every deployment should leave both the customer and the product better than before.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of product strategy, customer success, solution architecture, and healthcare transformation. You'll partner closely with Healthcare Solutions Product Managers, Engineering, and executive leadership while serving as one of the faces of UiPath within the provider and payer ecosystem.

What You'll Do

Strategic Customer Leadership

 - Serve as the executive deployment lead for UiPath's largest healthcare customers.

 - Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CFOs, Chief Digital Officers, CMIOs, Revenue Cycle executives, and operational leadership.

 - Help customers define long-term automation strategies—not simply implement individual workflows.

 - Translate complex organizational challenges into scalable AI-powered healthcare solutions.

Lead Complex Enterprise Deployments

 - Own end-to-end deployment strategy for enterprise healthcare implementations.

 - Lead discovery across clinical, operational, financial, and technology stakeholders.

 - Design implementation roadmaps spanning multiple hospitals, service lines, or payer organizations.

 - Resolve ambiguous business problems by balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and product capabilities.

Create Repeatable Solutions

 - Identify patterns across deployments and transform them into reusable implementation methodologies.

 - Build deployment playbooks, best practices, templates, and reference architectures.

 - Standardize successful customer implementations to accelerate future deployments.

 - Drive consistency across the Healthcare Vertical Solutions organization.

Shape the Product

 - Act as the primary voice of the customer within Product and Engineering.

 - Influence product roadmap decisions using evidence gathered from enterprise deployments.

 - Validate new product concepts with customers before broad release.

 - Help prioritize investments based on market demand and deployment experience.

Drive Industry Thought Leadership

 - Develop perspectives on the future of AI-powered Revenue Cycle automation.

 - Represent UiPath at customer executive briefings, conferences, advisory boards, and industry events.

 - Mentor other Deployment Strategists through coaching and technical leadership.

 - Help establish UiPath as the market leader in Healthcare AI automation.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

 - 10+ years of experience in Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, healthcare technology, consulting, or enterprise software.

 - Deep expertise across Revenue Cycle processes including:
   
   - Denials Management
   
   - Prior Authorization
   
   - Claims Submission
   
   - Revenue Integrity
   
   - Referral Management
   
   - Charge Capture
   
   - Appeals
   
   - Payer Operations

 - Extensive experience leading enterprise software implementations inside health systems or payer organizations.

 - Demonstrated success owning highly complex customer engagements from discovery through scaled deployment.

 - Executive presence with the ability to advise senior healthcare leaders on operational transformation.

 - Strong understanding of healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, HIPAA, and CMS regulations.

 - Experience balancing customer outcomes with product strategy and long-term platform scalability.

 - Exceptional communication, facilitation, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience implementing AI-powered healthcare solutions.

 - Experience with enterprise automation platforms (UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.).

 - Experience partnering directly with Product Management and Engineering organizations.

 - Consulting experience leading healthcare transformation initiatives.

 - Experience developing repeatable deployment methodologies across multiple enterprise customers.

What Makes Someone Successful

The ideal candidate is more than an implementation leader—they are a strategic builder who continuously improves both the customer experience and the product itself.

Successful Principal Deployment Strategists:

 - See patterns where others see one-off customer requests.

 - Build scalable solutions instead of custom fixes.

 - Influence executives through credibility rather than authority.

 - Thrive in ambiguity and move quickly from idea to implementation.

 - Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

 - Raise the bar for the entire deployment organization through mentorship, frameworks, and thought leadership.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
