jobs.title: F&B Manager - Brooklyn
jobs.description:
Job Title: F&B Manager

Location: Greenpoint, Brooklyn

Reports to: General Manager

The Lighthouse is a first-of-its-kind campus for creators and their teams, with locations in Venice, CA, and Brooklyn, NY.

We are a studio system and creative playground designed for creators to Learn, Make, and Belong—creating a more frictionless path from idea to production to publication.

Our mission is to assemble and inspire the Creator Generation, helping creators build sustainable careers while shaping what's next for the Creator Industry. Learn more: www.thelighthouse.com.

About the role:

The Lighthouse is looking for a Food & Beverage Manager to own the full cafe and bar program at our Brooklyn campus, from the first espresso of the morning to the last pour of an evening event. Working alongside the Assistant General Manager, you’ll set the vision for our food and beverage offering, run its daily operations and own its financial performance, all while creating warm, memorable hospitality for Creators, members and guests. You’ll start by leading a small team. As our full liquor license comes online, you’ll grow that team and build a cocktail and spirits program from the ground up.

Here’s what you’ll do day to day:

• Lead, hire, schedule and develop the cafe and bar team, starting with one part-time barista and one part-time bartender. Train them on drink preparation, service standards, the Toast point-of-sale (POS) system and responsible alcohol service.

• Run daily cafe operations, including espresso drinks, drip coffee and grab-and-go food. Refresh the menu with the Assistant General Manager using seasonal offerings and member feedback.

• Oversee bar setup, service and closing. Curate the beer and wine program now, and lead the build-out of a cocktail and spirits program once the full liquor license is in place.

• Be a visible, hands-on presence during peak service. Greet members, step behind the bar or espresso machine when needed, and resolve member concerns, escalating to campus leadership when necessary.

• Manage inventory and purchasing across coffee, food, beer, wine, spirits, glassware and supplies, including ordering, receiving, par levels, stock counts and tracking waste and variances.

• Build relationships with coffee roasters, food suppliers and beverage distributors, and negotiate pricing and terms.

• Partner with the Assistant General Manager to set and manage the F&B budget, covering cost of goods, labor and pricing. Own Toast setup and the accuracy of all transactions, house accounts, member credits and end-of-shift reporting.

• Support the process to secure and launch our full liquor license, and keep the team compliant with New York State Liquor Authority rules, health codes and food safety standards.

• Plan and lead F&B for campus events and activations, from menu and staffing through setup and breakdown. Partner with the Events team and Facilities Manager to bring in extra staff for larger events.

• Work with the Hospitality, Operations and Stewarding teams to keep the bar, cafe and pantry kitchen clean, organized and up to standard.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

• 3+ years in cafe, bar or restaurant operations, including experience supervising or managing a team.

• Strong knowledge of coffee and espresso preparation, plus real depth and enthusiasm for beer, wine and spirits that you enjoy sharing with others.

• Hands-on experience managing inventory, ordering, vendor relationships and food and beverage costs.

• Comfort running daily service on a POS system, including menu setup and reconciling sales.

• A TIPS, ATAP or equivalent responsible beverage service certification, or the ability to get one within 30 days of hire. You’ll also need an NYC Food Protection Certificate, or the ability to get one within 60 days of hire.

• Exceptional hospitality, communication and leadership skills. You set clear standards, coach people well and lead by example.

• Comfort with the physical side of the role, including long periods on your feet and lifting, pushing or pulling up to 30 lbs.

• A passion for building a space where Creators feel welcome and inspired.

This full-time, on-site role is based at The Lighthouse in Brooklyn, NY. You’ll work a standard 40-hour week on campus during operating hours, with the flexibility to occasionally shift your schedule for evening and weekend events. You’ll be at the heart of a creative campus, working alongside Creators, members and the teams who make The Lighthouse feel like home.

The salary range for this role is $70,000 - $75,000 and serves as a general guideline for the potential compensation. The final salary offer will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of factors such as the candidate’s experience, expertise, alignment with the position’s requirements, and, ultimately budget approvals.

The Perks:

The Lighthouse provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments and experiences so employees can work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs:

• Medical, Dental, Vision

• PTO + Sick Time

• HSA, FSA, and Commuter + Parking Benefits

• Company Paid Life & Disability Insurance

• Voluntary Life Insurance Policy

• Voluntary Hospital and Critical Illness Insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• 401k with Employer Matching. No Vesting Period.

Our values:

At The Lighthouse, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement, it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers.

The Lighthouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Equal opportunity extends to all aspects of the employment relationship, including hiring, promotions, training, working conditions, compensation, and benefits.

jobs.title: LNG Pipeline Engineer (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LNG PROCESS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

We are seeking an experienced engineer to join SpaceX to support methane liquefaction infrastructure build, as well as natural gas pipeline design projects. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of process fundamentals and project management skills to make high-level technical decisions, coordinate cross-functional efforts, and drive projects to completion in a timely, safe, and efficient manner.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide engineering and project management support for methane liquefaction systems and natural gas pipeline installations

• Coordinate with internal multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders to align on high-level technical decisions

• Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firms on the design and build of natural gas pipeline and methane liquefaction infrastructure

• Manage relationships with third-party contractors and vendors for core equipment (e.g., compressors, heat exchangers, cryogenic systems), ensuring deliverables meet quality, safety, and performance standards

• Oversee project execution from concept to commissioning, conducting regular progress reviews, site visits, and adjustments to maintain schedule, safety, and efficiency

• Apply fundamental knowledge of liquefaction processes to optimize design and evaluate contractor proposals

• Ensure all activities adhere to safety protocols, environmental standards, and best practices for timely project delivery

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in chemical, mechanical, or petroleum engineering

• 3+ years of relevant experience in liquefied natural gas (LNG) processing, cryogenics, or the natural gas industry

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong understanding of process fundamentals: cryogenic thermodynamics, heat exchangers, compressors, and expanders

• Hands-on experience with LNG plant operations and liquefaction systems

• Familiarity with process simulation tools (e.g., Aspen, HYSYS, ProMax)

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and with 3rd party vendors

• Knowledge of applicable codes and standards for LNG and pipeline design

• Familiarity with renewable or alternative energy applications

• Prior work in fast-paced, innovative environments, such as energy startups or industrial gas sectors

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Occasionally exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments - heat, cold, rain

• Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Must be willing to travel to other launch sites in support of build and operational activities and launches; travel requirement is up to 15%

• Availability to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility is required

• Stand: Up to 6 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 6 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 3 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 25 lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 1 hour per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 3 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 3 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees for 6 hours or more per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. If you're a leader who thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment and has a passion for shaping the future of storage technology, we'd love to hear from you!




Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Dyna Robotics builds general-purpose robots powered by a proprietary embodied AI foundation model with top-in-industry generalization and real-world performance. Already deployed with customers across multiple industries, our robots do commercial-grade work in the physical world. Our team comes from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Cruise, and we're backed by CRV, First Round, and other leading investors.



As a Technical Recruiter at Dyna Robotics, you’ll help build the team behind the next generation of humanoid robots. A company is only as strong as the people behind it, and your goal isn’t just to fill seats. It’s to build a high-performing community of innovators who are excited to bring general-purpose robotics to the world.



What You’ll Do

 - Be the face of Dyna: Be the first point of contact for top talent. Share our mission and make sure every candidate leaves inspired, whatever the outcome.

 - Run full-cycle recruiting: Manage the process from first conversation to signed offer, balancing headcount growth with a high talent bar.

 - Partner with engineering leads: Understand each team’s needs and act as a trusted advisor on what to look for and how to find it.

 - Build the pipeline: Source “hidden gem” candidates who aren’t actively looking but are a great fit for our mission.

 - Own the candidate experience: Be the candidate’s guide and advocate, and keep the process fast, transparent, and human.

 - Refine the craft: Look for ways to make our hiring process more inclusive, efficient, and reflective of our fast-moving culture.



Who You Are

 - Experienced: 4+ years in technical recruiting, with a focus on relationships over keyword matching

 - Proactive: You source and strategize rather than waiting for resumes, and you know how to compete for talent against other startups

 - A clear communicator: You make complex ideas accessible and are comfortable coaching hiring managers and giving honest feedback

 - Mission-driven: You’re genuinely excited about robotics, and candidates can tell

 - Adaptive: You’re organized, flexible, and comfortable with the pace of a startup



Bonus Points

 - Experience scaling teams at a fast-growing hardware or AI company

 - Experience leading diversity and inclusion initiatives in hiring

 - A “no task too small” attitude



At Dyna Robotics, we build technology for the real world, which requires a team as diverse as the environments our robots inhabit. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to technical rigor and mutual respect.

Don’t let a checklist stop you. Data shows that underrepresented groups often only apply if they meet 100% of the criteria. We value problem-solving and grit over keyword matching. If you’re passionate about robotics, no matter your discipline, we want to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

• Coordinate the care for select participants with highest level of complexity, including those in the hospital, ER, and skilled facility, with the appropriate clinical team members to ensure seamless transitions of care, participant satisfaction, and to prevent unfavorable outcomes, inappropriate utilization of resources, and unnecessary hospitalizations

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Clean Crop Technologies, Inc. (“Clean Crop”) stops crop loss at the source, removing pathogens from seeds before they are planted, increasing yields, reducing in-field waste, and improving food safety. Clean Crop’s Clean Current technology combines electricity and food-grade gases to create cold plasma, inactivating a broad spectrum of contaminants from seed surfaces in a dry, automated, and residue-free process. We are building a dynamic team of engineers and technicians, administrators, and scientists with a passion for innovation, experimentation, pushing the envelope of what's possible, and a hunger to work at an agile start-up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk!

About Clean Crop

Clean Crop Technologies builds domestic supply chains for specialty crops. We work with growers from seed through processing to deliver food-grade products to buyers who have historically relied on imports. Our first crop, mung beans, is in commercial production, and we are expanding into additional pulses and grains.

Our commercial processing operation runs at a partner mill campus in Hennessey, Oklahoma, where we receive, clean, sort, grade and store products alongside our operating partner. Our R&D and pilot operations are in Holyoke, Massachusetts. We are a venture-backed company.

About This Role

We are looking for a Process Engineer to own the technical performance of our mung bean processing line in Hennessey. You will set and calibrate the cleaning, optical sorting and gravity equipment to each customer specification, trace yield loss and grading defects back to their cause, and run the trials that correct them. You will keep the equipment reliable through preventive maintenance and small capital projects, and design how each new pulse and grain will run on the line as we expand. You will work on site alongside our Production Manager, our QA Manager and customer partners. You will also work closely with our Product team in Massachusetts.

What you can expect from this opportunity:

Process Ownership

• Own the facility layout and equipment performance

• Set, document and maintain equipment settings for each crop and customer specification, and adjust them as incoming lots vary

• Track yield, throughput, OEE and downtime, find the causes of loss, and run the trials that improve them

• Troubleshoot off-spec product with the QA Manager, trace the cause back through the process, and put the fix in place

• Write and keep current the SOPs, work instructions and process documentation the floor team runs from

Equipment and Reliability

• Build and run the preventive maintenance program for the Hennessey equipment, and manage spare parts and service vendors

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical and controls issues on sorters, augers, elevators, bins and conveyors, and fix them or direct the fix

• Scope, justify and manage small capital projects, from equipment selection through installation and commissioning

• Bring new crops onto the line: define the process, identify equipment changes and run first production lots

• Workflow design and documentation- manage how product will move through the facility

• Facilities management- install new unit ops and vendor/contractor management

Food Safety and Site Operations

• Support SQF certification and ongoing compliance, including sanitation, traceability and audit readiness

• Lead equipment-related safety practices on site, including lockout/tagout, guarding and dust control

• Work with our operating partner at the mill on shared equipment, utilities and site improvements, including the technical scope for any changes

• Build and sustain a 5S program across the processing line and storage areas, with visual standards and regular audits that keep equipment accessible, reduce changeover time between crops and support SQF readiness

We'd love to hear from you if:

• You have 4+ years as a process, manufacturing or plant engineer in food, grain, seed, feed or another bulk solids operation

• You have hands-on experience with cleaning, sorting, milling or material handling equipment, and are comfortable working on the floor

• You use data to improve a process: you have tracked yield, throughput or OEE and can point to a change you made that moved it

• You can read mechanical and electrical drawings and troubleshoot equipment and basic controls

• You write clear SOPs and can train a floor team to follow them

• You have a degree in chemical, agricultural, biological, food or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience through a technical program and time on the plant floor

• You do well on a small team where you will often be the person who figures it out, and you know when to call a vendor or a peer who has solved it before

• You are willing to relocate to, or already live within commuting distance of, Hennessey, Oklahoma

Not required, but we'd be thrilled to see:

• Experience processing pulses, specialty grains or seed (mung beans, lentils, chickpeas, quinoa or similar)

• Optical sorter setup and calibration (Bühler, Satake, TOMRA, Key Technology or similar)

• SQF, BRCGS or other GFSI food safety program experience

• Commissioning a new line or facility

• PLC or HMI experience

Why you should consider us:

• You will own the process at our main commercial site, with direct influence on how it runs and where we invest

• You will bring new crops onto the line as the company grows, so the role keeps expanding

• You will work with a small, hands-on team that values solving the customer's problem over using a particular technology

• You will have ownership, autonomy and equity participation in an early-stage company

Compensation and Benefits:

Our salary range for this role is $85,000 to $110,000 annually, based on experience, with early-stage equity participation. Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, life and long-term disability insurance, a 401(k), and paid time off.

Clean Crop is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified candidates regardless of race, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, Veteran status, marital status, or any other protected status. If you have a special need or disability that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Direct applications only. We do not accept candidates submitted by staffing agencies or third-party recruiters.

jobs.title: SHE Engineer
jobs.description:

• 协调组织举行SHE各项会议，并记录和推进会议跟进措施落实；
• 协组SHE经理拟订SHE规章制度和操作规程；
• 负责与政府监管机构、利益相关方沟通与协调SHE相关事务；
• 分享、推动行业内外适用的SHE最佳实践的实现；
• 负责SHE相关数据的收集、统计风险和报告等；
• 及时汇报工作进度和存在问题点，按时完成个人月报、年度工作总结及计划；
• 安全文化建设：主导建设项目安全文化体系构建，制定安全文化建设实施方案。建立健全安全文化考核与激励机制，鼓励员工主动参与安全管理，提出安全合理化建议，推动安全文化落地生根。
• 上级交办的其他事项。

Education教育背景

安全/环境/食品/机械/化学等工程类专业大专或以上学历

Experience工作经历

• 参与过至少1个5000万元人民币以上规模绿地建设项目SHE管理经验；

• 油脂生产、饲料加工、化工、食品加工等行业至少3年相关工作经验。

Competency能力

1、 良好学习能力；

2、 熟悉 SHE相关法规及具备 ISO14001&45001等基本知识；

3、 熟悉绿地项目相关合规性评价的相关法规要求和办理流程；

4、 良好的组织和人际交往能力；

5、 熟悉安全操作规程的编制、监督执行，了解工艺安全管理相关制度；

6、 良好的电脑操作能力。

Languages Skills语言技能

好的英语读、写能力，具备基本听、说能力者优先 额外信息 具有国家注册安全工程师资质（中级或以上）或同等国际认证资质优先

Additional Information for the job

What We Offer

LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.

What You’ll Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree with 1+ years of experience, OR associate degree with 2+ years, OR 3+ years of professional recruiting coordination experience

 - Hands-on experience with an ATS such as Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent Dyna professionally to candidates and senior hiring managers

 - Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when screening applications



Bonus Points For

 - Interest in growing into sourcing, ATS administration, and recruiting operations

 - A systems mindset: you notice manual work and look for ways to automate or simplify it

 - Comfort with ambiguity and wearing multiple hats in a startup environment

 - Ability to prioritize, work independently, and collaborate well





At Dyna Robotics, we build technology for the real world, which requires a team as diverse as the environments our robots inhabit. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to technical rigor and mutual respect.

Don’t let a checklist stop you. Data shows that underrepresented groups often only apply if they meet 100% of the criteria. We value problem-solving and grit over keyword matching. jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer - Building Engineering
jobs.description:
AECOM’s Building Engineering team continues to experience significant growth across Australia, and we are seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our expanding team in Perth, WA.

Working alongside a highly skilled multidisciplinary team, you will play a key role in delivering innovative, technically challenging building services solutions across a diverse portfolio of projects, including aviation, healthcare, defence, education, data centres, commercial developments and transport infrastructure.

This is an exciting opportunity to take on a senior technical leadership position, drive the successful delivery of major projects, and contribute to a growing team that is shaping the future of the built environment.

How you'll make a difference:

• Lead technical delivery: Drive the design and delivery of complex electrical engineering solutions across healthcare, defence, transport, data centres, sports facilities and other major building projects, ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality and regulatory compliance.
• Provide technical leadership: Act as a senior technical authority, overseeing design reviews, providing expert guidance and ensuring the effective integration of electrical systems and installation strategies.

jobs.title: Growth Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
The Company:
 
VeSync is a portfolio company with brands that cover different categories of health & wellness products. We wouldn’t be surprised if you have one of our Levoit air purifiers in your living room or a Cosori air fryer whipping up healthy and delicious meals for you every night.
 
We’re a young and energetic company, we’ve had tremendous success, and we are constantly growing our team. As we garner more industry attention – just check out our accomplishments and awards by CES Innovation, iF Design, IGA, and Red Dot – we also need driven and talented people to join our team.
 
That brings us to you, and what you’ll be joining. Our teams are smart and diligent and take ownership of their work – they’re confident in their work but know how to collaborate with open ears and a spirit of learning. If you’re down-to-earth, approachable, and easy to strike up a conversation with, this may be a great fit for you.
 
Check out our brands:
levoit.com | cosori.com | etekcity.com
 
 
Role Overview
 
The Growth Creative Strategist is responsible for translating consumer insights, performance data, and business objectives into compelling, high-impact creative strategies across paid social, YouTube, CTV, and emerging digital channels. This role bridges creative storytelling and performance marketing to develop campaigns that drive brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, and retention.
This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, creative development, performance media, and consumer research. You will identify what motivates consumers, uncover barriers to purchase, and develop scalable creative frameworks that improve marketing efficiency and sales growth.
 
The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative thinking. You are equally comfortable diving into creative performance data, conducting consumer/competitor research, developing messaging frameworks, and partnering with Creative, Product, and Growth teams to bring ideas to life.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Growth Creative & Consumer Insights
Own the development of creative strategies that translate performance insights into scalable growth opportunities across awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention. 
Identify customer motivations, objections, purchase triggers, and category education gaps through research, reviews, testing, and performance data. 
Develop persona, messaging, and content frameworks that help consumers progress through the purchase journey. 
Partner with Product, GTM, and IMC teams to transform strategic priorities and seasonal calendars into actionable creative testing initiatives and GTM plans. 
Build a deep understanding of how consumers evaluate premium products and determine what messages, proof points, and content formats most effectively influence purchase decisions.
 
Concept Development & Creative Pipeline
Deep endemic and non endemic competitor research for inspiration on top performing hooks, angles, and formats
Own the creative concept pipeline, continuously generating new angles, narratives, hooks, formats, and educational approaches that can be tested at scale. 
Distinguish between true strategic concepts and simple asset variations, ensuring creative exploration drives meaningful learning. 
Develop detailed creative briefs that include audience insight, core message, content structure, success metrics, testing variables, and underlying hypotheses. 
Establish repeatable systems for concept management, creative taxonomy, testing prioritization, naming conventions, and knowledge sharing. 
Build and maintain a testing roadmap designed to continuously improve creative effectiveness while preventing content fatigue.
 
Performance Creative & Optimization
Partner with Growth Marketing teams to evaluate creative performance across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, Amazon, affiliate, influencer, and emerging platforms. 
Analyze creative effectiveness using engagement, hook rate, sustain rate, CTR, CVR, CAC, ROAS, and incrementality metrics. 
Identify winning themes, messaging frameworks, creators, formats, and storytelling approaches that drive meaningful business impact. 
Rapidly scale successful concepts while discontinuing underperforming creative approaches. 
Champion a culture of experimentation where creative decisions are informed by data, consumer behavior, and testing outcomes.
 
Creator & Content Ecosystem
 
Partner with creators, influencers, agencies, production partners, and internal creative teams to bring concepts to life efficiently and at scale. 
Develop creator strategies and briefing frameworks that balance authenticity, platform best practices, and business objectives. 
Ensure content production pipelines remain ahead of media demand and creative fatigue. Identify opportunities to leverage customer stories, testimonials, reviews, expert validation, and user-generated content throughout the customer journey.
 
Full-Funnel Learning & Content Reuse
 
Build systems that capture creative learnings and apply them across paid media, ecommerce, lifecycle marketing, social content, retail marketing, and product launches. 
Translate winning advertising concepts into broader consumer communication strategies. 
Partner with Ecommerce and Lifecycle teams to extend successful messages across landing pages, PDPs, email programs, SMS journeys, and retention campaigns. 
Develop playbooks that help the organization understand what creative approaches are working, why they work, and how to scale them.
 
Qualifications:
 
Experience: 7 years performance creative, direct response, or paid social for consumer (B2C) brands, with hands-on direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience. Titles vary in this space. What matters is that you have run the loop: research, hypothesis, brief, production, test, and iterate.
Platform Fluency: Deep working knowledge of how creative performs on Meta and why. This starts on Meta and expands across channels, so full-channel experience is a necessary.
Analytical: Deep experience working with creative analytics platforms like Motion, Foreplay, or Atri. Reads creative performance honestly and uses it to decide what gets made next. Comfortable killing their own ideas.
Angles, Not Variations: Can show concepts you personally wrote, the brief behind each, and what the numbers did. Knows the difference between a new angle and a new edit.
Comfortable with Ambiguity: Can build while the brand, the positioning, and the claims framework are still being settled. Starts from a CAC target and a hypothesis rather than waiting for an account with history.
Claims & Regulatory Fluency: Experience in health, wellness, medical device, supplements, or a similarly regulated space. Knows how to write a strong hook that survives review.
Bonus Qualification: Demonstrated ability to rapidly prototype ideas through rough creative concepts, mockups, simple edits, or creator-style content to accelerate testing, learning, and iteration before full production investment.

Preferred Background 
Experience in consumer technology, home appliances, or health & wellness categories.

Starting Salary:  106K.
 
 
Why Join VeSync
Lead two category‑leading brands with strong consumer loyalty and momentum 
Own one of the most critical growth engines for the US business 
Partner with world‑class product, engineering, and marketing teams 
Opportunity to shape the future of DTC at scale within a global organization

jobs.title: IT Services Technician
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

IT SERVICES TECHNICIAN

Our IT Services team is the backbone of our operational efficiency, ensuring seamless connectivity and technical assistance for all our employees, regardless of their location. We are seeking a skilled and helpful IT specialist to join our IT services team. This role provides advanced technical guidance and service to end-users, resolves complex IT issues, and collaborates with Level 1 technicians and senior IT staff to ensure seamless technology operations. The ideal candidate is a problem-solver with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service. This is a full-time position, onsite five days a week in Palo Alto, California with occasional on-call or after-hours support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide second-line technical assistance for hardware, software, and network issues via phone, email, or in-person

• Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems, including system crashes, network connectivity issues, and software conflicts

• Manage and administer user accounts, permissions, and access controls in systems like Active Directory

• Assist with the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of hardware (desktops, laptops, servers, and peripherals) and software applications

• Monitor and maintain IT systems, including performing patch management, updates, and basic server administration

• Document and update IT service tickets with detailed resolutions and escalate unresolved issues to Level 3 experts or specialized teams

• Contribute to and maintain IT knowledge base articles and self-service wikis to enhance user self-sufficiency

• Support IT projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, or new technology rollouts

• Train and mentor Level 1 technicians, providing guidance on troubleshooting techniques and best practices

• Ensure compliance with company IT policies, security standards, and data protection protocols

• Provide new hire onboarding and offboarding service support

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 2+ years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, desktop support, field service, or hands-on technical role (e.g., NOC technician, systems support, IT technician)

• Knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems and Microsoft Office Suite

• Experience with IT service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) and ticketing systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a STEM field; equivalent experience considered

• Proficiency in troubleshooting network issues (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs) and basic server administration (Windows Server, Linux basics)

• Familiarity with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V) and cloud services (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365)

• Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Certified Professional, or ITIL)

• Experience with scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) for automation tasks

• Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and tools (e.g., antivirus, endpoint protection)

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure

• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and customer service skills

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$39 - $49 USD per hour

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Underwriting Regional Leader - West
jobs.location: Remote (US); Remote - West; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About At-Bay

At-Bay is the world’s first InsurSec provider designed from the ground up to help businesses tackle cyber risk head on. By combining industry-leading insurance with world-class cybersecurity technology, At-Bay offers end-to-end prevention and protection for the digital age. With 98% of cyber insurance claims in the past five years coming from small and mid-size businesses with revenue under $2B, providing an integrated solution to help manage risk is more critical than ever.

At-Bay helps its 35,000+ customers close their security technology and skills gap — all through their cyber insurance policy — making them less likely to be hit with a ransomware attack. As a full-stack insurance company, At-Bay offers multiple lines of specialty insurance, including Cyber, Tech E&O, and Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL) policies.

Job Summary

As an Underwriting Leader at At-Bay, you will be a pivotal player in our mission to transform the landscape in specialty lines insurance. In this role, you’ll own and be responsible for regional production and profitability goals for your team via our wholesale channel, managing a team of underwriters ensuring they meet their performance metrics. In addition, you must identify, establish and cultivate strong relationships with national brokerages, ensuring the effective distribution of our specialized insurance products in these higher revenue areas. This role reports to the Head of Middle Market and will regularly collaborate cross functionally with core internal stakeholders in our Underwriting, Insurance Operations, Insurance Product, Distribution, and Partnerships on strategic initiatives.  You will drive growth, foster collaboration, and enhance our brand presence in the market.

Key responsibilities:

• Responsible for owning the strategy for profitable growth with new business and renewal business in your region for wholesale to achieve profitable premium and rate goals. You’ll partner with our Tech/Cyber product leader, President, Business Development and Retail teams to execute the annual regional business plan and successfully deliver results consistent with our portfolio strategy.

• Responsible for delivering excellence in underwriting – at both an individual and regional leadership perspective.

• Lead and execute the regional and local adaptation of national underwriting, product segment, broker engagement strategies.

• Manage, coach, and create a talent pipeline for underwriters within the region.

• Develop and strengthen institutional relationships with key regional broker partners to achieve revenue objectives and unlock significant growth opportunities in collaboration with regional Business Development leads.

• Systematically gather and share market intelligence and pipeline insights to provide strategic analysis and identify priority targets for go-to-market engagement in collaboration with regional Business Development lead.

• Regularly institutionalize market intelligence and pipeline opportunities to proactively identify key targets for further GTM engagement in collaboration with regional Business Development lead and regional security sales team

• Manage and evaluate various KPIs to assess individual and team performance across regional, broker management, and underwriting performance.

• Promote the company's unique InsurSec expertise by participating in industry conferences and events while regularly conducting and taking leadership roles in client and broker meetings to educate on evolving cyber risk.

• Serve as a liaison to technology, security, marketing, and data teams to enhance the underwriting process and go-to-market strategy

• Embody and promote At-Bay company values as a leader within your region.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field

• 8-10 years of experience in Cyber and Tech E&O Underwriting including product development or portfolio management.

• Previous management experience preferred. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3 years of prior management experience.

• Previous experience in and qualified in handling large and complex risk segments.

• A proven track record of successfully building and nurturing broker partnerships on a national and local level.

• Comprehensive knowledge of commercial lines insurance products and risk management.

• Willingness and ability to travel regionally as required, up to 50%.

Work Arrangement: Remote or Hybrid

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.



The Opportunity:

From our entry into the Colorado market in 2022 we have grown our footprint to represent over 1,000 families on the Front Range, and are excited to continue that growth through developing and leveraging key relationships across the home care continuum. We’re hiring for a Strategic Partnerships leader to position Abby Care within the case management community, with the mission of building, owning, and scaling Abby’s relationships with case management professionals and organizations. Using a highly consultative, relationship-driven approach, you will help case management agencies fundamentally understand the Abby Care value proposition - how we enable caregivers to provide better quality care resulting in better patient outcomes - and leverage this knowledge to improve referral pipelines and help solve their placement challenges through trust and confidence in our model.

Mission-driven, you are adept at connecting your work to Abby Care’s goal of improving access to high quality home care. Developing relationships that result in impact resonates with you - trust and transparency are your calling cards. Self-directed, you are comfortable setting and achieving goals that move the mission forward. Growth-minded, you find professional satisfaction in creating the connections that will positively impact all your stakeholders. If you are excited about joining a growth-stage organization that cares deeply about improving care in our communities and serving at-need populations, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a Full-Time Remote opportunity based in the state of Colorado with anticipated travel to partners in the market.



What you’ll work on:

 - Build & Own Relationships: Grow, foster and manage relationships with case management agencies on the front range, supporting these partnerships from outreach, discovery and referral management.

 - Execute Market-Specific Strategies: Target, map, and build deep relationships directly with key stakeholders and decision makers in independent Case Management Agencies (CMAs).

 - Consultative Education: Educate and socialize exactly who fits our programs, how to initiate a referral effortlessly, and why Abby Care delivers the best outcomes for the families they manage.

 - Drive Targeted Referral Volume: Help us exceed our ambitious growth targets by opening new relationships with the leadership at CMAs. Part of your total compensation will be based on the success of the relationships you build.

 - Field-Based Activity: Prioritize face-to-face meetings, community networking, and regular check-ins over office time.

 - Relationship Management: Rigorously track all partner interactions, account statuses, and referral conversion metrics in our CRM.
   
   

What you’ll have:

 - 4+ years of field based relationship or business development experience, ideally within the CO CMA landscape, with a deep understanding of Medicaid, disability services, or home-based care space.

 - Familiarity with Colorado's CMA landscape. You know how Case Management Agencies operate, how case managers think and what they need to confidently place a client.

 - A consultative edge that sets you apart. You'll become the go-to expert case managers call first, not just another vendor in their inbox.
   
   


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work.

 - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

 - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

 - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

 - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.






OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description:
Axogen is committed to building and maintaining a strong and gratifying company culture that fosters professional growth. Our hands-on and personal approach makes transitioning to a new job a seamless and enjoyable process. Most benefits are effective on day one!

Axogen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Why you’ll love working at Axogen:

• Friendly, open, and fun team culture that values unique perspectives

• Company-wide dedication to profoundly impacting patients’ lives

• Comprehensive, high-quality benefits package effective on date of hire

• Educational assistance available for all employees

• Matching 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays, including floating holidays, to be used at your discretion

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Referral incentive program

Axogen Mission and Business Purpose

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by making restoration of peripheral nerve function an expected standard of care. We aim to lead the markets we serve by always requiring the solutions we offer patients and caregivers provide an improved benefit-to-risk profile as compared to existing standards of care. To ensure we deliver improved benefit-to-risk solutions, we will guide and expect the market and design requirement specifications underlying our engineering, business development, and clinical research activities, objectively target advancements in standards of care.

Job Summary of the Construction Delivery Lead - GMP Facilities & Projects

The Sr. Construction Engineer is responsible for coordinating and overseeing capital construction projects to ensure they are executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable codes, regulations, GMP requirements, and quality standards. This position serves as a technical resource during all phases of construction, collaborating with project managers, contractors, architects, engineers, operations, quality, EH&S, and facility teams to resolve engineering and construction challenges while ensuring successful project delivery.

Requirements of the Construction Delivery Lead - GMP Facilities & Projects

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction engineering, construction management, or a related engineering discipline.

• Minimum of 5 years of construction engineering, project engineering, or related experience preferably in a regulated industry such as medical devices, biologics, tissue-based products, or pharmaceuticals.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects of varying size, complexity, and lifecycle stage.

• Knowledge of design and construction process and methods, materials, engineering principles, and project management practices.

• Knowledge of GMP regulations, commissioning and qualification practices, and change management processes within regulated manufacturing environments.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.

• Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office).

• Experience with engineering and construction software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Primavera P6, Bluebeam

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

• OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification (preferred).

• Physical Requirements:

• Ability to walk, stand, climb ladders, and navigate active construction sites for extended periods.

• Ability to perform field inspections in various weather conditions.

• Capability to bend, kneel, crouch, and access confined or elevated work areas when required.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally.

• Visual acuity sufficient to review construction drawings, inspect work quality, and operate standard office equipment.

• Ability to travel between project sites as required.

Responsibilities of the Construction Delivery Lead - GMP Facilities & Projects

The specific duties of the Sr. Construction Engineer include but are not limited to:

• Provide engineering support for capital construction projects from conceptual planning through commissioning and project closeout.

• Review project designs, drawings, specifications, and construction documents for accuracy, constructability, GMP compliance, potential utility impacts, and adherence to applicable engineering standards

• Identify impacts to facility utilities and coordinate with facility maintenance team to develop and execute required modifications, outages, and mitigation plans.

• Collaborate with project managers, architects, contractors, subcontractors, Operations, Quality, EH&S, and regulatory agencies to define project requirements, scope, schedules, and execution strategies.

• Support change control processes, impact assessments, and documentation associated with facility modifications in regulated manufacturing environments.

• Coordinate construction activities within active manufacturing environments while minimizing operational disruptions and maintaining compliance with quality and regulatory standards.

• Monitor project scope, schedule, budget and resource; communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders.

• Conduct site inspections to verify work quality, safety compliance, and adherence to approved designs and specifications; identify and resolve technical issues, construction conflicts, and field design changes.

• Prepare and manage engineering documentation, RFIs, submittals, design revisions, and construction records.

• Support procurement activities through review of material specifications and evaluating contractor proposals.

• Ensure construction activities and methods comply with GMP requirements, local, state, and federal codes, environmental regulations, and applicable site safety and quality procedures.

• Promote a culture of safety, quality, operational excellence and continuous improvement across all project activities.

Working & Environmental Conditions

• Combination of office and field-based work environments.

• Regular exposure to active construction sites, including varying weather conditions, dust, noise, and uneven terrain.

• Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, and high-visibility clothing.

• Occasional evening, weekend, or extended work hours may be required to support project schedules and deadlines.

• Compliance with all company safety policies, site-specific requirements, and applicable regulatory standards is mandatory.

#LI-AC1

Benefits offered for this position include Health, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Paid Time Off, 9 Paid Holidays + 3 Floating Holidays, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Medical Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Caregiver Leave, Basic Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Disability Insurance, as described in more detail in summary plan descriptions.

$115,000—$130,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.



 


THE ROLE:

You'll be one of two infrastructure and reliability specialists on the Data Replication team, a full-stack product team running millions of sync jobs a week that power thousands of data use cases across multiple regions and clouds. You'll build and maintain the infrastructure, set reliability standards, drive down incidents, and make it easier and safer for engineers to ship. 

Expect to spend roughly 30 to 50% of your time in backend application code, and the rest on infrastructure and reliability. When the fix belongs in the application, you'll ship it there yourself, and you'll build features alongside product engineers. We believe every abstraction leaks, so the best engineers work up and down the stack. You're equally comfortable in a Terraform file, a Kubernetes cluster, a service's codebase, and a postmortem doc. And with two of you in the room, we want someone who will challenge a design, not just implement it.

We expect engineers here to actively use AI as a force multiplier: agentic tools to automate toil, augment incident response, and build smarter internal tooling. If you're not already doing this, you should be excited to start. We care as much about how you work as what you build. Trust, directness, and craftsmanship matter here.




 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the infrastructure underpinning the Data Replication platform: Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, networking, and cloud resource configuration across AWS and GCP.

 - Work across the stack: ship backend features and fixes in application code alongside product engineers, not just the infrastructure underneath them.

 - Improve performance and efficiency at scale, from bursty job scheduling to right-sizing compute.

 - Help us ship safely into customer-managed environments, where Airbyte runs in infrastructure we don't control.

 - Evolve observability, alerting, and anomaly detection, with an eye toward LLM automation.

 - Build AI-augmented release and internal tooling: canary deployments, progressive rollouts, automated release qualification, and rollback automation.

 - Set the infrastructure bar for the team: build self-serve tooling, write runbooks, and coach engineers to own more of their stack.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 7+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps.

 - Hands-on ownership of Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform in production environments.

 - Deep experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) and on-call operations.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipeline ownership and developer tooling.

 - Experience shipping changes to backend services in Go, Java, Kotlin, or Python, not only infrastructure code, and the appetite to do more of it.

 - Strong design judgment, and the confidence to challenge infrastructure decisions with data.

 - Fluency with AI tools: LLMs and agentic frameworks to automate, debug faster, and reduce toil.

 - A startup-ready mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and owning problems end to end.

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Data pipelines, replication systems, or ETL/ELT platforms.

 - Control plane / data plane architectures or internal developer platforms.

 - Shipping software customers run in their own environments (Helm charts, upgrade paths, varied configurations).

 - Experience with Airbyte, CDKs, or connector-based architectures.


LOCATION:

 - Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:



• Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
 • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents
 • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
 • 401(k) retirement plan
 • Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
 • Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 •  Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office
 • A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!



We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.


THE ROLE:

Airbyte is incubating new product opportunities at the intersection of data, AI, and developer infrastructure. Our small team builds tooling and infrastructure for data practitioners and software engineers, leveraging Airbyte's foundation in enterprise connectivity.

This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We're looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI applications or infrastructure. You'll own technical explorations, build prototypes, and take promising ideas through to production.

We're still early. Some of our work extends existing products, while other projects begin as hypotheses that need validation. There's significant room to influence technical direction, challenge assumptions, and help shape what we build next.






WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Airbyte MCP: Build infrastructure that lets AI agents configure Airbyte, troubleshoot syncs, and access data directly from connected sources and warehouses. Design reliable, secure, and observable interfaces across the connector ecosystem.

 - Semantic Search & Retrieval: Build and operate search infrastructure for high-quality retrieval over enterprise data. Improve relevance, latency, and reliability in production.

 - Semantic Models: Develop systems for defining and maintaining semantic models over enterprise data. Help AI applications use consistent business definitions and produce answers that can be verified against underlying data.

 - SaaS Sandbox: Build realistic, stateful replicas of SaaS systems for developing and testing agents. Reproduce API behavior, failures, and state changes so workflows can be evaluated without using production accounts.


EXPLORE NEW PRODUCT OPPORTUNITIES

 - Turn product hypotheses into focused technical experiments. Build prototypes that test feasibility and expose important constraints.

 - Work directly with customers, Product, Design, and customer-facing teams to understand real-world problems and incorporate feedback into technical decisions.

 - Evaluate competing technical approaches and use what you learn to influence product direction.


BUILD PRODUCTION-GRADE INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Design and implement backend systems, APIs, and infrastructure for AI, data, and developer products.

 - Build reliable, observable systems with clear failure handling, debugging, and operational safeguards.

 - Take promising prototypes into production and improve them based on usage, incidents, and customer feedback.


LEAD TECHNICAL DIRECTION

 - Own architecture and execution across technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Lead technical decisions that span teams. Align interfaces and dependencies, and influence architecture beyond your immediate projects.

 - Communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly, and follow through on commitments.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has shipped AI-powered products.

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems.

 - Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution.

 - Hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered products using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction across teams and influence architectural and engineering decisions.

 - Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality.

 - Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 environments.

 - Exceptional written communication skills.

 - A strong bias toward ownership and shipping.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building and operating AI agents in production, including debugging, observability, and evaluation.

 - Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems.

 - Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or semantic models.

 - Experience building developer tools, platform infrastructure, or integrations with third-party SaaS APIs.

 - Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success is not measured by the number of prototypes we build. It is measured by whether we turn promising ideas into products customers use and infrastructure they can depend on.

You'll help us:

 - Take new ideas from prototype to production and improve them through customer feedback and real-world usage.

 - Build reliable, observable systems that are easier to operate, debug, and improve over time.

 - Use technical experiments and engineering judgment to make better product and architecture decisions.

 - Lead technical decisions that make systems simpler, more reliable, and easier for other teams to build on.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

AI agents work impressively in demos. Making them reliable in production is much harder.

The difficult problems are often not the model itself. They are retrieving the right context, connecting to real enterprise systems, maintaining permissions, coordinating multiple actions, recovering from failures, and determining whether an answer can actually be trusted.

Airbyte already connects to hundreds of business systems. We’re building the runtime that allows agents to use that infrastructure intelligently and safely.

If we succeed, developers will not need to rebuild orchestration, retrieval, permissions, evaluation, and enterprise connectivity every time they build a new agent.






LOCATION

 - Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:



• Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
 • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents

 • 401(k) retirement plan
 • Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
 • Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 •  Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office
 • A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models. We seek people who share our passion for real-time computer graphics and commitment to our mission of helping make our Nation’s pilots safer. We will give you a chance to work with some of the most talented people in the graphics industry.

The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted partner to the General Manager of Aechelon Technology and as a bi-directional conduit of key information between the General Manager, Aechelon employees, functional teams, and Shield.

The primary focus of the role is to help implement, align and disseminate business strategy and operational priorities across Aechelon by ensuring information is communicated clearly, translated into action, and supported by a consistent feedback loop back to the General Manager. The Chief of Staff helps the General Manager stay connected to what is happening across the organization while ensuring employees and teams have the context they need to execute effectively.

This role is intentionally relationship-driven. It will require deep knowledge of Aechelon and its business strategy, trusted relationships with employees and managers, and the ability to connect information across functions. The Chief of Staff is not expected to personally own every operational task; rather, the role creates clarity, connects the right people, drives follow-through, and escalates issues when needed.

Core Responsibilities

Strategy Communication & Feedback

• Serve as a conduit for the General Manager's business strategy, priorities, decisions, and operational information across Aechelon.

• Translate high-level priorities into clear communication and actionable next steps for the appropriate teams.

• Maintain a reliable feedback loop so operational realities, employee perspectives, questions, and concerns flow back to the General Manager.

• Identify disconnects between strategic intent and day-to-day execution and help bring the right people together to resolve them.

General Manager Partnership

• Maintain visibility into key organizational priorities, decisions, commitments, and issues requiring the General Manager's attention.

• Provide organizational context and candid perspective to support informed decision-making.

• Help determine what should be escalated to the General Manager, what can be resolved through coordination, and what can be delegated to the appropriate function.

• Support selected special projects and time-sensitive priorities on behalf of the General Manager.

Employee Connection & Organizational Pulse

• Continue to establish a connection between Shield and all levels of the Aechelon team in regard to values, culture and mission as we integrate.

• Maintain a visible, approachable, and trusted connection with Aechelon employees and managers.

• Help employees navigate organizational questions and connect them with the appropriate People/HR, functional, or Shield resources.

• Surface meaningful employee themes, recurring friction points, and organizational needs while maintaining confidentiality and appropriate boundaries.

• Help preserve Aechelon's culture, relationships, and sense of community as integration with Shield continues.

Cross-Functional & Shield Coordination

• Connect Aechelon and Shield teams when initiatives, decisions, or issues cross organizational boundaries.

• Clarify ownership when responsibilities are unclear and ensure the right people are included in the conversation.

• Maintain appropriate visibility into significant people, headcount, operational, and integration matters affecting Aechelon.

• Help prevent important information and action items from becoming fragmented across teams, systems, or communication channels.

• Ensure that Aechelon team members feel a valued part of the Shield team.

Scope & Working Model

The Chief of Staff is an organizational connector and force multiplier for the General Manager. The role is accountable for helping priorities move forward, but it is not intended to absorb the day-to-day responsibilities of every function.

• Own: coordination, communication, follow-through, organizational visibility, and selected priorities delegated by the General Manager.

• Partner: with teams on matters within their areas of responsibility.

• Escalate: issues requiring executive direction, business decisions, or intervention from the General Manager.

• Preserve: the employee-facing relationships and institutional knowledge that help Aechelon remain connected and effective during integration.

Qualifications & Attributes

• Ability to gain both deep knowledge of the Shield culture and mission as well as of Aechelon, its products, customers, people, culture and process,

• Establish credibility and trusted relationships across multiple levels and functions of the organization.

• Strong judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and ability to handle sensitive matters appropriately.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex or ambiguous information into clear direction.

• Strong organizational skills, follow-through, and ability to influence outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced evolving environment where responsibilities and processes may still be taking shape.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a strong two-way connection between the General Manager and the Aechelon organization: strategy and operational direction move clearly across the team, execution stays visible, and useful feedback returns to the General Manager.

Employees and managers gain a trusted connection point who understands both Shield and Aechelon and can help them navigate the broader organization. Functional teams have clearer ownership and better coordination, and Shield has a knowledgeable partner who can provide Aechelon-specific context when needed.

Ultimately, the Chief of Staff allows  Aechelon to execute on its strategy by being more connected, coordinated, and effective without becoming the default owner of every task or issue that crosses functions.

Compensation and Benefits

$144,320 - $216,480 per year

The above range is specific to CALIFORNIA and may not be applicable to other locations. Final compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

We offer a very attractive compensation package including competitive base salary, company performance-based profit sharing, 401k, 100% employer paid health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, std, ltd, and life insurance plans).

No relocation reimbursement provided.

For more information about our company, please visit www.shield.ai.

This position description is not intended to be a complete listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee holding this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may be changed or others may be assigned at any time by the Company with notice to the employee.

Shield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing access and opportunities to individuals with disabilities. If you are an applicant who is unable to fully utilize/access our application process because of a disability, Aechelon Technology will provide a reasonable accommodation. Please send an email to dl-aechelon_hr-team@shield.ai to request that accommodation, and please be sure to include a detailed description of your requested accommodation, your name and preferred method of contact.

jobs.title: Developmental Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

As our programs scale, so does the need for disciplined, repeatable developmental testing. We are seeking a Developmental Test Engineer to plan and execute ground-based developmental tests that mature our designs, identify design deficiencies early, and reduce technical risk before systems enter flight test.

This role is hands-on and execution-focused, supporting component, subsystem, and system-level testing of advanced counter-UAS and missile systems for U.S. Department of Defense programs. The Developmental Test Engineer works closely with design engineering to turn test data into design improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop test plans and procedures for component, subsystem, and system-level developmental testing across functional, structural, dynamic, and environmental domains.

• Design and build test setups, including fixtures, harnessing, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems.

• Execute tests safely and efficiently in the lab and at external test facilities.

• Reduce and analyze test data; identify design deficiencies, failure modes, and performance margins.

• Investigate anomalies and failures, support root cause analysis, and recommend design changes.

• Partner with design and systems engineering to translate requirements and risks into executable test campaigns.

• Author test reports and present findings and residual risk to engineering and program stakeholders.

• Support Test Readiness Reviews (TRR) and maintain test configuration and data integrity.

• Help evolve test infrastructure, tooling, instrumentation, and automation capabilities.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience in developmental, qualification, or laboratory testing of aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability hardware.

• Skills:

• Hands-on experience with test instrumentation (strain gauges, accelerometers, load cells, thermocouples, pressure transducers).

• Experience with data acquisition systems and software (e.g., NI/LabVIEW, DEWESoft).

• Programming or scripting for data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB).

• Solid understanding of both mechanical and electrical systems.

• Strong technical writing and communication skills.

• U.S. Person status required due to export control regulations.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with MIL-STD-810 environmental testing (vibration, shock, thermal).

• Experience testing missile systems, guided munitions, or UAS.

• Experience with test automation and test fixture design.
