jobs.title: Business Development Director - Civil & Commercial
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

Rocket Lab’s Business Development team is responsible for connecting customers across government and commercial sectors with our industry leading mission solutions spanning launch and space systems. They work closely with new and existing customers to understand their needs and develop tailored solutions to deliver their missions. Building and maintaining relationships with customers and internally with engineering and operations teams is at the core of our Business Development team. They have their fingers on the pulse of the space industry and are driven to deliver results for our customers and our business.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR – CIVIL & COMMERCIAL

Based at Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA, as the Business Development Director, you will drive Rocket Lab’s growth in the satellite market. You will work with a range of customers, but primarily focused on civil and commercial opportunities such as government civil space agencies, research institutions, Earth observation, and technology companies. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for civil and commercial applications

• Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large commercial or civil space contracts,

• Engage with key customer stakeholders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab’s solutions align with their evolving needs

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business

• Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies

• Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities

• Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab’s capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements

• Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business

• Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders

• Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences and customer meetings

• Travel as needed for business opportunities

• Other duties as assigned or required

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical discipline

• 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace sector

• In-depth knowledge of commercial acquisition processes, government contracting, and the commercial space landscape

• Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace industry

• Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

• Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Master’s degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business

• Specialization in civil and commercial business development

• Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms

• Extensive awareness of current/ongoing commercial space satellite programs

• Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

• Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects

• Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project

• General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements

• Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software

• Experience with proposal development, writing, and best practice capture processes, and ability to independently complete cost and technical proposals

• Experience working with subject matter experts to collect and create compelling proposal content and detailed responses

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base Pay Range (CA Only)

$187,000—$280,000 USD

jobs.title: Assistant Manager(08019) - 2720 John Hayes Suite F601
jobs.description:
JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress,meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Additional Job Details Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Job Description

ABOUT THE JOB
You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.
Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
Prepare product.
Receive and process telephone orders.
Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.
Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
Must be able to make correct monetary change.
Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

TEMPERAMENTS
The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.
Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance. Additional Job Details Stooping/Bending Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients. Crouching/Squatting Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas. Reaching Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

jobs.title: Dishwasher (06840) - 5001 US-277
jobs.description:
Domino’s dishwashers are dedicated and organized people who enjoy working as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. The Dishwasher’s duties include gathering and removing soiled dishware from the Kitchen area, washing them thoroughly, making sure they are dry and putting them away in their proper place. They may also restock items, unload delivery trucks, assist in maintaining the Lobby area, clean appliances and machines, empty and clean trash receptacles, and other duties, as needed.

To be successful as a Dishwasher, you should be a committed, communicative team player with excellent time management skills. You should be able to prioritize tasks in a busy setting and adhere to all food safety regulations and procedures.

Dishwasher Responsibilities:

• Ensuring the availability of clean dishes by collecting all soiled prep tubs, pans, utensils and other cookware from the kitchen washing and storing clean and dry.
• Preparing dining areas and kitchen for next shift by cleaning and restocking cook stations.
• Cleaning machines and appliances used in the kitchen, such as ovens, makeline, cut table etc.
• Keeping dish pit area clean and organized.
• Assisting with unloading and storing deliveries.
• Sweeping and mopping floors, especially when items are spilled.
• Taking out the trash and rinsing garbage cans.
• Supporting other restaurant staff members by assisting with other tasks, as needed.
• Reporting kitchen accidents or violations of food safety codes and procedures.
• Making sure dining area is ready for the day at open, at close and during hours of operation.
• Setting up kitchen line for readiness before rushes.
• Setting back up kitchen at close for next business day.

Dishwasher Requirements:

• Minimal work experience.
• Strong problem solving and communication skills.
• Exceptional time management skills.
• Ability to stand or walk for 8-10 hour shifts and lift at least 30 pounds.
• Shows pride in work
• Willingness to comply with all food safety procedures.
• Texas Certified Food Handlers Certificate required.

Education and Experience

A high school diploma or equivalent degree is a plus but not required. Candidates for this position do not need prior experience as relevant training is provided on the job in order to learn employer-specific functions such as how to operate the computer system and to learn about cleaning chemicals and washing procedures. Communication skills and a positive attitude is a must!

Work Environment

A Domino’s Dishwasher will handle a large amount of kitchen cookware and dishes. Sharp objects are to be handled washed and stored in a safe manner. The environment is warm, bustling, and potentially noisy. The specific dish pit area will be wet and can be a slipping hazard. The environment of a Domino’s restaurant is populated by triple stack conveyor belt ovens, multiple warming shelves and carts on wheels which can lead to injury.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

· Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

· During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

· During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

· Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

· Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

· Deliver flyers and door hangers.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

About The Role:

You’ll lead mechanical engineering for a manufacturing Node or a group of related subsystems within Mechanisms and Fluid Systems. The machines you develop will expand the Matter Compiler’s capabilities and determine which devices we can manufacture, at what throughput and cost. The work spans precision motion, workholding, precision fluid handling, thermal control, and multi-physics processes. Reporting to our Director of Engineering, you’ll own the mechanical architecture and engineering delivery of your Node or subsystems.

You’ll manage one to four engineers while personally owning critical design and verification work. You’ll be in design reviews, the lab, and the machine shop, digging into the physics, setting the architecture with your peers, and solving hard problems alongside your team. You’ll set clear priorities, give direct feedback, and develop engineers who can take increasing ownership of design and execution.

Our engineering leaders are deeply technical, accomplished engineers themselves, and involved in the details. Your team will develop, test, and deploy Nodes in our Hybrid Fab, accelerated by in-house labs and a machine shop. You’ll work with engineers ranging from multi-decade principals to brilliant early to mid-career talent. You’ll build alongside technical partners across device, process, AI, electrical, controls, software, and manufacturing engineering.

Problems You'll Solve:

• Deliver systems with performance capabilities at micron-to-submicron precision, enabling high-volume, high-mix combinatorial manufacturing capability.

• Develop systems capable of executing novel manufacturing processes to meet cutting-edge product requirements.

• Chart the roadmap from prototypes through qualification, repeatable machine builds and sustained operation supporting high-volume device production.

Build, Own, Drive

• Build. You help set the bar, participate in interviews, and help grow the team to support our corporate needs and vision. You’ll learn to coach engineers, give feedback, and develop them into stronger contributors and future leads.

• Own. You hold responsibility for your team’s outcomes. You oversee Node performance, throughput, reliability, and cost through direct architectural definition and technical leadership. You uphold engineering standards and drive root-cause problem solving using frameworks like DMAIC.

• Drive. You set priorities for your team and own delivery of your programs in partnership with your Director. You empower your engineers, lead by example through tough technical problems, and apply phase-gate processes to ensure production readiness.

How We Work

• Fast learning loops. In-house robotics labs and our shop and build team let you validate machine designs early and iterate within weeks. Our Hybrid Fab supports device and process validation using your equipment.

• First principles over opinions. We decide through analysis, experiments, and open technocratic debate.

• System in the loop. Your machines produce devices for customers, so your work gets tested by physics and by the market.

• Forecasts grounded in evidence. We update plans and delivery forecasts as analysis, experiments, and machine builds reveal new information.

What You’ll Need:

Experience designing and delivering complex mechanical equipment in one or more of the following areas:

• Precision mechanisms and robotic systems from concept to production release.

• Optical or optomechanical systems design and manufacturing.

• High-vacuum systems, deposition equipment, or vacuum material handling.

• Fluid handling, dispensing, or electrochemical processing systems.

Ideally Your Background

• 8+ years developing complex integrated systems, including 3+ years leading technical work.

• Prior people-management experience is not required. You’ve led through your technical work by mentoring engineers, leading projects, or running design reviews.

• A record of mentoring engineers and helping them grow, and a genuine interest in hiring and developing people.

• Deep expertise in precision engineering, machine design, systems development, and the fundamentals to back it up.

• A record of delivering complete equipment from concept through qualification, documentation, repeatable builds, and sustained operation in production.

• Experience turning ambiguous requirements and new process physics into working machines with customer stakeholders and process engineers.

• Technical leadership: guiding technical direction, improving engineering tools and processes, and mentoring other engineers.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits.

Salary Range

$230,000—$280,000 USD

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager, Supply Chain & Revenue
jobs.description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

As our FP&A Manager, Supply Chain & Revenue, you will own the end-to-end operational and commercial financial model across our products, supply chain operations, and revenue. At a photonics semiconductor company where wafer allocations, yield curves, customer qualification timelines, and tape-out schedules dictate business performance, this role serves as the central financial bridge between Sales, Revenue Operations, Supply Chain, Foundry Engineering, and Executive Leadership. You will have full ownership of revenue forecasting, sales pipeline auditing, COGS forecasting, wafer economics, yield optimization, and R&D compute infrastructure spend, directly shaping our commercial strategy and gross margin execution as we scale volume production.

How Do You Stand Out?

You possess a rare combination of commercial acumen and operational depth—equally comfortable auditing customer pipeline with Sales leaders as you are modeling wafer yields, die-per-wafer economics, and standard costing with Supply Chain.

Responsibilities

• Deliver comprehensive customer-level revenue forecasts tracking units from sample evaluation through customer qualification and high volume production ramp.

• Responsible for auditing the sales pipeline alongside Sales Ops, analyzing Average Selling Prices (ASPs), customer mix, volume discount tiering, and Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) revenue timing.

• Create and maintain dynamic, bottom-up financial models for COGS, inventory absorption, standard-to-actual cost variance, and gross margin optimization.

• Support Supply Chain and Operations teams by aligning commercial revenue demand against foundry capacity reservations, long-lead inventory commitments, and wafer build schedules.

• Manage capacity and cost models for Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software licensing and high-performance compute (HPC) cloud data hosting.

• Partner with Accounting on WIP inventory valuation and month-end close commentary.

Qualifications

• 5-8 years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Operational Finance within the semiconductor industry.

• Demonstrated understanding of semiconductor economics, including tape-outs, die yields, wafer fabrication workflows, OSAT pricing, and inventory capitalization.

• Advanced Excel modeling capabilities with proven experience building complex, bottom-up manufacturing, COGS models from scratch.

• Active user of and passionate about modern AI/LLM tools to optimize complex modeling, data synthesis, and day-to-day work.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in a fast growing, high-tech hardware startup.

• Proven track record of building revenue forecasts, auditing sales pipelines, and partnering directly with Sales, Sales Ops, or Commercial teams.

• Familiarity with enterprise ERP, CRM, and FP&A tools (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, Anaplan, Pigment, Workday Adaptive).

• Strong cross-functional presence with a track record of pushing back on sales pipeline or engineering assumptions with data-backed rigor.

We offer competitive compensation. The base salary range for this role determined based on location, experience, educational background, and market data.

Salary Range: total compensation goes beyond base salary, it also includes a new hire equity grant, annual performance-based equity, and other rewards that recognize your impact and contribution.

Benefits

jobs.title: Technical Storyteller
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.
TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.


We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.


We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

TwelveLabs is looking for a storyteller who speaks fluent AI. Our models, Marengo and Pegasus, let machines understand video the way people do. Your job is to make people feel what that means. You’ll find the human story inside the technology and tell it in a way that sticks, whether the reader is a developer shipping their first integration, a creator or AI-native builder using our models through Claude, ChatGPT, or an MCP server, or a marketer imagining what’s suddenly possible with their video library. You know the technology well enough to get it right and to earn engineers’ respect. Your real strength is the narrative: turning “multimodal embeddings” into “find the exact moment in 10,000 hours of footage.” This isn’t a documentation role. You won’t write API references or manuals. You’ll write the stories that make people want to open them.

You're comfortable enough with code and APIs to follow along with a technical implementation, but your real skill is translation. You can take something complex, like multimodal video embeddings or video-to-text reasoning, and shape it into whatever form fits the audience: a step-by-step tutorial for a developer, a plain-language explainer for someone using our models through a chat interface, or a forum post that sparks a conversation.

Candidates must be able to travel up to 10% of the time annually to attend conferences, off-site meetings, and other business-related events as required by the role. This role may require participation in on-site interviews and/or completion of in-person onboarding processes.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Write blog posts, guides, video outlines, and tutorials that help a range of audiences, from developers to creators to AI-native builders, understand and start using TwelveLabs' products

 - Own SEO and on-page optimization for content, working with external SEO and web dev support to make sure what you write actually gets found

 - Create educational resources (explainers, how-tos, conceptual overviews) that lower the barrier to understanding video AI for both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Write technical articles for external placement on developer forums, industry publications, and news sites

 - Support email and social copy when technical accuracy or product nuance matters

 - Partner with product, engineering, and partner marketing to stay current on what TwelveLabs can do and where it's headed, including how our models show up in tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and MCP servers

 - Keep a pulse on how competitors and the broader video AI space talk about their own technology, and use that to sharpen how we talk about ours





YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience writing technical or product content for a mix of audiences, ideally including both developers and less technical end users

 - A portfolio that shows you can simplify a complex technical concept without dumbing it down, and that you can adjust register depending on who's reading

 - Enough technical fluency to read documentation, follow a code sample, or sit in on an engineering conversation and come away with something to write

 - Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals (you don't need to be an SEO specialist, but you should know how content and search intersect)

 - Strong instincts for structure: you know how to build a guide or tutorial that someone can actually follow, not just read

 - Comfort moving between formats: long-form guides one day, a tight forum post or social caption the next





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with video, multimodal AI, or computer vision concepts

 - Experience writing about or using AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or MCP servers, especially explaining them to non-technical audiences

 - Experience writing for developer communities (forums, Dev.to http://Dev.to, Hacker News, Reddit)

 - Basic comfort with Git, APIs, or SDKs, enough to test something out yourself before writing about it




BENEFITS AND PERKS

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual Learning & Development stipend to invest in your growth

💼 Global offices in San Francisco and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

🛂 VISA support where applicable

🚆 Transportation stipend (SF & NY onsite only)

🍲 Daily meal support (SF & NY onsite only)



If someone contacted you about this role and you’d like to verify they’re a member of our team, please email careers@twelvelabs.io

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.

What You'll Do

• Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning

• Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path

• Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11

• Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not

• Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them

• Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access

• Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization

• Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout

• Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget

• Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service

Responsibilities

• Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows

• Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints

• Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle

• Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space

• Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management

• Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support

• Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

• 8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers

• Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones

• Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent

• A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery

• Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts

• A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path

• Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively

• Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows

• Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives

• Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences

• Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks

• There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel

Preferred Qualifications

• Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification

• Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swiftDialog, or osquery

• Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs

• Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design

• Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs

• Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale

• Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers

Success Measures

• In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight

• In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment

• In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed

Location & Travel:

• This role is open to candidates based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

• The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week

• This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Principal Mechanical Engineer
Advanced Technology Development

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a PrinIcipal Mechanical Engineer to join the Advanced Technology Development team and lead mechanical architecture and design for rapid radar prototypes, electronics packaging, thermal solutions, test infrastructure, and early system integration.

You will join a high-performing, cross-disciplinary team where senior engineers have meaningful technical ownership, run fast experiments, and see their work move directly into future radar products. You will work on prototype development, including tiled-aperture integration, thermal management for high-power electronics, calibration infrastructure, and a packaged radar demonstrator for field learning.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on mechanical design depth with sound technical judgment, fast prototype execution, and the discipline to preserve a practical path from early hardware to reliable, producible products.

jobs.title: Executive Recruiter
jobs.description:
Lead the Future of Dentistry. 

Overjet is the world-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. Now, we’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission: improve oral health for all.

Overjet is where builders become leaders. Everyone here loves to make new things: new products, new partnerships, new content, and a new category of AI technology. And as Overjet grows ridiculously fast, so will you.

Simply put, there’s no better place to accelerate your career. Come join us!

The Mission and the Hard Part

Every company that grows as fast as Overjet hits the same wall: the leaders who got us here are not enough to get us where we’re going. The VPs, Directors, and C-suite executives we hire over the next few years will decide whether entire functions scale or stall, and a wrong hire at that level costs far more than a missed quarter. That’s the job. You’ll sit on the Talent Team and partner directly with our executives, and you will define how Overjet finds, assesses, and wins its leaders across every function, from engineering to sales to finance to clinical.

Nobody hands you a process or a shortlist. The people we want already have great jobs and aren’t looking, and they can work almost anywhere. You’ll be the person who makes the case for Overjet to someone who has never heard of us, earns the trust of a skeptical executive in a single conversation, and builds the assessment approach that tells us whether they’re truly a bar-raiser. If building the leadership hiring engine from the ground up sounds like the fun part of the job, keep reading.

What You’ll Own

 - The leadership hiring process itself, from intake to signed offer. That means designing how Overjet scopes, sources, assesses, and closes Director+ roles, then running it so consistently that every executive knows what to expect.

 - Full-cycle searches for senior leaders across functions, often several at once. That means running your own outreach, holding your own in a conversation with a CEO about what “great” looks like, and never waiting on a sourcer to fill your pipeline.

 - The leadership assessment standard. That means building a rigorous, repeatable way to evaluate candidates (structured interviews, work samples, references, and the tools that fit), so we know whether we want someone in this fight with us before an offer goes out.

 - The candidate experience for executives. That means timely, honest communication at every stage, and being the one who closes a candidate who has three other offers on the table.

 - Executive alignment on every search. That means pushing back when a role profile is vague or the bar is drifting, and shaping the recruitment strategy so it matches company goals and culture.

 - The playbook for what works next time. That means tracking where great leaders come from, what predicts

What Makes the Right Candidate Keep Reading

You’ve closed Director, VP, and C-suite hires across multiple functions at high-growth technology companies, and you came away with real judgment about who will succeed as a leader and who just interviews well. You build rapport with senior executives quickly, and you’re comfortable telling them what they don’t want to hear. The traits that matter most here are high agency and conviction: you’ll create the process rather than wait for one, and you’ll need to argue for a candidate or against one with evidence. You also need to be able to talk about Overjet’s mission in a way that wins over people who could work anywhere, because that’s the job every single week. If you want a mature, well-staffed recruiting machine where your role is to execute a defined process, this probably isn’t the right seat.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience welcome

 - Skills: Strong written and verbal communication; working knowledge of leadership assessment tools and techniques; ability to build rapport with senior executives

 - Experience: 5+ years in leadership or executive recruiting, with a focus on Director+ roles (VP, C-suite) across a variety of functions at high-growth technology companies

Why Overjet? 

 - Competitive Compensation and Equity

 - Hybrid workplace that provides flexibility, vibrant in-person workspaces, and the ability to build strong connections across all of Overjet - regardless of location

 - 401k plans with a matching program

 - Medical, Dental and Vision coverage: 99% employee premium covered, 75% dependent premium covered

 - Life and AD+D Insurance 

 - 8 weeks Paid Parental Leave 

 - Optional HSA with Employer contribution

 - Flexible Time Off and company paid holidays

 - Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Overjet's Values

 - Excellence: Aim Higher

 - Velocity: Quickly Deliver Results

 - Ownership: Go the Extra Mile

 - Win-win: Care Deeply

Experience with a broad number of provider specialties, professional, ancillary and other.

Priority network gaps closed by specialty, geography, and service line, with contracted sites available by agreed launch dates

jobs.title: Data Center Technician Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Data Center Technician Manager is a first-line people manager responsible for the day-to-day operational performance and development of DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering staff at the site.

This is the first formal people-management role in the Nebius data center technical career path. It serves as the primary operational and people-management layer between these teams and the Data Center IT Manager.

The role owns performance, development, scheduling, and accountability across the DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering disciplines. When the Data Center IT Manager is unavailable, this manager acts as the primary on-site operational authority, makes shift-level decisions across both managed disciplines, and coordinates incidents involving other site teams.

The successful candidate brings deep technical credibility in data center technician operations and/or facilities engineering, along with sufficient cross-disciplinary understanding to direct escalations, assess work quality, and represent the managed teams in site-level operational discussions.

The Senior DC Diagnostic & RMA Specialist, Field Network Engineer, and Senior DC Support Engineer report directly to the Data Center IT Manager.

You will work on-site at our Missouri data center location.

Core responsibilities

• Own the daily operational performance of DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering staff. Assign shift coverage, set priorities, balance workloads, and ensure open work is tracked, delegated, and completed to Nebius standards.

• Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with direct reports. Deliver structured performance feedback, set individual development goals aligned with the career framework, track progression, and manage performance concerns in partnership with HR and the Data Center IT Manager.

• Own shift handoff quality across both disciplines. Ensure incoming shifts have full visibility into open incidents, active vendor work, abnormal system conditions, deferred tasks, and escalated items before taking operational ownership.

• Serve as the on-site operational escalation authority during active incidents. Direct the response across managed teams, coordinate with the Lead DC Technician, Senior DC Facilities Engineer, and technical specialists reporting to the Data Center IT Manager, and escalate incidents that exceed site-level decision-making authority.

• Manage vendor and contractor activity on the data center floor and in engineering zones. Verify qualifications, enforce safe working practices, review and approve Methods of Procedure (MOPs) within assigned authority, oversee execution quality, and ensure work meets Nebius standards.

• Drive technical training and development for managed staff. Partner with the Lead DC Technician and Senior DC Facilities Engineer to identify skill gaps, arrange training, validate completion, and support progression within the Nebius career framework.

• Lead hiring activities for DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering roles. Conduct structured, competency-based interviews, provide hiring recommendations, and partner with recruiting and HR on offers, onboarding, and early-tenure support.

• Maintain a safe, inclusive, and high-performance team culture. Address conduct, attendance, and well-being concerns promptly and in accordance with Nebius policies, safe working requirements, and applicable employment obligations.

• Make recommendations regarding hiring, promotions, disciplinary action, advancement, scheduling, and termination.

• Make routine decisions regarding workflow, staffing, escalation, and corrective actions within assigned management authority.

• Provide ongoing coaching, training, and performance feedback.

Technical work may be performed when needed, but the position’s primary responsibility is managing the assigned team and data center operations.

Expected capabilities

• Proven first-line management ability, including leading, developing, and holding technical teams accountable across shift-based operations in a mission-critical environment.

• Deep technical credibility in data center technician operations and/or facilities engineering, with sufficient cross-disciplinary understanding to direct escalations, assess work quality, and evaluate readiness across both functions.

• Strong operational judgment, including assigning and reprioritizing work, managing incidents across disciplines, and making sound shift-level decisions without requiring approval for routine matters.

• Demonstrated performance-management capability, including delivering structured feedback, managing development plans, addressing underperformance, and supporting career progression and promotions in partnership with HR.

• Clear, structured communication with technicians, facilities engineers, the Data Center IT Manager, global engineering teams, vendors, and senior leadership.

• Proficiency in operational reporting and tracking metrics, with the ability to identify performance trends, surface risks, and recommend improvements to shift execution and team capability.

• Working knowledge of safe working practices, change control, emergency operating procedures, and vendor management, with the ability to learn and apply Nebius-specific requirements.

Core physical requirements

The role requires the ability to perform the following activities, with reasonable accommodation where applicable:

• Stand and remain on your feet for extended periods, typically four or more consecutive hours during active shift operations.

• Safely lift, carry, and position equipment weighing up to 50 pounds independently, using appropriate team-lift protocols or mechanical aids for heavier loads.

• Work at heights, including ascending and descending ladders and using approved elevated work platforms.

• Work in confined spaces, including under raised floors, within rack enclosures, and along cable management pathways.

• Work in environments with variable temperatures, including cold aisle containment zones and areas with active cooling infrastructure.

• Handle small components, precision cabling, and connector installations.

• Read equipment labels, interface indicators, and detailed wiring diagrams in variable lighting conditions.

• Safely push or pull wheeled equipment weighing up to 500 pounds on level surfaces, using appropriate equipment-handling procedures.

On-call requirement

This role carries on-call responsibility as the primary management escalation point for after-hours incidents, team welfare concerns, vendor emergencies, and site-level operational events requiring management authority across both managed disciplines.

Key employee benefits in the US:

• Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

• Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$125,000—$145,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

What We’re Looking For
GR0 is looking for an SEO and communication enthusiast with a track record of delivering bespoke and extraordinary client support. As a Senior Campaign Manager, SEO, you will manage 10-15 accounts and deliver GR0’s proven SEO strategies alongside our fast-growing GEO offering, helping clients rank on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Grok, and other LLM platforms.

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager, Food & Facilities
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOURCING MANAGER, FOOD & FACILITIES

We are a progressive procurement organization pushing the boundaries of traditional procurement reputation and methodologies. We are looking for individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and delivery. This individual will support indirect supplier management and SG&A spend reduction initiatives. The purchasing team has aggressive objectives for 2026 that positively impact our product and bottom line. We are looking for the right person who is equipped and ready for these challenges to join our team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Strategy/Sourcing: Create sourcing strategies for assigned categories to reduce risk and meet targets for the purchasing department including but not limited to payment terms, cash targets, and cost savings

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships to create strategic sourcing models that optimize the value of products and services that support business unit requirements to maintain continuous cost reduction programs for controllable expenditures. Communicate, manage, and drive compliance to category strategies. Provides solutions to a wide range of difficult problems

• Change Management: Successfully partner across functions and with senior internal stakeholders and external suppliers to drive results, influence others and facilitate change management across the company

• Analysis: Responsible for advanced quantitative analysis to identify financial impacts of decisions and performance for category managed. Perform business process analysis and develop models to improve cost Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers and measure the appropriate criteria, such as delivery of business results, cost reduction, quality, and timeliness of delivery

• Risk Management: Analyze global supply chain dynamics and market volatility impacting logistics providers; develop procurement strategies like multi-sourcing, diversification, and performance-based clauses to balance cost and risk

• Conduct research, perform benchmarking, and gather market analysis for assigned categories

• Contract Management: Responsible for authoring contract documents with the Legal Department. Management of contracts ensuring performance of the supplier to contract obligations. Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creativity and sound business reasoning to interpret the application of contracts to business needs

• Negotiations: Utilize negotiations to maximize value and cost savings benefits while lowering risk

• Supplier Management: Manage preferred suppliers for assigned category. Create and implement related management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage the performance of, and monitor KPIs of the supply base

• Tactical Purchasing - Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories

• Performs assignments independently with instruction limited to the results expected

• Efficiency: Develop and lead efforts to reduce the number of transactions for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:

• Engineering

• Purchasing

• Contract negotiation

• Operations or supply chain management

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience in a purchasing or supply chain role

• Experience sourcing within the food industry, preferably supporting in various food categories and hospitality services

• Experience with managing facilities services – waste, janitorial, security, office supplies, office construction

• Technical skills in current technologies and applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, SQL, PowerBI)

• Exceptional analytical and organizational skills

• Remarkable problem-solving skills

• Ability to prioritize appropriately to meet internal customer and company needs

• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with a strong ability to communicate with all levels of internal personnel

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Ability to conduct all activities with the highest integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines

• Ability to communicate outside of work hours

• Must be able to travel - up to 20% work week travel may be required

• This position is based in Bastrop, TX, and requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, NPI
jobs.description:
As a Senior Mechanical Engineer on our product development team, you will assume a key leadership role on the team, providing deep mechanical engineering expertise honed over a career of critical judgement and decision-making. You will develop mechanical designs for new and existing products by applying engineering and fabrication principles to product designs for the consumer market in accordance with business needs and the product road map. You will lead and mentor other engineers in the company and individuals both senior and junior to you and at the same level as you. You exhibit a strong capability to exercise judgement, communication with a wide variety of team members internally to the company and externally, and the ability to both see the future of our product development as well as design for the current state, all with excellence.

Essential Duties

• Develop concepts and ideas for new products or methods to improve existing products.
• Design mechanisms, drive systems, sheet metal, plastic housings and components in support of new products
• Develop cost estimates based on product concepts or designs
• Use engineering principles to develop the structural design of products by incorporating mechanical and electrical subsystems to meet industrial design, marketing, and customer requirements to meet project schedules.
• Specify materials and components in designs
• Manage multiple design projects at once. Work independently with little or no direction. Keep management informed and apprised of design. Work with other functional groups (marketing, sales, customer service, etc.) within the company to develop and evaluate designs that meet customer needs.
• Present and participate in design reviews and update designs as required.
• Develop schedules for part and product development.
• Proactively identify risks and develop and execute risk reduction measures
• Problem solve- identify root cause, verify the root cause through on/off testing and implement both corrective and preventative actions to resolve problems
• Keep appraised of the customer experience related to company products.
• Work with design and/or manufacturing partners to ensure manufacturability and smooth product ramps leading up to production.
• Perform testing of designs to prove functionality and reliability.
• Generate design specifications and drawings for external design and manufacturing activities.
• Apply statistical methods such as process capability studies and DOE’s in the development and improvement of products.
• Mentor other engineers through out the design cycle

Required

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering
• 5+ Years of applicable experience

Required Knowledge, Skills and Responsibilities

• Experience designing consumer based products similar to ours such as crafting machines, inkjet printers or similar electro-mechanical devices, medical devices or similar.
• Proficient in the use of 3D CAD (CREO preferred but also acceptable are SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and engineering analysis tools (e.g., ANSYS, MATLAB).
• Interest in and an aptitude for robotics, kinematics, dynamics, mechatronics, mechanism design, etc.
• Experienced in injection molded plastics design, tooling best practices and process tuning.
• Strong understanding of mechanical systems, materials, and manufacturing processes.
• Familiar with sheet metal design and fabrication processes
• Familiar with rapid prototype techniques and processes
• Proficient in the application of GD&T
• Effective communicator.

Cricut is in an exciting chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across everything we do. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who thrive in dynamic environments, turn challenges into momentum, and consistently deliver their best work. If that sounds like you, read on.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

· You set high standards. You take ownership, deliver quality, and hold yourself accountable.

· You stay focused when things move fast. You prioritize what matters most and tune out the noise.

· You collaborate like a pro. You elevate others, communicate clearly, and bring a low-ego, high-output energy.

· You embrace AI as part of your toolkit. From idea exploration to data analysis and creative problem-solving, you leverage AI to accelerate innovation and amplify impact—because technology and creativity go hand-in-hand here.

One More Thing (It’s a Big One)

This role is in-office 5 days per week. We believe real collaboration, innovation, and culture are built face-to-face. If you’re energized by working alongside smart, kind, creative people—and love those hallway conversations that spark the next great idea—you’ll feel right at home.

If you’re looking for a fully remote role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re excited by challenge, purpose, and building something better—let’s make something amazing together.
