jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Analyst, Technical Customer Manager - Product & Services

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization.  You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You'll Find Success

You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

How You’ll Grow

• Master advanced technical implementation: You will develop deep, hands-on expertise in the Qualtrics platform, evolving into a trusted technology advisor who leads medium and large-scale enterprise software implementations.

• Elevate your executive influence and consulting skills: You will build strong relationships with senior customer program owners and decision-makers, honing your ability to shape strategic feedback programs and guide large, complex organizations through business transformations.

• Develop commercial and portfolio leadership: By proactively monitoring account health and defining expansion strategies, you will move beyond standard project execution to directly drive portfolio performance, value realization, and account growth.

• Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.

Things You'll Do

• Portfolio Leadership: Own the success of a portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary technology advisor throughout the customer lifecycle

• Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities

• Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance

• Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution

• Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health

What We're Looking For On Your Resume

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.

• 3+ years of experience: Successfully working with large, complex organisations to execute and advise on customer facing programs that deliver sustainable business outcomes

• Technical Aptitude: High interest in learning the Qualtrics platform and new technologies and deployment of technical expertise with customers at scale

• Consulting & Program Management: Proven ability to plan and execute multiple concurrent projects on time and budget, with a blend of consulting and internal-customer experience. Collaborating with project managers, consultants, architects and product teams to support delivery of specific outcomes

• Customer Engagement: Ability to lead workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, utilise data and metrics to communicate understanding and produce high quality customer facing documentation

• Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build relationships with senior customer program owners and decision makers

• Industry Experience: Good understanding of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management in one or more specific industries.

• Entrepreneurial spirit: High tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, to understand business needs and to communicate and present to Senior Management effectively.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or business-related field.

• Willingness to Travel: Able to travel up to 25% to engage with clients and teams.

What You Should Know About This Team

Key Responsibilities

Help Customers Grow

• Build and maintain strong customer stakeholder relationships to deeply understand the context, ambition and strategic business goals for the customers within your portfolio Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps Monitor customer health, platform utilisation and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

Provide Technical & Execution Expertise

• Develop and maintain technical competence on the Qualtrics platform, ensuring a deep understanding of the leading indicators of customer adoption, ACV retention and value realisation Utilize experience and best practices in order to understand the customer and communicate effectively how the Qualtrics platform will support the delivery of value driving outcomes and enhance their program Lead specific project implementations for new customers to your portfolio and existing customers; including cross functional / cross team project teams consisting of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors, with the objective to deliver on project goals and objectives Conduct regular risk planning, monitoring, mitigation and reporting to stakeholders both during project delivery and account lifecycle

Demonstrate Operational Rigor

• Execute implementation and account management activities in accordance with global standard practices, ensuring rigorous account and project tracking and proactive risk and issue management Ensure all project and account documentation and artefacts are developed, maintained Stay current with product and strategic customer journey enhancements

Key Success Measures

For customer accounts within your portfolio over a 12 month period:

Customer Value

• Net ARR Customer adoption and maturity of customer account Customer satisfaction and advocacy

Successful Execution

• Billable Utilization attainment Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone) Time to Deliver new capabilities for customers in your portfolio Rigorous scope management measured by level of Variance on Completion (VAC) of specific project deliverables

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.

• Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement.

• Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Competitive matching company contributions to help secure your financial future.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - East
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



The Mission:

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership:

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

What You Will Achieve:

 - Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

 - Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

 - Navigate the C-Suite: Orchestrate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles, building deep trust with everyone from lead engineers to C-level executives.

 - Collaborative Excellence: Partner with our expert Solutions Engineering team to prove the massive ROI and technical superiority of the Kong platform.

 - Define Your Legacy: Maintain a pristine pipeline and deliver accurate forecasts that help shape the strategic direction of our sales organization.

What You Bring to the Journey:

 - A Track Record of Excellence: 8+ years of experience selling complex enterprise software platforms, with a history of consistently exceeding goals and reaching the top tier of your organization.

 - Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

 - Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

 - Executive Presence: You are a compelling storyteller, capable of articulating the strategic business value of AI and APIs to the world’s most sophisticated technical leaders.

 - Resilient Drive: You bring the persistence, grit, and proactive mindset required to win in a high-velocity, competitive landscape.

Why You’ll Thrive at Kong

 - Category-Defining Technology: Sell a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to survive an AI-first world.

 - Uncapped Opportunity: A competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure that rewards those who go above and beyond.

 - Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there.

 - Inclusive Excellence: We offer comprehensive health coverage, equity, flexible PTO, and a culture where diverse perspectives are the fuel for our innovation.

Our Commitment to You: At Kong, we believe that talent is diverse by nature. If you are excited about this role but your background doesn't perfectly match every single bullet point, we encourage you to apply anyway. We value potential, passion, and the unique perspective you bring to the table.



#LI-TM1



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Chemist I - GCMS (M-F, 1p-10p) Eurofins Environment Testing Southwest, Calscience, Tustin, CA
jobs.description:
Eurofins Environment Testing Southwest in Tustin CA is searching for a SVOA GCMS Chemist I to prepare and analyze environmental samples following EPA protocols in adherence with Eurofins Quality Assurance programs and SOP’s.

Chemist / Analyst duties will include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Extract and prepare samples for analysis by Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry.
• Evaluate chromatography and mass spectra for qualitative and quantitative criteria.
• Monitor and manage backlog workload to meet client program requirements.
• Upload and peer review data using the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
• Perform basic instrument maintenance and repair, including column replacement and ion source cleaning.
• Prepare standards and reagents for sample analysis.
• Maintain instrument calibrations in accordance with laboratory QAQC requirements.
• Communicate with preparation team and project management team regarding work status.
• Perform general housekeeping within the laboratory to maintain an organized and safe working environment.
• Conduct daily duties in an efficient and safe manner, remaining compliant with environmental health and safety programs.
• Perform other laboratory duties as assigned.

The ideal candidate would possess the following qualifications

• 1+ years’ experience operating a GC or GCMS in a production laboratory setting, required.
• BS or BA in chemistry or related field; 3 years laboratory experience may substitute for a degree
• Previous production oriented work experience a plus (awareness and ability to efficiently meet deadlines)
• Effective time management and multitasking skills
• Ability to perform and evaluate basic mathematical calculations and formulas
• Ability to work independently, following written and verbal instructions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship
• Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English

Compensation range: $18- $22 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.

Position is Full-time and eligible for overtime pay.

Candidate must be able to work the following shift in addition to the initial training shift of Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 6:00pm:

• Monday thru Friday, 1:00pm - 10:00pm

Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base compensation may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base compensation of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location.

As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work.  We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Eurofins USA Environment Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Analyst, Technical Customer Manager - Locations (Restaurant, Retail, Travel, and Hospitality)

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization.  You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.

Customer Value

jobs.title: Manager, Field Marketing & Events
jobs.description:
Our customers and partners are used to the way legacy networking has operated for decades. We strongly believe that events are a highly effective way for our audience to understand what Meter does and why we’re different from these legacy solutions. Events are often where customers, partners, network engineers, and future teammates first experience Meter. This role makes sure every one of those moments count and deliver results back to the business.



Meter is looking for a leader who has built events at a company that was growing faster than its playbook. You’ve run a flagship conference and taken a program on the road to multiple cities. You see events as a strategic growth lever, energized by the challenge of transforming ambitious ideas into measurable pipeline growth and stronger brand visibility. You know the best events start weeks before the attendees arrive and keep working long after they leave. You’ve led teams that have a reputation of being “the best of the best”, and you want to do it again.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Events are already proven as a successful channel for Meter, backed by investments that make up about 30% of our marketing budget. This year, the team took Meter on the road to 13 cities with Meter Circuit, our roadshow event series. We showed up at NRF, RSA, Channel Partners, Educause, and others, plus dozens of industry and regional shows and partner events. Sales and partners are running even more events on their own in the field. And now we’re shifting our focus to MeterUp, our flagship conference taking place in April 2027.



You’ll lead the team that makes it all happen, ensuring every event has a clear goal, feels uniquely Meter, and shows its return. Across strategic events, field marketing, partner events, internal brand, and EMEA, the team is already strong. We need a leader who keeps raising the bar.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first month, you know each person on the team, their scope, and where they want to grow. You’ve met GTM leaders in every region and learned how events are currently being leveraged, where they are working, and where we have room to improve.



Within three months, you’ve delivered an updated events strategy and FY28 calendar, developed in alignment with marketing and GTM leaders. You’ve published an event standard for Meter covering promotion, pre-event comms, onsite experience, and follow-up. Sales has a clear intake process, self-serve playbook, and view into our calendar of events. You’ve set clear pipeline targets for the team and every event reports pipeline at 30, 60, and 90 days, including partner-led events.



Over time, you’ll shape how Meter shows up in person across every region and audience as the company scales.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You’ve led a growing events or field marketing team at a high-growth company

 - You’ve run both field marketing and strategic events. You use field events as a data-driven lever for growth, but you know brand events drive pipeline too.

 - You’ve worked closely with partners, or in a channel-led company.

 - You measure everything. You love seeing your team’s direct impact and sharing that story with the company.

 - You build a partnership with sales, not a service desk. Sales feels supported, and your team’s time goes to the programs that matter most.

 - You care how people experience a brand. One great event can change how someone sees Meter: as a customer, partner, future teammate, or industry voice.

 - You believe every event can be high value, from a small regional partner sponsorship to MeterUp.

 - You aren’t satisfied with what’s been done before. You push your team to try new things.

 - You move with intentional urgency. You know when to slow down and when to challenge the pace.

 - You hold a high bar and inspire others around you to do their best work.

 - You lead with Meter’s core values: kindness, ambition, optimism, and paranoia.





WHY METER?

Meter is a vertically integrated networking company. Hardware, software, services, ISP, and autonomous networks—all built on a single data pipeline from the local network to the data center.



The internet runs the world. Every purchase you make, video call you join, it's all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.



We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.



Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.




COMPENSATION

 - The estimated base salary for this role is between $150,000 - $200,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Meter's equity plan.



By applying to this job you acknowledge that you've read and understood Meter's Job Applicant Privacy Notice https://www.meter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy.

jobs.title: Flight Test Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Position Summary

As a Test Engineering Manager, you will lead one of the engineering teams within Zone 5's Test & Evaluation organization — which spans flight testing, test operations, and environmental testing — while partnering with T&E leadership and peer managers to grow the discipline's shared methods, tools, and standards. You will be a working manager: accountable for your team's execution against its commitments, and expected to contribute independently at the test engineering level when that is what it takes to get the job done. Your team plans and executes the testing that verifies our air vehicles and their subsystems — from lab and environmental campaigns through integrated ground test and flight test — and your role is to ensure that work is delivered safely, rigorously, and consistently, and that your engineers are developed, supported, and well matched to the programs they serve.

Responsibilities

• Manage and grow a team of test engineers, fostering collaboration, technical rigor, and a strong safety culture.

• Be accountable for your team's execution — the test commitments it makes to programs and concept development efforts — and contribute independently as a test engineer where needed to deliver.

• Ensure the correct and consistent application of test methodologies, processes, tools, and standards within your team, and contribute to their continued development across the discipline.

• Ensure your engineers are trained, equipped, and supported to do high-quality work, and be accountable for the quality of your team's test planning, execution, data, and documentation.

• Staff and balance your engineers across concept development efforts and program teams based on skills, availability, and development needs, in coordination with T&E leadership and peer managers.

• Guide the team in developing test plans, procedures, safety documentation, and reports, and in executing lab, environmental, ground, and flight test campaigns.

• Oversee test readiness — instrumentation, telemetry and data acquisition, range and facility coordination, and hazard analysis — so campaigns enter execution prepared.

• Represent the test discipline at design and test readiness reviews, ensuring designs are testable and verification evidence is credible.

• Capture lessons learned from completed test campaigns and help fold them back into discipline processes, standards, and training.

• Drive innovative approaches to test methods, automation, and infrastructure that increase test tempo without sacrificing rigor.

• Ability to travel approximately 25% (roughly equivalent to one week a month), with expectation to be flexible to test schedule(s)

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or related technical field.

• Demonstrated experience leading test engineers or test teams, with responsibility for their development and the quality of their work.

• Hands-on experience planning and executing test campaigns for aerospace or defense systems — flight test, environmental test, and/or integrated ground test.

• Experience authoring test plans, procedures, hazard analyses, and test reports, and reviewing others' work for rigor and completeness.

• Working knowledge of instrumentation, telemetry, and data acquisition systems and of test data reduction and analysis.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, and program teams.

• Must be a U.S. Person as defined by ITAR (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).

Preferred Qualifications

• Flight test experience with UAS, munitions, or other air-launched systems, including range operations, airspace and frequency coordination, and flight clearances.

• Familiarity with range safety practices (e.g., RCC standards).

• Experience standing up or scaling test infrastructure, automation, or data pipelines.

jobs.title: Product Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.


OUR ETHOS

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Compliance Manager to make sure every product Rain ships is compliant by design. You'll sit between Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, turning regulations and card network rules into clear product requirements before code is written, not after launch.

Rain moves fast: partners go live in weeks, and new products like embedded wallets, credit and prepaid programs, and agent-issued virtual cards keep coming. You'll own the compliance review that lets that speed hold up with regulators, the networks, our bank partners and auditors.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own product compliance reviews. Assess new products, features and partner programs end to end, from PRD to launch, and sign off on the compliance requirements each one needs.

 - Translate rules into requirements. Turn regulations and network rules into concrete specs, controls and acceptance criteria that Product and Engineering can build against.

 - Keep card programs network-compliant. Own adherence to Visa and Mastercard operating rules as a Principal Member, including program approvals, network registrations and periodic attestations.

 - Cover consumer protection. Apply Reg E, Reg Z, TILA, UDAAP, ECOA and state requirements to cardholder agreements, disclosures, fees, rewards and dispute flows.

 - Review partner programs. Assess partner use cases, marketing materials, cardholder terms and onboarding flows before launch, and monitor them after.

 - Partner with Financial Crimes. Make sure KYC/KYB, sanctions screening and transaction monitoring requirements are built into products such as wallets, payouts, onramps and offramps.

 - Track the landscape. Follow stablecoin, payments and money transmission developments in the US and abroad, including federal stablecoin rules and MiCA, and flag what changes our roadmap.

 - Build the program. Maintain product compliance policies, the review process, a product risk inventory and the evidence trail that bank partners, networks, regulators and auditors ask for.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in product compliance, regulatory compliance or a similar role at a fintech, card issuer, program manager, sponsor bank or payments company.

 - Hands-on knowledge of card issuing: Visa and/or Mastercard operating rules, prepaid and credit programs, and the issuer–processor–program manager model.

 - Working knowledge of US consumer financial regulation, including Reg E, Reg Z, UDAAP and state money transmission rules.

 - A track record of reviewing products before launch and writing requirements that engineers actually build from.

 - Sound judgment on risk: you know when to say "yes, if" and when to say no, and you can explain both.

 - Clear writing for very different readers, from an engineer's ticket to a bank partner's due diligence questionnaire.


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY

 - Experience with stablecoins, digital assets or crypto-linked card programs.

 - Exposure to international regimes such as MiCA, UK FCA rules or APAC payments licensing.

 - Background at a Principal Member issuer or sponsor bank, including network audits or bank partner exams.

 - Familiarity with BSA/AML, OFAC and FinCEN requirements.

 - A JD or a certification such as CAMS or CRCM.

 - Comfort reading API docs and working inside tools like Linear, Jira or Notion.


THINGS THAT ENABLE A FULFILLING, HEALTHY, AND HAPPY EXPERIENCE AT RAIN:

 - Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take at least 10 days off.

 - Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace. If you feel comfortable at home, please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office, feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will receive a stipend to create a comfortable home environment.

 - Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

 - Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.

jobs.description:

Ever wondered what it’s like behind the bubbles?  #lushcareers

Store Manager

Whether you're interacting with customers, motivating your team, or making important business decisions, you always keep the following in mind: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose. As the Store Manager, you're responsible for:

• Recruiting your team

• Training and developing your management team

• Training and developing your team on brand, product, and service

You oversee all aspects of the retail business, from managing budgets to exceeding sales targets. But you know that there's more to it than just the numbers – it's also about creating an environment that fosters a strong customer experience, staff experience, and operational excellence. And as you lead your team to greatness, you'll be constantly assessing your own performance and seeking feedback, resources, and opportunities to grow and develop.

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer  Experience:

• Customer Service: collaborate with your team on plans to exceed daily sales goals and ensure a unique and inclusive customer experience that makes every visitor feel welcome, meets their needs, and makes their day.

• Building the Brand: educate our customers and staff on our brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed and product recommendations for every need.

• Driving Sales: demonstrate strong business acumen and understanding of your metrics and reports by developing and executing business plans that align with the American business strategy to achieve both short- and long-term goals that improve KPIs and achieve sales goals.

Team Leadership:

• Leadership Practices and Staff Development: demonstrate the Leadership Practices and coach and develop your team in their careers by creating development plans, encouraging learning through Lush tools, coaching behaviors as they arise, and providing constructive feedback that inspires and motivates.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: actively committed to maintaining a diverse team and creating an inclusive environment by prioritizing DEIB training and initiatives and actively collaborating with your team on solutions that promote equity and belonging.

• Engagement and Performance: balances analysis, experience, and perspective when making decisions about performance concerns and creates action plans to improve staff engagement, demonstrating empathy and considering personal situations/struggles when approaching performance concerns.

• Excellent listening and communication skills

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.

• Strong customer service, supervisory and sales skills

Preferred:

We Are Lush

YouTube

jobs.title: Director, GTM Operations
jobs.description:
Fairmarkit is the #1 autonomous sourcing platform revolutionizing the way all organizations buy & sell. Fairmarkit equips procurement teams with automation, AI, and GenAI so they can source more competitively at scale. Our solutions for tail spend and strategic sourcing help innovative procurement teams reduce cycle times, drive out costs, meet ESG/Diversity targets, and provide a better stakeholder experience to internal partners and suppliers. Fairmarkit has been recognized with awards by organizations such as Gartner and IDC, and is backed by strategic investors like Notable Capital, Insight Partners, 1984.VC, and Newfund.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of GTM Operations to lead the systems, processes, and insights that improve sales and marketing performance. You’ll own the operational framework across the full acquisition funnel—from account and prospect targeting, campaign engagement, and lead generation through pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and closed-won revenue.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Deal Desk, and Finance leadership to align priorities, improve execution, and build scalable ways of working. You’ll establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks that connect sales and marketing activity to pipeline and revenue, helping leaders make informed investment decisions.

You’ll bring an AI-native approach to operations, embedding AI and automation into how we design workflows, generate insights, and create capacity. Success requires someone who can set direction, influence stakeholders, lead change, and stay close to execution.  This role will have one direct report and will align directly with the CFOO.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Marketing Operations Leadership

• Set and lead the Sales and Marketing Operations strategy, translating company priorities into a roadmap that improves pipeline generation, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

• Advise Sales, Marketing, and Business Development leaders on operational priorities, investment decisions, and opportunities to improve execution.

• Establish shared performance expectations, decision-making frameworks, and accountability across Sales and Marketing.

• Lead cross-functional change, building alignment among stakeholders and resolving competing priorities to deliver measurable business outcomes.

• Anticipate operational needs as the business scales and proactively evolve processes, systems, and capabilities.

Full Funnel Operations & Attribution

• Define and own the operational framework across the full acquisition funnel—from account and prospect targeting through closed-won revenue.

• Establish consistent funnel definitions, qualification criteria, routing logic, and handoff expectations that align Sales, Marketing, and Business Development.

• Lead the attribution strategy, connecting marketing campaigns and sales activities to pipeline and revenue to measure ROI and guide investment decisions.

• Guide investment and prioritization decisions through analysis of campaign effectiveness, acquisition efficiency, conversion, and funnel velocity.

• Identify systemic barriers to performance and lead initiatives that improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, and sales cycle efficiency.

Sales Performance & Planning

• Lead the operational framework for pipeline management and forecasting, strengthening predictability and informing Sales leadership decisions and financial planning.

• Enhance performance scorecards and leadership review cadences that translate insights into decisions, clear ownership, and action.

• Partner with Finance and Sales leadership to maintain impactful sales commission plans that align incentives with strategic initiatives and business goals.

• Lead territory, coverage, and capacity strategy in partnership with Sales leadership, aligning organizational design and resource investment with market opportunity and long-term growth objectives.

Sales & Marketing Systems Strategy

• Set the sales and marketing technology strategy and roadmap, balancing business needs, scalability, cost, and adoption.

• Lead the design and evolution of integrations across Salesforce and connected platforms to enable reliable data flow and effective workflows.

• Establish standards for system design, access, documentation, and change management in coordination with other system stakeholders.

• Evaluate technology investments against measurable business value, driving adoption and consolidating or replacing tools where appropriate.

AI-Native Operations & Transformation

• Define and lead an AI-native approach to Sales and Marketing Operations, making AI and automation core to how work is designed and delivered.

• Build and prioritize a portfolio of AI and automation initiatives that improve team capacity, campaign execution, lead prioritization, and sales productivity.

• Lead experimentation from initial use case through implementation and adoption, with clear measures of quality, efficiency, and business impact.

• Recommend workflow (re)design to capture the benefits of AI and automation, challenging existing processes and simplifying how teams work.

• Influence leaders and users to adopt new capabilities, establishing practical standards for responsible use, output validation, and ongoing improvement.

Data Strategy, Insights & Enablement

• Establish the sales and marketing measurement framework, aligning leaders on trusted metrics, data definitions, and ownership.

• Own the quality and reliability of sales and marketing data, addressing root causes and establishing sustainable governance.

• Deliver executive-level insights that explain performance, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend action.

• Set the reporting and analytics roadmap, prioritizing visibility that improves decisions and accountability.

• Recommend enablement and adoption strategies that embed systems, processes, and insights into how Sales and Marketing operate.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or related roles in B2B SaaS, including experience setting operational direction and leading cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrated ownership across both sales and marketing operations, with full-funnel experience spanning pre-pipeline activity through closed-won revenue.

• Proven expertise in campaign measurement, attribution models, funnel analytics, and connecting sales and marketing investments to pipeline and revenue outcomes.

• Strong systems expertise, with experience shaping technology strategy and designing scalable platforms, integrations, and automation.

• Experience managing marketing automation, sales engagement, data enrichment, forecasting, and reporting platforms.

• Demonstrated use of AI and automation to improve workflows, with sound judgment around data quality, output validation, and adoption.

• Strong analytical skills, including proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboard development, and translating complex data into clear recommendations.

• Ability to influence leaders, align stakeholders, and lead change across teams without relying on direct authority.

• A strategic perspective paired with the willingness and technical ability to build, troubleshoot, and execute.

• Excellent communication, prioritization, and project leadership skills in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Remote work opportunities may be limited to designated states. The compensation range for this position is $162,000 - $245,000 (including bonus) + equity, and benefits. This range is provided in accordance with applicable U.S. pay transparency laws. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location. #LI-remote #LI-YM1

Headquartered in Boston, and backed by a $35.6M Series C co-led by OMERS, Highland, Notable Capital, Insight Partners, and ServiceNow. We are looking for exceptional candidates who want to help grow our company into a global enterprise and make their mark on the B2B tech industry. Come soar to new heights with us!

jobs.title: Senior Production Application Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Production Analytics team is seeking an Senior Production Application Engineer to join our team. The Production Analytics team plays a pivotal role in optimizing production operations through the implementation and management of proof of concept, advanced digital solutions, and improvement of existing MES / ERP / WMS systems. The team ensures that production processes and digital tools are efficient, scalable, and integrated with the latest industry standards.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Production Application Engineer at Anduril, you will be a critical driver of operational excellence. You will leverage diverse operational data (production, quality, supply chain, equipment performance) to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and unlock new levels of efficiency and scalability for our cutting-edge production operations. Collaborating with product line and functional teams, you will design, develop, and validate data-driven solutions as proofs of concept, directly informing strategic decisions on systematic implementation and ensuring our production methods are robust, agile, and future-proof.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Work with production leadership to develop and implement digital production strategies / solutions that enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve quality.

• Conduct detailed analysis of manufacturing data, including production metrics, process flow, and resource utilization, to identify areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of manufacturing strategies with overall business objectives.

• Monitor industry trends and best practices to keep our manufacturing processes at the cutting edge.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of production processes and strategies for continuous improvement.

• Lead and facilitate operational excellence initiatives to optimize production processes and operations.

• Provide strategic input into capacity planning and workforce management to ensure scalability of operations.

• Implement and refine production KPIs to measure performance and drive accountability.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Data Science, Software Engineering or related field. Master’s degree preferred (either MBA of MS of Engineering).

• 8 + years of experience and expertise developing insights and solutions using data visualization tools: SQL, DataBricks, PLTR Foundry, Python, Typescript, Tableau, PowerBI, MS VBA, etc...

• Understanding of data science and exposure to data pipelines such and Dagster, SQLmesh, etc...

• Proven experience in a production strategy or analysis role, with a track record of tangible insights and their implementations that drove results.

• Ability to quickly understand current operations and potential issues on the product line and can speak the language.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strength working with production leadership to conceptualize solutions and gain / understand requirements

• Familiarity with production software and advanced proficiency in statistical analysis and data presentation tools.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying complex information in an understandable manner.

• Experience with lean manufacturing principles and process improvement methodologies such as Six Sigma.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and lead cross-functional projects.

• Adept at managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Interim Trade Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
ALOHA Collection is a fast growing lifestyle brand that was born out of a love of travel, adventure and the ocean. This California based brand with Hawaiian roots located in Encinitas, CA focuses on travel accessories. Travel is our inspiration, the beach is our home.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Marketing department brings the ALOHA Collection brand to life through immersive brand experiences, meaningful community connections, and engaging retail initiatives.

ALOHA Collection is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive temporary Trade Marketing Specialist to support the execution of retail marketing initiatives, store openings, and outside events. This individual will be responsible for managing day-to-day event planning, coordinating cross-functional teams, overseeing vendor relationships, and ensuring that all retail marketing initiatives and events are executed successfully, on time, and within budget.

Reports to the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing, who owns day-to-day priorities and resource decisions. Partners with the Marketing Project Manager on creative workflow and provides leadership updates as requested. Vendor commitments, budget changes, and material changes to event scope require approval under ALOHA’s authorization guidelines.

The ideal candidate is a strong project manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable managing multiple priorities independently, and brings a hands-on approach to event execution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Retail Event Management & Store Openings

• Retail Marketing & Event Execution: Support the planning and execution of retail marketing initiatives, including seasonal promotions, product launches, brand collaborations, Gift with Purchase (GWP) campaigns, and customer engagement events under the strategic direction and approval of the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing.

• New Store Openings: Assist with the planning and execution of grand opening events, including event logistics, vendor coordination, creative needs, and cross-functional deliverables. The Senior Manager, Retail Marketing maintains overall ownership of the store opening process and approval of key event plans and decisions.

• Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing, Marketing Project Manager, Retail Operations, and Creative teams to coordinate project timelines, creative deliverables, event logistics, and execution, ensuring alignment across departments.

• Event Production & Print Deliverables: Coordinate the production of event signage, promotional materials, and print assets, ensuring timely approvals, production, and delivery in collaboration with Creative and Retail teams.

• Marketing Calendar & Event Documentation: Maintain retail marketing and event calendars, track key milestones and deadlines, and develop planning materials, including event one-sheets, decks, checklists, and run-of-shows.

• Retail & Internal Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for assigned retail marketing and event initiatives, communicating event details, responsibilities, timelines, and updates to retail leadership, store teams, and internal stakeholders.

Vendor Management & Event Logistics

• Vendor Coordination: Manage relationships with event vendors, production partners, printers, and external service providers.

• Event Logistics: Coordinate event equipment, shipping, inventory needs, staffing schedules, permits, insurance requirements, and other operational details.

• On-Site Event Management: Oversee event setup, execution, and breakdown, ensuring smooth operations and a positive customer experience.

• Event Staffing: Coordinate event staffing needs and provide clear instructions, schedules, and expectations to participating teams.

• Event Asset Management: Maintain and coordinate reusable event fixtures, signage, equipment, and activation materials.

• Problem Solving: Troubleshoot event-related challenges and proactively identify solutions to keep projects on schedule.

Creative, Marketing & Content Coordination

• Creative Requests & Production: Submit and manage event-related creative requests, including signage, invitations, promotional materials, and branded assets. Partner with the Marketing Project Manager to coordinate creative timelines, approvals, production, and delivery.

• Retail Signage & Deliverables: Support the coordination and production of retail signage and related deliverables under the direction and oversight of the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing, who maintains overall ownership of these initiatives.

• Event Marketing Support: Collaborate with Marketing and Social Media teams to coordinate event promotions, customer communications, and digital marketing needs.

• Content Support: Assist the Social Media team with on-site event content capture, including photography, video, and behind-the-scenes footage as needed.

• Community & Grassroots Event Support: Support the planning, coordination, and execution of grassroots marketing initiatives, local partnerships, and community events under the strategic direction and oversight of the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing. Assist with partner communication, event logistics, and on-site execution to strengthen local community engagement and brand awareness.

• Brand Consistency: Ensure all event materials, activations, and community initiatives align with ALOHA Collection's brand guidelines and established marketing strategies.

Budget Management & Event Reporting

• Event Budget Tracking: Manage and track approved event budgets, ensuring spending remains aligned with established allocations.

• Vendor Invoices & Payments: Coordinate vendor estimates, contracts, invoices, and payment requests with internal teams.

• Budget Reporting: Maintain accurate expense trackers and provide regular budget updates to Marketing leadership.

• Event Performance Reporting: Collect and report event metrics, including revenue, foot traffic, customer engagement, and email/SMS acquisition.

• Post-Event Recaps: Prepare event recap reports highlighting performance, key learnings, and opportunities for improvement.

• Leadership Communication: Provide regular project status updates, flag potential challenges, and communicate key decisions requiring leadership approval.

Temporary Coverage & Project Continuity

• Project Ownership: Takes ownership of assigned retail marketing and event projects during the maternity leave coverage period, ensuring continuity, timely execution, and alignment with established strategies under the guidance, oversight, and approval of the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing.

• Independent Execution: Manage day-to-day responsibilities independently while maintaining alignment with established marketing strategies and leadership direction from the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing.

• Project Prioritization: Balance multiple projects, deadlines, and event needs while proactively identifying and resolving challenges.

• Process Documentation: Maintain organized project files, vendor contacts, timelines, budgets, and event documentation to support a seamless transition.

• Leadership Alignment: Communicate regularly with the Senior Manager, Retail Marketing and relevant stakeholders regarding project progress, upcoming deadlines, and decisions requiring approval.

• Transition Support: Participate in onboarding and handoff processes before and after the coverage period to ensure continuity of responsibilities.

EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 2–4 years of experience in retail marketing, event planning, experiential marketing, or related roles. Experience in apparel, accessories, DTC retail, or consumer brands is preferred.

• Proven experience coordinating retail events, store openings, product launches, brand activations, and community initiatives.

• Experience managing event logistics, vendor coordination, print production, budgets, and on-site execution.

• Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Retail Operations, and external partners.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, project management tools (Asana preferred), and presentation software.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects, timelines, vendors, and deliverables at once.

• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, team-first approach.

• A proactive, detail-oriented, solutions-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently while following established strategies and leadership direction.

• A customer-focused perspective, with an understanding of brand consistency, retail experiences, and community engagement.

• The ability to quickly learn existing processes, take ownership of assigned projects, and maintain continuity throughout the temporary coverage period.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Willingness to travel to retail locations and event venues as needed.

• Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends based on event schedules.

• Comfortable supporting hands-on event setup, execution, and breakdown.

WHAT WE OFFER

From the start, our founders, Heather and Rachael, envisioned a company culture that was dynamic, intentional and sustainable. We provide education about Hawaiian culture and opportunities for personal and professional growth for every member of Team ALOHA. We believe in work-life balance and trust, which is why we offer flexible remote working options and show up with compassion when life’s unexpected moments arise. And if you haven’t heard, we LOVE working together!

Schedule

MAHALO!

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, Satellites (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. MECHANICAL DESIGN ENGINEER, SATELLITES (STARLINK)

As a member of the Starlink Production Design team you will design the factory of the future, enabling mass production of satellites, ground stations, and high-performance space hardware that has never been produced in volume. You will design custom tooling and machinery for production processes that range from manual to highly automated. You will use your expertise in mechanical engineering to design, analyze, fabricate, qualify, and commission structures, mechanism and automation equipment, optimizing for pace of execution and net impact to SpaceX. You will personally own high impact projects and drive them from concept to completion on a time scale measured in months, not years.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design and develop structures, mechanisms and automation equipment to enable high volume production of Starlink Satellites

• Demonstrate extreme ownership of projects through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept generation through fabrication and production bring-up

• Balance simultaneous projects of varying scope and complexity in a fast-paced environment

• Partner with flight design and production teams to develop the satellite, factory and production processes in parallel

• Solve complex, open-ended problems with an emphasis on speed of execution and efficiency

• Hone your organizational skills as you coordinate with internal SpaceX resources and external vendors and maintain a project schedule and budget

• Assemble and commission the equipment you design

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 5+ years of professional experience in Mechanical Engineering

• Prior experience designing mechanical systems using 3D CAD software and 2D drawings

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with custom machine design; electromechanical systems, motors, actuators, linear rails, bearings, lifting/rigging, etc.

• Ability to perform structures hand calculations

• Strong expertise in design for manufacturability and design for assembly including experience taking products from development to high-volume production

• Familiarity with drafting standards and the application of GD&T

• Solid understanding of common manufacturing processes and machines including mills, lathes, manual and CNC, and hands-on machining experience

jobs.title: Creative Director, Art
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Translation is an award-winning independent creative agency that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world.

We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges – at our best, we make what was once invisible unmissable.

As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone never could. What makes Translation’s work stand out is our ability to collaborate and create with individuals who don’t just consume “culture”, they’re a part of making it and living it every day.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence.

The Role

We are looking for a Creative Director (Art) to join Translation in our Brooklyn headquarters!

The ideal candidate is culturally fluent and creatively ambitious. They understand how culture moves, what’s happening now, what’s around the corner, and what has staying power.

At Translation, all of our Creative Directors (Art) lead the development of bold visual concepts, and
guide/mentor/manage creative teams on a given project. They proactively collaborate with strategy and context planning partners, as well as directly with clients, to ensure work is both creatively exceptional and strategically aligned.

Our CDs lead by example to consistently inspire creative colleagues to create world-class, pioneering ideas. They generate useful, usable ideas across all existing and emerging digital platforms – continually develop practices and processes to inspire, innovate, and harness new ways of thinking.

What You’ll Do

• Ensure the timely development and execution of multiple campaigns and projects that not only meet client objectives but are breakthrough ideas for the creative industry.

• Create distinction in crowded categories. Develop a clear creative vision for brands, products, and services that separates them from competitors and gives people a reason to care.

• Develop creative solutions that defend budget recommendations and measurement objectives to provide both profitable and quality work to our current and prospective clients.

• Display an industry-leading understanding and application of the principles that make innovative and effective campaigns

• Ensures the execution of high-quality work that is on time, on budget, and uses appropriate technology.

• Look beyond what's being asked to identify creative opportunities that can grow the brand, deepen its relevance, or create unexpected cultural impact.

• Serve as an arbiter of verbal and visual tone and craft for creative assignments for internal executive and external client review.

• Provide leadership and motivation, conveying the vision and values of the agency to staff.

• Train and supervise assigned creative teams

• Collaborate with the core leadership team on assigned accounts and projects to ensure alignment on creative recommendations and client opportunities.

• Maintain professional external relationships with production partners, freelance networks, agency partners, and others to ensure we’re sharing the agency POV across the industry and recruiting the right talent and partners

• Participate in the creation and presentation of client pitches and new business efforts, as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

You are results and bottom-line-oriented, yet possess deep appreciation and sensitivity towards people, culture, and values. You are persistent,  diplomatic, passionate, and optimistic, with a proactive, hands-on mentality. You hold yourself accountable and take great pride in your work – just like us. We’re proudly diverse in our backgrounds, our accents, and our fiercely held personal passions. We are, in every sense of the word, independent and not beholden to anyone else’s agenda. So are you.

• Ability to successfully lead, motivate, and mentor teams of creative talent (art and design) to create work that moves the cultural needle.

• Knowledge of the pre- and post-production process across formats and media.

• An understanding of the current landscape of creative advertising work in the market.

• Create conceptual platforms that visually tie both design and art direction together across media and the comms funnel.

• Strong aptitude for providing clear creative direction, career path guidance, and timely / helpful feedback that will improve creative processes, as well as keep work on budget and on schedule.

• Able to prioritize work and resources across engagements based on short- and long-term needs, timelines, and budgets.

• Possess and encourage high degrees of initiative, drive, empathy, accountability, creativity, and maturity.

• Demonstrate, evangelize, and live the core values of the agency.

• Incorporate the passion, excitement, and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of agency deliverables.

• Be able to move with the ebbs and flows of pitches, brainstorming sessions, and deadlines with agility, humor, and focus.

• Possess and demonstrate impeccable interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills across all levels of both internal and client organizations.

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience at an agency or similar creative organization

• Has held at least an Associate Creative Director title (or equivalent)

• A background with progressive experience in a client-facing, creative leadership role in a creative agency environment.

• Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office suite, Adobe Creative Suite as well knowledge of current A.I. tools and platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

• Training or degree in a directly related field, such as advertising, graphic design, commercial art, or web/digital design.

Salary Range: $205,000.00 - $240,000.00

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.
