jobs.title: Omnichannel Customer Support Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Program Manager for Customer Support Strategy, based on-site at our DFW1 facility in Lewisville, TX. Your focus is reducing ticket volume, claims, and contra revenue, and improving the merchant experience. You will do this by improving support processes, ops processes, and engineering, by gathering merchant feedback (starting with NPS) and working cross-functionally to turn it into changes merchants feel, and by keeping content current and owning merchant communications. AI strategy and Zendesk optimization are key levers along the way.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Strategy:

• Own omnichannel customer support programs from inception to execution, aligned to business goals and merchant needs.

• Develop strategies with cross-functional teams, incorporating stakeholder feedback and industry best practices.

• Drive implementation, overseeing timelines, resources, and budgets.

Ticket Reduction:

• Analyze ticket data to find the top contact drivers, size them by volume, handle time, and cost, and build a prioritized reduction roadmap with clear targets.

• Support processes: redesign workflows, macros, routing, and agent guidance so issues are resolved faster with fewer repeat contacts.

• Ops processes: work with operations and site teams to fix the upstream breakdowns that create tickets, such as inbound, inventory, order, and billing issues.

• Engineering: partner with engineering and product to prioritize and track the fixes and self-serve tools that remove root causes.

Merchant Experience and Feedback:

• Own the feedback program, starting with NPS and adding other channels such as post-ticket surveys, agent and account manager input, ticket themes, and direct merchant conversations.

• Analyze feedback themes and share insights with leadership and partners on a regular cadence.

• Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations to apply feedback to the merchant’s actual experience, track changes to completion, and close the loop with merchants.

Claims and Contra Revenue Management:

• Own the claims process end to end, including intake, investigation, resolution, and recovery from carriers and vendors where applicable.

• Manage and improve contra revenue (credits, refunds, reimbursements, and adjustments) by setting policies, approval thresholds, and controls, and partnering with finance on accurate tracking and reporting.

• Analyze claim and contra revenue drivers, and work with operations and engineering to fix root causes and reduce both over time.

Content and Merchant Communications:

• Keep all support content current and managed (help center, knowledge base, macros, internal guides, process documentation), with clear owners and review cadences.

• Own merchant communications, including notices, announcements, policy and process change letters, banners, and templates.

AI Strategy and Implementation:

• Build and own the roadmap for AI in support, focused on ticket reduction and merchant experience: agent assist, summarization, auto-categorization and routing, self-service and deflection, QA automation, and knowledge content.

• Evaluate vendors and models, run pilots with clear success criteria, and take proven use cases into production.

• Set guardrails for accuracy, human escalation, data privacy, and quality review, and lead training and change management for onsite and offshore teams.

Zendesk Management and Optimization:

• Own Zendesk configuration and governance: forms and fields, triggers, automations, macros, views, SLAs, routing, groups, and roles. Audit regularly and manage a clear change process.

• Manage integrations and reporting that turn Zendesk data into decisions, and turn agent pain points into workflow improvements.

Performance, Collaboration, and Stakeholders:

• Establish and track KPIs: ticket volume, tickets per order or merchant, repeat contact rate, handle time, first-contact resolution, CSAT, NPS, claims, contra revenue, and cost per ticket.

• Work closely with product, engineering, finance, and operations to integrate support initiatives into overall business operations.

• Give stakeholders at all levels regular updates on status, challenges, and opportunities.

• Continuously evaluate and refine programs based on feedback, industry trends, evolving merchant needs, and new AI capabilities.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, or related field.

• 5+ years of program management experience, preferably in customer support or a related role, with a proven record of delivering complex programs from concept to completion with measurable results.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel customer support principles, strategies, and technologies.

• Experience analyzing ticket, claims, or contact data to find root causes and reduce volume or cost, working with operations and engineering to fix them.

• Experience running or using a merchant or customer feedback program such as NPS, and turning insights into cross-functional changes.

• Strong writing skills, with experience owning customer communications and keeping support content current.

• Hands-on Zendesk administration experience (triggers, automations, macros, views, SLAs, reporting).

• Experience evaluating or implementing AI or automation in support, with a practical view of risks and limits.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Analytical mindset, able to use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

• Strong project management skills: prioritizing, managing timelines, and allocating resources.

• Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, adapting to changing priorities. A resilient, focused problem solver and self-starter who can multitask and prioritize in a complex and occasionally ambiguous environment.

Physical requirements:

• Must be able to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Must be willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.

• Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours.

• Must be able to work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud.

• Must be able to work in an environment where the temperature may vary between 60 and 90 degrees and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees.

Bonus Points

• Experience with SQL (Snowflake a plus), creating and running reports, or Zendesk Explore.

• Experience writing and testing prompts, or building knowledge content that AI tools draw on.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

Dirac is building the creative suite for manufacturing engineering. Manufacturing engineering has been underserved by fractured tooling. The work of defining how a product gets built is spread across process plans, MBOMs, routings, work instructions, spreadsheets, PLM configurations, ERP tables, and internal tools. Each artifact represents only part of the process, forcing engineers to rebuild context whenever a design changes.

BuildOS brings these workflows together in one environment. Manufacturing engineers author, version, review, and distribute the Build—the canonical definition of how a product is produced.

About the Role

Our customers build aircraft, spacecraft, defense systems, ships, energy equipment, and heavy machinery. You'll own features end to end, from the services underneath to the tools manufacturing engineers use every day. The work spans backend, frontend, and 3D, and most of it starts with a real customer problem.

We want engineers who take a problem from vague to shipped, find the root cause before the fix, and use AI tools well while owning the result.

What You'll Work On

Depending on your strengths, you might work on:

• Turning CAD models into structured, versioned manufacturing data

• An authoring experience manufacturing engineers live in all day

• Interactive 3D in the browser for assemblies with thousands of parts

• AI that drafts work instructions and helps engineers plan a build

• Integrations with the enterprise systems manufacturers already run

• Secure deployments for aerospace and defense customers

Our Stack

Go, TypeScript and React, Rust and WebAssembly, Python and C++, on AWS and Azure. You don't need experience with all of it.

Requirements

• Strong in Go or TypeScript, and willing to work in the other; able to read Rust, Python, or C++ when a bug leads there

• Experience building backend services with typed APIs (protobuf/gRPC or similar) on top of a relational database

• Experience building non-trivial React frontends with real state management

• You debug from evidence: logs, a reproduction, and the root cause before the fix

• You check your own work in the running app, not just in passing tests

• You use AI coding agents every day and review their output as hard as a colleague's

• Clear, concise writing in design notes, PR descriptions, and tickets

• You've built something, at work or not, and can explain it in conversation

Nice to Have

• CAD, 3D graphics, or computational geometry

• Rust, WebAssembly, or GPU programming

• Integrations with enterprise systems such as PLM, ERP, or MES

• Shipping LLM-based features to production

• Cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes

• Security or compliance work in regulated industries

• A background in manufacturing, aerospace, or defense

How We Work

• Own it end to end. You take work from the first customer conversation to proof that it works in the product.

• Learn the user. You'll work with the manufacturing engineers who use what you build, and sometimes spend time on their factory floors.

• High trust, high agency. If something needs doing, you do it.

• AI-native. We build with AI tools every day and hold their output to the same bar as our own.

• Fix it once. When we catch a mistake, we fix it and make sure it can't happen again.

Compensation

Base: $120,000 - $200,000 + Equity

Location

Fully in person at our NYC office in the Empire State Building (350 5th Ave). Relocation assistance is available.

New York Pay Range

$120,000—$200,000 USD

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dirac is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Dirac is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Eligibility

Employment is restricted to U.S. Persons as defined by ITAR (22 CFR § 120.62)

Benefits:

- Health, Dental, Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure you and your family stay healthy.
- Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy flexible, high-trust PTO and sick leave.
- Stock Options: Participate in our success with a generous stock option plan.
- Commuter Benefits (NYC): Save on transportation costs with our commuter benefits program.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Render's mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works.

We're evolving from the go-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast-scaling teams. Our brand has to evolve with us. Developers already love Render for how it feels to use; now the brand needs to carry that same clarity and confidence everywhere else: on our site, in our campaigns, on a conference floor, and in every launch we put into the world.

As Brand Designer, you'll be a core maker on the brand team. You'll take briefs and turn them into sharp, finished work across campaigns, launches, events, and everyday brand moments. You'll contribute ideas in concept development, own projects from first sketch to final files, and help keep the brand system consistent as it grows. You'll work closely with senior brand designers and creative leads, with plenty of room to take on bigger projects as you grow.

What makes this work hard and interesting: developers are a famously skeptical audience. They can spot marketing gloss from a mile away, and they reward brands that are honest, specific, and a little bit delightful. Great brand work here has to earn attention from people who don't want to be sold to. That takes real craft and a good sense of what engineers find genuine.

You'll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep collaboration with marketing, product, and engineering. You'll thrive here if you love making things, care deeply about the details, and want to grow your craft alongside people who will push you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Create high-craft graphic design across the brand. Design key visuals, web and social assets, ads, presentations, print, and merch. Typography, layout, color, and composition are your everyday tools, and you'll bring care to every piece, no matter how small.

 - Contribute to concept development. Join brainstorms and creative explorations with a steady stream of ideas. You'll sketch directions, build out options, and help the team find the concept that best fits the brief, then refine it until it's ready to ship.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience contributing to concepts. You can show how you've helped shape an idea, not just execute one: the sketches, the explorations, and how your thinking moved the work forward.

 - Campaign and launch work. You've designed assets for campaigns or product launches across digital, social, and print, and you know how to keep an idea consistent across many formats.

 - Some event or physical design experience. You've designed for print production, signage, booths, or merch, and you understand what it takes to get files ready for the real world.

 - Comfort working within a brand system. You can work fluently inside an established identity and know when to stretch it thoughtfully.

 - Curiosity about developers. You don't need a technical background, but you're interested in how developers think and what kind of brand they trust.

 - Ownership and reliability. You manage your own projects, hit deadlines, and know when to ask for direction. You take feedback well and use it to make the work better.

NICE-TO-HAVES

jobs.title: Senior Nursing Learning Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Stepful:



Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.


Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.


Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.


Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-55m-series-c-to-scale-its-ai-powered-training-platform-across-the-healthcare-workforce. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025 https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list.



Our values:



We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

 - Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

 - Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.

 - Build together: We win when we rely on each other.

 - Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.



The opportunity:

Stepful is seeking a Senior Nursing Learning Program Manager to lead curriculum development and content delivery across existing and new healthcare education programs. This role will combine hands-on clinical nursing experience with expertise in healthcare learning to help Stepful graduate competent, confident, and compassionate practice-ready healthcare workers. 



Two particular areas of focus include 1) improving the quality of clinical learning, including virtual and in-person simulation, preceptorships, and supervised practice, and 2) integrating content and learning methodologies that improves graduates’ performance, resilience, and retention in clinical work. The role oversees content-development projects, leads curriculum developers and subject matter experts, strengthens educational quality, and uses evidence and learner data to improve outcomes as Stepful grows.



This hybrid role is based out of our NYC office (in-office T, W, Th) and reports to our VP of Learning.



What you’ll do:

1. Core Learning Responsibilities

 - Oversee end-to-end clinical curriculum and content-development projects, from needs assessment and design through development, review, implementation, and revision. Curricula will include both nursing and other healthcare professionals.

 - Manage improvements to existing programs and the successful launch of new programs; maintain clear workplans, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.

 - Lead and coordinate curriculum developers and clinical subject matter experts; set priorities, provide feedback, and ensure timely, high-quality work.

 - Translate clinical workflows and complex technical content into accurate, practical, accessible learning experiences for adult learners.
   
   

2. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Business Growth

 - Partner with Operations, Student Success, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to align learning content with learner needs, program delivery, and health system requirements.

 - Provide clinical and educational expertise for new program development, health system proposals, and expansion opportunities as appropriate.

 - Design for efficient development, consistent implementation, and scalable delivery while maintaining the highest educational quality.
   
   

3. Educational Quality and Innovation

 - Establish and maintain content quality-control processes covering clinical accuracy, currency, assessment alignment, accessibility, and consistency across programs, and work with program and compliance leaders to meet applicable educational, regulatory, accreditation, certification, and health system expectations.

 - Use Stepful’s Learning Quality Scorecard, learner engagement, competency, confidence, and completion data, and feedback from learners and educators to find where programs need to improve, then prioritize and put those improvements in place.

 - Pilot and evaluate evidence-based learning approaches and delivery methods, including online learning, skills labs, simulation, and blended experiences, and document and share what works so other programs can adopt it.
   
   

4. Thought Leadership and Representation

 - Contribute clinical and educational expertise to Stepful’s external presentations, webinars, professional forums, and publications as relevant to the role.

 - Develop constructive relationships with clinical educators, professional organizations, and health system partners; represent Stepful professionally.
   
   

5. Team and Professional Development

 - Build a collaborative, accountable team culture; coach curriculum developers and subject matter experts and share practical expertise.

 - Promote ongoing professional learning and feedback, and support the development of team members under direct supervision where applicable.



What you’ll bring:

 - Hands-on clinical experience as a Registered Nurse (RN) in an inpatient or outpatient setting. Your RN license does not need to be currently active.

 - Professional experience developing, delivering, managing, or evaluating education or training in a healthcare delivery setting, such as a hospital, health system, clinic, community health organization, or other care setting.

 - 5+ years of experience in program management, curriculum development, instructional design, clinical education, or related learning functions.

 - Experience managing end-to-end learning content development and collaborating with clinical subject matter experts.

 - Working knowledge of instructional design, adult learning, and online or blended education.

 - Strong project leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, with demonstrated use of data to improve learning.

 - Adaptability, sound judgment, and ability to execute effectively in a fast-moving organization.



Bonus points if:

 - You have or have had an academic appointment.

 - You have worked in education technology or developed online/virtual learning programs.

 - You have formally managed curriculum developers, instructional designers, or clinical educators.

 - You have designed or evaluated skills labs, clinical simulation, or competency-based assessments.



Interview Process:

 - Introductory call with Talent Acquisition team member

 - Interview with Hiring Manager

 - Take-Home Assignment

 - Virtual Panel Interview

 - On-Site Panel Interview

 

Benefits and Compensation:

 - Meaningful Equity Stake

 - Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plan options

 - 401(k)

 - FSA, HSA and commuter benefits

 - Learning stipend

 - Open vacation policy, including:
   
   - Guidance of 15 days PTO annually
   
   - Stepful closed the last week of December
   
   - 15 work-from-anywhere days
   
   - 10 public holidays observed for 2026

 

The target base salary range for this opportunity is $115,000 - $130,000, and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, internal pay equity and other relevant business considerations.

 

Please note we do not have a bonus structure at this time so all cash compensation will come in the form of base salary. The total compensation package will also include our benefits package and an equity (ISOs) package.



Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @stepful.com email address to guide you through our interview process.

jobs.title: Staff Brand Designer
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Render's mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works.

We're evolving from the go-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast-scaling teams. Our brand has to evolve with us. Developers already love Render for how it feels to use; now the brand needs to carry that same clarity and confidence everywhere else: on our site, in our campaigns, on a conference floor, and in every launch we put into the world.

As Staff Brand Designer, you'll set the creative direction for how Render looks, sounds, and shows up. You'll take ideas from a blank page to a shipped campaign, build the visual system that holds it all together, and raise the craft bar for everyone who touches the brand. This is a senior IC role with real scope: you'll own work end to end, shape brand strategy alongside marketing leadership, and lead by example through the quality of what you make.

What makes this work hard and interesting: developers are a famously skeptical audience. They can spot marketing gloss from a mile away, and they reward brands that are honest, specific, and a little bit delightful. Great brand work here has to earn attention from people who don't want to be sold to. That means ideas with real substance, design with genuine craft, and a voice that respects how engineers think.

You'll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep collaboration with marketing, product, and engineering. You'll thrive here if you love building ideas from scratch, can move between big concepts and pixel-level detail in the same day, and want your work to define how a generation of developers sees Render.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the creative direction for Render's brand. Define and evolve how Render looks and feels across every touchpoint: website, launches, social, ads, swag, events, and beyond. You'll hold the vision and make sure every expression of the brand feels like it came from the same confident, thoughtful place.

 - Lead concept development from blank page to big idea. You'll generate, pressure-test, and sell creative concepts that are smart, specific, and unmistakably Render. You know how to explore widely, narrow fast, and articulate why an idea works, not just how it looks.

 - Own campaigns end to end. From brand moments to product launches to integrated campaigns, you'll shape the creative platform, design the key visuals, and extend them across channels and formats. You'll partner with marketing on goals and messaging, then bring the idea to life with craft and consistency.

 - Bring the brand to life in physical space. Design event experiences for conferences, meetups, booths, and Render-hosted gatherings, from environmental graphics and signage to merch and print. You'll make Render the booth developers go out of their way to visit.

 - Push graphic design craft to its highest level. Typography, layout, color, illustration, iconography, and art direction are your core tools. You'll produce work that other designers study, and you'll sweat the details that make it feel inevitable.

 - Build and steward the brand system. Evolve our visual identity, guidelines, templates, and asset libraries so that the brand scales with the company. You'll make it easy for others to do great on-brand work without you in the room.

 - Art direct and collaborate with outside partners. When the work calls for it, you'll brief and direct illustrators, photographers, motion studios, and agencies, keeping the output sharp and true to the brand.

 - Raise the bar across the team. As a Staff designer, you'll lead through your work and your feedback. You'll mentor other designers, contribute a strong point of view in weekly critiques, and help define what great brand work means at Render.

 - Partner across the company. Brand lives at the intersection of marketing, product, engineering, and leadership. You'll communicate clearly, align stakeholders around creative direction, and make the case for bold, considered work inside business conversations.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of brand and graphic design experience, including time leading creative direction for a brand, campaign, or major launch. We care more about the impact and quality of your work than your title, but you've operated at a senior level and set the direction others follow.

 - World-class graphic design craft. You have a deep command of typography, layout, color, and composition, and an eye for detail that borders on obsessive. Your portfolio shows work that other designers admire and that holds up at every scale, from a social tile to a 20-foot banner.

 - A track record of concept development. You can show the thinking behind the work: how you got from a brief to an idea, the directions you explored, and why the final concept was the right one. You're as strong with ideas as you are with execution.

 - Campaign experience across channels. You've led integrated campaigns from creative platform to final assets, across digital, social, out-of-home, print, and video. You know how to build an idea that flexes across formats without losing its spine.

 - Event and physical brand experience. You've designed for real-world spaces, such as conference booths, environmental graphics, signage, print, or merch, and you understand how brand translates when people can walk around it.

 - Brand systems thinking. You've built or evolved a visual identity and know how to create guidelines, templates, and tools that let a brand scale without getting diluted.

 - A genuine interest in developer culture. You don't need to write code, but you're curious about how developers think, what they respect, and what makes them roll their eyes. Experience designing for a technical audience is a strong plus.

 - Strong creative judgment and the ability to prioritize. You know when to go big and when to ship something simple and sharp. You can balance a long-term brand vision with the realities of a fast-moving company.

 - Clear, persuasive communication. You can present and defend creative work to leadership, give and receive candid feedback, and collaborate generously with marketing, product, and engineering partners.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Animation and motion design. You can bring a brand to life in motion, whether that's animated logos, launch videos, social motion, or kinetic type. Experience with tools like After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, or Lottie is a plus.

 - Interactive design and experiences. You've designed interactive web moments, launch microsites, playful experiments, or installations that invite people to engage rather than just look.

 - Comfort near code. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, WebGL, creative coding, or prototyping tools that help you build and test interactive ideas yourself.

 - Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure, or technical company. You've seen what resonates with engineers and what falls flat.

 - Illustration or 3D skills that expand what the brand can do in-house.

 - Curiosity about AI-assisted design and how new tools can speed up exploration without lowering the bar.

 - Writing, talks, or side projects that show your craft and point of view.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 4 weeks of paid vacation.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

jobs.title: Precision Cleaning Technician II - C Shift
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

PRECISION CLEANING TECHNICIAN II - C SHIFT

Based out of Rocket Lab Headquarters in Long Beach, California the Precision Cleaning Technician II will work with various fluid systems and sub-assembly components for the Rutherford and Archimedes Rocket engines.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO

• Based out of Rocket Headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Precision Cleaning Technician is responsible for cleaning machined flight hardware components and assemblies.

• All major components of the Rutherford rocket engine are 3D printed including; thrust chamber, injectors, main valves and pump parts. Remaining parts are machined from raw material or procured externally.

• Position requires a high-level of attention to detail.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of experience in precision cleaning in aerospace industry.

• Experienced in precision cleaning, ultrasonic cleaners, degreasers, oxygen cleaning and clean room methodology/practices.

• Experience bagging parts and creating labels accordingly.

• Experience working in a cleanroom.

• Ultrasonic Cleaning Tanks

• NVR (non-volatile residue).

• Particle Part Testing.

• Experience in the aerospace industry

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience working under pressure and to tight deadlines.

• Computer literate, able to follow instructions and record day to day activities.

• Highly organized with faultless attention to detail.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willing to work C Shift (Friday - Sunday 5:00am - 3:30pm)

• Stand and walk extended periods ( 8+ hours) on production floor

• Perform repetitive motions including grasping, bending, twisting, reaching, pushing, and pulling

• Operate equipment and controls requiring manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination

• Lift, carry, push, and pull materials up to 25 lbs.

• Work in a production environment with noise, moving machinery, and varying environmental conditions

• Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$25—$35 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter, GTM
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRINC:

At BRINC, we are building the technology that will define the future of emergency response. As a vertically integrated U.S. drone technology company, BRINC designs and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems, autonomous drone stations, command-and-control software, and advanced autonomy for public safety. Today, BRINC deploys Drone as First Responder (DFR) networks that dispatch drones directly to 911 calls, providing real-time aerial intelligence before ground units arrive and helping first responders make faster, safer decisions. BRINC serves more than 1,000 public safety customers across all 50 states, is the sole drone supplier to Motorola Solutions, and has raised more than $280 million from leading strategic and technology investors, including Motorola Solutions, Index Ventures, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, and others. BRINC is recruiting exceptional engineers to build the next generation of autonomous emergency-response technology, including flight-critical firmware and advanced pilot-assistance capabilities.

About this Role:
As a Senior GTM Recruiter, you’ll own the end-to-end hiring process across BRINC’s go-to-market organization, including Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Sales Operations, Area Sales Managers, Marketing, and GTM leadership. You’ll partner closely with sales and marketing leaders to develop hiring strategies, provide market insights, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. You’ll proactively source top revenue talent, manage pipelines, and continuously improve recruiting processes to help us scale our GTM team efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Own the full-cycle recruitment process for GTM roles, including sourcing, interviewing, running debriefs, negotiating offers, and HR handoff.

 - Evaluate sales acumen, quota attainment and track record, cultural/behavioral fit, and alignment with BRINC’s mission of serving public safety.

 - Partner with executives, sales leaders, and hiring managers to deeply understand GTM hiring needs and provide insights on market trends, compensation (OTE/variable pay), and talent availability.

 - Lead strategic initiatives to improve our GTM talent acquisition process, including diversity hiring, employer branding within the sales and public safety communities, and candidate experience.

 - Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of high-caliber sales, customer success, and marketing talent for both immediate needs and future territory and team expansion.

 - Leverage data to track and report key recruitment metrics, ensuring GTM hiring targets are met in line with revenue and territory plans.

 - Collaborate closely with the People Operations and Sales Operations teams to support headcount planning, territory coverage, and onboarding/ramp.

 - Adapt to a fast-paced, hyper-growth culture

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting sales and GTM functions (AEs, CSMs, Sales Ops, ASMs, Marketing, and Sales Leadership), ideally in a hyper-growth startup environment.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Asset Movements Operations team at Robinhood is dedicated to offering fast, safe, and secure execution of customer requests such as wires, checks, and internal account transfers. As a critical pillar of Robinhood's brokerage business model, our team focuses on risk management and operational accuracy to support the firm's growth. We collaborate with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to troubleshoot complex issues and ensure seamless processing. Our culture thrives on teamwork, continuous improvement, and a shared dedication to protecting our customers' assets. Together, we are building the future of retail brokerage operations!

As an Asset Movements Operations Specialist, you will play a central role in executing daily financial transactions with precision and resolving customer requests. In this position, you will be accountable for high-priority wire, check, and journal processing while identifying operational inefficiencies. You will collaborate with project and operations teams to launch and scale Robinhood's electronic financial products. Your analytical skills will be key in mitigating money movement risks and safeguarding customer and firm assets. This is an exciting opportunity to help build our brokerage infrastructure and grow your career with us!

This role is based in our Denver, CO or Westlake, TX office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week (Wednesday, Thursday and Friday).

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Process high-priority transactions, including wires, checks, journals, and bank-linking, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.

• Evaluate and manage money movement risks from both a customer and firm perspective to mitigate financial losses.

• Collaborate with project and operations teams to test, launch, and scale retail brokerage products and operational systems.

• Develop and document operational processes and procedures to improve efficiency and maintain compliance standards.

• Serve as a subject matter expert in asset movements, collaborating with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to resolve complex customer issues.

What you bring

• A Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), along with 4+ years of experience in brokerage operations or financial services.

• Active FINRA Series 7 license; an active FINRA Series 24 license is preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies, propose concrete solutions, and manage operational risk.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex operational and compliance concepts clearly.

• Exceptional attention to detail, deep knowledge of banking operation standards, and advanced familiarity with securities industry compliance policies.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors. We've grown 20x from $5M to $100M+ in annualized revenue run rate in under two years, reaching a $1.5B+ valuation.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, San Antonio Spurs, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

We are hiring our first in-house finance leader focused on FP&A. You will report directly to a Founder and be the person who builds how Retell AI plans, forecasts, and measures the business as we scale. This is a hands-on role with real influence on pricing, hiring, and investment decisions, and the finance foundation you build now will carry the company through its next stage of growth.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITY

This hire owns Retell AI's financial planning and analysis end to end: the plan, the forecast, and the numbers leadership uses to make decisions.

 - Build and run the annual plan, rolling forecast, and operating model covering revenue, usage-based gross margin, headcount, and cash.

 - Run the monthly business review: explain what changed versus plan, why it changed, and what we should do about it.

 - Partner with the Founder and leaders across Sales, Product, and Engineering on pricing, unit economics, hiring plans, and where to invest next.

 - Define and report the core metrics (ARR, net revenue retention, gross margin, burn, CAC payback) and prepare board and investor materials.

 - Set up the finance foundation: planning tools, reporting cadence, and clean data, working with our accounting and tax partners.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 5+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, or corporate finance, ideally at a high-growth software or usage-based business.

 - Advanced financial modeling skills, including scenario analysis and driver-based forecasting.

 - Experience working directly with founders or executives and presenting to a board or investors.

 - Comfort with data. You can pull and analyze numbers yourself using SQL or BI tools, not just spreadsheets.

 - Comfort being a first hire: you are happy to be hands-on and build from scratch.

 

Nice to have:

 - Experience at a venture-backed company through a fundraise.

 - Familiarity with usage-based pricing and infrastructure or AI inference costs.

 - Background in investment banking, consulting, or a top finance team before moving to a startup.

 


HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Modeling quality: accurate, clear, and built so others can use it.

 - Judgment: turning messy numbers into a clear recommendation.

 - Ownership under ambiguity: moving forward without a playbook.

 - Communication: explaining finance to non-finance leaders in plain language.

 


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You would rather ship a working v1 model this week than a perfect one next quarter.

 - You like being close to business and talking with sales, product, and engineering every day.

 - You enjoy building systems and processes where none exist yet.

 


JOB DETAILS

Location: Redwood City, California (Relocation support provided)

US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT).

 


COMPENSATION

Our compensation ranges reflect different scopes of responsibility and cash/equity options. Your offer will depend on the skills and impact you demonstrate during interviews, the scope of the role, and your preferred cash/equity balance.

Annual base salary ranges:

 - Senior: $150,000–$190,000

 - Staff: $170,000–$210,000

 - Principal: $210,000 - $270,000




OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement

 


COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - Best offer upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed

 - Top 1% talent: Above-market pay (top 5th percentile) to attract exceptional builders

 - High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity

 - Performance-based: Offers tied to interview performance, not tenure or past salary

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

jobs.title: Associate Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE

DEPT® is looking for an Associate Director, Growth Marketing, Americas, who treats marketing as part of the commercial engine, not a separate function. Someone who can connect marketing, sales, CRM, data, and AI into one system – and prove it with real results.

You’ll:

• Take our Americas growth plan and turn it into a working, measurable growth machine.

• Focus less on filling the top of the funnel and more on creating and accelerating opportunities with the right accounts.

• Work with a lean budget rather than relying on massive paid demand.

• Design a robust ABM program, activating email, content, partners and events against a priority audience.

You’ll report to the VP, Marketing, Americas.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Integrated Growth Strategy: Design and implement a marketing strategy that connects all the dots – aligning marketing, sales, CRM, data, business development and AI into a single pipeline engine driving qualified opportunities. Be able to sell that strategy to stakeholders and peers of all levels.

Execute the Growth Plan: Activate DEPT®’s Americas growth plan. Target our ideal customer profiles in key verticals and use strategic partnerships and events to convert high-value prospects into our pipeline.

Break Down Silos: Work closely with sales and client teams to ensure marketing and business development operate in sync, sharing insights and aligning on goals instead of working in silos.

Build Relationships: Nurture relationships with prospective clients and partners through content, events, and personal outreach – turning trust and engagement into tangible new business opportunities.

Data-Driven Optimization: Leverage our tech stack (Salesforce, Pardot, and Dreamdata) to track performance and optimize marketing investments around revenue goals. You’ll monitor what’s working, double down on the best channels, and pivot quickly based on data insights.

Scrappy Demand Generation: Drive demand with creative, high-impact tactics rather than big budgets – think thought leadership content, targeted campaigns, smart automation, and ABM, all designed to deliver results without heavy paid spend.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience & Expertise

• 7–10+ years in growth, demand, or performance marketing in B2B (ideally tech, SaaS, digital, or consulting).

• Strong grasp of paid media and ABM (especially LinkedIn and targeted syndication), but you don’t rely on big budgets to make an impact.

• You’ve owned a number (pipeline and/or revenue) and can show how your work moved accounts through the funnel, not just how many MQLs you generated.

• Proven track record of turning strategy into execution – building integrated programs that connect campaigns, CRM, content, partners, and sales into one system that converts.

• Hands-on with Salesforce and Pardot for CRM and marketing automation, plus Dreamdata (or similar) for planning and measuring what actually drives revenue.

• Deep experience with pipeline analytics, forecasting, and attribution – you know how to read the numbers and the limits of the models.

• Practical experience using AI in workflows – for research, targeting, personalization, creative variations, and outreach – with a clear view of where it improves conversion or speed.

• Experience working across functions (Sales, Growth, Partnerships, Brand, RevOps) and managing agencies or contractors to drive one coherent GTM, not disconnected activities.

• Experience navigating GDPR is a plus.

Characteristics & Ways of Working

• You care how opportunities show up in the forecast and constantly test, learn, and refine based on results.

• You naturally break down silos between marketing, sales, CRM, and partners, and get people aligned around a simple plan.

• You’re comfortable when things aren’t fully defined and can build structure, priorities, and next steps without waiting for perfect inputs.

• You explain complex ideas simply – in writing, slides, and live – and you’re not afraid to push back when something won’t move the needle.

• You can zoom out to shape strategy and zoom in to help write a sequence, fix a dashboard, or tune a targeting list.

• You know how to build trust, influence, and momentum with distributed teams across time zones.

• You have strong follow-through, attention to detail, and a bias for finishing things and getting them into market rather than endlessly iterating.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our  benefits package:

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401k plan, plus matching

• PTO

• Paid Company Holidays

• Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work.  Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you  to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Willingness and ability to travel 25%+ regionally within Latin America and periodically to global headquarters as business needs require

Bonus points if you have

• Experience directly within the Observability, APM, or log analytics industry.

• Familiarity with Generative AI application development, AI observability, and agentic AI technology stacks.

Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 6,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Analyst, Technical Customer Manager - FSI

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization.  You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You'll Find Success

You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

How You’ll Grow

• Master advanced technical implementation: You will develop deep, hands-on expertise in the Qualtrics platform, evolving into a trusted technology advisor who leads medium and large-scale enterprise software implementations.

• Elevate your executive influence and consulting skills: You will build strong relationships with senior customer program owners and decision-makers, honing your ability to shape strategic feedback programs and guide large, complex organizations through business transformations.

• Develop commercial and portfolio leadership: By proactively monitoring account health and defining expansion strategies, you will move beyond standard project execution to directly drive portfolio performance, value realization, and account growth.

• Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.

Things You'll Do

• Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities

• Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance

• Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution

• Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health

What We're Looking For On Your Resume

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.

• Technical Aptitude: High interest in learning the Qualtrics platform and new technologies and deployment of technical expertise with customers at scale

• Consulting & Program Management: Proven ability to plan and execute multiple concurrent projects on time and budget, with a blend of consulting and internal-customer experience. Collaborating with project managers, consultants, architects and product teams to support delivery of specific outcomes

• Customer Engagement: Ability to lead workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, utilise data and metrics to communicate understanding and produce high quality customer facing documentation

• Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build relationships with senior customer program owners and decision makers

• Industry Experience: Good understanding of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management in one or more specific industries.

• Entrepreneurial spirit: High tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, to understand business needs and to communicate and present to Senior Management effectively.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or business-related field.

• Willingness to Travel: Able to travel up to 25% to engage with clients and teams.

What You Should Know About This Team

Key Responsibilities

Help Customers Grow

• Build and maintain strong customer stakeholder relationships to deeply understand the context, ambition and strategic business goals for the customers within your portfolio Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps Monitor customer health, platform utilisation and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

Provide Technical & Execution Expertise

• Develop and maintain technical competence on the Qualtrics platform, ensuring a deep understanding of the leading indicators of customer adoption, ACV retention and value realisation Utilize experience and best practices in order to understand the customer and communicate effectively how the Qualtrics platform will support the delivery of value driving outcomes and enhance their program Lead specific project implementations for new customers to your portfolio and existing customers; including cross functional / cross team project teams consisting of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors, with the objective to deliver on project goals and objectives Conduct regular risk planning, monitoring, mitigation and reporting to stakeholders both during project delivery and account lifecycle

Demonstrate Operational Rigor

• Execute implementation and account management activities in accordance with global standard practices, ensuring rigorous account and project tracking and proactive risk and issue management Ensure all project and account documentation and artefacts are developed, maintained Stay current with product and strategic customer journey enhancements

Key Success Measures

For customer accounts within your portfolio over a 12 month period:

Customer Value

• Net ARR Customer adoption and maturity of customer account Customer satisfaction and advocacy

Successful Execution

• Billable Utilization attainment Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone) Time to Deliver new capabilities for customers in your portfolio Rigorous scope management measured by level of Variance on Completion (VAC) of specific project deliverables

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.

• Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement.

• Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Competitive matching company contributions to help secure your financial future.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Role Summary

The UAV Aircraft Assembler II independently assembles aircraft structures and systems within a defined production scope while maintaining quality and schedule expectations. Tasks and responsibilities expected for this role include those captured by lower role specific levels.

This role involves working closely with engineers, production technicians, and operations teams to support multiple programs and value streams.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assemble aircraft structures and sub-assemblies to released engineering drawings.

• Perform drilling, reaming, fastening, torquing, and sealing operations independently.

• Install production-released mechanical and system components.

• Route and secure tubing, hoses, and cables per defined standards.

• Conduct in-process inspections and identify non-conformances.

• Maintain accurate as-built documentation and part traceability via MES.

• Execute standard work to meet takt time and schedule requirements.

Responsibilities (Level I):

• Assemble basic aircraft components and sub-assemblies using released work instructions.

• Perform drilling, fastening, and hardware installation using approved tools.

• Install basic brackets, panels, and structural components.

• Follow torque, sealant, and bonding procedures as directed.

• Perform visual self-inspection of completed work.

• Accurately complete work instructions and required production documentation.

• Maintain FOD, safety, and quality standards.

• Support senior assemblers as assigned.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 1–3 years of aircraft/aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience.

• Proficient in reading drawings, work instructions, and torque requirements.

• Comfortable working independently in a production environment.

• Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Technical training or equivalent

$23—$27 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!
