jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Faith & Strategy
jobs.description:
About Pushpay

Pushpay exists to serve the Church. We build software that helps faith communities manage generosity, connect members, and focus on what matters most: ministry. As we deepen our commitment to the churches we serve, we are looking for a Senior Product Manager who brings world-class product craft and an authentic understanding of how church life actually runs, someone who sees this work as more than a job.

About the Role

Our core church portfolio is where most of our customers live, and the value they get from it is the heart of our business. As Senior Product Manager, Faith & Strategy, you will make sure that value is real.

You will be pointed at the highest-impact opportunities across the portfolio, and your focus will shift as our priorities do. One season it might be a workflow churches struggle to adopt. The next, a part of the product where satisfaction is slipping. You will ship the work that moves those outcomes, and you will leave the team better at it than you found them.

This role is for someone who is a church operations expert and a product leader at once. You can walk into an unfamiliar area, find what matters, build the case, and ship it. Success is not about controlling a roadmap. It is about earning the trust and building the clarity of argument that gets the right work shipped, and keep the real needs of churches at the center of decisions made by teams with broader mandates.

This is not a first step into product management. We’re looking for someone who has already shipped products customers use and value, and wants to do it where it matters.

Named as one of BuiltIn ‘Best Places to Work’ in Seattle, Denver and Dallas for 2025; ranked number 10 by Seattle Business Magazine in the ‘Washington’s 100 Best Companies to Work For’ list in the large companies category for 2024; named as a 2025 'Best Places to Work for Women' by Best Companies Group.

Benefits and Compensation

We have a passion for making all employees feel supported. In addition to having a genuine interest in helping you do your best work and drive your career, we offer:

• 100% employer-paid premiums for Medical HDHP Plan, Dental, and Vision for employee

• 70% employer-paid premiums for Medical PPO Plan for employees, and Medical, Dental, and Vision for dependents

• 401K match

• Hybrid work model - 3 days in the office / 2 days remote each week: COS area only

• Remote: All other approved locations

• 12 paid Company Holidays

• 2 paid Volunteer Time Off days

• 20 days PTO to start, increases with tenure and seniority.

• Paid parental and adoption leave

• Compensation Range: $106k - $137k, depending on location.

Compensation ranges are determined by role and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The following states are approved as remote work locations for this position: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA - All other states are not in consideration for this role at this time.

What You'll Do

• Ship Where the Value Is: Take ownership of high-priority problems and opportunities across the portfolio, from discovery through launch and adoption. Ramp quickly in new workflow areas, form a point of view in weeks, and get product into customers’ hands.

• Be the Voice of the Church: Apply deep knowledge of church operations to product decisions from day one. Use targeted discovery with pastors, administrators, and volunteer leaders to validate direction and surface nuance across church size, governance, weekly rhythms, and seasons.

• Read the Signals: Watch adoption, retention, NPS, and CSat across the portfolio. Spot trends before they show up as churn, turn them into clear recommendations, and help teams act on them.

• Set the Standard for PM Craft: Model strong product habits: sharp problem statements, outcome-based success measures, honest retros. Coach other PMs and share what works, so how we decide and deliver keeps getting better.

• Navigate and Influence the Portfolio: Work across product domains, Engineering, and UX to make sure church needs are understood, prioritized, and delivered, including where AI can reduce friction or surface insight. Build trust, make the business case, and know when to escalate.

• Responsible AI: Champion a “Human-in-the-Loop” approach that reduces administrative burden without replacing pastoral judgment or the personal relationships at the heart of church life. Ensure every AI feature honors the privacy and trust churches place in us.

• Market Advocacy: Help Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing explain Pushpay’s value in language that resonates with pastors and church administrators. Show up at key church conferences and customer events as a credible product voice.

How We'll Measure Success

In your first 12 months:

• Product Shipped & Adopted: Meaningful product delivered in each area you’re assigned, with clear, measurable results defined up front and reported honestly.

• Adoption & Retention: Growth in the share of accounts actively using delivered features, with churn as the lagging indicator of real value.

• Satisfaction: Measurable improvement in NPS and CSat where you’ve focused.

• Insight to Action: Trends you surfaced that changed a roadmap or a decision.

• Time Savings: Quantified reduction in time-on-task for church staff using delivered features.

• PM Craft: Visible improvement in shared practices and in the PMs you coach.

What You'll Bring

• Proven Product Management Leadership (Required): 5+ years owning B2B SaaS products end to end, from discovery through adoption, with outcomes you can quantify and defend. You have a track record of shipping products customers adopt, and you’ve measured and owned the results, including the misses. Complex workflows or financial data preferred.

• Church Operations Fluency (Required): Ministry from the inside, through church staff or volunteer leadership, or product work on church or ministry software. You understand how churches staff, volunteer, communicate, and steward resources. A personal connection to or deep respect for the Church is essential.

• Range and Fast Ramp: You get fluent in a new domain quickly, and you’re energized, not rattled, when priorities shift.

• Influence Without Authority: You drive outcomes across teams you don’t control, through expertise and trust, not org chart position.

• Data-Driven Judgment: You turn adoption and satisfaction data into decisions, and you know when the numbers need a conversation with a customer to explain them.

• AI Product Fluency: You know what AI can and cannot do in a ministry context, can define requirements for LLM-based features, and recognize when a human touch matters more than automation.

• Operational & Technical Fluency: Comfortable with APIs and integrations. You understand why being the source of truth for church data matters.

• Communication That Moves People: Clear point of view. Adapts on evidence. Doesn’t hedge.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer will be required. This role consistently operates standard office equipment such as computers and phones. This is largely a sedentary role but may occasionally require lifting up to 50 pounds, walking, bending, or standing as necessary. This description reflects management's assignment of essential functions, it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

If you require a modification to your work equipment or furniture please contact the People Team - peopleteam@pushpay.com

Our 550 Pushpay teammates support 10,000+ customers as they drive social good, and we’re honored to have processed over $15 billion in charitable giving. jobs.title: Head of Financial Crimes Compliance
jobs.description:
ABOUT DAKOTA

Dakota is a stablecoin infrastructure platform powering modern financial products through regulated money movement, stablecoin orchestration, and cross-border settlement. We serve institutional clients — fintechs, payment service providers, marketplaces, and enterprises — through an API-first platform that abstracts the complexity of custody, compliance, settlement, and banking partnerships.

We are a remote first team across North America and Europe. We value high quality work, clear thinking and ownership.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial risk and advisory

 - Serve as senior FCC point of contact and SME on fiat and digital assets; contribute to the FCC framework.

 - Identify and assess money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, fraud and other illicit finance risks across digital asset products, clients, counterparties and transaction flows, including blockchain, wallets, custody models, and stablecoins.

 - Provide risk-based advice and effective challenge across the product and client lifecycle: new initiatives, product approvals, onboarding and material changes.

 - Assess cross-business and cross-regional impacts, promoting consistent minimum standards and documented treatment of regional variances.

Controls and program oversight

 - Partner with first-line and other teams to design, enhance and oversee controls for CDD/EDD and KYC, sanctions screening, blockchain analytics, transaction monitoring, case management, investigations, suspicious activity escalation and recordkeeping.

 - Review AML programs and internal control structures, including automated solutions, through policy and procedure reviews, gap analyses, risk assessments and regulatory compliance assessments.

 - Identify and escalate material risks and control weaknesses, and oversee agreed remediation.

FCC technology, models and data

 - Lead implementation of FCC technology solutions, including onboarding blockchain analytics and digital asset intelligence vendors and managing vendor relationships.

 - Develop transaction monitoring scenarios aligned to products, services and risk appetite.

 - Lead testing, tuning and optimization of transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, customer risk rating and detection, before production and on an ongoing basis.

 - Validate AML models across those same areas.

 - Perform and oversee data reconciliation, lineage and quality testing; interpret complex analyses to identify patterns, risks and conclusions.

 - Improve data quality, system capabilities and automation to strengthen preventive and detective controls.

Regulatory engagement and governance

 - Monitor new laws, regulations, guidance, enforcement actions and industry practice, and translate them into practical requirements and action plans.

 - Support engagement with regulators, auditors and independent reviewers, including exam preparation, information requests and remediation of findings, as necessary.

 - Develop policies, procedures, training, metrics, and governance materials for senior stakeholders and committees.

Leadership and relationships

 - Lead multiple complex FCC initiatives from initiation to completion, on time, within budget and to stakeholder expectations.

 - Manage teams, delegating effectively to managers and mentoring junior and mid-level staff, while still being hands-on.

 - Build strong relationships with executives, business, technology, Risk and Audit partners, and industry forums or trade associations.

 - Lead stakeholder discussions, identify new opportunities to add value, and deliver special projects as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years in Financial Crime Compliance, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Internal Audit or a related control function, preferably at a financial institution or regulated digital assets business.

 - Practical experience in legal, financial, technical, risk or compliance background is preferred.

 - Deep knowledge of AML, CTF, sanctions and fraud risk frameworks, including CDD, transaction monitoring, investigations, regulatory reporting and common typologies.

 - Working knowledge of blockchain and digital assets, or experience assessing financial crime risk in new products, technologies or payment models.

 - Track record building controls for digital assets risk, including work with blockchain analytics vendors.

 - Experience conducting risk assessments and designing, implementing or overseeing financial crime controls.

 - Hands-on design and implementation of FCC technology, including transaction monitoring rule development, tuning and CIP systems, and TM systems.


SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

 - Analytical: understands complex product structures, workflows, transaction flows and data dependencies; analyzes issues independently and turns conclusions into actionable recommendations.

 - Regulatory interpretation: translates complex, evolving expectations into practical guidance, control requirements and executable plans.

 - Communication: excellent written, verbal and presentation skills; explains complex issues, risk decisions and metrics clearly to all levels, including senior management.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SPRIG

Sprig is the customer survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, teams have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers. These platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast products move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear, actionable insight. Teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor. Product teams no longer guess. They know.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the best teams in the world can build products their customers love.

Companies like Microsoft, DoorDash, Notion, Figma, Coinbase, and TripAdvisor use Sprig to stay close to their users. Backed by $85M from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're growing quickly across the world's leading product organizations.

The category is being rebuilt, with AI at the core. If you're excited by hard problems and the chance to define how modern teams understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Engineer at Sprig, you will help customers successfully deploy, integrate, troubleshoot, and scale Sprig across their organizations. You’ll partner directly with product teams, researchers, and technical stakeholders to solve complex challenges and ensure customers maximize the value of our platform.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success and Solutions Engineering. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, own complex technical engagements, and act as a strong internal advocate for customer needs and product improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys technical problem solving, customer interaction, and cross-functional collaboration, and who is comfortable independently navigating complex customer environments in a fast-moving environment.

This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office 4x per week.



Your Impact

 - Diagnose and troubleshoot integration issues, conduct technical demos, and align with business and product goals.

 - Partner directly with customers to troubleshoot technical issues related to integrations, SDK implementations, APIs, survey deployments, and platform configuration

 - Lead technical onboarding and implementation for a portfolio of mid-market customers, driving fast time-to-value so teams can roll out Sprig across their workflows

 - Act as liaison with our product & engineering teams on escalations. Detailed discovery to allow product teams to efficiently address any issues.

 - Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to identify common customer requests, test workarounds and new feature releases, and improve technical documentation to ensure customer success

 - Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to support technical evaluations, renewals, expansions, and customer growth opportunities

Your Strengths

 - 2-4+ years of experience as customer support engineer

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a genuine curiosity for understanding how systems work and the ability to independently navigate ambiguous technical problems

 - Problem solver mindset - Hunger for understanding why something is happening and enjoy digging into the source code to troubleshoot issues

 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Highly collaborative and energized by working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams

 - Experience supporting mid-market customers at a SaaS company is preferred


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive Salary

 - Competitive Employee Equity

 - 401K Program

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits

 - FSA/HSA Benefit

 - $175/month Commuter Benefit

 - Additional Wellbeing Benefits

 - Flexible Paid Time Off

 - Paid Parental Leave

 - Professional Development Stipend

 - Lunch and dinner provided daily

 - Company Sponsored Social Events

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.




EMPLOYEE PAY DISCLOSURE

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $135,000 + Equity + Benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all locations (San Francisco, CA; New York, NY). Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your Recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits.

Sprig Technologies Inc. requires that candidates on F-1 student visas have at least two years of remaining Optional Practical Training (OPT) at the time of hire.

***Please beware of scammers who are posing as Sprig and Sprig team members. Our recruiters use @sprig.com http://sprig.com email addresses exclusively. We do not conduct interviews via text or instant message, and we do not ask candidates to purchase equipment through us or solicit money from you. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be from a different domain about a job offer, please report it as potential job fraud to law enforcement and contact us here.***

jobs.title: Senior Director, People Experience (Americas)
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Director, People Experience, Americas
San Mateo, CA | Hybrid - 2 days per week in our San Mateo office

Role Summary:

Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation) is seeking a strategic, operationally strong, and people-centered Senior Director, People Experience, Americas to lead our regional People Experience (PX) organization, supporting approximately 7,000 employees across engineering, product, studios, and corporate functions.

This leader will oversee a broad portfolio of employee-facing HR services, including HR advisory and generalist services, Employee Relations operations, Americas Payroll, HR compliance, recognition programs, and HR service transformation. Working closely with HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, Legal, HR Technology, and global PX leaders, they will translate people strategy into scalable, well-governed execution and a consistent employee experience.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with hands-on operational leadership, bringing the ability to lead complex transformation while maintaining service excellence and business continuity. They will build on an established foundation, strengthen operational effectiveness, and guide teams through evolving business needs, technologies, and ways of working.

Success requires a collaborative and thoughtful leadership style, sound judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to influence across a global, highly matrixed organization. This leader will bring curiosity, humility, and a listen-and-learn mindset, balanced with the confidence to challenge constructively, make informed recommendations, and align stakeholders around shared priorities.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Lead the Americas People Experience organization, setting regional strategy, operational priorities, and service standards aligned with global People & Places objectives while building on existing strengths and driving continued transformation.

• Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning HR advisory and generalist services, Employee Relations operations, Americas Payroll, HR compliance, recognition, and employee-facing HR services.

• Partner with HR Business Partners and senior business leaders to translate workforce, talent, organizational design, and change priorities into coordinated implementation plans and effective operational delivery.

• Oversee employee lifecycle services and complex workforce activities, including organizational changes, acquisitions and integrations, restructures, role eliminations, and workforce transitions, ensuring thoughtful execution and a consistent employee experience.

• Provide senior governance for Employee Relations operations, including case management, escalation, documentation, risk identification, and partnership with Legal, Compliance, and HR Business Partners.

• Oversee Americas Payroll and regional HR compliance, ensuring effective operational controls, regulatory alignment, risk management, audit readiness, and service continuity across multiple jurisdictions.

• Drive modernization and transformation of HR service delivery, leveraging Workday, ServiceNow, analytics, automation, and responsible AI to simplify processes, strengthen self-service capabilities, and improve the employee and manager experience.

• Establish clear service standards, KPIs, dashboards, and governance practices to measure operational performance, service quality, employee experience, risk, and team capacity, using insights to drive continuous improvement.

• Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives that simplify fragmented processes, clarify decision rights and accountability, strengthen documentation, and establish scalable, consistent practices across regions.

• Build strong partnerships with global PX leaders, HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, HR Technology, Finance, and Legal to operationalize people programs and align regional delivery with global priorities.

• Serve as a trusted adviser and escalation point for senior People leadership, navigating complex and sensitive matters, influencing decisions, and balancing employee experience, business needs, and organizational risk.

• Build and develop a high-performing leadership team, fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, succession planning, and the ability to navigate change with confidence and resilience.

• Manage regional budgets, vendors, workforce plans, and resource allocation to ensure effective, sustainable, and well-controlled service delivery.

• Represent the Americas in global People Experience forums and initiatives, influencing enterprise standards while ensuring regional requirements, local-market needs, and employee impacts are understood and addressed.

What We're Looking For:

• 15+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, including significant responsibility for People Experience, HR Operations, HR Shared Services, Employee Relations, or HR transformation within a large, complex organization.

• Proven experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary HR teams, with accountability for operational performance, talent development, organizational effectiveness, and service delivery.

• Demonstrated success operating at the Senior Director level or equivalent, advising executives and influencing across a global, highly matrixed environment.

• Deep understanding of HR operating models and the distinct responsibilities of HR Business Partners, People Experience or People Operations, Centers of Excellence, Legal, and HR Technology.

• Strong systems thinking, with the ability to navigate dependencies across HR services, technology, processes, and stakeholders while balancing enterprise priorities with regional business needs.

• Broad knowledge of U.S. employment practices, HR compliance, employee lifecycle operations, and complex workforce matters, with the judgment to navigate sensitive employee situations and organizational change.

• Experience overseeing or governing payroll operations, including controls, compliance, issue management, systems, vendors, and cross-functional dependencies.

• Proven success leading complex HR transformation and change initiatives, translating strategy into execution across people, processes, technology, communications, and adoption while maintaining operational stability.

• Experience modernizing HR service delivery through Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable HR technology platforms, analytics, automation, and digital employee experiences.

• Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to define meaningful KPIs, evaluate operational performance, identify risks, and translate insights into actionable business decisions.

• Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and executive influencing skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and differing perspectives.

• A collaborative, adaptable, and people-centered leadership style, demonstrating curiosity, humility, resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable:

• Experience supporting employees across multiple Americas jurisdictions, including Canada and Latin America.

• Background in gaming, technology, media, entertainment, or similarly complex, fast-paced industries.

• Experience supporting diverse employee populations across engineering, product, creative, and corporate functions.

• Experience leading large-scale organizational transformations, mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or workforce restructuring.

• Experience with global HR service-delivery models, recognition programs, employee experience initiatives, and cross-regional transformation.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled HR solutions, digital employee experiences, and responsible AI adoption.

• Advanced HR certification or qualification, such as SPHR, SHRM-SCP, FCIPD, or equivalent.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative (Wisconsin)
jobs.description:
About Equip 

Equip is the leading virtual, evidence-based eating disorder treatment program on a mission to ensure that everyone with an eating disorder can access treatment that works. Created by clinical experts in the field and people with lived experience, Equip builds upon evidence-based treatments to empower individuals to reach lasting recovery. All Equip patients receive a dedicated care team, including a therapist, dietitian, physician, and peer and family mentor. The company operates in all 50 states and is partnered with most major health insurance plans. Learn more about our strong outcomes https://equip.health/outcomes and treatment approach at www.equip.health. http://www.equip.health

Founded in 2019, Equip has been a fully virtual company since its inception and is proud of the highly-engaged, passionate, and diverse Equipsters that have created Equip’s culture.  Recognized by Time https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2023/6285207/equip/ as one of the most influential companies of 2023, along with awards from Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2022-50-us-companies-rise-linkedin-news/ and Lattice https://lattice.com/blog/announcing-the-2023-finalists-for-lattices-people-success-awards, we are grateful to Equipsters for building a sustainable treatment program that has served thousands of patients and families.

About the role

The Field Sales Representative drives patient acquisition by building strategic relationships across a multi-state territory with healthcare and community organizations. They represent Equip's mission, connect people to treatment, and require an entrepreneurial and self-driven approach. This remote role involves regular field engagement, balancing virtual and in-person meetings.

Responsibilities

 - Create strategies for maximizing brand reach and provider relationships within a territory.

 - Cultivate new relationships and nurture existing ones through video calls, in-person meetings, events, and educational presentations—often collaborating closely with Equip’s clinical leaders to ensure impactful engagement.

 - Deliver on patient acquisition and admissions goals in collaboration with various departments.

 - Manage data, outreach efforts, and reports in a Customer Relationship Management  to demonstrate territory performance, identify key areas for improvement, and inform future strategy.

 - Effectively plan and execute regional events that drive engagement with the target professional audience.

 - Deeply understand the specific territory’s needs and position Equip as a solution for providers.

 - Identify inactive providers and create actionable plans and timelines to re-engage.

 - Collaborate with the Referral Coordinators and Admissions team to create a stellar referral process for provider partners.

 - Work collaboratively with marketing, clinical operations, and payor partnership teams to effectively penetrate new markets.

 - Identify local sponsorship opportunities and represent Equip at conferences.

 - Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

 - Must reside in Wisconsin, with a strong preference for candidates in Milwaukee or Madison.

 - Ability to travel regularly throughout Wisconsin, with occasional travel to major metro areas in Iowa and Nebraska. 

 - Bachelor’s degree or higher.

 - 2+ years experience in a sales or business development role, preferably in healthcare.

 - Strong interpersonal skills, relationship-building expertise, and professional presence.

 - Effective communication, rapport-building, and influence at all organizational levels.

 - Strong organizational skills and detail-oriented in a fast-paced fluid environment.

 - Proven track record of meeting goals.

 - Comfortable with remote work, high autonomy, and self-motivation.

 - Critical thinking for navigating challenges and rapid change.

Time Off:

 - Flex PTO policy (3-5 wks/year recommended) + 11 paid company holidays.

 - Generous parental leave.

Core Benefits:

 - Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance.
   
   - Equip pays for a significant percentage of benefits premiums for individuals and families.

 - Spring Health, a 100% employer-paid mental health benefit through Guardian.
   
   - You can receive 5 free therapy sessions and 5 free coaching sessions per year for you and each of your dependents.

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more!

 - HealthJoy, a 100% employer-paid platform connecting you to a healthcare concierge who can help you navigate your benefits.

 - 401K Option!

Work From Home Additional Perks:

 - $50/month stipend added directly to an employee’s paycheck to cover home internet expenses.

 - $250/month stipend to use a co-working space.

 - Initial work-from-home stipend of up to $500.
   
   - Reload of $200 on the home office stipend at the 3-year mark and then every other year after that (year 5, year 7, etc.).

 - Company Laptop.

Physical Demands

Work is performed 100% remotely with regular field travel required within assigned territory (up to 40%).  Position requires being in-market 2–3 days per week across a mix of local account visits (half or full days) and occasional overnight stays (approx. 2–4 overnights per month). Actual field time may vary based on assigned territory geography, account density, and business performance goals.

Must live in the assigned region with access to reliable transportation. This position requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards as well as to talk or hear by telephone. Sit or stand as needed.

At Equip, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) are woven into everything we do. At the heart of Equip’s mission is a relentless dedication to making sure that everyone with an eating disorder has access to care that works regardless of race, gender, sexuality, ability, weight, socio-economic status, and any marginalized identity. We also strive toward our providers and corporate team reflecting that same dedication both in bringing in and retaining talented employees from all backgrounds and identities. We have an Equip DEIB council, Equip For All; also referred to as EFA. EFA at Equip aims to be a space driven by mutual respect, and thoughtful, effective communication strategy - enabling full participation of  members who identify as marginalized or under-represented and allies, amplifying diverse voices, creating opportunities for advocacy and contributing to the advancement of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging at Equip.

As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability, weight, and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law. 

Our dedication to equitable access, which is core to our mission, extends to how we build our "village." In line with our commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB), we are dedicated to an accessible hiring process where all candidates feel a true sense of belonging. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, interview, or perform the essential functions of a role, we invite you to reach out to our People team at accommodations@equip.health.

jobs.title: Banquet Cook II - Limelight Denver
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Banquet Cook II participates in the preparation, production, and service of menu items according to the direction of the Banquet Chef. The Banquet Cook II is responsible for preparing and cooking a variety of food items following established recipes and safety standards. This position requires maintaining cleanliness and organization in the kitchen while ensuring food is prepared in a timely manner and to the highest quality standards. This position reports to the Banquet Chef.

The pay range for this position is $22.00 to $24.00 per hour; actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until November 22, 2026.

Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities

•    Maintain a clean and sanitary work environment, participate in pre and post shift cleaning and organization to include but not limited to: kitchen equipment, walk in fridge/freezer storage, dry storage, trash, recycle, mopping, sweeping

•    Prepare & serve food items according to standardized recipes and chef specifications

•    Follow daily preparation list to ensure items are ready for service

•    Assist with storage of food deliveries

•    Report any problems with food product, kitchen equipment or work area to the Banquet Chef

•    Work a food station during service, including direct guest interaction if working in a guest facing restaurant

•    Ensure Manager is aware of guest comments and concerns

•    Safely operate and train others on the operation of various kitchen equipment to include oven, grill, flattop, soup kettles, slicers, robo-coupe, immersion blender

•    Ensure accurate portion sizes and presentation of dishes to meet both quality standards and customer expectations

•    Manage cooking times to ensure food is prepared and served in a timely manner, especially during peak hours

•    Work closely with kitchen team members to ensure smooth operation and effective communication during food service

•    Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience Requirements

•    Culinary School graduate preferred

•    1-2 year(s) of experience in a commercial kitchen preferred

•    ServSafe or similar food safety course certification is preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

•    Proficient written and verbal communication English skills, Spanish a plus

•    Proficient experience in guest facing roles

•    Knowledge of a variety of cooking techniques to include baking, broiling, grilling, sauté, roasting, blanching and more

•    Knowledge of food handling, safety and other restaurant guidelines

•    Knowledge of simple sauce and dressing

•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

•    Excellent time management skills

•    Ability to manage difficult or emotional situations whether they be customer or employee related

•    Ability to work under stressful circumstances

•    Ability to quickly adapt to changes in processes, customer flow, environments, and tasks

•    Ability to engage with customers in a positive and helpful manner

•    Ability to work in collaboration with others to achieve team goals

Work Environment & Physical Demands

•    Ability to reach, crouch, kneel, stand, walk or be on your feet for extended periods of time

•    Regularly work in wet, hot and humid conditions for extended periods of time and may be required to walk on slippery and uneven surfaces

•    Must be able to occasionally lift, push or pull up to 50 lbs. individually or with assistance (weight limits can vary according to position, but no more than 50)

Job Benefits

This position is classified as a regular part-time position eligible for the following benefits:

Enrollment dates differ across the various programs.

•    Paid Time Off Programs

•    Employee Ski Pass

•    Other company perks

jobs.title: Sr. Counsel
jobs.description:
SENIOR COUNSEL

About Troveo

Troveo builds the data platform that AI labs and model builders need to train the next generation of models. We have created the world's largest licensed platform of scarce, proprietary data for AI, spanning video, audio, text, and business workflows.

Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high-quality data into formats ready for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development.

Role Summary

As Senior Counsel, you will be a member of the company’s senior leadership team, involved in both company legal strategy and day to day execution as a hands-on deal lawyer at a company where legal work is core to our business.

You will draft, negotiate, and close data and content license agreements end to end, including inbound agreements with content owners, outbound agreements with AI companies and data platforms (frequently on counterparty paper), and the multi-party structures in between.

Key Responsibilities

 - Negotiate and close outbound data license and sublicense agreements with AI labs, data platforms, and resellers — managing redline cycles on counterparty forms and driving open issues (liability, indemnification, insurance, IP scope) to close

 - Own and evolve Troveo's inbound template suite (content and business data license agreements, riders, annexes), partnering with outside counsel on major revisions

 - Structure complex multi-party arrangements: pass-through sublicensing, consent instruments for downstream transactions, and back-to-back partner agreements where upstream and downstream terms must align

 - Advise on copyright and IP issues at the frontier of AI training, including fair use, exclusivity and corpus-segregation obligations, and provenance representations

 - Counsel on data privacy and regulatory strategy, including PII handling, de-identification structures, and state data-broker regimes

 - Handle contractor, services, and MSA/SOW agreements where Troveo is the hiring principal

 - Manage outside counsel efficiently on specialist matters

 - Help build a modern, AI-native legal function — we invest heavily in AI-assisted contract review and knowledge tooling across our agreement corpus, and you'll use and improve these tools daily



Qualifications



 - JD and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar

 - 7+  years of transactional experience, including meaningful time at a major law firm; in-house experience at a technology or media company a plus

 - Deep commercial contracts background centered on IP licensing, content/data licensing, or technology transactions

 - Proven ability to run negotiations independently — setting posture, holding positions, and knowing when to trade

 - Strong drafting command of the terms that decide these deals: license scope, sublicensing mechanics, indemnity caps, audit rights, term and survival

 - Comfort operating on counterparty paper and reconciling mismatched terms across a deal chain

 - Familiarity with AI/ML training data issues, or the ability to get up to speed fast

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling in legal practice



What We Offer

 - Compensation Target: $180K-$220K+ DOE and location
   Comprehensive Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - PTO & Paid Holidays: Unlimited PTO with encouragement to actually use it

 - Remote First Policy: Work from anywhere in the US (with occasional team offsites)

 - Equity Ownership: Competitive equity package with clear growth potential as we scale

 - Modern Tech Stack & Tools: Budget for the best equipment and software

 - Strong Culture: High-trust, low-ego environment focused on impact, transparency, and work-life balance

 - We believe great work happens when people are supported, challenged, and given ownership.

jobs.title: CSM, Enterprise | Lifecycle
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp's Enterprise Customer Success Managers on the Lifecycle team don't stop at go-live — they make sure customers keep getting more from Ramp as their business grows. Ramp has grown its product suite significantly over the last several years. As we've matured as an organization, our customer relationships have grown more complex too: customers are buying more of the platform at once, running it across more entities and teams, and relying on it for more of how their finance function operates. Hitting an activation milestone doesn't mean the job's finished. Too often, a feature that could solve a real problem goes unused because no one is there to show how it would work in that customer's business.

That's where you come in. This is a role for people who understand how finance teams actually run, who think in years rather than quarters, and who already use AI the way surgeons use instruments: not occasionally, not as an experiment, but as the default way they work. You'll own the customer experience after implementation for a book of Ramp's highest-potential enterprise customers, partnering with Account Management on long-term account strategy. You'll also be one of the first Lifecycle CSMs on a newly formed team, helping define how Ramp earns and keeps the trust of its most important customers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the post-implementation experience for a book of enterprise customers, with clear accountability for sustained adoption, customer satisfaction, and renewal readiness

 - Drive sustained adoption by understanding each customer's goals and guiding them toward the workflows that improve outcomes for their business — including the products and features they've already purchased but haven't fully put to work

 - Act as each customer's expert in finance workflows: understand how they run their business, advise on decisions as their needs change, and make the value of new Ramp capabilities clear in their context

 - Build multi-threaded relationships across every account and partner with Account Management on executive relationships, so the account stays steady through change like a new Controller or CFO

 - Partner with Account Management on QBRs and executive business reviews, quantifying Ramp's impact in the language CFOs and Controllers care about — close cycle improvement, spend visibility, savings, and ROI — not just product usage metrics

jobs.title: Applications Engineer - León
jobs.description:
APPLICATIONS ENGINEER, MEXICO

Mexico · Field Applications / Deployment · Full-time




ABOUT OVERVIEW.AI http://Overview.ai

We're building AI-powered quality control systems for manufacturing. Unlike traditional machine vision, our systems use AI to solve inspection challenges that were previously difficult or impossible to automate.

We work with companies like Tesla, SpaceX, and Amphenol, deploying our technology directly into production environments around the world.

Our customers don't need another software tool. They need systems that work on their production lines, integrate with existing equipment, and perform reliably under real manufacturing constraints.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the engineer making our AI vision systems work on the factory floor.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you'll install and configure hardware, integrate vision systems with PLCs, troubleshoot technical challenges, and ensure our technology performs reliably in production.

You'll work directly with manufacturing customers across Mexico, collaborating with their engineering, maintenance, and operations teams to bring new systems online.

From initial installation through production validation, you'll own technical execution and help customers get the most out of our technology.

This is a field-based position with frequent travel to customer manufacturing facilities. We're looking for someone who enjoys being hands-on, solving problems in real time, and taking ownership in a fast-moving environment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


INSTALL AND INTEGRATE AI VISION SYSTEMS

 - Install and configure Overview cameras, lighting, and supporting hardware on manufacturing lines.

 - Integrate vision systems with existing PLC platforms, including Allen Bradley, Siemens, and similar systems.

 - Configure I/O mapping, communication protocols, and connectivity between equipment.

 - Collaborate with customer engineers and maintenance teams to coordinate successful deployments.


TROUBLESHOOT TECHNICAL CHALLENGES

 - Diagnose and resolve electrical, hardware, networking, and controls integration issues.

 - Troubleshoot signal timing, connectivity, encoder feedback, and I/O configurations.

 - Use tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and diagnostic software to identify problems.

 - Solve issues in live production environments while minimizing operational disruption.


ENSURE PRODUCTION PERFORMANCE

 - Validate system accuracy, speed, and reliability under real manufacturing conditions.

 - Optimize configurations for lighting, vibration, material variation, and other production constraints.

 - Document configurations, technical findings, and deployment procedures.

 - Train customer operators, engineers, and maintenance teams on system operation and troubleshooting.


OWN CUSTOMER DEPLOYMENTS

 - Serve as a technical point of contact throughout installation, ramp-up, and production.

 - Work independently on-site while collaborating with Overview's engineering and product teams.

 - Provide technical support and help customers resolve issues efficiently.

 - Share field insights and product feedback to improve future deployments.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING


MUST HAVE

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, or related fields.

 - Practical experience working with PLC systems such as Allen Bradley, Siemens, or similar platforms, including I/O configuration, troubleshooting, and basic programming.

 - Experience installing, configuring, or integrating equipment in manufacturing environments.

 - Strong electrical troubleshooting skills and familiarity with diagnostic tools such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.

 - Experience working directly on production floors and understanding manufacturing constraints.

 - Ability to work independently, troubleshoot unfamiliar problems, and take ownership of technical projects.

 - Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently to customer manufacturing facilities across Mexico.

 - Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish.


STRONG TO HAVE

 - Experience with industrial machine vision systems, cameras, lighting, or inspection equipment.

 - Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, or serial communication.

 - Experience working directly with manufacturing customers or supporting equipment deployments.

 - Familiarity with Allen Bradley CompactLogix/ControlLogix or Siemens S7 platforms.

 - Experience training operators, technicians, or engineers on technical systems.

 - Exposure to AI-powered inspection systems or industrial networking.


LOCATION & TRAVEL

Location: Mexico, field-based.

This role requires frequent travel to customer manufacturing facilities. Candidates should be based in a location with convenient access to a major airport and be comfortable traveling for multi-day or multi-week deployments.




WHY OVERVIEW.AI http://Overview.ai?

 - Real-world impact: Work with AI technology already deployed on production lines at leading global manufacturers.

 - Technical growth: Develop expertise across industrial controls, machine vision, and AI systems.

 - High ownership: Lead technical deployments and make meaningful decisions from day one.

 - Global collaboration: Work alongside talented engineers and product teams across international markets.

 - Fast-paced environment: Join a rapidly growing startup where your work directly influences our customers and product development.

jobs.title: Lead Consultant, Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you are curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment and Health team as our new Lead Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

Ramboll is seeking a Lead Consultant, Geospatial Analyst based in Arlington, VA to support environmental, infrastructure, federal, and industrial projects across the Mid-Atlantic region and nationally. This role will combine office-based GIS consulting with periodic field and client-site support throughout Virginia, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York, and surrounding states.. This is a hands-on consulting role that combines office-based GIS analysis and data management with field-based geospatial support, mobile data collection, and direct collaboration with project teams and clients. The successful candidate will apply GIS throughout the project lifecycle, from planning field activities and configuring digital data collection workflows to managing, analyzing, and visualizing project data and delivering maps, web applications, and other geospatial solutions. The role requires someone comfortable working in both office and field environments, independently managing geospatial tasks across multiple projects, and providing regular on-site support at project and client locations.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Provide office and field-based GIS support for environmental, remediation, infrastructure, industrial, and federal projects.
• Plan, configure, and support digital field data collection using ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, GPS/GNSS equipment, mobile devices, and related geospatial technologies; support field teams by managing and validating field-collected data, troubleshooting mobile GIS and positioning technologies, and integrating field information into project systems and decision-making workflows.
• Work directly with scientists, engineers, field personnel, project managers, and clients to understand project needs and develop practical geospatial and data management solutions.
• Develop and maintain geospatial databases, ArcGIS Online environments, web maps, applications, and field workflows; perform geospatial analysis, mapping, data visualization, quality assurance and quality control, and preparation of client-ready technical deliverables.
• Independently lead GIS tasks and smaller geospatial workstreams while coordinating schedules, priorities, deliverables, and technical requirements with project teams.

About you

• Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Environmental Science, Geospatial Science, Engineering, or a related field, with five or more years of professional GIS experience, including experience in an environmental, engineering, infrastructure, or similar consulting environment.
• Demonstrated field experience supporting environmental, engineering, construction, infrastructure, industrial, or similar projects.
• Strong proficiency with ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online, including experience with ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, and other mobile GIS applications, as well as practical experience with GPS/GNSS equipment, field data collection, digital forms, mobile devices, and field-to-office data workflows.
• Experience managing geospatial data and independently delivering GIS solutions across multiple concurrent projects, with strong communication and client-service skills and the ability to work effectively with project managers, technical professionals, field personnel, and clients.
• Ability and willingness to travel to project and client sites approximately two times per month, primarily within the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, to provide field-based GIS and digital data collection support.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $86,130 - $107,663 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

As part of our hiring process, Ramboll may conduct pre-employment drug screenings for applicable roles to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.  You may be subject to random drug testing in accordance with client requirements.

jobs.title: Director, Product Security, PSIRT
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Within the Product Security team, our Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) owns Okta's response when a security vulnerability in our products is reported, exploited, or puts customers at risk, across Okta, Auth0 and the systems they run on. PSIRT triages reports from researchers, customers, our bug bounty program and our own automated discovery, leads each incident from intake to closure, drives fixes with engineering and leadership, and publishes CVEs and security advisories as Okta's CVE Numbering Authority.

AI is changing how vulnerabilities are found, by us and by attackers, and the volume of high-impact reports is rising quickly. We seek a director to lead PSIRT through that change: run day-to-day incident response, build the team and the agentic workflows that let it scale, and be the steady, credible voice for Okta when a vulnerability matters to our customers.

What You Will Do

• Lead Okta's PSIRT program across all business units, defining its strategy, roadmap and operating model

• Own the vulnerability-handling lifecycle, from intake and triage through remediation, coordinated disclosure and post-incident review, and keep our procedures and runbooks current

• Act as senior incident lead on Critical and high-profile vulnerabilities, including industry-wide issues, and make clear calls under pressure

• Partner with Engineering leaders to drive fixes and hotfixes on time, while engineering owns remediation

• Run coordinated disclosure with researchers and partners, and own Okta's CVE and security advisory process with Customer Trust and Security Communications

• Work closely with Cyber Defense, Identity Defense, Legal and Federal teams on exploitation analysis, customer impact and regulatory obligations

• Own the bug bounty program and relationships with the security research community

• Scale the team with automation and AI: agentic triage, root-cause and variant analysis, and tooling that holds up under a surge in volume

• Set and report key performance indicators (time to acknowledge, time to resolve, SLA attainment, advisory timeliness) to security and executive leadership

• Brief executives clearly and in proportion to risk, and lead post-incident reviews that feed lessons back into the Secure Development Lifecycle

• Maintain and strengthen a team culture of growth, openness, trust, rigor, humility, and mutual support

• Lead the process of recruiting great engineers to meet the growth plan for the team in collaboration with our recruiters

• Mentor PSIRT and Product Security engineers in their career progression

• Represent Okta with authority in industry forums and with customers, researchers and peer PSIRTs

What You Bring

• United States citizenship and eligibility to obtain Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance, with active or prior security clearance a plus

• Flexibility to travel as needed and maintain availability for off-hours incident response escalation

• Extensive background in product security incident response or vulnerability management, including leadership or managerial roles, and a commitment to cultivating high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative teams

• Proven track record managing geographically distributed teams that cover incidents across time zones

• Hands-on experience leading high-severity vulnerability incidents, from triage and impact analysis through fix validation and public disclosure

• Strong technical depth in web application, identity and cloud vulnerabilities, with the ability to reproduce issues and judge exploitability and customer impact

• Working knowledge of coordinated disclosure and vulnerability handling standards (ISO/IEC 29147 and 30111, FIRST PSIRT Services Framework) and of CVE and CVSS

• Experience running or working closely with a bug bounty program

• Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC2, PCI, FedRAMP, et al.)

• Exceptional ability to communicate, influence, and articulate vulnerability risk to engineers, executives and customers, including in high-pressure situations

• Experience working with cross-functional teams, possessing exceptional stakeholder management skills

• Experience applying automation or AI to security operations is a plus

jobs.description:
About TEAM LEWIS

TEAM LEWIS is a global marketing agency that has grown from start-up to multi-national in a little over two decades. Its success is due to a combination of factors: talented creatives delivering award winning campaigns; expanding client relationships into new markets or services; its independence from outside investors. The agency, its people and client campaigns have won many awards, including Cannes Lions, PRovoke Media, ICCO, European Excellence, PRCA Digital, Digital Impact, Global Digital Excellence.

At the heart of the business is the TEAM LEWIS Foundation (TLF), a non-profit charitable entity. Since its launch in 2021, it has funded over 2,700 causes. The TLF promotes a wide variety of social, cultural, and environmental causes that benefit society. It aims to strengthen the bonds between the creative industries, businesses, government, and non-profits. Community charities are championed by employees who, in addition to the financial donation, volunteer their time and skills to maximize the grants’ effectiveness.

Purpose of the role

The Senior Campaign Executive is responsible for day-to-day media liaison and project management within accounts. As the most media-focused role within the Account Servicing team, a Senior Campaign Executive will thrive on successfully pitching their clients’ stories to the media. This person integrates social media into PR campaigns and has the necessary skills to communicate effectively with their clients, teams, and media contacts.

Key responsibilities and tasks

Client Management

• Assists the Campaign Managers and Campaign Directors with the management of clients and projects

• Offers thoughtful advice and recommendations to clients and team regarding media strategy, tactics and media opportunities

• Maintains assigned relationships with clients, establishing self and TEAM LEWIS as an invaluable long-term partner for marketing and communications services

• Manages communication with select clients and ensures deadlines and service agreements are met consistently

• Participates in the business development process by supporting with pitch preparation and research

Media Relations

• Understands and avidly follows the news agenda, positioning clients and products within the wider news narrative

• Directly pitches engaging content to journalists, bloggers and analysts on an on-going basis

• Reviews and refines campaign programs at a tactical level, ensuring on-going relevance and adapting plans where necessary

• Deploys rapid response to breaking news on behalf of clients, reacting quickly to emerging stories in line with client profiles

• Researches, identifies and approaches appropriate media contacts (eg. journalists, bloggers, analysts) on an ongoing basis

• Identifies and secures standing opportunities such as columns and Q&As with a wide range of industry and national news platforms

• Attends and coordinates industry events with a view to growing and strengthening individual and TEAM LEWIS media network

Content

• Drafts a broad range of written materials including biographies, briefing documents, media alerts, soundbites, Q&As, backgrounders and boilerplates, ensuring a consistent level of high-quality content

• Creates press materials and compelling content for both traditional and digital media

Team working and development

• Accurately reports activity levels and regularly completes timesheets to ensure correct allocation of client duties

• Works closely with line manager to maximize own strengths, improve weaknesses and support individual and team career development

• Supports with the training of Interns, Campaign Coordinators, and Campaign Executives wherever possible

Reporting and analysis

• Tracks and reports on media activity, including coverage reports, press clippings, online media engagement

• Reviews reports and metrics prepared by Interns/Campaign Executives/Campaign Coordinators

• Ensures that all account activity and results are reported back to the Campaign Manager/Campaign Director

General

• Supports the Account Servicing team on a range of initiatives and projects

• Takes a proactive role in promoting the TEAM LEWIS brand, its work, identity and values

• Supports the HR/talent team by promoting both internal and external opportunities at TEAM LEWIS across social media and via the referral scheme

• Contributes and supports the continuous improvement of systems, practices and policies

About you

• Relevant experience of working in a B2B, corporate, consumer or digital communications agency environment at a Campaign Executive or Senior Campaign Executive level
• Attention to detail
• Proven written ability in English and local languages
• Creative thinking
• Understanding of client business issues and requirements
• Highly developed presentation skills
• Thorough knowledge of media: print and broadcast
• Understanding of market research and analysis
• Ability to motivate and lead a team
• Ability to delegate effectively
• Calmness under pressure and ability to achieve tight deadlines
• Ability to interact with confidence at board-level with clients
• Proven ability to keep abreast of current affairs and relate them to client situations

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of the responsibilities for this role. Other responsibilities may be added from time to time.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About The Role

Our Growth & Sales teams hear something new from merchants every day: a coverage gap that cost us a deal, a feature our partners keep asking for, a trend in the data nobody has acted on yet. The way we win is by connecting those signals and turning them into something that will grow revenue for Extend and our merchant partners.

We are looking for a GTM Strategy & Program Manager to own that feedback loop for a portfolio of retail verticals. You will listen to what our merchant partners want and need, decide what is worth building, drive the right teams to build it in a scalable way, and make sure your Pod knows exactly how to sell it. Your success shows up in new deals won, existing partnerships grown, and stronger margins on both.

This is a role for someone who presents ideas without hesitation, can hold a room with leaders, and never settles for not knowing the answer.

What You’ll Do

• Own the feedback loop. Run a regular cadence with Sales, Growth and Analytics to pull together merchant feedback, win/loss reasons and performance data, and turn it into a clear, prioritized view of what we need to build to win more.

• Grow the top and bottom line. Find the opportunities that win new merchants and expand existing partnerships, and build the business case for each one in terms of revenue and margin impact.

• Turn merchant needs into scalable solutions. Listen to what our partners are asking for and shape it into products, features and program offerings that work across your verticals, not one-off custom builds.

• Run the project plan. Set scope, milestones and owners for every initiative, hold teams accountable to deadlines, and raise risks early when something starts to slip.

• Know exactly what is being built. Understand every feature well enough to explain how it works, who it is for and where its limits are, from requirements through launch.

• Enable your Pod. Equip your vertical Pod with the playbooks, talk tracks and training they need to sell and use each new feature, and track adoption after launch.

• Present with conviction. Pitch new ideas to cross-functional partners, executives and leadership, back your recommendations with data, and drive the decision.

• Go find the answer. When a question comes up that nobody can answer, dig into the data, the contracts or the market yourself and come back with the answer and a recommendation.

Required Qualifications

• Relevant experience. 5+ years in GTM Strategy, BizOps, or a similar cross-functional role at a fast-paced tech company.

• Ownership from idea to launch. You have taken an initiative from a customer or partner need through build, launch and enablement, and can point to the commercial results.

• Project management discipline. You run several initiatives in parallel, set realistic plans and keep cross-functional teams on deadline without being chased.

• Executive presence. You put ideas in front of people early and often, present to executives with conviction, and hold your ground when you have the data to back it up.

• A numbers-first mindset. Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills. You size opportunities, build models and root your recommendations in data.

• Relentless curiosity. You do not accept "we don't know" as an answer. You go dig it up and report back.

• An AI-native way of working. You already use AI tools like Claude to research, analyze and move faster, and you pick up new tools quickly.

Nice To Have

• SQL or BI tool experience

• Experience in retail, finance, or consulting

• Exposure to underwriting concepts like frequency, severity and loss ratio

Expected Pay Range: $125,000 - $135,000 per year salaried

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

• Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.

• Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.

• Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.

• Generous, flexible paid time off policy.

• 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

Extend CCPA HR Notice
